title: Dunlop launches Blue Response TG in 99 European sizes
what_happened: Dunlop Tyre Europe launched the SRI-developed Blue Response TG for combustion and electric vehicles, with 99 sizes from 15 to 21 inches and European availability beginning in March. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The range breadth makes the post-acquisition Dunlop relaunch commercially material, but supplier performance claims still require independent size-specific testing. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: Dunlop 推出覆盖 99 个欧洲规格的 Blue Response TG
what_happened_zh: Dunlop Tyre Europe 推出由住友橡胶开发、面向燃油车和电动车的 Blue Response TG，提供从 15 英寸到 21 英寸的 99 个规格，欧洲市场自 3 月起开始供货。产品开发正朝着面向特定应用的性能和更快验证推进。规格广度使收购后的 Dunlop 品牌重启具有实质商业意义，但供应商的性能主张仍需要按规格进行独立测试。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: Mitas details Terraguard VF implement-tire range
what_happened: An in-window industry report detailed the Terraguard VF implement radial introduced at Commodity Classic, designed for higher loads at lower pressure with a sawtooth tread and square-shoulder construction. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The product targets soil compaction and implement stability, but the March report recaps a 26 February launch and public comparative field data were not provided. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: Mitas 详细介绍 Terraguard VF 农机具轮胎系列
what_happened_zh: 一篇报告期内的行业报道详细介绍了在 Commodity Classic 展会上推出的 Terraguard VF 农机具子午线轮胎，该产品面向更低气压下的更高载荷，采用锯齿形胎面和方形胎肩结构。产品开发正朝着面向特定应用的性能和更快验证推进。该产品针对土壤压实和农机具稳定性，但 3 月的这篇报道回顾的是 2 月 26 日的发布，且未提供公开的田间对比数据。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: Vredestein debuts Quatrac Pro 2 with 120-size rollout plan
what_happened: Apollo's Vredestein brand debuted Quatrac Pro 2, scheduling 38 sizes from June and a later portfolio of 120 dimensions from 17 inches upward, including mixed, high-load and up-to-24-inch fitments. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The breadth and timing create a material all-season portfolio commitment, while production completion, availability by market and independent results remain to follow. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: Vredestein 发布 Quatrac Pro 2 并公布 120 个规格的推广计划
what_happened_zh: Apollo 旗下 Vredestein 品牌发布 Quatrac Pro 2，计划自 6 月起推出 38 个规格，后续产品线将覆盖 17 英寸及以上的 120 个尺寸，并包含混合规格、高承载规格以及最大至 24 英寸的配套。产品开发正朝着面向特定应用的性能和更快验证推进。覆盖面和时间安排构成了具有实质意义的全天候产品线承诺，而生产落地、各市场的供货情况和独立测试结果仍有待跟进。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: Falken keeps Sensing Core-equipped Porsche in Nürburgring program
what_happened: SRI retained a single Falken Porsche 911 GT3 R for the 2026 NLS and Nürburgring 24-hour race; the car uses Sensing Core, applying machine learning to wheel-speed data for sensorless estimates of tire pressure, load and wear. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The system is attached to an operating high-demand test environment, but public material did not disclose estimation accuracy, incident reduction or pit-strategy performance versus a baseline. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: Falken 让搭载 Sensing Core 的 Porsche 继续参加 Nürburgring 项目
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶为 2026 年 NLS 和 Nürburgring 24 小时耐力赛保留了一辆 Falken Porsche 911 GT3 R；该车使用 Sensing Core，通过机器学习分析轮速数据，在不加装传感器的条件下估算轮胎气压、载荷和磨耗。产品开发正朝着面向特定应用的性能和更快验证推进。该系统已置于一个实际运行的高强度测试环境中，但公开材料未披露估算精度、事故减少情况或相对基线的进站策略表现。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: Shanghai sprint qualifying exposes Pirelli compound behavior
what_happened: At the 2026 Chinese Grand Prix sprint qualifying, Pirelli reported roughly a 0.6-second soft-to-medium delta, the C3 medium delivering peak performance on a second push lap, and light front graining on the cool, low-grip Shanghai surface. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The observations provide real-use tire behavior under a constrained practice format, but they are circuit- and temperature-specific and not road-product validation. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: 上海冲刺排位赛暴露倍耐力配方表现特征
what_happened_zh: 在 2026 年中国大奖赛冲刺排位赛中，倍耐力报告软胎与中性胎之间约 0.6 秒的差距、C3 中性胎在第二个推进圈达到性能峰值，以及在低温、低抓地力的上海赛道表面出现轻微的前胎起粒。产品开发正朝着面向特定应用的性能和更快验证推进。这些观察提供了受限练习赛制下的真实使用轮胎行为，但它们具有赛道和温度特定性，并非公路产品验证。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: ARLANXEO Orange HNBR and BR units gain ISCC PLUS certification
what_happened: ARLANXEO's Therban HNBR and Buna BR units in Orange, Texas received ISCC PLUS certification, enabling supply under its mass-balance Eco label. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The certification expands traceable lower-fossil feedstock options for specialty elastomers, but it does not disclose certified sales volume or customer uptake. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: ARLANXEO 位于 Orange 的 HNBR 与 BR 装置获得 ISCC PLUS 认证
what_happened_zh: ARLANXEO 位于德克萨斯州 Orange 的 Therban HNBR 和 Buna BR 装置获得 ISCC PLUS 认证，可按其质量平衡 Eco 标识供货。材料保障、认证和循环性正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。该认证扩大了特种弹性体可追溯的低化石基原料选择，但并未披露经认证的销售量或客户采用情况。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: LANXESS raises tire and rubber additive prices 15%-50%
what_happened: LANXESS announced immediate increases of 15%-50% for functional additives used in tires and specialty rubbers, citing higher energy, critical-raw-material and logistics costs. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The range is a direct upstream cost signal, while product-level changes, contract exposure and realized tire-maker procurement effects were not disclosed. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: LANXESS 将轮胎与橡胶助剂价格上调 15%-50%
what_happened_zh: LANXESS 宣布，用于轮胎和特种橡胶的功能性助剂价格立即上调 15%-50%，理由是能源、关键原材料和物流成本上升。材料保障、认证和循环性正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。这一涨幅区间是直接的上游成本信号，而产品层面的调整、合同敞口以及轮胎企业实际承受的采购影响均未披露。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Chinese report recaps Bridgestone truck-tire wear-particle collection method
what_happened: An in-window Chinese report described Bridgestone's announced method for collecting tire and road-wear particles generated by truck and bus tires for environmental analysis. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The method is relevant to wear-particle measurement, but the underlying company announcement predates the week and field datasets or standardization evidence were not provided. retained as an in-window recap of a 6 March announcement, not presented as a new 11 March event. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 中文报道回顾普利司通卡客车轮胎磨耗颗粒收集方法
what_happened_zh: 一篇报告期内的中文报道介绍了普利司通已公布的方法，用于收集卡车和客车轮胎产生的轮胎与路面磨耗颗粒，以供环境分析。材料保障、认证和循环性正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。该方法与磨耗颗粒测量相关，但其背后的公司公告早于本报告期，且未提供实地数据集或标准化证据。本条作为 3 月 6 日公告的报告期内回顾保留，而非作为 3 月 11 日的新事件呈现。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Court schedules auction of Jiangsu Senguang rubber assets
what_happened: A court auction notice covered 5,715.8 square metres of titled buildings, 2,499.44 square metres of untitled buildings, 12,420.4 square metres of industrial land and equipment, with a RMB9.6365 million starting price and RMB13.7664 million appraisal. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The scheduled asset sale is a concrete exit and capacity-reallocation signal for a long-running engineering-tire producer, although auction completion and asset reuse were still pending. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: 法院安排 Jiangsu Senguang 橡胶资产拍卖
what_happened_zh: 一份法院拍卖公告涉及 5,715.8 平方米有证建筑、2,499.44 平方米无证建筑、12,420.4 平方米工业用地及设备，起拍价为 RMB9.6365 million，评估价为 RMB13.7664 million。制造企业正在把产能举措与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律的更严格关注结合起来。这项已排期的资产处置，对一家长期经营的工程轮胎生产企业而言是明确的退出和产能再配置信号，不过拍卖成交和资产再利用仍悬而未决。后续应关注许可审批、工程进展、投产、产能利用率以及经审计的财务兑现。

title: Hubei Yijia opens environmental review for 100,000-tire OTR project
what_happened: An in-window report said the company opened the first environmental-impact consultation for a RMB140 million project in Songzi's Lingang industrial park designed for 100,000 engineering tires annually. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The filing moves the proposed capacity into a public pre-construction process, but approval, financing, groundbreaking and commissioning remain unconfirmed. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: Hubei Yijia 为 100,000 条 OTR 轮胎项目启动环评程序
what_happened_zh: 一篇报告期内的报道称，该公司就位于松滋临港工业园、设计年产 100,000 条工程机械轮胎的 RMB140 million 项目启动了第一次环境影响评价公示。制造企业正在把产能举措与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律的更严格关注结合起来。该申报把拟建产能推入公开的开工前流程，但审批、融资、动工和投产均尚未确认。后续应关注许可审批、工程进展、投产、产能利用率以及经审计的财务兑现。

title: Sichuan Haida operates smart logistics and plans a second digital upgrade
what_happened: Sichuan Haida said its new smart-logistics system entered full operation in January, digitizing production management and automating logistics; it also planned another equipment and digital-transformation project with an internal estimate of more than RMB20 million in added annual profit after completion. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The operating system is concrete factory-digitalization evidence, while the profit figure is a forward company estimate and the next upgrade has not yet been completed. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: Sichuan Haida 智能物流投入运行，并规划第二轮数字化升级
what_happened_zh: Sichuan Haida 表示，其新建的智能物流系统已于 1 月全面投入运行，实现了生产管理数字化和物流自动化；公司还规划了另一项设备与数字化转型项目，内部估算完成后每年可增加利润超过 RMB20 million。制造企业正在把产能举措与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律的更严格关注结合起来。已投运的系统是工厂数字化的具体证据，而利润数字属于公司的前瞻性估算，下一轮升级尚未完成。后续应关注许可审批、工程进展、投产、产能利用率以及经审计的财务兑现。

title: Triangle enters Shandong's excellence-level smart-factory cultivation pool
what_happened: Triangle said it was included in the excellence tier of Shandong's 2026 smart-factory cultivation pool, one of 15 organizations in that tier among more than 30 tire and supply-chain companies selected across three levels. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The selection indicates formal scrutiny of digital design, intelligent production, lean management and green operations, but it is a cultivation-stage recognition rather than measured productivity proof. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: 三角轮胎入选山东智能工厂培育库卓越级
what_happened_zh: 三角轮胎表示，公司入选山东省 2026 年智能工厂培育库卓越级，是该层级 15 家单位之一；在三个层级中共有 30 多家轮胎及供应链企业入选。制造企业正在把产能举措与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律的更严格关注结合起来。此次入选表明其数字化设计、智能生产、精益管理和绿色运营受到了正式审核，但这属于培育阶段的认定，而非经实测的生产率证明。后续应关注许可审批、工程进展、投产、产能利用率以及经审计的财务兑现。

title: Klipboard embeds AI in ERP and operations platform
what_happened: Klipboard announced assistive AI functions in software serving rental, automotive, distribution, manufacturing and field-service users. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The launch is relevant to tire-channel operations, but the public report did not identify a tire customer, deployment count, model method or measured operating result. retained as Engineering AI adjacency because tire-specific industrial or customer evidence was not disclosed. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: Klipboard 在 ERP 与运营平台中嵌入 AI
what_happened_zh: Klipboard 宣布在其软件中加入辅助性 AI 功能，服务对象包括租赁、汽车、分销、制造和现场服务用户。制造企业正在把产能举措与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律的更严格关注结合起来。此次发布与轮胎渠道运营相关，但公开报道并未指明轮胎行业客户、部署数量、模型方法或经实测的运营结果。本条作为 Engineering AI 邻接内容保留，因为未披露轮胎行业特定的工业或客户证据。后续应关注许可审批、工程进展、投产、产能利用率以及经审计的财务兑现。

title: Chinese tire makers announce broad 2%-5% price increases
what_happened: The China Rubber Industry Association recorded 9 March notices from Doublestar, Cheng Shin, Maxxis, Yanchang Rubber, Aeolus, Wanda Boto and Bayi Rubber, following earlier notices from ZC Rubber, Linglong, Guizhou Tyre and Goodyear; changes covered TBR, PCR, OTR and inner-tube products. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The breadth and product coverage make this a material cost-pass-through signal, but notices do not establish realized dealer prices, demand response or restored margins. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.
title_zh: 中国轮胎制造商宣布 2%-5% 的普遍涨价
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会记录了双星、Cheng Shin、Maxxis、Yanchang Rubber、Aeolus、Wanda Boto 和 Bayi Rubber 在 3 月 9 日发布的涨价通知，此前中策橡胶、玲珑轮胎、贵州轮胎和固特异已发布通知；调价覆盖全钢子午线（TBR）、半钢子午线（PCR）、工程机械（OTR）轮胎和内胎产品。在需求不均和贸易压力下，轮胎制造商正在调整价格、定位和市场渠道。涨价的覆盖面和产品范围使其成为具有实质意义的成本传导信号，但这些通知并不能确立实际成交的经销商价格、需求反应或已修复的利润率。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、终端销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Triangle completes regional spring market meetings with dealers
what_happened: Triangle reported spring market meetings in Harbin, Changchun, Shenyang, Taiyuan and other cities, presenting 2026 product, margin, enablement and channel-foundation priorities to core dealers. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The multi-city program is a concrete channel-execution signal under cost and demand pressure, though orders, sell-through and dealer economics were not disclosed. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.
title_zh: 三角轮胎完成与经销商的区域春季市场会议
what_happened_zh: 三角轮胎称，公司在哈尔滨、长春、沈阳、太原等城市举办了春季市场会议，向核心经销商介绍 2026 年的产品、盈利、赋能和渠道基础建设重点。在需求不均和贸易压力下，轮胎制造商正在调整价格、定位和市场渠道。这一多城市项目是成本和需求压力下具体的渠道执行信号，不过订单、终端销售和经销商经营效益均未披露。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、终端销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Nexen supplies three OE tire lines for Kia Seltos in Korea
what_happened: Nexen announced OE supply for Kia's all-new Seltos in Korea across 16-, 18- and 19-inch configurations, using Roadian GTX, N'Priz S and N'Fera Supreme products selected for SUV and hybrid requirements. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. Multiple named sizes and a production vehicle provide concrete customer adoption, but volumes and contract duration were not disclosed. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: Nexen 为韩国市场起亚 Seltos 供应三条原配轮胎产品线
what_happened_zh: Nexen 宣布为起亚在韩国推出的全新 Seltos 提供原配轮胎，覆盖 16 英寸、18 英寸和 19 英寸配置，所用产品为按 SUV 和混合动力需求选定的 Roadian GTX、N'Priz S 和 N'Fera Supreme。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场采纳最清晰的公开证据。多个具名规格和一款量产车型提供了具体的客户采纳证据，但供货量和合同期限未披露。后续应关注推广数量、更多车型项目、续约证据和实际使用表现。

title: Kumho recalls 11,169 Solus TA11 tires in United States
what_happened: Kumho's NHTSA filing covered 11,169 Solus TA11 tires in size 225/60R16 made in Gwangju from week 4 of 2021 through week 5 of 2023; it estimated 10% had a potential FMVSS 139 noncompliance. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. The authority filing creates a bounded safety and customer-service obligation, with completion rate and field outcomes still to be monitored. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.

sources.publisher: US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration
sources.link_label: US National Highway Traffic Safety Administration

title_zh: 锦湖在美国召回 11,169 条 Solus TA11 轮胎
what_happened_zh: 锦湖向 NHTSA 提交的报告涉及 11,169 条在光州生产的 225/60R16 规格 Solus TA11 轮胎，生产时间为 2021 年第 4 周至 2023 年第 5 周；公司估计其中 10% 可能存在 FMVSS 139 不符合项。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场采纳最清晰的公开证据。向主管部门提交的报告形成了范围明确的安全和客户服务义务，完成率与实际使用结果仍有待跟踪。后续应关注推广数量、更多车型项目、续约证据和实际使用表现。

title: Yokohama renews Kondo Racing Nürburgring partnership
what_happened: Yokohama renewed tire supply to Kondo Racing for the 2026 Nürburgring 24-hour race and NLS SP9 program using a Ferrari 296 GT3 Evo; it also planned supply to several other top teams. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. The repeat named program provides demanding customer-use evidence for ADVAN racing tires, although it does not by itself quantify transfer to road products. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶续签 Kondo Racing 的 Nürburgring 合作
what_happened_zh: 横滨橡胶续签了面向 Kondo Racing 的轮胎供应，用于 2026 年 Nürburgring 24 小时耐力赛和 NLS SP9 组别项目，赛车为 Ferrari 296 GT3 Evo；公司还计划为其他几支顶级车队供胎。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场采纳最清晰的公开证据。这一重复的具名项目为 ADVAN 赛车轮胎提供了严苛工况下的客户使用证据，但它本身并不能量化向公路产品的转化。后续应关注推广数量、更多车型项目、续约证据和实际使用表现。

title: Continental EcoContact 7 selected for smart #5
what_happened: Continental said its EcoContact 7 in 255/45 R20 and 255/40 R21 was approved as original equipment on the smart #5, a model developed by the Mercedes-Benz and Geely joint venture. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. The two approved high-load sizes provide adoption evidence on a China-linked global EV platform; supply volume and in-service efficiency were not disclosed. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: 大陆集团 EcoContact 7 获选 smart #5 原配

title: KH-151 treatment improves crumb-rubber asphalt compatibility in laboratory study
what_happened: A peer-reviewed study using 25% crumb rubber by asphalt weight reported an optimum 1.6% KH-151 treatment; the abstract reported segregation softening-point difference falling from 12.7C to 1.8C, viscosity from 5.1 to 2.6 Pa.s, and -24C BBR stiffness from 298 to 221 MPa. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The results quantify an interface-treatment route for higher recycled-rubber loading, but they remain binder-scale laboratory evidence rather than asphalt-mixture or field-service validation. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.

title_zh: Halfords 公布胎面花纹深度与制动距离研究

title: Reduced-order tire model reaches up to 20-fold simulation speedup
what_happened: A peer-reviewed paper presented a two-step projection and hyper-reduction strategy for nonlinear rolling contact and reported a maximum 20-fold speedup for a time-domain nonlinear finite-element tire model while reproducing full-order dynamic behavior. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. title_zh: 降阶轮胎模型仿真加速比最高达到 20

title: Full-scale tests validate a hydroplaning simulation under realistic pavement conditions
companies: University of Science and Technology Beijing
what_happened: Researchers combined a coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian tire-water-pavement model with a 200 m full-scale accelerated-loading track using a 12.00R20 tire, varying speed, load, water depth and lateral position. The field responses supported the model and showed that speed and water depth reduce pavement support while greater load lowers the water-lift share. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The work supplies field-backed evidence for wet-road design and safety assessment, although it studies one truck-tire geometry and controlled pavement conditions rather than a broad commercial tire population. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: 全尺寸试验在真实路面条件下验证滑水仿真
what_happened_zh: 研究人员把耦合欧拉-拉格朗日轮胎-水-路面模型与一条 200 m 全尺寸加速加载试验道结合起来，使用一条 12.00R20 轮胎，并改变速度、载荷、水膜深度和横向位置。现场响应支持了该模型，并表明速度和水膜深度会降低路面支撑，而载荷增大则会降低水升力占比。产品开发正朝着面向具体应用的性能表现和更快的验证推进。这项工作为湿路设计与安全评估提供了有现场数据支撑的证据，不过它研究的是一种卡车轮胎几何形状和受控的路面条件，而不是广泛的商用轮胎群体。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: AVL 与 Ansible 的模拟器合作在报告期内获得回顾报道
what_happened_zh: 一篇 3 月 31 日的行业回顾重新提及 AVL 在 3 月 17 日与 Ansible Motion 建立的合作，内容是把整车仿真模型与驾驶员在环模拟器结合起来；两家供应商称该方案每天可以评估超过 70 个赛道场景。产品开发正朝着面向具体应用的性能表现和更快的验证推进。该工作流与虚拟整车和轮胎开发相关，但报告期内的这条信息属于回顾，并未披露具名客户结果、精度基线或生产部署。报告期内的文章回顾的是 3 月 17 日的供应商公告，没有披露经过测量的客户或工业成果。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: Bridgestone motorhome-tire announcement receives in-window follow-up
what_happened: An April 3 regional release repeated Bridgestone's March 26 Duravis Camper All Season announcement: four 15- and 16-inch sizes were planned from June with CP designation, 3PMSF and M+S markings and EU A wet-grip and noise labels. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The in-window page confirms regional commercialization detail but does not add measured independent performance beyond the earlier launch. The April 3 page is a regional follow-up to the March 26 launch and adds no independent test or new commercial stage. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: 普利司通房车轮胎公告在报告期内获得后续发布
what_happened_zh: 一则 4 月 3 日的区域新闻稿重复了普利司通 3 月 26 日的 Duravis Camper All Season 公告：四个 15 和 16 英寸规格计划从 6 月起供货，带有 CP 标记、3PMSF 和 M+S 标识，以及欧盟 A 级湿地抓地力和噪声标签。产品开发正朝着面向具体应用的性能表现和更快的验证推进。报告期内的页面确认了区域商业化细节，但没有在此前发布之外增加经过测量的独立性能数据。4 月 3 日的页面是对 3 月 26 日发布的区域性后续，没有增加独立测试或新的商业阶段。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: Soil experiments show 6PPD-quinone remains concentrated near the surface
what_happened: Peer-reviewed tests in three contrasting soils found more than 90% of radiolabeled 6PPD-quinone retained in the top 6 cm after artificial rainfall and less than 10% desorbed after 48 hours; sandy soil photodegraded it fastest while organic- and clay-rich soils retained it longer. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The findings narrow environmental-fate assumptions for a tire additive transformation product and point to surface-soil exposure and runoff as priorities, but controlled indoor tests do not reproduce full field variability. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 土壤实验显示 6PPD-醌 主要集中在表层
what_happened_zh: 在三种性质迥异的土壤中开展的同行评议试验发现，人工降雨后超过 90% 的放射性标记 6PPD-醌 仍保留在表层 6 cm 以内，48 小时后解吸不足 10%；砂质土壤中的光降解最快，而富含有机质和黏土的土壤保留时间更长。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在成为商业约束，而不只是技术约束。这些发现收窄了对一种轮胎添加剂转化产物的环境归趋假设，并指出表层土壤暴露和径流是优先事项，但受控的室内试验无法再现完整的田间变异。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经测量的材料性能。

title: China tire margins tighten as rubber costs outrun tire-price increases
what_happened: A dated China market snapshot put sample semi-steel utilization at 79.37% and all-steel utilization at 72.24%, while benchmark theoretical margins were negative and upstream rubber increases exceeded the 2%-5% range of finished-tire price adjustments. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The mismatch signals near-term margin and production pressure even before announced price changes fully reach dealers, but the figures are sample-market indicators rather than audited company results. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 橡胶成本涨幅超过轮胎提价，中国轮胎利润空间收窄
what_happened_zh: 一份有明确日期的中国市场快报显示，样本半钢产能利用率为 79.37%、全钢产能利用率为 72.24%，基准理论利润为负，而上游橡胶涨幅超过了成品轮胎 2%-5% 的价格调整区间。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在成为商业约束，而不只是技术约束。这一错配表明，即使在已公布的调价完全传导到经销商之前，近期的利润和生产就已经面临压力，但这些数字是样本市场指标，而不是经审计的公司业绩。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经测量的材料性能。

title: Hybrid deep-learning model forecasts natural-rubber prices up to five days
what_happened: A preprint combined variational mode decomposition, BiLSTM and Transformer encoders for daily RSS3 FOB price-change forecasting. On a 237-observation holdout it reported Pearson correlation 0.812, directional accuracy 67.1% and StdR 0.819, but skill collapsed by the 10-day horizon. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The bounded horizon and explicit variance metric make the result relevant to short-term procurement analysis, while the preprint has no peer review or industrial decision trial. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 混合深度学习模型可预测天然橡胶价格至多五天
what_happened_zh: 一篇预印本把变分模态分解、BiLSTM 和 Transformer 编码器结合起来，用于每日 RSS3 FOB 价格变动预测。在 237 个观测的留出样本上，论文报告 Pearson 相关系数 0.812、方向准确率 67.1% 和 StdR 0.819，但预测能力在 10 天期限上已经崩塌。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在成为商业约束，而不只是技术约束。有界的预测期限和明确的方差指标使该结果对短期采购分析具有参考价值，而这篇预印本没有经过同行评议，也没有工业决策试验。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经测量的材料性能。

title: Explosion shuts part of Nizhnekamskneftekhim synthetic-rubber complex
what_happened: Following a March 31 explosion, Interfax reported a shutdown affecting about 180,000 tonnes per year, or roughly 6% of the plant's capacity. SIBUR's April 3 update confirmed seven fatalities and five people still missing. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The event is a material supply and safety disruption at a large synthetic-rubber site; the operational duration, customer allocation impact and restart path were not yet public. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 爆炸导致 Nizhnekamskneftekhim 合成橡胶综合体部分停产
what_happened_zh: 在 3 月 31 日发生爆炸之后，Interfax 报道称，停产影响约 180,000 tonnes 的年产能，约占该厂产能的 6%。SIBUR 在 4 月 3 日的通报中确认有七人死亡、五人仍然失联。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在成为商业约束，而不只是技术约束。该事件是一家大型合成橡胶基地的材料供应与安全中断；停产持续时间、对客户供货分配的影响以及复产路径尚未公开。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经测量的材料性能。

title: Sinopec Guangzhou Engineering signs EPC contract for Kazakhstan butadiene complex
what_happened: Samruk-Kazyna said Sinopec Guangzhou Engineering signed the EPC contract for a Kazakhstan butadiene and synthetic-rubber complex designed for more than 300,000 tonnes per year of products in the National Industrial Petrochemical Technopark special economic zone. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The contract advances a cross-border feedstock and synthetic-rubber project from planning toward execution, but commissioning, on-spec output and tire-customer qualification remain future stages. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: Sinopec Guangzhou Engineering 签下哈萨克斯坦丁二烯综合体 EPC 合同
what_happened_zh: Samruk-Kazyna 表示，Sinopec Guangzhou Engineering 已签署哈萨克斯坦一座丁二烯与合成橡胶综合体的 EPC 合同，该综合体规划年产品产能超过 300,000 tonnes，位于 National Industrial Petrochemical Technopark 特别经济区内。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在成为商业约束，而不只是技术约束。该合同把一个跨境原料与合成橡胶项目从规划推进到执行阶段，但投产、合格产品产出和轮胎客户认证仍属于未来阶段。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经测量的材料性能。

title: Crumb-rubber binder meets high-modulus asphalt target in cold-region study
companies: University of Alberta and CRM Co.
what_happened: A peer-reviewed ASTM paper found that 12% crumb-rubber modifier processed for 60 minutes met the 14,000 MPa stiffness requirement at 10 degrees C and 10 Hz, while Hamburg wheel tracking and disk-shaped compact-tension tests indicated rutting, moisture and low-temperature fracture performance comparable or superior to the control. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The study supports a higher-value end market for tire rubber in demanding pavement, but field construction, aging and lifecycle economics were outside the disclosed laboratory program. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.

sources.publisher: ASTM Journal of Testing and Evaluation
sources.link_label: ASTM Journal of Testing and Evaluation

title_zh: 寒区研究中胶粉改性胶结料达到高模量沥青指标
what_happened_zh: 一篇同行评议的 ASTM 论文发现，掺量 12% 的胶粉改性剂在加工 60 分钟后，于 10 摄氏度、10 Hz 条件下满足 14,000 MPa 的劲度要求，同时汉堡车辙试验和圆盘紧凑拉伸试验表明其车辙、水稳定性和低温断裂性能与对照组相当或更优。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在成为商业约束，而不只是技术约束。该研究支持把轮胎橡胶用于要求严苛的路面这一更高附加值的终端市场，但现场施工、老化和全生命周期经济性不在所披露的实验室研究范围之内。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经测量的材料性能。

title: Michigan reports $2.2 million in new scrap-tire market-development grants
companies: Michigan Department of Environment, Great Lakes, and Energy
what_happened: Michigan's FY2025 report recorded 64 cleanup grants totaling $1.093 million and about 500,000 tires removed, plus six market-development grants totaling $2.206 million for collection infrastructure and rubber-modified roads and concrete. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The report provides audited-scale public demand support for end-of-life tire uses rather than a pilot announcement, though grant totals do not by themselves establish long-term market economics. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 密歇根州报告新增 $2.2 million 废旧轮胎市场开发补助
what_happened_zh: 密歇根州的 FY2025 报告记录了 64 项清理补助，合计 $1.093 million，清除约 500,000 条轮胎，另有六项市场开发补助，合计 $2.206 million，用于收集基础设施以及橡胶改性道路和混凝土。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在成为商业约束，而不只是技术约束。该报告为报废轮胎的利用提供了审计规模的公共需求支持，而不是一则试点公告，不过补助总额本身并不能确立长期的市场经济性。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经测量的材料性能。

title: Wire-calender control case reports lower variability across three tire plants
what_happened: A Rubber News technical article described beta, X-ray and laser measurement integrated with model-predictive, feedforward and zone controls across three tire plants and more than 1.2 million tires over 12 months. It reported gum-thickness variability falling from 0.10 to 0.018 mm and total-weight 3-sigma variability from 53.6 to 28.5 GSM. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The cross-plant deployment is unusually concrete process-control evidence, but the article is authored by the solution supplier and does not disclose plant identities or an independent audit. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: 钢丝压延控制案例报告三家轮胎工厂波动下降
what_happened_zh: 一篇 Rubber News 技术文章介绍了把 β 射线、X 射线和激光测量与模型预测控制、前馈控制及分区控制相结合的做法，覆盖三家轮胎工厂、12 个月内超过 1.2 million 条轮胎。文章报告胶片厚度波动从 0.10 降至 0.018 mm，总重 3-sigma 波动从 53.6 降至 28.5 GSM。制造商正在把产能举措与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律更严格的关注结合起来。这一跨工厂部署是异常具体的过程控制证据，但该文章由解决方案供应商撰写，没有披露工厂身份或独立审计。后续应关注审批、工程进展、投产、产能利用率和经审计的财务落实。

title: Hwa Fong completes purchase of former Sumitomo Tonawanda site
what_happened: Hwa Fong completed the purchase of Sumitomo Rubber USA's former Tonawanda, New York property and renamed it HF Industrial Park, with plans for automotive rubber and parts operations later in 2026 and an initial 100-250 jobs. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The completed real-estate transaction creates an operating option for a closed tire site, but production scope, capital expenditure and commissioning remain to be demonstrated. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: Hwa Fong 完成对住友橡胶原 Tonawanda 厂区的收购
what_happened_zh: Hwa Fong 完成了对住友橡胶美国公司位于纽约州 Tonawanda 的原有物业的收购，并将其更名为 HF Industrial Park，计划在 2026 年晚些时候开展汽车橡胶及零部件业务，初期提供 100-250 个岗位。制造商正在把产能举措与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律更严格的关注结合起来。这笔已完成的不动产交易为一处关停的轮胎厂区创造了运营选项，但生产范围、资本支出和投产仍有待验证。后续应关注审批、工程进展、投产、产能利用率和经审计的财务落实。

title: CRIA's five-year blueprint shifts emphasis toward quality and advanced capacity
what_happened: An April 2 industry recap surfaced CRIA's March 25 outline for China's Fifteenth Five-Year tire-industry plan, emphasizing higher-quality development, technology upgrading and a more disciplined capacity structure. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The plan is directional association guidance rather than a binding project approval, but it frames the policy and investment tests Chinese producers may face through 2030. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会五年蓝图转向质量与高端产能
what_happened_zh: 一则 4 月 2 日的行业回顾披露了中国橡胶工业协会 3 月 25 日提出的中国轮胎行业十五五规划纲要，强调更高质量的发展、技术升级以及更有纪律的产能结构。制造商正在把产能举措与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律更严格的关注结合起来。该规划属于协会的方向性指导，而不是具有约束力的项目批复，但它勾勒出中国轮胎企业到 2030 年可能面临的政策与投资考验。后续应关注审批、工程进展、投产、产能利用率和经审计的财务落实。

title: Prinx Chengshan grows 2025 revenue and tire volume as profit falls
what_happened: Prinx Chengshan reported 2025 revenue of RMB11.807 billion, up 7.59%, and tire sales of 29.29 million units, up 4.7%, while net profit fell 17.1% to RMB1.088 billion and operating cash flow fell 3.92% to RMB1.201 billion. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The results show higher throughput and sales did not translate into profit growth, sharpening the need to watch utilization and returns on Malaysia and off-road-tire capital commitments. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: 浦林成山 2025 年收入与轮胎销量增长，利润下滑
what_happened_zh: 浦林成山报告 2025 年营业收入 RMB11.807 billion，增长 7.59%，轮胎销量 29.29 million 条，增长 4.7%，而净利润下降 17.1% 至 RMB1.088 billion，经营活动现金流下降 3.92% 至 RMB1.201 billion。制造商正在把产能举措与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律更严格的关注结合起来。业绩显示产量和销量的提升并未转化为利润增长，因此更需要关注马来西亚和非公路轮胎资本投入的产能利用率与回报。后续应关注审批、工程进展、投产、产能利用率和经审计的财务落实。

title: Chinese tire makers implement a broad April price increase wave
what_happened: An in-window industry compilation recorded April 1 replacement-market increases across passenger, truck, off-road and inner-tube lines, including ZC Rubber, Triangle, Sailun, Linglong and Guizhou Tyre, mostly in the 2%-5% range. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The synchronized execution date indicates sector-wide cost pass-through rather than an isolated brand move, although the evidence is a compilation of company notices and does not establish dealer sell-through. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.

sources.publisher: 轮胎商业 via Sina Finance
sources.link_label: 轮胎商业 via Sina Finance

title_zh: 中国轮胎企业实施大范围的 4 月提价
what_happened_zh: 报告期内的一份行业汇总记录了 4 月 1 日生效的替换市场提价，涵盖乘用车、卡车、非公路和内胎产品线，涉及中策橡胶、三角轮胎、赛轮、玲珑轮胎和贵州轮胎，幅度多在 2%-5% 区间。轮胎企业正在需求不均和贸易压力下调整价格、定位和市场通路。统一的执行日期表明这是全行业的成本传导，而不是个别品牌的孤立行动，不过证据是对公司通知的汇总，并不能确立经销商的实际销售情况。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、实际销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Oak Group acquires ETB and enters direct retail
what_happened: Oak Group acquired ETB from Bridgestone, adding a fast-fit retail operation and four warehouses across Wales, the Midlands and southwest England to its wholesale activities. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The transaction changes Oak's route-to-market by adding direct consumer access and creates a vertically linked outlet for its house and distributed brands. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.
title_zh: Oak Group 收购 ETB 并进入直营零售
what_happened_zh: Oak Group 从普利司通收购了 ETB，在其批发业务之外增加了一项快修零售业务以及分布于威尔士、英格兰中部和英格兰西南部的四个仓库。轮胎企业正在需求不均和贸易压力下调整价格、定位和市场通路。这笔交易通过增加直接面向消费者的通路改变了 Oak 的市场路径，并为其自有品牌和代理品牌建立了纵向衔接的出口。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、实际销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: US tire imports rise while China-origin volume falls
what_happened: An in-window trade summary reported US tire imports of about 286 million units in 2025, up 4.8%, with Thailand at 73.5 million and China-origin imports down 15% to roughly 21 million amid tariff barriers. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The mix shift suggests trade measures continue to redirect manufacturing and sourcing toward Southeast Asia even as overall US import demand expands. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.
title_zh: 美国轮胎进口增长，中国原产进口量下降
what_happened_zh: 报告期内的一份贸易综述称，2025 年美国轮胎进口约 286 million 条，增长 4.8%，其中泰国为 73.5 million 条，而中国原产进口在关税壁垒下下降 15% 至约 21 million 条。轮胎企业正在需求不均和贸易压力下调整价格、定位和市场通路。这一结构变化表明，即使美国整体进口需求在扩大，贸易措施仍在继续把制造和采购转向东南亚。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、实际销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Bridgestone's China-specific B'STYLE EX001 reaches TuHu channel
what_happened: An April 1 in-window trade listing recapped the China launch of Bridgestone's B'STYLE EX001, co-developed with TuHu for wet-road safety and sold through the platform; the underlying company announcement was dated March 24. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The product combines China-specific development with an exclusive aftermarket channel, but claimed wet-handling, comfort, noise and fuel-use gains remain bounded to disclosed supplier and third-party comparisons. retained as context because the original 24 March launch is captured in the preceding weekly record; the April listing adds no distinct stage change. what_happened_zh: 规格为 245/50R19 105V 的 Maxxis VS6 轮胎被确认为华为支持的 Shangjie Z7 整车项目的原厂配套。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场采用情况最清晰的公开证据。这一具名的中国电动车配套，是该款高端 Maxxis 产品获得客户采用的具体证据。后续应关注推广数量、更多整车项目、续约证据以及实际使用表现。

title: Nexen wins 2026 Jeep Cherokee OE fitment
what_happened: Nexen Tire was selected as an original-equipment supplier for the 2026 Jeep Cherokee, including the model's new hybrid configuration. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. The nomination extends Nexen's North American OE book through a named high-volume vehicle program. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: Nexen 获得 2026 款 Jeep Cherokee 原配配套
what_happened_zh: Nexen Tire 被选为 2026 款 Jeep Cherokee 的原厂配套供应商，其中包括该车型新增的混合动力版本。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场采用情况最清晰的公开证据。此次提名通过一个具名的大批量整车项目扩充了 Nexen 的北美原配业务。后续应关注推广数量、更多整车项目、续约证据以及实际使用表现。

title: Continental EcoContact tires win Volkswagen T-Roc fitments
what_happened: Volkswagen approved Continental EcoContact 7 and EcoContact 7 S tires in 16- to 19-inch sizes for the latest T-Roc. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. Multiple approved sizes across efficiency and sport variants provide broad named-program adoption evidence. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: 大陆集团 EcoContact 轮胎获得大众 T-Roc 配套
what_happened_zh: 大众批准大陆集团 EcoContact 7 和 EcoContact 7 S 轮胎用于最新一代 T-Roc，规格为 16 至 19 英寸。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场采用情况最清晰的公开证据。在节能与运动两种取向上获得多个规格认证，构成了范围较广的具名项目采用证据。后续应关注推广数量、更多整车项目、续约证据以及实际使用表现。

title: Goodyear brings Eagle Medium tires to ELMS Le Castellet
what_happened: Goodyear introduced its Eagle Medium competition tire for the European Le Mans Series round at Le Castellet. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. Race deployment advances the product from development into customer use under endurance conditions. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: 固特异将 Eagle Medium 轮胎带到 ELMS 的 Le Castellet 分站
what_happened_zh: 固特异为在 Le Castellet 举行的 European Le Mans Series 分站推出了其 Eagle Medium 比赛轮胎。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场采用情况最清晰的公开证据。赛事投用使该产品从开发阶段进入耐久工况下的客户实际使用。后续应关注推广数量、更多整车项目、续约证据以及实际使用表现。

title: Dunlop launches SPORT MAXX RS performance tire in China
what_happened: Dunlop introduced SPORT MAXX RS to the Chinese market, positioning it for high-performance road use with a tread, compound and structural package aimed at steering response and grip. International brands continue to localize high-performance product portfolios for China's premium replacement market. A market launch is stronger than a preview, but published performance claims still require independent comparative tests. Watch for size coverage, verified wet-braking results and OE nominations.
title_zh: Dunlop 在中国推出 SPORT MAXX RS 高性能轮胎
what_happened_zh: Dunlop 将 SPORT MAXX RS 引入中国市场，定位于高性能道路使用，其胎面、配方与结构方案面向转向响应和抓地力。国际品牌仍在继续为中国高端替换市场本地化高性能产品线。上市发布比预告更有力，但已公布的性能主张仍需独立对比测试。后续应关注规格覆盖、经验证的湿地制动结果以及原配提名。

title: CST presents lightweight two-wheel tire portfolio at China Cycle 2026
what_happened: CST showed multiple lightweight bicycle-tire products at the Shanghai exhibition, using a 'weight disappears' display to frame performance and product-range changes for two-wheel mobility. Lightweight construction and application-specific two-wheel portfolios are moving into mainstream product positioning. The launch provides a current product signal in China's large two-wheel market, although no independent performance data accompanied the display. Watch commercial size releases, mass specifications and third-party rolling-resistance or puncture tests.
title_zh: CST 在 China Cycle 2026 展出轻量化两轮车轮胎产品线
what_happened_zh: CST 在上海的展会上展示了多款轻量化自行车轮胎产品，并以“重量消失”的展示方式呈现两轮出行领域的性能与产品线变化。轻量化结构以及针对具体应用的两轮车产品线正进入主流产品定位。此次发布为中国庞大的两轮车市场提供了当期产品信号，但展示本身没有附带独立性能数据。后续应关注商品化规格发布、重量参数以及第三方滚动阻力或抗刺穿测试。

title: Vredestein Comtrac 2+ wins Promobil motorhome summer-tire test
what_happened: Promobil ranked the Comtrac 2+ first in a motorhome summer-tire group test, highlighting short wet and dry braking distances. Independent category tests can influence specialist replacement demand. The accessible report lacks the full protocol and result table needed for a stronger cross-product conclusion. The ranking is attributable, but the accessible summary does not provide the complete test protocol or table. Review the full test method, sizes, competitors and score spread.
title_zh: Vredestein Comtrac 2+ 在 Promobil 房车夏季轮胎测试中夺冠
what_happened_zh: Promobil 在一次房车夏季轮胎横评中将 Comtrac 2+ 排在首位，并强调其湿地和干地制动距离较短。独立的品类测试可能影响专业替换市场需求。可获取的报道缺少完整的测试方案和成绩表，不足以支撑更有力的跨产品结论。该排名有明确出处，但可获取的摘要没有提供完整的测试方案或成绩表。后续应查阅完整的测试方法、规格、参测对手及得分分布。

title: European Commission proposes excluding retreaded tires from EUDR product scope
what_happened: The Commission proposed removing retreaded tires from the EU Deforestation Regulation's product scope as part of simplification ahead of planned application in December 2026. Regulators are distinguishing circular products from new rubber-intensive goods when calibrating traceability burdens. An exclusion could reduce administrative friction for retreading, but it is not effective law at the proposal stage. Watch the legislative text, adoption timeline and treatment of replacement rubber used in retreads.
title_zh: 欧盟委员会提议将翻新轮胎移出 EUDR 产品范围
what_happened_zh: 欧盟委员会提议，作为简化工作的一部分，在欧盟零毁林法规（EUDR）计划于 2026 年 12 月开始适用之前，把翻新轮胎从其产品范围中移除。监管机构在设定可追溯性负担时，正把循环类产品与新的橡胶密集型产品区分开来。排除在外有可能减少翻新业务的行政摩擦，但在提案阶段还不是生效的法律。后续应关注立法文本、通过时间表以及翻新中所用替换橡胶的处理方式。

title: Linglong shows concept tire containing 85% sustainable materials
what_happened: Linglong presented an 85% sustainable-material concept tire at the WBCSD meeting in Montreux and reiterated targets for 100% sustainable materials by 2040 and climate neutrality by 2050. Chinese tire makers are raising sustainable-material content in demonstrators, but concept-stage evidence remains distinct from scaled production. The disclosed material share is a useful development-stage marker and a basis for later commercial qualification checks. Watch formulation disclosure, life-cycle accounting, independent testing and a production-tire launch.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎展出可持续材料占比 85% 的概念轮胎
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎在蒙特勒举行的 WBCSD 会议上展示了一条可持续材料占比 85% 的概念轮胎，并重申了到 2040 年实现 100% 可持续材料、到 2050 年实现气候中性的目标。中国轮胎企业正在提高示范样品中的可持续材料含量，但概念阶段的证据仍与规模化生产有所区别。所披露的材料占比是有价值的开发阶段标志，也是后续商业化认证核查的基础。后续应关注配方披露、生命周期核算、独立测试以及量产轮胎上市。

title: Bekaert completes acquisition of Bridgestone steel-cord plants in China and Thailand
what_happened: Bekaert completed its EUR60 million purchase of tire-reinforcement operations in Shenyang, China and Rayong, Thailand, with a long-term supply arrangement and about EUR80 million in expected annual revenue cited. Tire makers are transferring captive reinforcement assets to specialist materials suppliers while preserving supply through contracts. The deal changes ownership of a strategic input and directly affects the regional steel-cord supply base. Watch employee integration, customer diversification and post-close output disclosures.
title_zh: Bekaert 完成收购普利司通在中国和泰国的钢丝帘线工厂
what_happened_zh: Bekaert 以 EUR60 million 完成了对中国沈阳和泰国 Rayong 轮胎增强材料业务的收购，交易同时包含长期供应安排，并提及预计年收入约为 EUR80 million。轮胎制造商正把自有的增强材料资产转让给专业材料供应商，同时通过合同保障供应。该交易改变了一项战略投入品的所有权，并直接影响区域钢丝帘线供应基础。后续应关注员工整合、客户多元化以及交割后的产量披露。

title: China's expanded zero-tariff treatment for Africa does not broadly unlock cheaper rubber
what_happened: China expanded zero-tariff treatment to 20 additional African partner countries, but CRIA noted that the change covers a specified product list rather than all goods and therefore does not create a broad new source of low-cost rubber. Headline tariff liberalization can have limited tire-material impact when product coverage and producing-country capacity are narrow. The clarification prevents an overstatement of the policy's near-term effect on natural-rubber sourcing costs. Watch the covered tariff lines, supplier qualification and actual China-Africa rubber trade flows.
title_zh: 中国扩大对非洲零关税待遇，但并未普遍带来更低价的橡胶
what_happened_zh: 中国将零关税待遇扩大至另外 20 个非洲伙伴国，但中国橡胶工业协会指出，此次变化覆盖的是特定产品清单而非全部商品，因此并不会形成广泛的新低成本橡胶来源。当产品覆盖范围和产胶国产能都较为有限时，表面上的关税自由化对轮胎原料的影响可能很小。这一澄清避免了夸大该政策对天然橡胶采购成本的近期影响。后续应关注覆盖的税目、供应商资质认定以及中非橡胶贸易的实际流向。

title: Pirelli plans Cyber Tire production and a MIRS upgrade at its Georgia plant
what_happened: Pirelli announced that its US plant in Georgia will produce connected Cyber Tires and receive the latest version of the company's MIRS manufacturing system. Connected-tire capability is moving closer to regional series production alongside flexible manufacturing upgrades. Combining product electronics with plant modernization is a concrete manufacturing direction, but the announcement does not establish commissioning. Watch equipment installation, start of production, customer nominations and sensor-data functionality.
title_zh: 倍耐力计划在佐治亚工厂生产 Cyber Tire 并升级 MIRS
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力宣布，其位于美国佐治亚州的工厂将生产联网的 Cyber Tire 轮胎，并将获得公司最新版本的 MIRS 制造系统。联网轮胎能力正随着柔性制造升级，更接近区域化批量生产。把产品电子化与工厂现代化结合起来是明确的制造方向，但该公告并不能确立投产调试。后续应关注设备安装、量产启动、客户提名以及传感器数据功能。

title: Pirelli reports Xushen Tyre as a fully consolidated China operation
what_happened: Pirelli's first-quarter reporting included Xushen Tyre as a fully consolidated entity after the group exercised its call option with effect from 1 January 2026, supporting its China new-energy-vehicle strategy. Control of Chinese manufacturing assets is being tightened to align local production and product development with premium EV demand. Full consolidation changes governance and financial control, even though it does not by itself prove a new capacity increase. Watch plant investment, localized EV fitments and segment reporting after consolidation.
title_zh: 倍耐力将 Xushen Tyre 列为在华全面合并的经营主体
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力的第一季度报告已把 Xushen Tyre 作为全面合并主体纳入，此前集团行使了认购期权并自 2026 年 1 月 1 日起生效，以支撑其中国新能源汽车战略。对中国制造资产的控制正在加强，以使本地生产和产品开发与高端电动车需求相匹配。全面合并改变了治理与财务控制，尽管这本身并不能证明新增产能。后续应关注工厂投资、本地化电动车配套以及合并后的分部报告。

title: Sanli Tire's RMB636.71 million expansion receives environmental approval
what_happened: Heze authorities approved the environmental report for a Cao County expansion designed for 3.38 million semi-steel radial tires a year, including UHP, EV, run-flat and self-sealing products, supported by 162 equipment sets. Chinese manufacturers are directing brownfield capex toward larger-rim, EV and safety-oriented product mixes. The approval advances the project beyond announcement while remaining short of construction or commissioning evidence. Watch construction permits, equipment delivery and the first verified production milestone.
title_zh: Sanli Tire 的 RMB636.71 million 扩建项目获得环评批复
what_happened_zh: 菏泽主管部门批复了曹县一个扩建项目的环境影响报告，该项目设计年产 3.38 million 条半钢子午线轮胎，产品包括 UHP、电动车、缺气保用和自修补轮胎，并配套 162 台套设备。中国制造商正把棕地资本支出投向更大轮辋、电动车和安全导向的产品结构。该批复使项目推进到公告之后的阶段，但仍未构成建设或投产调试的证据。后续应关注施工许可、设备交付以及首个经核实的投产节点。

title: Continental raises tire and ContiTech profitability despite lower sales
what_happened: Continental reported improved adjusted EBIT margins in Tires and ContiTech despite a weak market, tariffs and currency headwinds, citing cost discipline, product mix and lower raw-material costs. Manufacturing economics are improving through mix and cost control even without top-line expansion. The result gives an operating benchmark for margin resilience during demand softness. Watch volume, restructuring execution and whether raw-material relief persists.
title_zh: 大陆集团在销售额下滑的情况下提升轮胎与 ContiTech 盈利能力
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团报告称，尽管市场疲弱并面临关税和汇率不利影响，轮胎与 ContiTech 板块的调整后 EBIT 利润率仍有改善，公司将其归因于成本管控、产品结构和原材料成本下降。即便没有收入端增长，制造经济性也在通过产品结构和成本控制得到改善。该业绩为需求走弱期的利润率韧性提供了运营参照。后续应关注销量、重组执行情况以及原材料成本缓解能否延续。

title: Chinese tire makers announce May price increases, but channel pass-through remains uneven
what_happened: Fangxing Tire said semi-steel, all-steel and OTR prices would rise 3%-5% from 10 May, while the report counted more than 80 domestic and international price notices since March. Raw-material inflation is prompting broad list-price action, but notices do not establish realized transaction prices. The gap between announced increases and dealer acceptance is a direct signal about channel power and margin recovery in China. Track invoice prices, dealer inventory and whether the 10 May increase is sustained.
title_zh: 中国轮胎企业宣布 5 月涨价，但渠道传导仍不均衡
what_happened_zh: Fangxing Tire 表示，半钢、全钢及 OTR 轮胎价格将自 5 月 10 日起上调 3%-5%，而该报道统计，自 3 月以来国内外已有超过 80 份涨价通知。原材料涨价正推动广泛的挂牌价调整，但通知并不能确立实际成交价格。宣布的涨价与经销商接受程度之间的差距，是观察中国渠道话语权和利润率修复的直接信号。后续应跟踪发票价格、经销商库存，以及 5 月 10 日的涨价能否持续。

title: Goodyear posts a $249 million first-quarter loss as tire volume falls 11.6%
what_happened: Goodyear reported a $249 million net loss, sales down 8.7% to $3.881 billion and tire units down 11.6% to 34.0 million in the first quarter. Weak North American replacement demand and volume pressure are forcing sharper portfolio and footprint decisions. The scale of the decline is a material demand signal and a baseline for later restructuring actions. Watch regional volumes, factory utilization, price/mix and cash generation.
title_zh: 固特异第一季度亏损 $249 million，轮胎销量下降 11.6%
what_happened_zh: 固特异报告第一季度净亏损 $249 million，销售额下降 8.7% 至 $3.881 billion，轮胎销量下降 11.6% 至 34.0 million 条。北美替换市场需求疲弱和销量压力，正迫使公司做出更为果断的产品组合与产能布局决策。此次下滑的幅度是重要的需求信号，也是后续重组行动的基准。后续应关注各区域销量、工厂产能利用率、价格与产品结构以及现金生成。

title: China's March tire exports fall, while first-quarter volume remains above 2025
what_happened: China exported 800,000 tonnes of rubber tires in March, down 6.9% year on year, with value down 11.3% to RMB13.475 billion; cumulative first-quarter volume remained higher than a year earlier. Export volume and value are diverging, signaling pricing or mix pressure even while cumulative shipments grow. The customs-based data is a direct measure of external demand and pricing pressure facing Chinese producers. Watch April-May tonnage, unit value and destination shifts.
title_zh: 中国 3 月轮胎出口下降，第一季度总量仍高于 2025 年
what_happened_zh: 中国 3 月出口橡胶轮胎 800,000 tonnes，同比下降 6.9%，出口金额下降 11.3% 至 RMB13.475 billion；第一季度累计出口量仍高于上年同期。出口量与出口额出现分化，表明在累计出货量增长的同时仍存在价格或产品结构压力。基于海关的数据直接衡量了中国生产企业面临的外部需求和价格压力。后续应关注 4 月至 5 月的出口吨位、单位价值以及目的地结构变化。

title: CEAT builds localized European entities in four key markets
what_happened: CEAT confirmed entities or branches in the UK, Germany, France and Poland, describing a shift from an export-led model toward a permanent localized presence. Emerging tire makers are adding local commercial infrastructure to compete beyond importer-only distribution. Legal and operating presence can improve market access and partner support, though it does not establish sales growth by itself. Watch staffing, distributor agreements, inventory hubs and country-level revenue.
title_zh: CEAT 在四个重点市场建立欧洲本地化实体
what_happened_zh: CEAT 确认已在英国、德国、法国和波兰设立实体或分支机构，并将其描述为从出口主导模式转向长期本地化存在。新兴轮胎制造商正在增加本地商业基础设施，以便超越单纯进口商式分销展开竞争。法律与运营层面的存在能够改善市场准入和对伙伴的支持，但其本身并不能证明销售增长。后续应关注人员配置、经销协议、库存中心以及各国收入。

title: China commercial-tire demand improves while cost pass-through stays weak
what_happened: An industry review described a weakly stable first-half market: raw-material costs remained elevated, channel inventory constrained replenishment and first-quarter commercial-vehicle sales reached 1.114 million units, up 6% year on year. Volume recovery and pricing power are diverging, leaving manufacturers to balance utilization, inventory and margin. The combination explains why announced tire increases may not translate quickly into channel prices. Watch replacement demand, factory utilization and inventory days after the May notices.
title_zh: 中国商用车轮胎需求改善，成本传导依然疲弱
what_happened_zh: 一份行业综述把上半年市场描述为弱稳定：原材料成本维持高位，渠道库存抑制了补货，第一季度商用车销量达到 1.114 million 辆，同比增长 6%。销量复苏与定价能力正在分化，使制造商需要在产能利用率、库存和利润率之间取得平衡。这种组合解释了为何已宣布的轮胎涨价可能难以迅速传导至渠道价格。后续应关注 5 月涨价通知之后的替换市场需求、工厂产能利用率和库存天数。

title: European replacement consumer-tire sales return to modest growth in Q1
what_happened: Tyres Europe members sold 58.144 million replacement consumer tires in the first quarter, up 1% from 57.499 million a year earlier. European replacement demand is stabilizing after a weak 2025, but the recovery remains shallow. The association dataset offers a comparable volume signal for channel demand rather than relying on a single manufacturer. Watch Q2 sell-in, winter timing and segment differences.
title_zh: 欧洲替换市场乘用车轮胎销量在 Q1 恢复小幅增长
what_happened_zh: Tyres Europe 成员企业第一季度销售替换市场乘用车轮胎 58.144 million 条，较上年同期的 57.499 million 条增长 1%。欧洲替换市场需求在 2025 年走弱之后趋于稳定，但复苏幅度仍然有限。该协会数据集提供了可比的渠道需求量信号，而不必依赖单一制造商。后续应关注 Q2 的渠道进货、冬季轮胎时点以及细分市场差异。

title: Grupo Andres expands Salamanca warehouse and acquires Seville site
what_happened: The distributor added almost 4,000 square metres and capacity for about 100,000 tires at Salamanca, while acquiring 25,000 square metres in Seville for a new southern Spain warehouse; its network now exceeds 55,000 square metres. European tire wholesalers are adding regional inventory capacity to shorten service distance and support broader assortments. Physical storage expansion is a concrete channel investment rather than a marketing-only expansion claim. Watch construction timing, inventory turns and customer coverage from Seville.
title_zh: Grupo Andres 扩建萨拉曼卡仓库并收购塞维利亚场地
what_happened_zh: 这家分销商在萨拉曼卡新增了近 4,000 平方米面积和约 100,000 条轮胎的存储能力，同时在塞维利亚收购 25,000 平方米土地，用于建设西班牙南部的新仓库；其网络面积目前已超过 55,000 平方米。欧洲轮胎批发商正在增加区域库存能力，以缩短服务距离并支持更广的产品组合。实体仓储扩建是具体的渠道投资，而不只是营销层面的扩张说法。后续应关注工程进度、库存周转以及塞维利亚所覆盖的客户范围。

title: Jiangsu General reports revenue growth but profit pressure during ownership reform
what_happened: Jiangsu General reported robust 2025 top-line growth alongside a sharp profitability decline, while an ownership reform was positioned as a change to the company's longer-term strategy. Scale growth is not automatically converting into earnings as Chinese manufacturers absorb input costs and trade pressure. The result provides a counterweight to capacity announcements and highlights the financial constraint on overseas and product expansion. Watch 2026 margin, utilization and whether governance changes alter capital allocation.
title_zh: 通用股份营收增长，但股权改革期间利润承压
what_happened_zh: 通用股份报告 2025 年收入实现较强增长，同时盈利能力大幅下滑，而股权改革被定位为公司更长期战略的转变。在中国制造商承受投入成本和贸易压力的背景下，规模增长并不会自动转化为盈利。该业绩为各类产能公告提供了一个制衡视角，并凸显了海外与产品扩张面临的财务约束。后续应关注 2026 年利润率、产能利用率，以及治理变化是否会改变资本配置。

title: MRF reports roughly 29% profit growth for fiscal 2026
what_happened: MRF's audited full-year results showed standalone and consolidated revenue growth above 10% and profit growth close to 30% for the year ended 31 March 2026. India's domestic and replacement-market exposure is supporting stronger earnings than several mature-market peers. The result helps distinguish regional demand and margin trajectories across global tire makers. Watch raw-material inflation, price realization and fiscal 2027 volume.
title_zh: MRF 报告 2026 财年利润增长约 29%
what_happened_zh: MRF 经审计的全年业绩显示，在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的财年内，母公司与合并层面的收入增长均超过 10%，利润增长接近 30%。印度本土市场和替换市场的业务结构，正支撑其盈利表现强于若干成熟市场同行。该结果有助于区分全球轮胎企业在区域需求和利润率上的不同走势。后续应关注原材料涨价、价格实现情况以及 2027 财年的销量。

title: Linglong runs Master Gen 2 campaign across 22 transport hubs
what_happened: Linglong placed Master Gen 2 advertising in airports and rail stations across 22 Chinese cities and linked the product to a 4 May fan event. Chinese premium-tire brands are combining national media reach with experiential events. The campaign shows channel and positioning activity but provides no measured sales or conversion outcome. This is a brand-supplied campaign account without independently measured commercial outcomes. Watch dealer orders, campaign reach and repeat activity after the holiday period.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎在 22 个交通枢纽投放 Master Gen 2 推广
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎在中国 22 个城市的机场和火车站投放 Master Gen 2 广告，并把该产品与 5 月 4 日的一场粉丝活动相关联。中国高端轮胎品牌正在把全国性媒体覆盖与体验式活动结合起来。该推广显示了渠道和定位层面的动作，但没有提供经衡量的销售或转化结果。这是品牌方提供的推广说明，不含经独立衡量的商业结果。后续应关注经销商订单、推广触达以及假期之后的重复投放。

title: Bridgestone and Penske share first Decarbonization Lab findings after 500,000 fleet miles
what_happened: The partners reported first-phase observations from more than 500,000 fleet miles and scheduled a public discussion at ACT Expo. Large-fleet field programs are becoming the proving ground for tire and operating changes tied to fuel and emissions reduction. Real fleet mileage raises the evidence level above a lab-only claim, although the public summary did not provide a complete controlled baseline. Watch for route conditions, tire specifications, fuel deltas and a reproducible baseline.
title_zh: 普利司通与 Penske 在 500,000 英里车队里程后公布 Decarbonization Lab 首批发现
what_happened_zh: 双方报告了来自超过 500,000 英里车队运行的第一阶段观察结果，并安排在 ACT Expo 上进行公开讨论。大型车队的实地项目正成为与燃油和排放削减相关的轮胎及运营调整的验证场。真实的车队里程使证据层级高于仅限实验室的主张，但公开摘要并未提供完整的受控基线。后续应关注路线条件、轮胎规格、油耗差异以及可重复的基线。

title: GRI extends pneumatic-tire warranty coverage to as long as ten years
what_happened: GRI updated its limited warranty for pneumatic tires manufactured from 1 January 2025, extending eligible coverage to as long as ten years across more than 80 countries. Specialty-tire suppliers are using longer warranties to support lifetime-value positioning and distributor confidence. The policy changes the customer proposition across a broad geographic footprint, subject to its terms and exclusions. Watch claim rates, exclusions, dealer implementation and competitor responses.
title_zh: GRI 将充气轮胎质保覆盖期延长至最长十年
what_happened_zh: GRI 更新了针对 2025 年 1 月 1 日起生产的充气轮胎的有限质保政策，将符合条件的保障期延长至最长十年，覆盖超过 80 个国家。特种轮胎供应商正借助更长的质保期来支撑全生命周期价值定位和经销商信心。该政策在广泛的地理范围内改变了客户价值主张，但须遵守其条款与除外规定。后续应关注索赔率、除外条款、经销商执行情况以及竞争对手反应。

title: Aeolus produces China's first reported 60/80R57 giant radial OTR tire
what_happened: Aeolus rolled out a 60/80R57 radial tire for 50-ton loaders, describing it as the first domestically produced tire in the size and linking it to a RMB1.464 billion expansion designed for about 20,000 giant OTR tires a year. Chinese OTR programs are moving into larger, higher-load segments previously concentrated among global specialists. A physical first article is stronger evidence than a project announcement, while design capacity and performance remain to be qualified. Watch field trials, mine or port customers, certification and repeat production.
title_zh: 风神轮胎下线中国首次报道的 60/80R57 巨型工程机械子午线轮胎
what_happened_zh: 风神轮胎下线一款用于 50 吨装载机的 60/80R57 子午线轮胎，称其为该规格首条国产轮胎，并将其与一项规划年产约 20,000 条巨型工程机械轮胎、总投资 RMB1.464 billion 的扩产项目相关联。中国非公路轮胎项目正在进入此前主要由全球专业厂商占据的更大规格、更高负荷细分市场。实物首件比项目公告是更强的证据，而设计产能和产品性能仍有待验证。后续应关注现场试用、矿山或港口客户、认证以及批量重复生产。

title: Yokohama opens R&D center at its new Hangzhou passenger-tire plant
what_happened: Yokohama Rubber opened a development center at its Hangzhou plant to localize product development and support production for Chinese demand; the associated passenger-tire plant began production in November 2025. Global manufacturers are co-locating local R&D with Chinese production to shorten product-response cycles. The operating center is a concrete localization step rather than a future research commitment. Watch locally developed product launches, staffing, test capability and China OE wins.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶在杭州新乘用车轮胎工厂内设立研发中心
what_happened_zh: 横滨橡胶在其杭州工厂设立开发中心，以实现产品开发本地化并支撑面向中国需求的生产；配套的乘用车轮胎工厂已于 2025 年 11 月投产。全球制造商正把本地研发与中国生产布局在一起，以缩短产品响应周期。该中心已经运营，属于具体的本地化举措，而非未来的研究承诺。后续应关注本地开发产品的上市、人员配置、测试能力以及中国市场的原配项目获取。

title: State-of-knowledge review finds tire-wear health evidence remains inconclusive
what_happened: A three-part literature review concluded that inconsistent sampling and analytical methods prevent robust quantification of human-health impacts attributable to tire-wear emissions. Measurement harmonization remains a prerequisite for credible health-risk comparison and regulation. The conclusion is decision-relevant, but the weekly source is a summary rather than the full papers and therefore remains context. The accessible weekly article summarizes the review; the underlying papers should be used for method-level claims. Review the underlying papers, study inclusion criteria and emerging standardized methods.
title_zh: 知识现状综述认为轮胎磨损的健康影响证据仍不确定
what_happened_zh: 一项分为三部分的文献综述认为，采样和分析方法不一致，使得归因于轮胎磨损排放的人体健康影响无法得到可靠量化。测量方法的统一仍是可信健康风险比较与监管的前提。该结论对决策有参考价值，但本周来源是综述摘要而非完整论文，因此仍作为背景信息呈现。可获取的周度文章只是对该综述的概述，涉及方法层面的论断应以原始论文为依据。后续应查阅原始论文、研究纳入标准以及正在形成的标准化方法。

title: Greenline Tyres joins Marangoni Ringtread network in Morocco
what_happened: Greenline Tyres became a Marangoni Ringtread partner to supply retreading solutions to Moroccan fleets. Retreading systems are expanding through local partners in North Africa rather than only through direct manufacturer operations. The partnership creates a concrete route for circular tire services, although customer volume is not disclosed. Watch installed capacity, fleet contracts, casing supply and annual retread output.
title_zh: Greenline Tyres 加入 Marangoni Ringtread 网络，服务摩洛哥市场
what_happened_zh: Greenline Tyres 成为 Marangoni Ringtread 合作伙伴，为摩洛哥车队提供翻新解决方案。翻新体系正通过北非本地合作伙伴扩张，而不只是依靠制造商的直营业务。此次合作为循环轮胎服务建立了具体路径，但客户使用量并未披露。后续应关注已安装产能、车队合同、胎体供应以及年度翻新产量。

title: Goodyear plans 55%-sustainable-material racing tires and retreading for TGP
what_happened: Goodyear announced that it would supply racing tires containing 55% sustainable materials to the new TGP Championship and retread used tires for commercial transport applications. Motorsport programs are being used to connect alternative materials with a second-life pathway. The plan is relevant but remained prospective at publication, with no race-use or retread outcome yet available. The supply and retreading plan was announced before the first race and had no reported operating result in the window. Watch event use, material accounting, retread yield and commercial-fleet deployment.
title_zh: 固特异计划为 TGP 提供 55% 可持续材料赛车轮胎并开展翻新
what_happened_zh: 固特异宣布将为新设立的 TGP Championship 提供含 55% 可持续材料的赛车轮胎，并把用过的轮胎翻新用于商用运输领域。赛车运动项目正被用来把替代材料与二次生命周期路径连接起来。该计划具有参考价值，但在发布时仍属前瞻性内容，尚无比赛使用或翻新结果。该供胎与翻新计划在首场比赛之前宣布，报告期内没有已公布的运营结果。后续应关注赛事中的实际使用、材料核算、翻新成品率以及商用车队的落地应用。

title: BKT approves Rs20 billion capacity program with advanced production automation
what_happened: BKT's board approved Rs20 billion for OHT and on-road tire capacity, infrastructure and advanced automation in its highway-tire operations, alongside sustainability initiatives. Large Indian manufacturers are coupling segment expansion with automation rather than treating capacity and process technology as separate programs. Board approval makes the capex concrete, but the source discloses neither the technical architecture nor measured factory outcomes. Watch site allocation, equipment contracts, commissioning and baseline-to-result metrics.
title_zh: BKT 批准 Rs20 billion 产能计划，并包含先进生产自动化
what_happened_zh: BKT 董事会批准 Rs20 billion 投资，用于非公路轮胎（OHT）与公路轮胎产能、基础设施以及公路轮胎业务中的先进自动化，同时配套可持续发展举措。印度大型制造商正把细分市场扩张与自动化结合起来，而不是把产能和工艺技术当作彼此分离的项目。董事会批准使这笔资本支出变得具体，但来源既未披露技术架构，也未披露经测量的工厂成果。后续应关注厂址安排、设备合同、投料试车以及从基线到结果的指标。

title: Linglong cancels Tongchuan factory plan and flags delays in Anhui and Brazil
what_happened: Linglong terminated its planned Tongchuan tire factory after slow preliminary work and uncertain returns, while reporting that its Anhui project was behind schedule and Brazil negotiations remained unresolved. Chinese tire makers are becoming more selective about large greenfield projects as execution and return risks rise. A withdrawn RMB-scale project is as material to capacity forecasting as a new announcement and prevents overstating future supply. Watch formal termination approvals, asset treatment and alternative site selection.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎取消铜川工厂计划，并提示安徽与巴西项目延期
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎因前期工作推进缓慢、回报不确定，终止了原计划的铜川轮胎工厂，同时表示安徽项目进度落后、巴西项目谈判仍未落定。随着执行与回报风险上升，中国轮胎制造商对大型绿地项目正变得更加谨慎。一个撤回的 RMB 级规模项目对产能预测的意义不亚于一项新公告，并可避免高估未来供给。后续应关注正式终止审批、资产处理以及替代厂址的选择。

title: Yokohama plans $245 million OTR plants in India and Mexico
what_happened: Yokohama announced new mining and construction tire plants in India and Mexico to receive production acquired with Goodyear's OTR business, plus equipment for giant OTR tires. Post-acquisition manufacturing networks are being rebuilt around regional OTR demand and larger products. The plan ties capital, product scope and geographic transfer together, but construction and commissioning remain future stages. Watch permits, site work, equipment orders and production-transfer timing.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶计划在印度和墨西哥建设 $245 million 非公路轮胎工厂
what_happened_zh: 横滨橡胶宣布在印度和墨西哥新建矿山与工程机械轮胎工厂，用于承接随固特异非公路轮胎业务一并收购的产能，并配置生产巨型工程机械轮胎的设备。收购完成后的制造网络正围绕区域性非公路轮胎需求和更大规格产品重新布局。该计划把资本、产品范围与产能地理转移结合在一起，但工程建设和投料试车仍属未来阶段。后续应关注许可、现场施工、设备订单以及产能转移的时间安排。

title: Inner Mongolia approves RMB1.2 billion aviation and specialty-tire base
what_happened: Hohhot authorities approved the environmental report for a base designed for 80,000 specialty tires, 15,000 new aviation tires and 15,000 retreaded aviation tires annually, with digital hazardous-waste traceability specified. Specialty capacity projects are combining high-value products, retreading and more granular environmental controls. The approval advances a strategic aviation-tire project but does not establish construction or qualified output. Watch financing, equipment awards, construction and aviation qualification milestones.
title_zh: 内蒙古批准 RMB1.2 billion 航空与特种轮胎基地
what_happened_zh: 呼和浩特主管部门批复了一个基地的环评报告，该基地规划年产 80,000 条特种轮胎、15,000 条新航空轮胎和 15,000 条翻新航空轮胎，并明确要求危险废物数字化溯源。特种产能项目正把高价值产品、翻新业务与更精细的环保管控结合在一起。该批复推进了一个具有战略意义的航空轮胎项目，但并不能确立工程建设或合格产量。后续应关注融资、设备招标结果、工程建设以及航空产品的型号认证节点。

title: Shandong LIBLIK completes mixing, curing, power and fire-system upgrades
what_happened: The Weifang manufacturer reported completed upgrades to rubber mixing, bladder curing, emergency power and fire-protection systems for continuous specialty-tire production. Smaller Shandong producers are investing in process stability and production continuity, not only headline capacity. The work identifies specific factory systems, but the company release provides no before-and-after quality or uptime metrics. Watch defect rates, downtime, energy use and third-party certification.
title_zh: Shandong LIBLIK 完成密炼、硫化、供电与消防系统升级
what_happened_zh: 这家潍坊制造商表示，已完成橡胶密炼、胶囊硫化、应急供电和消防系统的升级，以保障特种轮胎的连续生产。规模较小的山东生产企业正在投资工艺稳定性和生产连续性，而不只是追求产能数字。相关工作明确了具体的工厂系统，但公司发布的信息没有提供改造前后的质量或开机率指标。后续应关注不良率、停机时间、能耗以及第三方认证。

title: US maintains antidumping and countervailing measures on Chinese passenger and light-truck tires
companies: US Department of Commerce / China tire exporters
what_happened: A second expedited sunset review maintained the US trade-remedy framework, with cited dumping and subsidy margins indicating that the duties would continue rather than expire. Persistent trade barriers keep overseas manufacturing and market diversification central to Chinese tire strategy. The decision affects market access and capacity-location economics, although company-specific duty treatment varies. Watch the final administrative notices, company rates and shifts in origin-country shipments.
title_zh: 美国维持对中国乘用车及轻卡轮胎的反倾销与反补贴措施
what_happened_zh: 第二次快速日落复审维持了美国的贸易救济框架，所引用的倾销与补贴幅度表明相关关税将继续执行而非到期终止。持续存在的贸易壁垒，使海外建厂和市场多元化仍是中国轮胎企业战略的核心。该决定影响市场准入和产能布局的经济性，不过各公司适用的税率处理并不相同。后续应关注最终行政公告、各公司税率以及出口原产国结构的变化。

title: Sailun raises China OTR tire prices 7%-9% amid input-cost pressure
what_happened: Sailun said domestic non-road tire prices increased 7%-9% from 11 May; the same market report listed 3%-5% increases by several other Chinese makers across truck, passenger and OTR ranges. The largest increases are appearing in material-intensive OTR products, where cost exposure and order structure differ from passenger tires. The effective date makes this more concrete than a general pricing warning, though realized prices remain unverified. Watch dealer invoices, order volumes and whether raw-material prices reverse.
title_zh: 赛轮在投入成本压力下将中国非公路轮胎价格上调 7%-9%
what_happened_zh: 赛轮表示，国内非公路轮胎价格自 5 月 11 日起上调 7%-9%；同一份市场报告还列出另外几家中国制造商在卡车、乘用车和非公路轮胎产品线上 3%-5% 的涨幅。涨幅最大的出现在材料占比高的非公路产品上，其成本敞口和订单结构与乘用车轮胎不同。生效日期使这一调价比笼统的涨价预警更为具体，不过实际成交价格仍未得到验证。后续应关注经销商发票、订单量，以及原料价格是否回落。

title: Guangrao Tire Expo opens as Yongsheng presents new EV, load and all-terrain tires
what_happened: The 16th China (Guangrao) International Rubber Tire and Auto Parts Exhibition opened on 15 May, and local maker Yongsheng displayed TBR and PCR products including EV08, RF28 and AT03. Guangrao is using a full-chain trade platform to connect local product development with global buyers, equipment suppliers and materials companies. The in-window company account confirms local-maker participation and concrete products, while exhibition attendance does not establish orders. Watch buyer agreements, follow-on production, equipment deals and disclosed digital-manufacturing deployments.
title_zh: 广饶轮胎展开幕，Yongsheng 展出新能源、载重与全地形新产品
what_happened_zh: 第十六届中国（广饶）国际橡胶轮胎暨汽车配件展览会于 5 月 15 日开幕，本地制造商 Yongsheng 展出了包括 EV08、RF28 和 AT03 在内的全钢子午线（TBR）与半钢子午线（PCR）产品。广饶正借助全产业链贸易平台，把本地产品开发与全球买家、设备供应商和材料企业连接起来。报告期内的公司信息确认了本地制造商的参展情况和具体产品，但参展本身并不能确立订单。后续应关注买家协议、后续生产、设备交易以及已披露的数字化制造部署。

title: Sailun plans new EV, UHP, winter and commercial products for Tire Cologne
what_happened: Sailun announced a broad product display and new-generation launches for Tire Cologne, using the event to reinforce its European-market commitment and sustainability positioning. Chinese tire makers are using European trade platforms to broaden product mix and distributor visibility. The plan signals market-entry intent and product pipeline breadth, but not realized sales. Watch final launch specifications, distributor contracts and EU label results.
title_zh: 赛轮为 Tire Cologne 规划新能源、UHP、冬季与商用车新产品
what_happened_zh: 赛轮宣布将在 Tire Cologne 展出广泛的产品阵容并发布新一代产品，借此强化其对欧洲市场的投入和可持续发展定位。中国轮胎制造商正利用欧洲贸易平台扩大产品结构和经销商曝光度。该计划显示出进入市场的意图和产品储备的广度，但并不代表已实现的销售。后续应关注最终的上市规格、经销商合同以及 EU 标签结果。

title: Citira reports UK market entry and acquisition-led first-quarter expansion
what_happened: Citira reported first-quarter revenue of SEK632.6 million, up 54.6%, while like-for-like revenue rose 3.1%; the period included entry into the UK tire-service market. European tire retail consolidation is producing headline growth well above underlying organic expansion. Separating acquisition and like-for-like growth gives a clearer view of channel momentum. Watch integration, UK site performance and organic revenue after acquisitions annualize.
title_zh: Citira 报告进入英国市场，并以并购驱动第一季度扩张
what_happened_zh: Citira 报告第一季度营业收入 SEK632.6 million，同比增长 54.6%，而同店收入增长 3.1%；期内还包括进入英国轮胎服务市场。欧洲轮胎零售整合正带来远高于内生扩张的表观增长。把并购增长与同店增长区分开来，能更清楚地看出渠道动能。后续应关注整合情况、英国门店表现，以及并购影响年化之后的内生收入。

title: Apollo Tyres posts 14% fourth-quarter revenue growth
what_happened: Apollo reported fourth-quarter revenue of Rs73.36 billion, up 14%, and operating profit of Rs10.69 billion, up 28%; Indian truck-bus radial growth exceeded 20%. India replacement and OE demand remains a relative growth engine despite weaker European conditions. The segment commentary helps locate current market strength and channel momentum. Watch raw-material costs, European demand and whether TBR growth persists.
title_zh: Apollo Tyres 第四季度营业收入增长 14%
what_happened_zh: Apollo 报告第四季度营业收入 Rs73.36 billion，同比增长 14%，营业利润 Rs10.69 billion，增长 28%；印度全钢载重子午线（TBR）轮胎增长超过 20%。尽管欧洲市场条件走弱，印度替换市场和原配需求仍是相对的增长引擎。这部分分部说明有助于定位当前的市场强弱和渠道动能。后续应关注原料成本、欧洲需求，以及全钢子午线轮胎的增长能否延续。

title: UK moves 3.5-4.25 tonne electric vans to three-year first MOT cycle
what_happened: From 1 June, new electric vans between 3.5 and 4.25 tonnes will use Class 7 MOT rules and receive their first test after three years rather than one. Regulation is reducing a service burden created by the extra weight of electric commercial vehicles. The change can affect fleet maintenance timing and inspection touchpoints, including tire-service opportunities. Watch implementation guidance, failure rates and fleet inspection practices outside the statutory MOT.
title_zh: 英国将 3.5-4.25 吨纯电货车首次 MOT 周期延长至三年
what_happened_zh: 自 6 月 1 日起，总重在 3.5 至 4.25 吨之间的新纯电货车将适用 Class 7 MOT 规则，首次检测由一年后改为三年后进行。监管正在减轻电动商用车因额外重量而产生的一项维护负担。这一变化会影响车队的维护时点和检测接触点，其中包括轮胎服务机会。后续应关注实施指引、不合格率，以及法定 MOT 之外的车队检测做法。

title: Giti's GitiComfort retail program links product technology with more than 100 Chinese dealers
what_happened: More than 100 core retail representatives attended a China training and factory-visit program covering Giti's AdvanZtech 2.0 and EV READY product frameworks and channel collaboration. Product-platform communication is being paired with dealer education as brands push higher-value EV and performance ranges. The program is evidence of channel enablement, not proof of sell-through or manufacturing performance. Watch dealer rollout, SKU adoption and measured sales after training.
title_zh: 佳通 GitiComfort 零售项目把产品技术与超过 100 家中国经销商连接起来
what_happened_zh: 超过 100 位核心零售代表参加了在中国举办的培训与工厂参观活动，内容涵盖佳通的 AdvanZtech 2.0 和 EV READY 产品技术框架以及渠道协作。随着品牌推广更高价值的新能源和高性能产品线，产品平台的传播正与经销商培训结合起来。该项目是渠道赋能的证据，但不能证明终端销售或制造表现。后续应关注经销商落地、SKU 采用情况，以及培训之后经量化的销售结果。

title: Hankook launches China-wide iON EV tire promotion through certified stores
what_happened: Hankook began a 15 May-31 July promotion offering RMB30 per tire on 17-inch-and-larger iON products through certified offline stores, alongside its service-registration program. EV tire portfolios are being supported by linked retail incentives and customer-service enrollment rather than product advertising alone. The campaign shows an active China channel mechanism, but no redemption or incremental-sales data is yet available. Watch coupon redemption, store participation and repeat service registrations.
title_zh: 韩泰通过认证门店在中国全国推出 iON 新能源轮胎促销
what_happened_zh: 韩泰启动一项 5 月 15 日至 7 月 31 日的促销活动，通过认证线下门店对 17-inch 及更大规格的 iON 产品提供每条 RMB30 的优惠，并同步推进其服务注册项目。新能源轮胎产品线正通过联动的零售激励和客户服务登记获得支持，而不只是依靠产品广告。该活动显示出中国渠道中一套正在运行的机制，但目前尚无核销或增量销售数据。后续应关注优惠券核销、门店参与度以及重复的服务注册。

title: Continental publishes EU fleet-safety framework for digital tire management
what_happened: Continental released a white paper arguing that continuous pressure and temperature monitoring can identify risks missed between manual inspections and improve fleet safety and reliability. Commercial tire service is shifting from periodic inspection toward continuous condition monitoring. The paper clarifies the service model and operational problem, but is not an independent outcome study. Watch fleet case data, alert accuracy, downtime changes and total service cost.
title_zh: 大陆集团发布面向数字化轮胎管理的 EU 车队安全框架
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团发布白皮书，认为持续的胎压与温度监测能够发现人工点检之间被遗漏的风险，并提升车队安全性与可靠性。商用轮胎服务正从周期性点检转向持续的状态监测。该白皮书阐明了服务模式和运营问题，但并不是独立的效果研究。后续应关注车队案例数据、报警准确率、停机时间变化以及服务总成本。

title: Pirelli develops two bespoke P Zero OE fitments for BMW iX3
what_happened: Pirelli developed two original-equipment fitments for the BMW iX3: a P Zero variant prioritizing handling and a P Zero E-based fitment aimed at electric-driving efficiency. EV platforms are supporting multiple tire calibrations for distinct performance priorities on the same vehicle line. A named OE fitment is direct customer adoption evidence, while comparative performance remains supplier-described. Watch launch sizes, label ratings, vehicle trims and independent tests.
title_zh: 倍耐力为 BMW iX3 开发两款定制 P Zero 原配轮胎
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力为 BMW iX3 开发了两款原厂配套轮胎：一款侧重操控的 P Zero 版本，以及一款基于 P Zero E、面向电驱动效率的配套产品。新能源平台正在同一车型线上支持面向不同性能侧重的多种轮胎标定。具名的原配配套是直接的客户采用证据，而对比性能仍只有供应商的描述。后续应关注上市规格、标签等级、车型配置以及独立测试。

title: European recall covers several Goodyear TreadMax retread lines over curing issue
what_happened: The European Commission Safety Gate system listed several Goodyear TreadMax truck retread products for recall because of a curing issue. Retread growth depends on manufacturing control and traceable corrective action as much as circularity benefits. A formal safety recall is direct customer-service and quality evidence with immediate operating implications. Watch affected production codes, remedy completion and root-cause disclosure.
title_zh: 欧洲召回涉及固特异 TreadMax 多个翻新产品系列，原因为硫化问题
what_happened_zh: 欧盟委员会 Safety Gate 系统将固特异 TreadMax 的多款卡车翻新产品列入召回，原因是硫化问题。翻新业务的增长既依赖循环利用带来的收益，也同样依赖制造过程控制和可追溯的纠正措施。一次正式的安全召回是直接的客户服务与质量证据，并带有即时的运营影响。后续应关注受影响的生产批号、整改完成情况以及根本原因的披露。

title: HD Ricketts reports uptime and cost benefits from Michelin X Works fleet policy
what_happened: The UK haulier said X Works tires and an accidental-damage guarantee improved durability and helped control tire-related costs in mixed on- and off-road service. Fleet customers are evaluating tires as a package of casing durability, uptime and risk coverage. A named operating customer provides adoption evidence, although the public account does not quantify a controlled savings baseline. Watch mileage, breakdown frequency, retread yield and cost-per-kilometre data.
title_zh: HD Ricketts 报告米其林 X Works 车队方案带来的车辆可用率与成本收益
what_happened_zh: 这家英国运输企业表示，在公路与非公路混合作业中，X Works 轮胎加上意外损伤保障提升了耐久性，并帮助控制了与轮胎相关的成本。车队客户正把轮胎作为胎体耐久性、车辆可用率和风险保障的组合来评估。一个具名的使用客户提供了采用证据，不过公开说明并未量化受控的节省基线。后续应关注里程、故障频次、翻新成品率以及单公里成本数据。

title: Triangle receives Chinese civil-aviation authorization for four radial aircraft tires
what_happened: Triangle announced CAAC CTSOA authorization for four civil-aviation radial tire part numbers intended for C919 and A320 applications after static-load, high-speed rolling and extreme-temperature testing. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. A Chinese tire maker has crossed a formal aviation-product authorization gate rather than only announcing development intent. Track aircraft fitment approvals, delivery volumes and in-service reliability evidence.
title_zh: 三角轮胎四款子午线航空轮胎获得中国民航授权
what_happened_zh: 三角轮胎宣布，四个民用航空子午线轮胎件号在通过静负荷、高速滚动和极端温度测试后获得 CAAC CTSOA 授权，拟用于 C919 和 A320 机型。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。一家中国轮胎制造商已经跨过正式的航空产品授权门槛，而不只是宣布开发意向。后续应关注飞机配套批准、交付数量以及在役可靠性证据。

title: Giti launches EV commercial-tire matrix built on its T5 development platform
what_happened: At its 18 May event, Giti presented six electric-commercial-vehicle products for port, regional, mining and urban applications and described a T5 process using AI modelling, digital twins, big-data analysis and performance simulation. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The launch connects virtual development methods to a named multi-application product portfolio, while leaving comparative validation undisclosed. Watch for controlled benchmarks, named fleet trials and product-specific durability or energy-use data.
title_zh: 佳通发布基于 T5 开发平台的新能源商用车轮胎产品矩阵
what_happened_zh: 在 5 月 18 日的活动上，佳通发布了面向港口、区域、矿山和城市应用的六款电动商用车产品，并介绍了采用 AI 建模、数字孪生、大数据分析和性能仿真的 T5 流程。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。此次发布把虚拟开发方法与一个具名的多应用产品组合联系起来，但未披露对比验证情况。后续应关注受控基准测试、具名车队试用以及产品层面的耐久性或能耗数据。

title: Continental develops SportContact 7 Force for Brabus Bodo
what_happened: Continental developed the SportContact 7 Force ultra-ultra-high-performance derivative to debut as original equipment on the Brabus Bodo.
