The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. A named tuner fitment shows product co-development continuing at the very high-performance edge of the passenger-tire market. Watch independent wet, dry and wear testing and whether the derivative gains further fitments.
title_zh: 大陆集团为 Brabus Bodo 开发 SportContact 7 Force
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团开发了 SportContact 7 Force 这一超超高性能衍生产品，将作为原厂配套首次用于 Brabus Bodo。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。一项具名改装厂配套表明，产品联合开发仍在乘用车轮胎市场的极高性能端持续推进。后续应关注独立的湿地、干地和磨耗测试，以及该衍生产品能否获得更多配套。

title: Linglong says 59/80R63 mining tire remains in factory trials
what_happened: In an investor-platform response, Linglong clarified that its 59/80R63 giant mining tire remained in factory trial and test work rather than mass production. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Negative stage evidence prevents an experimental giant tire from being overstated as commercial output. Watch for completed validation, customer field trials and a separately confirmed production start.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎称 59/80R63 矿用轮胎仍处于厂内试验阶段
what_happened_zh: 在投资者问答平台的一则答复中，玲珑轮胎说明其 59/80R63 巨型矿用轮胎仍处于厂内试制与测试阶段，尚未进入量产。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。这类否定性阶段证据可以避免把一款试验性巨型轮胎夸大为商业产量。后续应关注验证完成情况、客户现场试用以及另行确认的量产启动。

title: Goodyear adds 57 sizes to Blue Streak historic range
what_happened: Goodyear expanded its Blue Streak historic-racing tire range by 57 sizes, broadening fitment coverage for classic competition cars. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Specialty makers continue monetizing small-volume heritage fitments through wider, application-specific portfolios. Track availability by region and whether the added sizes translate into event or restoration-market adoption.
title_zh: 固特异为 Blue Streak 历史赛车轮胎系列新增 57 个规格
what_happened_zh: 固特异将其 Blue Streak 历史赛车轮胎系列扩充了 57 个规格，扩大了经典赛车的配套覆盖范围。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。特种轮胎制造商仍在通过更宽、更具针对性的产品线，把小批量经典车型配套转化为收益。后续应关注各地区的供货情况，以及新增规格能否转化为赛事或复原市场的实际采用。

title: Pirelli prepares new Scorpion AT tires for European Rally Championship debut
what_happened: Pirelli named its new Scorpion AT6 soft and AT8 supersoft products for their competitive debut on Rally Scandinavia's fast gravel roads. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Motorsport is being used as a visible validation stage for a revised gravel-tire portfolio. Watch event results, puncture data and any transfer of construction changes into customer products.
title_zh: 倍耐力备战欧洲拉力锦标赛，新款 Scorpion AT 轮胎将首次参赛
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力公布了新款 Scorpion AT6 软胎和 AT8 超软胎，将在 Rally Scandinavia 的高速砂石路面上完成比赛首次亮相。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。赛车运动正被用作改进后砂石轮胎产品线的可见验证环节。后续应关注赛事成绩、刺穿数据，以及结构改动向量产客户产品的任何转移。

title: Albourgh previews expanded off-highway range for Tire Cologne
what_happened: Albourgh previewed an expanded off-highway tire display for the June Tire Cologne event. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The announcement is useful as an upcoming product lead but is not evidence that the products had launched or entered customer service. Future event preview only; no in-window product launch or customer adoption was established. Recheck after the show for exact products, specifications and customer evidence.
title_zh: Albourgh 预告将在 Tire Cologne 展出扩充的非公路轮胎系列
what_happened_zh: Albourgh 预告了将在 6 月 Tire Cologne 展会上扩大的非公路轮胎展示。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该公告可作为后续产品线索，但并不能证明这些产品已经发布或进入客户使用。属于未来展会预告；报告期内未确立产品发布或客户采用。后续应在展会之后重新核实具体产品、规格和客户证据。

title: Continental grants unrestricted supply approval for Pyrum recovered carbon black
what_happened: Continental granted unrestricted delivery approval for Pyrum's ThermoTireBlack produced on the new 750-kilogram-per-hour milling and pelletizing line in Dillingen after a short-term capability analysis. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. A buyer qualification is stronger circular-material evidence than a pilot sample or memorandum. Track order volumes, tire applications and long-run consistency beyond the short capability study.
title_zh: 大陆集团对 Pyrum 再生炭黑给予无限制供货批准
what_happened_zh: 在一项短期能力分析之后，大陆集团对 Pyrum 在 Dillingen 新建的 750 公斤/小时研磨与造粒生产线所生产的 ThermoTireBlack 给予了无限制交付批准。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。买方的合格认定比中试样品或备忘录构成更有力的循环材料证据。后续应关注订单量、轮胎应用场景，以及超出该短期能力研究之外的长期一致性。

title: Jiangsu project targets bio-based nanosilica and calcium-carbonate capacity
what_happened: A Jiangsu project disclosure described RMB800 million of planned investment for 100,000 tonnes of bio-based nanosilica, 100,000 tonnes of nano calcium carbonate and 65,000 tonnes of activated silica using rice-husk feedstock. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Agricultural-residue silica is moving toward a material-scale project relevant to lower-carbon tire fillers. Verify permits, commissioning, tire-grade specifications and any named customer's qualification data.
title_zh: 江苏项目规划生物基纳米二氧化硅与纳米碳酸钙产能
what_happened_zh: 一份江苏项目披露介绍了 RMB800 million 的计划投资，以稻壳为原料建设 100,000 tonnes 生物基纳米二氧化硅、100,000 tonnes 纳米碳酸钙和 65,000 tonnes 活性二氧化硅产能。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。农业残余物路线的二氧化硅正朝着具备材料规模的项目推进，与更低碳的轮胎填料相关。后续应核实审批、投产、轮胎级规格，以及任何具名客户的认证数据。

title: Enviro files permit and secures site option for first fully owned Nordic pyrolysis plant
what_happened: Enviro applied for an environmental permit and secured an exclusive property option for its first fully owned full-scale pyrolysis plant in the Nordic region. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The project advanced into site-control and permitting, but remained short of a final investment decision. Watch the permit decision, property exercise, financing and final investment approval.
title_zh: Enviro 为首座全资北欧热解工厂提交许可申请并取得场地选择权
what_happened_zh: Enviro 为其在北欧地区首座全资全规模热解工厂申请了环境许可，并取得了一项排他性的地产选择权。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该项目已推进到场地控制和许可申请阶段，但仍未达到最终投资决策。后续应关注许可审批结果、地产选择权的行使、融资以及最终投资批准。

title: Jiangsu project opens second disclosure for 360,000-ton used-tire handling plan
what_happened: A second public disclosure described a RMB130 million project designed to handle 360,000 tonnes of used tires annually, with 60,000 tonnes processed into crumb and reclaimed rubber and the balance traded. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The filing separates true material conversion capacity from the larger collection-and-resale headline number. Watch for environmental approval, construction, commissioning and actual conversion yields.
title_zh: 江苏项目就 360,000-ton 废旧轮胎处理方案进行二次公示
what_happened_zh: 第二次公开公示介绍了一个 RMB130 million 的项目，设计年处理废旧轮胎 360,000 tonnes，其中 60,000 tonnes 加工为胶粉和再生橡胶，其余部分用于贸易。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该公示把真正的材料转化产能与更大的收集转售总量数字区分开来。后续应关注环保审批、工程建设、投产以及实际转化收率。

title: China Resources Recycling delegation reviews Ekovel tire-recycling operation
what_happened: A China Resources Recycling delegation visited Ekovel, whose first phase was described as handling 140,000 tonnes of used tires with output capacity for 50,000 tonnes of recovered carbon black and 56,000 tonnes of oil. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The visit exposes an operating-scale circular-material asset to a large state-backed recycling network, although no transaction was announced. Watch for supply, investment or offtake agreements and verified operating throughput.
title_zh: China Resources Recycling 代表团考察 Ekovel 轮胎回收业务
what_happened_zh: 一个 China Resources Recycling 代表团走访了 Ekovel；该公司一期被描述为可处理废旧轮胎 140,000 tonnes，产出能力为再生炭黑 50,000 tonnes 和油 56,000 tonnes。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。此次走访使一处具备运营规模的循环材料资产接触到大型国资背景回收网络，但未宣布任何交易。后续应关注供应、投资或包销协议，以及经核实的实际运营处理量。

title: Hankook's China plant gains ISCC PLUS certification
what_happened: Hankook reported ISCC PLUS certification for its Jianxing plant in China, the fourth certified site in its global production network. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The certification extends mass-balance and sustainable-feedstock controls into another large tire-production location. Watch for certified product volumes, feedstock shares and customer programs sourced from the site.
title_zh: 韩泰中国工厂获得 ISCC PLUS 认证
what_happened_zh: 韩泰表示，其位于中国的 Jianxing 工厂获得 ISCC PLUS 认证，成为其全球生产网络中第四个获得该认证的基地。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该认证把质量平衡和可持续原料管控延伸到又一处大型轮胎生产基地。后续应关注认证产品产量、原料占比，以及由该基地供货的客户项目。

title: Aeolus plans $390 million Egypt tire-plant joint venture with Prometeon
what_happened: Aeolus disclosed a RMB2.681 billion investment alongside Prometeon in Alexandria, with a 20-month construction plan and annual capacity for 1.5 million truck and bus tires plus 60,000 OTR and agricultural radials. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. A named Chinese manufacturer is moving a cross-border project from general expansion intent to a costed, product-specific plant plan. Watch for final transaction documents, site work, equipment orders and any revision to the 20-month schedule.
title_zh: 风神轮胎计划与 Prometeon 合资建设 $390 million 埃及轮胎工厂
what_happened_zh: 风神轮胎披露将与 Prometeon 共同在 Alexandria 投资 RMB2.681 billion，建设期计划 20 个月，年产能为 1.5 million 条卡车及客车轮胎，另有 60,000 条 OTR 和农业子午线轮胎。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。一家具名中国制造商正把跨境项目从笼统的扩张意向，推进为有明确投资额和产品结构的工厂方案。后续应关注最终交易文件、现场施工、设备订单，以及 20 个月工期的任何调整。

title: Goodyear opens talks over possible 2027 Fayetteville plant closure
what_happened: Goodyear said it was discussing closure of its Fayetteville, North Carolina commercial-tire plant by the end of 2027, a proposal affecting about 1,700 workers. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The proposal would remove a long-standing US commercial-tire asset and continues a broader manufacturing-footprint restructuring. Watch union negotiations, a final decision, closure timing and supply reallocation.
title_zh: 固特异就 Fayetteville 工厂可能在 2027 年关闭展开磋商
what_happened_zh: 固特异表示，正在讨论于 2027 年底关闭其位于北卡罗来纳州 Fayetteville 的商用车轮胎工厂，该方案将影响约 1,700 名员工。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该方案将移除一处长期运营的美国商用车轮胎资产，并延续更大范围的制造布局重组。后续应关注工会谈判、最终决定、关闭时间以及供应的重新分配。

title: Goodyear's Dalian plant receives local Green Factory certification
what_happened: Goodyear's Pulandian plant in Dalian was certified as a Green Factory in Dalian; the report linked the designation to measures including 29,700 solar panels installed in 2023. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Plant-level environmental certification supplies a concrete operating signal, although it is not itself a quantified reduction in tire-level footprint. Look for the certifying authority's criteria and audited energy, water and emissions outcomes.
title_zh: 固特异大连工厂获得地方绿色工厂认定
what_happened_zh: 固特异位于大连的普兰店工厂被认定为大连市绿色工厂；报道将该认定与多项措施相关联，其中包括 2023 年安装的 29,700 块太阳能板。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。工厂层面的环境认定提供了具体的运营信号，但其本身并不等于轮胎层面碳足迹的量化下降。后续应关注认定机构的评价标准，以及经审核的能源、水和排放结果。

title: Ralson marks production of its one-millionth tire
what_happened: Ralson representatives reported production of the company's one-millionth tire as the maker builds its truck-and-bus radial presence. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. An output milestone supplies realized production evidence beyond a plant-capacity announcement. Track product mix, monthly run rate and customer shipments after the milestone.
title_zh: Ralson 庆祝第一百万条轮胎下线
what_happened_zh: Ralson 的代表表示，公司第一百万条轮胎已经下线，该制造商正在扩大其卡车与客车子午线轮胎业务。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。产量里程碑提供了已实现产量的证据，而不只是工厂产能公告。后续应关注里程碑之后的产品结构、月度产出节奏和客户发货情况。

title: Two Hebei tire projects disclose acceptance and construction progress
companies: Dukadi Tire and Hebei Wanda Tire
what_happened: A dated trade-media project screen reported environmental acceptance for phases two and three of Dukadi Tire's 10-million-unit tire and tube project and continuing construction in the same regional cluster. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Acceptance records give a more concrete capacity-stage signal than project promotion alone. Retrieve the underlying acceptance reports and verify stable output before counting full nameplate capacity.
title_zh: 河北两个轮胎项目披露验收与建设进展
what_happened_zh: 一份带日期的行业媒体项目汇总显示，Dukadi Tire 的 10-million-unit 轮胎及内胎项目二期、三期已通过环保验收，同一区域集群内的建设仍在继续。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。验收记录提供了比单纯项目宣传更具体的产能阶段信号。后续应调取相关验收报告，并在按全部铭牌产能计算之前核实产出是否稳定。

title: Sailun expands German replacement distribution with Minrath
what_happened: Sailun and Minrath Group formed a German replacement-market partnership covering summer, winter and all-season tires through 14 dealer and service locations. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The agreement adds a named downstream network to a Chinese maker's European channel expansion. Track stocked sizes, dealer sell-through and whether the arrangement expands beyond the initial network.
title_zh: 赛轮携手 Minrath 扩大德国替换市场分销
what_happened_zh: 赛轮与 Minrath Group 建立德国替换市场合作，通过 14 家经销和服务门店覆盖夏季、冬季和全季轮胎。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该协议为一家中国制造商的欧洲渠道扩张增加了一个具名的下游网络。后续应关注备货规格、经销商的终端销售情况，以及该合作是否会扩展到初始网络之外。

title: The Tyre Group describes integrated online and branch retail model
what_happened: The Tyre Group described how it is integrating ecommerce with physical branches after acquiring Just Tyres. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Independent tire retail is moving toward combined digital acquisition and local fitting capacity rather than treating the two channels separately. Track branch conversion, online-to-store bookings and customer acquisition economics.
title_zh: The Tyre Group 介绍线上与门店一体化的零售模式
what_happened_zh: The Tyre Group 介绍了在收购 Just Tyres 之后，如何把电商业务与实体门店整合起来。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。独立轮胎零售正朝着数字化获客与本地装配能力相结合的方向发展，而不再把两个渠道分开对待。后续应关注门店改造、线上到门店的预约转化，以及获客经济性。

title: ZC Rubber issues Arsenal title congratulations
what_happened: ZC Rubber used its Arsenal partnership in a celebratory brand communication after the club's title win. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The post confirms active sponsorship activation but provides no measurable distribution or sales change. Promotional activation without a disclosed commercial outcome; excluded from the core count. Track campaign reach, dealer activation and any attributable commercial result.
title_zh: 中策橡胶发布祝贺 Arsenal 夺冠的内容
what_happened_zh: 在 Arsenal 夺冠之后，中策橡胶借其与该俱乐部的合作发布了一则庆祝性品牌内容。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该内容确认赞助权益正在激活，但没有提供可衡量的渠道或销售变化。属于未披露商业结果的推广激活；不计入核心内容。后续应关注传播覆盖、经销商联动，以及任何可归因的商业结果。

title: AI-powered robotic tire changers move into public demonstration
what_happened: Automated Tire Inc. publicly demonstrated its SmartBay robotic tire-changing platform in mid-May alongside other emerging automation concepts for workshop service. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Robotics vendors are targeting a labor-intensive service step, but public evidence remains at demonstration rather than scaled deployment. Watch verified cycle time, damage rate, supported wheel range and named workshop deployments.
title_zh: AI 驱动的机器人拆装胎设备进入公开演示阶段
what_happened_zh: Automated Tire Inc. 在 5 月中旬公开演示了其 SmartBay 机器人拆装胎平台，同场还有其他面向门店服务的新兴自动化方案。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。机器人厂商正瞄准一个劳动密集的服务环节，但公开证据仍停留在演示阶段，而非规模化部署。后续应关注经核实的作业循环时间、损伤率、可支持的轮辋范围以及具名门店的部署情况。

title: Dunlop tires gain OE fitment on US-market Subaru Uncharted
what_happened: Sumitomo Rubber Industries began supplying Dunlop SP Sport Maxx 060 and e.Sport Maxx tires in two specified sizes for the North American Subaru Uncharted electric SUV. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. A model- and size-specific nomination provides concrete customer evidence for EV-oriented passenger tires. Watch shipment volume, regional launch timing and follow-on platform nominations.
title_zh: Dunlop 轮胎获得美国市场 Subaru Uncharted 原配配套
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶开始为北美市场的 Subaru Uncharted 纯电 SUV 供应两种指定规格的 Dunlop SP Sport Maxx 060 和 e.Sport Maxx 轮胎。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。按车型和规格确定的提名，为面向电动车的乘用车轮胎提供了具体的客户证据。后续应关注出货量、各地区上市时间以及后续平台提名。

title: AZuR preview says German retreading conditions remain critical
what_happened: A preview of an AZuR survey said respondents viewed the German retreading situation as critical or declining, with full results scheduled for June. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The preview flags demand pressure but withholds the sample and method needed for a core market conclusion. Survey direction is visible, but sample, method and full results were not yet public; excluded from the core count. Review the full presentation for sample size, respondent mix and question wording.
title_zh: AZuR 预览称德国翻新行业状况依然严峻
what_happened_zh: 一份 AZuR 调查的预览称，受访者认为德国翻新行业的状况属于严峻或正在恶化，完整结果定于 6 月公布。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该预览提示了需求压力，但未给出形成核心市场结论所需的样本和方法。调查方向可见，但样本、方法和完整结果尚未公开；不计入核心内容。后续应查阅完整演示材料中的样本量、受访者构成和问题表述。

title: Michelin's universal tire digital twin receives a second in-window technical account
what_happened: A May 25 technical account described Michelin's universal tire digital twin as a modelling framework intended to transfer across tire sizes and operating conditions, following the first public account on 22 May. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. A generalizable virtual model could reduce physical-prototype cycles, but no public industrial baseline or customer result was disclosed. Watch peer-reviewed method detail, validation error across sizes and documented development-time reduction.
title_zh: 米其林通用轮胎数字孪生在报告期内获得第二份技术报道
what_happened_zh: 一篇 5 月 25 日的技术报道将米其林的通用轮胎数字孪生描述为一套旨在跨轮胎规格和运行工况迁移的建模框架，此前 5 月 22 日已有首次公开报道。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。可泛化的虚拟模型有可能减少实物样胎的开发循环，但未披露任何公开的工业基线或客户结果。后续应关注经同行评议的方法细节、跨规格的验证误差，以及有记录的开发时间缩减。

title: Pirelli's new Scorpion AT wins on European rally debut
what_happened: Mikko Heikkila won Rally Scandinavia by more than 23 seconds on the competitive debut of Pirelli's new Scorpion AT gravel range. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The result advances the product thread from a pre-event supply plan to observed competition performance. Watch performance across warmer, rougher events and any construction changes after the debut.
title_zh: 倍耐力全新 Scorpion AT 在欧洲拉力赛首次参赛即夺冠
what_happened_zh: Mikko Heikkila 在倍耐力全新 Scorpion AT 砾石路面产品系列的比赛首秀中，以超过 23 秒的优势赢得 Rally Scandinavia。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该结果使这一产品线索从赛前供胎计划推进到可观察的比赛表现。后续应关注在更炎热、更粗糙赛事中的表现，以及首秀之后是否有结构改动。

title: Bridgestone launches three tires for underground mining
what_happened: Bridgestone launched VMNT, VMDL and VMMS underground-mining tires using its new Subterranean technology platform. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The range targets a high-cost specialty duty cycle with application-specific cut and load management claims. Watch mine trials, casing life, payload data and independent comparison at equal inflation pressure.
title_zh: 普利司通推出三款井下矿用轮胎
what_happened_zh: 普利司通基于其全新 Subterranean 技术平台推出 VMNT、VMDL 和 VMMS 井下矿用轮胎。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该系列面向使用成本较高的特种工作循环，并提出针对具体应用的抗割伤和载荷管理主张。后续应关注矿区试用、胎体寿命、载重数据，以及在相同充气压力下的独立对比。

title: Hankook returns to UUHP segment with Ventus evo Z
what_happened: Hankook launched the Ventus evo Z, its first new ultra-ultra-high-performance product in more than a decade. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The launch refreshes the maker's top performance tier as more brands subdivide premium summer-tire portfolios. Watch independent wet, dry, wear and rolling-resistance comparisons.
title_zh: 韩泰凭 Ventus evo Z 重返 UUHP 细分市场
what_happened_zh: 韩泰推出 Ventus evo Z，这是其十多年来首款全新的超超高性能（UUHP）产品。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该产品更新了这家制造商的最高性能层级，而更多品牌正在细分高端夏季轮胎产品组合。后续应关注独立的湿地、干地、磨耗和滚动阻力对比测试。

title: Prinx previews TBR range for Tire Cologne
what_happened: Prinx previewed a truck-and-bus tire range and possible OTR products for a June exhibition. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The item shows product-marketing direction but not a completed launch or named customer adoption. Future display plans, including a tentative OTR reference, are not treated as a completed product launch. Recheck after the exhibition for exact products, availability and orders.
title_zh: 浦林成山为 Tire Cologne 预告全钢子午线轮胎系列
what_happened_zh: 浦林成山为 6 月的一场展会预告了一个卡客车轮胎系列以及可能的 OTR 产品。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。本条体现了产品营销方向，但并非已完成的产品发布或具名客户采用。未来的展示计划，包括一项初步提及的 OTR 产品，不作为已完成的产品发布看待。后续应在展会结束后重新核查确切产品、供货情况和订单。

title: QuberTech raises GBP3.4 million for engineered-dandelion rubber
what_happened: UK biotech company QuberTech raised GBP3.4 million in combined grant and equity funding to develop natural rubber from engineered dandelions in controlled growing environments. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The funding supports a geographically diversified natural-rubber pathway, though commercial yield and tire qualification remain unproven. Watch hectare-equivalent yields, polymer specifications, pilot scale and tire-compound validation.
title_zh: QuberTech 为工程化蒲公英橡胶融资 GBP3.4 million
what_happened_zh: 英国生物技术公司 QuberTech 获得 GBP3.4 million 的补助与股权组合融资，用于在受控种植环境中以工程化蒲公英生产天然橡胶。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该笔资金支持一条地域更为分散的天然橡胶路径，但商业化产量和轮胎认证仍未得到证实。后续应关注每公顷当量产量、聚合物规格、中试规模以及轮胎胶料验证。

title: PetroChina Guangxi reports successful production of functional SSBR grade
what_happened: PetroChina Guangxi reported successful production of dual-end functional SSBR2055DF2 from its 120,000-tonne-per-year solution-SBR project after outreach to 27 tire companies. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. A domestic functional SSBR grade has crossed into plant production, potentially broadening local supply for performance-tire compounds. Watch tire-company qualification, stable commercial batches and independently measured compound performance.
title_zh: 中国石油广西石化称功能化 SSBR 牌号生产成功
what_happened_zh: 中国石油广西石化称，其年产 120,000 tonnes 的溶聚丁苯橡胶（SSBR）项目在向 27 家轮胎企业开展推介后，成功生产出双端功能化 SSBR2055DF2。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。一个国产功能化 SSBR 牌号已进入装置生产阶段，有望扩大高性能轮胎胶料的本地供应。后续应关注轮胎企业的认证、稳定的商业化批次，以及经独立测定的胶料性能。

title: Post-cutoff report documents May 29 permit notice for 200,000-ton green-silica project
what_happened: A 2 June report reproduced details of a 29 May Changle County land-planning notice for a RMB1.02 billion carbon-dioxide-carbonation silica project planned in three phases. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The underlying in-window permit is material, but the exact public page was not recoverable during this run and the accessible account is post-cutoff. The accessible source was published after cutoff and the original May 29 county notice was not recovered; retained as context only. Recover and archive the original county notice before promoting the item into a historical core edition.
title_zh: 后截止期报道记录 5 月 29 日 200,000-ton 绿色白炭黑项目的许可公示
what_happened_zh: 一篇 6 月 2 日的报道转述了 5 月 29 日昌乐县一份用地规划公示的细节，内容涉及一个 RMB1.02 billion 的二氧化碳碳化法白炭黑项目，计划分三期建设。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。作为依据的报告期内许可事项具有实质意义，但本轮工作未能找回确切的公开页面，可获取的报道又发布于截止期之后。可获取来源发布于证据截止之后，且 5 月 29 日的原始县级公示未被找回；本条仅作为背景信息保留。后续应在将本条提升为历史核心内容之前，找回并归档原始的县级公示。

title: ZC Rubber's Jintan electric-curing factory reaches full operation
what_happened: A Jintan government report said ZC Rubber's locally developed electric-curing intelligent factory reached full operation in May, with stated daily output of about 24,500 passenger and light-commercial tires. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The plant combines electric curing with a complete operating line and reported process and performance metrics rather than a future-only factory concept. Watch audited energy intensity, stable yield and independent validation of the product-performance claims.
title_zh: 中策橡胶金坛电硫化工厂实现满负荷运行
what_happened_zh: 金坛区一份政府报道称，中策橡胶自主开发的电硫化智能工厂已于 5 月实现满负荷运行，并称日产量约为 24,500 条乘用车和轻型商用车轮胎。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该工厂把电硫化与完整的运行生产线结合在一起，并公布了工艺和性能指标，而不只是一个仅停留在未来的工厂概念。后续应关注经审计的能耗强度、稳定的成品率，以及对产品性能主张的独立验证。

title: Apollo sets FY2027 India and Europe capacity investment plan
what_happened: Apollo outlined INR35 billion of FY2027 capital expenditure, with INR30 billion for India and INR5 billion for Europe, focused mainly on truck and passenger radial capacity. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. High stated utilization is translating into a geographic capacity program while the company also restructures its European footprint. Watch board-approved project breakdowns, commissioning schedules and utilization after expansion.
title_zh: Apollo 制定 FY2027 印度与欧洲产能投资计划
what_happened_zh: Apollo 提出 FY2027 资本支出 INR35 billion，其中 INR30 billion 用于印度、INR5 billion 用于欧洲，重点投向卡车和乘用车子午线轮胎产能。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。较高的宣称产能利用率正在转化为一项分地区的产能计划，同时公司也在重组其欧洲布局。后续应关注经董事会批准的项目拆分、投产时间表以及扩产后的产能利用率。

title: Linglong shareholders approve termination of Tongchuan factory project
what_happened: Linglong's 27 May extraordinary shareholder meeting approved termination of the planned Tongchuan project for 15.2 million radial tires and 500,000 retreads. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Shareholder approval completes a governance gate that was still pending when the proposed termination was first announced. Watch recovery of roughly RMB380 million in preliminary land and project spending and any capacity reallocation.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎股东会批准终止铜川工厂项目
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎 5 月 27 日召开的临时股东大会批准终止规划中的铜川项目，该项目原计划年产 15.2 million 条子午线轮胎和 500,000 条翻新轮胎。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。股东批准完成了此前首次公告拟终止时尚未走完的一道治理程序。后续应关注约 RMB380 million 前期土地及项目支出的收回情况，以及是否有产能重新配置。

title: Linglong terminates proposed Brazil tire-factory joint venture
what_happened: Linglong disclosed termination of its proposed Brazil factory joint venture with Sunset after the parties did not reach agreement on final core terms. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The filing removes a previously anticipated overseas capacity route and highlights negotiation risk before a project reaches substantive construction. Watch alternative overseas site selection and accounting for any Brazil-project costs.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎终止拟设巴西轮胎工厂合资项目
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎披露，因双方未能就最终核心条款达成一致，其与 Sunset 拟设的巴西工厂合资项目已终止。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该公告取消了一条此前被预期的海外产能路径，并凸显出项目进入实质建设之前的谈判风险。后续应关注替代的海外选址，以及巴西项目相关费用的会计处理。

title: Continental inaugurates EUR300 million Rayong plant expansion
what_happened: Continental inaugurated a Rayong, Thailand expansion adding three million passenger and light-truck tires per year and starting local radial motorcycle-tire production. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The project is operating capacity, not a proposal, and expands both volume and product mix in Southeast Asia. Track utilization, regional shipment mix and verified water- and energy-intensity data.
title_zh: 大陆集团为 EUR300 million 罗勇工厂扩建项目举行启用仪式
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团为位于泰国罗勇的扩建项目举行启用仪式，该项目新增每年三百万条乘用车和轻型载重轮胎产能，并开始本地生产摩托车子午线轮胎。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该项目属于已投运产能，而非规划提案，同时扩大了东南亚的产量和产品结构。后续应跟踪产能利用率、区域出货结构，以及经核实的水耗和能耗强度数据。

title: Goodyear Dalian quiet-tire project adds 1.6 million-unit foam line
what_happened: A May 25 trade report on a May 21 acceptance disclosure described a Dalian project adding annual capacity for 1.6 million foam-based quiet tires while reducing ordinary passenger-car tire capacity to 13.48 million units. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The project changes product mix toward noise-reduction technology without increasing the site's total ordinary passenger-tire line on a like-for-like basis. Retrieve the acceptance file and track utilization, scrap and named OE or replacement programs.
title_zh: 固特异大连静音轮胎项目新增 1.6 million 条泡棉生产线
what_happened_zh: 一篇 5 月 25 日的行业报道介绍了 5 月 21 日的一份验收披露，称大连一个项目新增年产 1.6 million 条泡棉静音轮胎的产能，同时将普通乘用车轮胎产能缩减至 13.48 million 条。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该项目在不按同口径增加厂区普通乘用车轮胎总产能的前提下，把产品结构向降噪技术倾斜。后续应调取验收文件，并跟踪产能利用率、废品率以及具名的原配或替换市场项目。

title: JK Tyre advances truck and passenger radial expansions
what_happened: JK Tyre described ongoing truck-and-bus radial expansion at Chennai and Vikrant alongside passenger-radial expansion at Chennai after record annual volumes and revenue. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Demand and utilization evidence is being followed by product-specific capacity additions rather than a general capex statement alone. Watch commissioning dates, added units and utilization after ramp-up.
title_zh: JK Tyre 推进卡车与乘用车子午线轮胎扩产
what_happened_zh: JK Tyre 表示，在年度销量和营收创纪录之后，公司正在金奈和 Vikrant 推进全钢子午线轮胎扩产，并在金奈同步扩建乘用车子午线产能。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。需求和产能利用率方面的证据，正被具体产品的产能新增所接续，而不仅仅是一份笼统的资本支出表述。后续应关注投产日期、新增条数和爬坡后的产能利用率。

title: Prinx signs equipment contracts for Malaysia-base expansion
what_happened: Prinx Malaysia signed three equipment-purchase contracts totaling RMB116.072 million for the second stage of its Malaysia production base. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Equipment commitments move a Chinese maker's overseas project beyond general construction language toward an executable production package. Watch delivery, installation, commissioning and the capacity tied to the purchased systems.
title_zh: 浦林成山为马来西亚基地扩建签署设备合同
what_happened_zh: 浦林成山马来西亚公司为其马来西亚生产基地二期签署了三份设备采购合同，合同总金额为 RMB116.072 million。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。设备承诺把这家中国制造商的海外项目从笼统的建设表述推进为可执行的生产装备方案。后续应关注交付、安装、调试，以及与所采购系统相对应的产能。

title: TVS Srichakra approves two-wheeler and off-highway capacity investment
what_happened: TVS Srichakra's board approved up to INR2.2 billion for capacity expansion at Vellaripatti, split equally between two-wheeler and off-highway tire facilities. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The board action translates demand claims into a costed investment decision across two product segments. Watch capacity increments, construction schedule and realized segment volumes.
title_zh: TVS Srichakra 批准两轮车与非公路轮胎产能投资
what_happened_zh: TVS Srichakra 董事会批准在 Vellaripatti 投入不超过 INR2.2 billion 用于产能扩建，资金在两轮车和非公路轮胎设施之间平均分配。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。董事会决议把需求主张转化为一项有明确金额的投资决定，覆盖两个产品板块。后续应关注产能增量、建设进度和实际实现的板块销量。

title: Hantaiwei tire project tops out mixing center and begins equipment installation
what_happened: A May 30 report on 26 May site progress said Hantaiwei's mixing-center structure and core equipment foundations were complete and main equipment was entering installation at a RMB980 million project. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The project has moved into a verifiable construction-and-installation stage ahead of planned line commissioning. Watch first-tire output, trial-production quality and whether the 1.2 million truck and 50,000 mining-tire plan is phased as stated.
title_zh: Hantaiwei 轮胎项目密炼中心封顶并启动设备安装
what_happened_zh: 一篇 5 月 30 日的报道介绍了 5 月 26 日的现场进展，称 Hantaiwei 密炼中心主体结构和核心设备基础已完成，主要设备正进入安装阶段，该项目投资为 RMB980 million。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。项目已进入可核实的建设与安装阶段，为计划中的生产线投产做准备。后续应关注首胎下线、试生产质量，以及 1.2 million 条卡车轮胎和 50,000 条矿用轮胎的规划是否按所述分期实施。

title: Shandong Tongyi's second-phase tire plant reaches 90% structural completion
what_happened: Trade reporting put the second phase of Shandong Tongyi's RMB3.64 billion tire project at 90% structural completion, with the 6-million-unit passenger-tire phase scheduled for equipment installation from September. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. A quantified construction milestone improves visibility on a large Shandong capacity build beyond its announced nameplate. Watch the June structural milestone, equipment installation and November trial-production evidence.
title_zh: Shandong Tongyi 二期轮胎工厂主体结构完成度达 90%
what_happened_zh: 行业报道称，Shandong Tongyi 投资 RMB3.64 billion 的轮胎项目二期主体结构完成度已达 90%，其中 6-million 条乘用车轮胎阶段计划自 9 月起进入设备安装。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。一个量化的建设节点，使这项大型山东产能建设的可见度超出其公布的设计产能。后续应关注 6 月的主体结构节点、设备安装，以及 11 月的试生产证据。

title: HF opens second India unit for tire-mixing equipment service
what_happened: HF Group opened an additional Bengaluru unit after taking full ownership of its India subsidiary, adding local rebuilding, repair, overhaul and new mixing-equipment support. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. Localization brings tire-mixing equipment service and modernization closer to customers in a growing production market. Watch customer contracts, service capacity and locally delivered equipment orders.
title_zh: HF 在印度开设第二家轮胎密炼设备服务机构
what_happened_zh: HF Group 在完成对其印度子公司的全资控股后，在班加罗尔新增一家机构，提供本地的设备翻修、维修、大修以及新密炼设备支持。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。本地化使轮胎密炼设备的服务和升级改造更贴近这一增长中的生产市场的客户。后续应关注客户合同、服务能力和本地交付的设备订单。

title: EU supplemental disclosure points to lower China tire antidumping rates
what_happened: A report on the European Commission's 26 May supplemental disclosure said proposed antidumping rates on Chinese passenger and light-truck tires had been revised to a 4.3%-45.3% range ahead of a planned final measure in June. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The revision changes the prospective market-access burden across exporters, while remaining non-final during the reporting week. Verify the final regulation, company-specific rates and effective date after the consultation stage.
title_zh: EU 补充披露指向更低的中国轮胎反倾销税率
what_happened_zh: 一则关于欧盟委员会 5 月 26 日补充披露的报道称，针对中国乘用车和轻型载重轮胎的拟征反倾销税率已修订为 4.3%-45.3% 区间，最终措施计划于 6 月出台。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。此次修订改变了各出口商未来面临的市场准入负担，但在本报告周内仍非最终结果。后续应在磋商阶段结束后核实最终法规、企业专属税率和生效日期。

title: Continental uses Shanghai anniversary pop-up to outline China retail-chain strategy
what_happened: Continental opened a 28-31 May Shanghai pop-up marking 20 years in China and described a strategy to develop a mid- and high-end retail chain in the market. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The maker is pairing brand activation with a concrete downstream network direction rather than a one-off exhibition alone. Watch store count, ownership or franchise model, regional rollout and service economics.
title_zh: 大陆集团借上海周年快闪活动阐述中国零售连锁战略
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团在上海举办 5 月 28-31 日的快闪活动，纪念进入中国 20 年，并介绍了在该市场发展中高端零售连锁体系的战略。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。这家制造商正把品牌活动与明确的下游渠道方向结合起来，而不只是举办一次性展览。后续应关注门店数量、自营或加盟模式、区域铺开节奏以及服务经济性。

title: Advance previews Vietnam-made passenger tires for European show debut
what_happened: Advance said Vietnam-made passenger tires would be shown in Europe at June's Tire Cologne event and described Morocco production as a later objective. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The announcement is a market-entry lead but does not establish in-window European sales or completed Morocco capacity. Future show appearance and stated market intent, without current customer adoption; excluded from the core count. Recheck after the show for distributor orders, certifications and actual regional availability.
title_zh: Advance 预告越南制造乘用车轮胎将在欧洲展会首次亮相
what_happened_zh: Advance 表示，越南制造的乘用车轮胎将在 6 月的 Tire Cologne 展会上于欧洲亮相，并把摩洛哥生产列为后续目标。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。该公告是一条市场进入线索，但并未确立报告期内的欧洲销售或已建成的摩洛哥产能。未来的展会亮相和所述市场意图，缺少当期客户采用证据；不计入核心内容。后续应在展会结束后重新核查经销商订单、认证以及实际的区域供货情况。

title: Yokohama ADVAN V61 selected for new Mazda CX-5
what_happened: Yokohama announced ADVAN V61 size 225/65R17 102V as original equipment for new Mazda CX-5 models in Japan and Europe. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. A named model, region and size constitute concrete customer evidence for the crossover tire line. Watch shipment volumes and whether the fitment extends to other regions or sizes.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶 ADVAN V61 获选新款马自达 CX-5 原配轮胎
what_happened_zh: 横滨橡胶宣布，ADVAN V61 规格 225/65R17 102V 成为日本和欧洲市场新款马自达 CX-5 车型的原配轮胎。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。具名车型、地区和规格构成了这条跨界车轮胎产品线的具体客户证据。后续应关注出货量，以及该配套是否会扩展到其他地区或规格。

title: Prometeon previews fleet-strategy focus for upcoming RTX show
what_happened: Prometeon previewed a truck-tire and fleet-strategy display for a future RTX event. The item records a concrete change in the tire-and-rubber value chain. The item identifies a service theme but supplies no in-window customer contract or operating result. Future event preview only; retained as a follow-up lead and excluded from the core count. Review post-event product, fleet and contract disclosures.
title_zh: Prometeon 为即将举行的 RTX 展会预告车队战略重点
what_happened_zh: Prometeon 预告了面向未来一届 RTX 活动的卡车轮胎与车队战略展示。本条记录了轮胎与橡胶价值链中的一项具体变化。本条识别出一个服务主题，但未提供报告期内的客户合同或运营结果。仅为未来活动预告；作为后续跟踪线索保留，不计入核心内容。后续应查阅活动结束后的产品、车队和合同披露。

title: Pirelli buys 30 per cent of Univrses and folds AI computer vision into Cyber Tyre
what_happened: Tire Review reported on 2 June 2026 that Pirelli signed an agreement to integrate Swedish firm Univrses' AI computer-vision technology into its Cyber Tyre platform, and took a 30 per cent equity stake in Univrses with an option to move to a majority holding. Per the report, tyre-sensor data processed through Cyber Tyre is fused with onboard camera imagery interpreted by Univrses software; a first deployment ran in Italy from 2025 with the Apulia region, monitoring the regional road network. No financial terms beyond the stake, and no performance metrics, were disclosed. Tyre makers are buying perception software rather than licensing it, which reframes the smart tyre from a sensor product into a data platform whose customers can be road authorities as well as carmakers. An equity stake with a majority option signals Pirelli intends to own the perception layer, not rent it, and the Apulia deployment shows the near-term buyer is a public road authority rather than an OEM. That is a different revenue model from OE fitment and a different competitive set. Treat the technical fusion description as reported rather than verified: no Pirelli press release for this deal was recoverable. Watch whether Pirelli exercises the majority option, and whether any ADAS or autonomous-driving programme adopts the fused Cyber Tyre and camera output.
title_zh: 倍耐力收购 Univrses 百分之 30 股权，把 AI 计算机视觉并入 Cyber Tyre
what_happened_zh: Tire Review 在 2026 年 6 月 2 日报道，倍耐力已签署协议，将瑞典企业 Univrses 的 AI 计算机视觉技术整合进自有的 Cyber Tyre 平台，并取得 Univrses 百分之 30 的股权，同时拥有增持至控股的选择权。据该报道，经 Cyber Tyre 处理的轮胎传感数据，与由 Univrses 软件解读的车载摄像头图像相融合；首个部署自 2025 年起在意大利与 Apulia 大区合作开展，用于监测该区域路网。除股权比例之外，未披露任何财务条款，也未披露性能指标。轮胎企业正在收购而不是授权许可感知软件，这把智能轮胎从一款传感产品重新定义为一个数据平台，其客户既可以是整车厂，也可以是道路管理部门。带控股选择权的股权投资表明，倍耐力意在自己掌握感知层而不是租用，而 Apulia 的部署显示近期买方是公共道路管理机构而不是整车厂。这与原配配套是不同的收入模式，面对的也是不同的竞争对手。技术融合的描述应作为报道内容而非已核实事实对待：未能找回倍耐力就此交易发布的新闻稿。后续应关注倍耐力是否行使控股选择权，以及是否有 ADAS 或自动驾驶项目采用融合后的 Cyber Tyre 与摄像头输出。

title: Sumitomo Rubber and Fujitsu cut tyre structural analysis from 45 minutes to 5 with a graph-neural-network surrogate model
what_happened: In a joint release dated 3 June 2026, Sumitomo Rubber Industries and Fujitsu said they have developed an AI surrogate model that predicts tyre deformation and road-contact behaviour on meshes of about 600,000 elements, cutting one structural analysis from about 45 minutes to about 5 minutes. The companies report 87.7 per cent average accuracy for contact-shape prediction against conventional finite-element analysis, describe the work as a completed proof of concept rather than a production tool, and set April 2027 as the target for practical operation of a design-support tool at DUNLOP. Tyre makers are beginning to treat trained surrogate models, not faster solvers, as the way past the accuracy-versus-runtime trade-off in tyre CAE, which also ties tyre development roadmaps to specific compute platforms. A ten-fold cut in analysis turnaround changes how many design variants a tyre engineer can screen before committing to tooling, so it compresses development cycles for competitors that can reproduce it and widens the gap for those still limited by full FEM runs. The 87.7 per cent accuracy figure and the April 2027 target also mark the practical boundary: this is a screening accelerator with a stated error margin, not a validated replacement for FEM sign-off. Watch whether the promised design-support tool reaches operation at DUNLOP by April 2027, and whether the FUJITSU-MONAKA prototype verification due to start by December 2026 reports inference speed, accuracy and power-efficiency figures.
title_zh: 住友橡胶与 Fujitsu 以图神经网络代理模型把轮胎结构分析从 45 分钟压缩到 5 分钟
what_happened_zh: 在 2026 年 6 月 3 日的联合发布中，住友橡胶工业（DUNLOP）与 Fujitsu 表示，双方已开发出一套 AI 代理模型，可在约 600,000 个单元的网格上预测轮胎变形与接地行为，把一次结构分析从约 45 分钟缩短到约 5 分钟。两家公司报告称，相对传统有限元分析，接地印痕预测的平均精度为百分之 87.7；它们把这项工作描述为已完成的概念验证而不是量产工具，并把设计支持工具在 DUNLOP 投入实际运行的目标定在 2027 年 4 月。轮胎企业开始把训练好的代理模型、而不是更快的求解器，当作绕过轮胎 CAE 中精度与运行时间取舍的途径，这也把轮胎开发路线图与特定算力平台绑定在一起。分析周转时间缩短十倍，会改变轮胎工程师在投入模具之前能够筛选多少设计变体，因此会压缩那些能够复现这一能力的竞争对手的开发周期，并拉大仍受完整有限元计算限制的企业的差距。百分之 87.7 的精度数字和 2027 年 4 月的目标同时划出了实用边界：这是一个带有明确误差范围的筛选加速工具，而不是经过验证的有限元终审替代方案。后续应关注所承诺的设计支持工具能否在 2027 年 4 月之前在 DUNLOP 投入运行，以及计划于 2026 年 12 月之前启动的 FUJITSU-MONAKA 原型验证是否会给出推理速度、精度和能效数据。

title: Prinx Chengshan closes a 20-month rubber fatigue and life-prediction project with Qingdao University of Science and Technology
companies: Prinx Chengshan; Qingdao University of Science and Technology
what_happened: Prinx Chengshan said on 5 June 2026 that its joint project with Professor Yong Zhanfu's team at Qingdao University of Science and Technology, 'Rubber fatigue mechanisms and service-life prediction technology development', has formally concluded after about 20 months, having started in July 2024. The company says the project delivered a standardised, transferable rubber-fatigue optimisation method and trained its own engineers in rubber materials and tyre simulation. No test data, fatigue-life figures or percentage improvements are published. Shandong tyre makers are contracting fatigue and durability modelling capability from local polymer universities rather than building it in-house, which turns a regional research cluster into shared industrial infrastructure. Fatigue-life prediction is the constraint on how aggressively a maker can cut weight and rolling resistance without losing durability margin, so an in-house prediction method has more compounding value than a single product launch. The absence of any published metric is the limit: the announcement establishes that the project closed and that a method was handed over, not that predicted lives match measured ones. Watch whether Prinx Chengshan publishes fatigue or durability figures for products designed with the method, or whether the work appears as a peer-reviewed output from the QUST team.
title_zh: 浦林成山与青岛科技大学完成为期 20 个月的橡胶疲劳与寿命预测项目
what_happened_zh: 浦林成山 2026 年 6 月 5 日表示，公司与青岛科技大学 Yong Zhanfu 教授团队的联合项目《橡胶疲劳机理与使用寿命预测技术开发》已正式结题；该项目自 2024 年 7 月启动，历时约 20 个月。公司称，项目交付了一套标准化、可迁移的橡胶疲劳优化方法，并培养了自有工程师在橡胶材料与轮胎仿真方面的能力。未公布任何测试数据、疲劳寿命数值或改善百分比。山东轮胎企业正从本地高分子院校承接疲劳与耐久建模能力，而不是完全自建，这把一个区域研究集群变成了共享的产业基础设施。疲劳寿命预测决定了一家企业能在不损失耐久余量的前提下，把减重和滚动阻力压到多低，因此一套自有预测方法的复利价值高于一次单独的产品发布。缺少任何公开指标是其局限：公告只能表明项目已经结题、方法已经移交，而不能表明预测寿命与实测寿命一致。后续应关注浦林成山是否公布采用该方法设计的产品的疲劳或耐久数据，以及这项工作是否以青岛科技大学团队的同行评议成果形式发表。

title: Qingdao researchers report a silane-terminated liquid polyisoprene that bridges silica and SSBR at 4 phr
companies: Qingdao University of Science and Technology
what_happened: A peer-reviewed paper published online in Polymers on 6 June 2026 by a Qingdao University of Science and Technology team reports a functionalised liquid polyisoprene rubber made by adding an alkoxysilane functionalising agent at the termination step of anionic polymerisation. FT-IR and proton NMR confirmed silyl groups on the chain ends. Adding the material to an SSBR/silica compound raised tensile strength, 300 per cent modulus and bound-rubber content relative to the compound without it, with 4 phr giving the best overall balance. The authors attribute the effect to reaction between silyl groups and silica surface hydroxyls plus co-crosslinking with SSBR. Silica dispersion is the practical ceiling on how far a low-rolling-resistance tread compound can be pushed, and a chain-end-functionalised liquid rubber is a cheaper intervention than reformulating the polymer backbone. The result is laboratory-scale: bound rubber and tensile data say the interface improved, not that a finished tyre gains rolling resistance or wear. Watch whether the group or a Shandong compounder reports pilot-scale mixing trials, or tyre-level rolling-resistance and wet-grip data, for a compound using the functionalised liquid rubber.
title_zh: 青岛研究人员报告一种硅烷封端液体聚异戊二烯，可在 4 phr 下桥联白炭黑与 SSBR
what_happened_zh: 在 2026 年 6 月 6 日于《Polymers》上线发表的一篇同行评议论文中，青岛科技大学团队报告了一种功能化液体聚异戊二烯橡胶，其制备方法是在阴离子聚合的终止步骤加入烷氧基硅烷功能化试剂。FT-IR 与质子 NMR 确认了链端的硅烷基团。将该材料加入 SSBR 与白炭黑胶料后，相对不含该材料的胶料，拉伸强度、百分之 300 定伸模量和结合胶含量均有提高，其中 4 phr 给出最佳的综合平衡。作者把这一效果归因于硅烷基团与白炭黑表面羟基的反应，以及与 SSBR 的共交联。白炭黑分散是低滚动阻力胎面胶料可以推进的实际上限，而链端功能化的液体橡胶，是比重新设计聚合物主链更便宜的干预手段。该结果仍属实验室规模：结合胶与拉伸数据说明界面得到改善，而不能说明成品轮胎在滚动阻力或磨耗上有所获益。后续应关注该团队或某家山东胶料企业是否报告中试规模的混炼试验，或是否报告采用这种功能化液体橡胶的胶料在轮胎层面的滚动阻力与湿地抓地数据。

title: Nexen launches a single UHP fitment for EV and combustion cars, developed with AI prediction and a driving simulator
what_happened: Nexen Tire said on 2 June 2026 that it launched the N'FERA Primus UX ultra-high-performance replacement tyre in Korea on 1 June, with rollout planned across Asia-Pacific and the Middle East. The tyre is built around a 'One Universal Fit' strategy covering electric, combustion and SUV platforms and carries Nexen's own EV ROOT mark. Nexen says development used an AI-based performance prediction system together with a high-dynamic driving simulator it describes as an industry first in Korea, and claims a 20 per cent tread-wear improvement over the predecessor product. A single-SKU strategy that spans EV and combustion fitments is the commercial answer to EV-specific ranges fragmenting dealer inventory, and it puts the burden on virtual development to prove one construction can satisfy both duty cycles. If one UHP line genuinely covers both powertrains, distributors carry fewer SKUs for the same coverage, which matters more to channel economics than any single performance figure. The claim is currently company-stated: the 20 per cent wear gain has no published test method and is not tied to the AI system, so it cannot yet be read as independently validated. Watch for Independent wear or rolling-resistance results for the N'FERA Primus UX, and whether the EV ROOT mark is defined against a published test protocol.
title_zh: Nexen 推出面向电动车与燃油车的单一 UHP 配套产品，开发中结合 AI 预测与驾驶模拟器
what_happened_zh: Nexen Tire 2026 年 6 月 2 日表示，其 N'FERA Primus UX 超高性能替换轮胎已于 6 月 1 日在韩国上市，并计划向亚太和中东地区推广。该产品围绕一条覆盖电动、燃油和 SUV 平台的“One Universal Fit”策略构建，带有 Nexen 自有的 EV ROOT 标识。Nexen 称，开发中使用了基于 AI 的性能预测系统，以及一台被其描述为韩国业内首创的高动态驾驶模拟器，并声称胎面磨耗相对上一代产品改善百分之 20。横跨电动与燃油配套的单一 SKU 策略，是对电动专用产品线割裂经销商库存的商业回应，同时把举证责任压到虚拟开发上，要求它证明一套结构可以同时满足两种工况。如果一条 UHP 产品线真能覆盖两种动力形式，经销商就能以更少的 SKU 实现同样的覆盖面，这对渠道经济性的意义大于任何单项性能数字。目前这一主张仍属公司自述：百分之 20 的磨耗改善没有公布测试方法，也没有与该 AI 系统挂钩，因此尚不能视为经独立验证。后续应关注 N'FERA Primus UX 的独立磨耗或滚动阻力结果，以及 EV ROOT 标识是否依据公开的测试规程来界定。

title: Bridgestone names virtual development and on-track validation as the route to Maserati's MCPURA fitment
what_happened: Bridgestone announced on 3 June 2026 that it is the exclusive tyre partner for the Maserati MCPURA, with bespoke Potenza Sport tyres in 245/35 ZR20 95Y front and 305/30 ZR20 103Y rear, carrying the MGT Maserati Genuine Tyres sidewall marking and developed and produced in Europe. Bridgestone says it used its Virtual Tyre Development and predictive simulation tools to optimise the design early and converge on the final specification faster, then confirmed performance in joint on-track validation with Maserati. The commercially interesting part is not the fitment but the stated sequence: simulation first to narrow the specification, physical track work only to confirm it. That is the workflow premium makers are using to keep bespoke low-volume OE programmes economic, and it is the same capability Sumitomo Rubber and Fujitsu are trying to accelerate with surrogate models. Watch whether Bridgestone carries the MCPURA compound and carcass work into its replacement Potenza range, which the release says bespoke UHP development is intended to feed.
title_zh: 普利司通称虚拟开发与赛道验证是拿下 Maserati MCPURA 配套的路径
what_happened_zh: 普利司通 2026 年 6 月 3 日宣布，公司是 Maserati MCPURA 的独家轮胎合作伙伴，提供定制 Potenza Sport 轮胎，前胎为 245/35 ZR20 95Y、后胎为 305/30 ZR20 103Y，带有 MGT Maserati Genuine Tyres 胎侧标识，并在欧洲完成开发与生产。普利司通表示，公司使用自有的虚拟轮胎开发与预测仿真工具，在早期优化设计并更快收敛到最终规格，随后与 Maserati 共同通过赛道验证确认性能。商业上值得注意的不是这次配套，而是其所述的顺序：先用仿真收窄规格，再用实车赛道工作仅作确认。这正是各家制造商用来维持定制化小批量原配项目经济性的工作流红利，也正是住友橡胶与 Fujitsu 试图用代理模型加速的同一种能力。后续应关注普利司通是否把 MCPURA 的配方与胎体工作延续到其替换市场 Potenza 产品线，该发布称定制超高性能开发正是为此服务。

title: Goodyear will supply lunar tyres for the Pegasus rover, with crewed missions targeted from 2028
companies: Goodyear; Lunar Outpost; NASA Artemis programme
what_happened: Goodyear said on 3 June 2026 that it will supply advanced lunar tyres for Lunar Outpost's Pegasus Lunar Terrain Vehicle under NASA's Artemis programme, with the vehicle expected to support astronaut missions from 2028 and to operate at the lunar South Pole. Pegasus development is led by Lunar Outpost with General Motors, Goodyear and Leidos. Goodyear names extreme temperature swings, rocky surfaces and low gravity as the design constraints; the release discloses no contract value, tyre construction details or test results. Extreme-environment programmes are where airless and metallic-structure tyre concepts get funded and instrumented, and that work has historically fed back into terrestrial off-road and agricultural products. For a maker in the middle of a cost-reduction programme, it is also a low-volume, high-visibility technology platform rather than a revenue line. Watch for Publication of tyre construction or test data ahead of the 2028 mission window, and whether Goodyear's non-pneumatic work surfaces in commercial off-highway or agricultural products.
title_zh: 固特异将为 Pegasus 月面车供应月球轮胎，载人任务目标自 2028 年起
what_happened_zh: 固特异 2026 年 6 月 3 日表示，公司将在 NASA 的 Artemis 计划下，为 Lunar Outpost 的 Pegasus 月面地形车供应先进月球轮胎；该车预计自 2028 年起支持航天员任务，并将在月球南极作业。Pegasus 的开发由 Lunar Outpost 牵头，参与方包括 General Motors、固特异和 Leidos。固特异把极端温差、多岩石表面和低重力列为设计约束；该发布未披露合同金额、轮胎结构细节或测试结果。极端环境项目是无气轮胎和金属结构轮胎概念得到资金和实测机会的场合，这类工作在历史上也会反馈到地面非公路和农业产品。对一家正处在降本计划中的制造商而言，它同时是一个低产量、高曝光度的技术平台，而不是一条收入线。后续应关注 2028 年任务窗口之前是否公布轮胎结构或测试数据，以及固特异的非充气轮胎工作是否出现在商用非公路或农业产品中。

title: Triangle's civil aviation radial tyres clear CAAC design and production authorisation
companies: Triangle Tyre; Civil Aviation Administration of China
what_happened: Tyrepress reported on 3 June 2026 that Triangle Tyre's civil aviation radial tyres received a China Civil Aviation Technical Standard Order Authorization from the Civil Aviation Administration of China on 11 May 2026, which the article describes as the formal CAAC sign-off for the design and production of aviation components. Triangle's own announcement of 23 May 2026 states the certificate covers four civil aviation radial tyre part numbers intended for mainstream aircraft including the C919 and the Airbus A320, that the regulator tracked manufacturing and testing on site including static load, high-speed rolling and extreme ambient temperature trials, and that development began in 2017. Aviation tyres are one of the last tyre categories where Chinese makers have had no domestic design-and-production authorisation, so a CTSOA changes who can bid for Chinese civil aircraft programmes rather than just who can supply parts. The scope is narrow for now: four part numbers, and a Chinese authorisation carries no automatic recognition elsewhere. This is a recap. The certification itself is dated 11 May 2026 and Triangle announced it on its own site on 23 May 2026, both before this reporting window; the in-window trade-press page is a subscriber-gated extract that adds the certificate name, authority and date but no new stage. The CAAC record itself was not opened, and no aircraft programme or customer is named, so the authorisation's commercial scope is unknown. Watch whether Triangle names an aircraft programme or airline customer under the CTSOA, and whether any non-Chinese authority recognises or duplicates the approval.
title_zh: 三角轮胎民用航空子午线轮胎通过 CAAC 设计与生产批准
what_happened_zh: Tyrepress 在 2026 年 6 月 3 日报道，三角轮胎的民用航空子午线轮胎于 2026 年 5 月 11 日获得中国民用航空局颁发的中国民用航空技术标准规定项目批准书，该文章把它描述为航空零部件设计与生产的 CAAC 正式认可。三角轮胎自身 2026 年 5 月 23 日的公告称，该证书覆盖四个民用航空子午线轮胎件号，面向包括 C919 和 Airbus A320 在内的主流机型；监管部门在现场跟踪了制造与测试，包括静态负荷、高速滚动和极端环境温度试验；相关研发自 2017 年启动。航空轮胎是中国制造商此前没有本国设计与生产批准的最后几个轮胎品类之一，因此一份 CTSOA 改变的不只是谁能供货，而是谁能参与中国民用飞机项目的投标。目前范围仍然有限：只有四个件号，而且中国的批准在其他地区不会自动获得承认。本条属于回顾。该认证本身的日期是 2026 年 5 月 11 日，三角轮胎在自有网站的公告日期是 2026 年 5 月 23 日，两者都在本报告期之前；期内的行业媒体页面是一份需订阅的节选，只补充了证书名称、颁发机构和日期，没有新的进展阶段。CAAC 的原始记录未被打开，也没有具名的飞机项目或客户，因此该批准的商业范围尚不清楚。后续应关注三角轮胎是否在 CTSOA 之下具名某个飞机项目或航空公司客户，以及是否有非中国的主管机构承认或重复这一批准。

title: Giti claims Europe's first A-rated rolling-resistance drive tyre
what_happened: Tyrepress reported on 5 June 2026 that Giti Tire has launched the GDL272 Ecoroad long-haul drive tyre in 315/70R22.5, orderable now, carrying an A grade for rolling resistance coefficient on the EU tyre label, and that Giti intends to extend A-rated rolling resistance across drive, steer and trailer positions. The article states the tyre is the first available in Europe with the highest RRC grade. An A grade on the EU label is a regulated, comparable measurement rather than a marketing figure, so a truck fitment reaching it sets a reference point fleets can use in tender arithmetic. The 'first in Europe' framing is the part that is not independently checked here. Only the free extract of a subscriber-gated article was readable, and the 'industry first' claim is a comparative superiority statement that was not verified against the EU tyre label database or any competitor's published grade. Giti's own website carried no in-window release for this launch. Watch whether the A-rated RRC grade appears for GDL272 Ecoroad in the EU product database, and whether Giti releases steer and trailer positions at the same grade.
title_zh: 佳通称其为欧洲首款滚动阻力达到 A 级的驱动轮胎
what_happened_zh: Tyrepress 在 2026 年 6 月 5 日报道，佳通已推出 315/70R22.5 规格的 GDL272 Ecoroad 长途驱动轮胎，现在即可订购，在欧盟轮胎标签上滚动阻力系数为 A 级；佳通还打算把 A 级滚动阻力扩展到驱动轮、转向轮和挂车位。该文章称，这是欧洲首款可供货且达到最高滚动阻力系数等级的轮胎。欧盟标签上的 A 级是受监管、可比较的测量结果，而不是营销数字，因此一款卡车配套达到该等级，就给车队招标的算账提供了一个参照点。“欧洲首款”的表述是此处没有得到独立核实的部分。只能读到需订阅文章的免费节选，而“业内首创”属于比较性优势表述，并未对照欧盟轮胎标签数据库或任何竞争对手公布的等级加以验证。佳通自有网站在报告期内没有关于此次上市的发布。后续应关注 GDL272 Ecoroad 的 A 级滚动阻力等级是否出现在欧盟产品数据库中，以及佳通是否以同一等级推出转向轮和挂车位产品。

title: Linglong's Atlas ECO-LINE truck range carries unverified wear and fuel claims
what_happened: China Tire Business Network published brand coverage on 6 June 2026 of three Atlas ECO-LINE long-haul truck and bus replacement tyres, models 902, 921 and 911, positioned on total cost of ownership. The article states, as the brand's claims, that the 921 raises wear volume by 10 per cent and performance by 23 per cent, and that the 911 has tested wear life exceeding 400,000 km, rolling resistance cut by over 25 per cent and roughly 1.5 litres per 100 km of fuel saved. Service commitments listed include extended warranty for non-accident early failures, a nationwide joint warranty with roadside assistance and free tyre inspections. Chinese truck-tyre competition is being fought on total-cost-of-ownership arithmetic rather than unit price, and the specific numbers a brand chooses to publish show which cost lines it expects fleets to weigh. Whether these particular figures hold is a separate question the source does not answer. This is brand-promotional trade-portal coverage. Every performance figure is the manufacturer's own claim with no disclosed test method, baseline tyre, load or route conditions, and no independent test was found, so the numbers are reported as claims rather than measured results. Watch for Publication of the test method, reference tyre and operating conditions behind the 400,000 km wear life and 25 per cent rolling-resistance figures.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎 Atlas ECO-LINE 卡客车产品线的磨耗与油耗主张未经核实
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 在 2026 年 6 月 6 日发布了关于三款 Atlas ECO-LINE 长途卡客车替换轮胎（型号 902、921 和 911）的品牌报道，产品定位围绕总拥有成本展开。文章以品牌主张的形式称，921 使磨耗体积提高百分之 10、性能提高百分之 23，911 经测试磨耗寿命超过 400,000 km、滚动阻力降低超过百分之 25，每 100 km 约节省 1.5 升燃油。所列服务承诺包括非事故早期损坏的延长质保、全国联保加道路救援以及免费轮胎检测。中国卡车轮胎竞争正围绕总拥有成本的算账而不是单价展开，而一个品牌选择公布哪些具体数字，显示出它预期车队会权衡哪些成本项。这些具体数字是否成立是另一个问题，该来源没有回答。本条属于品牌推广性质的行业门户报道。每一项性能数字都是制造商自己的主张，没有披露测试方法、基准轮胎、负荷或路线条件，也没有找到独立测试，因此这些数字是作为主张而不是实测结果呈现的。后续应关注 400,000 km 磨耗寿命和百分之 25 滚动阻力数字背后的测试方法、参照轮胎与使用条件是否公布。

title: Shandong University finds tyre-additive residues seven times higher in turning drills than straight driving
companies: Shandong University; Research Center for Eco-Environmental Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences
what_happened: A peer-reviewed letter published online in Environmental Science and Technology Letters on 3 June 2026 by a Shandong University and Chinese Academy of Sciences team reports 124 tyre additives and transformation products in dust from six driving-training modules across 20 driving schools in Qingdao, China, with a median total of 1.31 x 10^4 nanograms per gram and 12 compounds newly reported. Antioxidants dominated at a median 7.03 x 10^3 nanograms per gram, ahead of plasticisers at 4.14 x 10^3 and vulcanisation accelerators at 1.27 x 10^3. Quarter-turning modules showed the highest median at 3.47 x 10^4 nanograms per gram against 4.69 x 10^3 for straight-driving modules, about a seven-fold difference, with module type the leading driver of enrichment. Integrating persistence, bioaccumulation, toxicity and exposure, the authors identify two high-priority and 20 medium-priority pollutants. Non-exhaust emission research is moving from bulk tyre-wear mass toward the specific chemistry released, and it is finding that driving manoeuvre, not distance, sets the release rate. A seven-fold difference between turning and straight-line modules means abrasion-based regulatory test cycles that lean on steady-state running will understate real additive release, which matters directly for how Euro 7 style abrasion limits and any future additive restrictions are written. Antioxidants dominating the profile also points regulatory attention at the 6PPD chemical family that tyre makers are already trying to replace. The study measures dust concentrations at training facilities used as proxies for urban driving, not on-road exposure, and full text is paywalled. Watch whether the two high-priority compounds are named in regulatory screening lists, and whether abrasion or additive test protocols add cornering or transient manoeuvres.
title_zh: 山东大学发现转弯训练科目中的轮胎添加剂残留比直线行驶高出约七倍
what_happened_zh: 在 2026 年 6 月 3 日于《Environmental Science and Technology Letters》上线发表的一篇同行评议快报中，山东大学与中国科学院团队报告，在青岛 20 所驾校六类驾驶训练科目的扬尘中检出 124 种轮胎添加剂及其转化产物，总量中位值为 1.31 x 10^4 纳克/克，其中 12 种化合物为首次报告。防老剂占主导，中位值为 7.03 x 10^3 纳克/克，高于增塑剂的 4.14 x 10^3 和硫化促进剂的 1.27 x 10^3。定点转弯科目的中位值最高，为 3.47 x 10^4 纳克/克，而直线行驶科目为 4.69 x 10^3，相差约七倍，科目类型是富集程度的首要驱动因素。综合持久性、生物累积性、毒性与暴露，作者识别出两种高优先级和 20 种中优先级污染物。非尾气排放研究正从轮胎磨耗的总质量转向所释放的具体化学物质，并且发现决定释放速率的是驾驶动作而不是行驶距离。转弯科目与直线科目之间约七倍的差异意味着，依赖稳态行驶的磨耗类法规测试循环会低估真实的添加剂释放量，这直接关系到 Euro 7 式的磨耗限值以及未来任何添加剂限制如何制定。防老剂在成分谱中占主导，也把监管注意力指向轮胎企业已经在设法替代的 6PPD 化学品家族。该研究测量的是作为城市驾驶替代场景的训练场地扬尘浓度，而不是道路实际暴露，且全文需付费获取。后续应关注这两种高优先级化合物是否被列入监管筛查清单，以及磨耗或添加剂测试规程是否会增加转弯或瞬态动作。

title: Orion starts circular carbon black output in Qingdao, with drop-in replacements for N326 and N330
what_happened: Orion S.A. announced on 4 June 2026 that it has begun producing circular carbon black at its ISCC PLUS-certified plant in Qingdao, using tyre pyrolysis oil alongside conventional carbon black oil. Three ECORAX Circular grades are made there: 200, a hard black for tyres, plus 210 and 215 for tyres and mechanical rubber goods. Orion states that ECORAX Circular 200 and 210 are full drop-in substitutes for ASTM grades N326 and N330 respectively. Both the Qingdao and Jasło, Poland plants use dedicated tanks that keep pyrolysis oil and carbon black oil separate and feed them to the reactor as distinct streams, which Orion says lets it modulate the blending ratio. No capacity figures, volumes or customers are disclosed. Circular carbon black is shifting from certified-grade announcements to installed multi-site dosing infrastructure, and the second site being in China puts the capability next to the world's largest tyre production base. A stated drop-in equivalence to N326 and N330 is what a compounder actually needs, because it removes requalification cost as the barrier to adopting circular grades. Building the second line in Qingdao rather than Europe means Chinese tyre plants can buy certified circular carbon black locally, which changes who can credibly bid on recycled-content specifications. Without volumes, the scale of available supply remains unknown. Watch for Disclosed Qingdao capacity or tyre-pyrolysis-oil offtake volumes, and the first named Chinese tyre maker using ECORAX Circular grades in series production.
title_zh: Orion 在青岛启动循环炭黑生产，并提供 N326 与 N330 的直接替代牌号
what_happened_zh: Orion S.A. 2026 年 6 月 4 日宣布，公司已在其获得 ISCC PLUS 认证的青岛工厂开始生产循环炭黑，原料为轮胎热解油与常规炭黑油并用。该厂生产三个 ECORAX Circular 牌号：用于轮胎的硬质炭黑 200，以及用于轮胎和橡胶制品的 210 和 215。Orion 表示，ECORAX Circular 200 和 210 分别是 ASTM 牌号中 N326 和 N330 的完全直接替代品。青岛与波兰 Jasło 两座工厂都使用专用储罐，把热解油与炭黑油分开存放，并作为彼此独立的物流送入反应器，Orion 称这使其能够调节掺混比例。未披露产能、产量或客户。循环炭黑正从认证牌号公告转向已建成的多基地掺混设施，而第二个基地设在中国，使这一能力紧邻全球最大的轮胎生产基地。对 N326 和 N330 声明直接替代，正是胶料企业真正需要的，因为它消除了采用循环牌号的重新认证成本这一障碍。把第二条产线建在青岛而不是欧洲，意味着中国轮胎工厂可以在本地采购经认证的循环炭黑，这会改变谁能可信地参与再生含量规格的投标。在没有产量数据的情况下，可供应规模仍然未知。后续应关注青岛产能或轮胎热解油承购量的披露，以及首家在量产中使用 ECORAX Circular 牌号的具名中国轮胎企业。

title: Recycled steel enters the ISCC PLUS materials list after a Pirelli pilot with Chinese cord maker Xingda
what_happened: Pirelli said in a release dated Milan, 5 June 2026 that a pilot project it promoted has added recycled steel for tyre reinforcement to the ISCC PLUS materials list. Pirelli helped define the technical requirements and sustainability guidelines and supported its strategic supplier Xingda and Xingda's own upstream suppliers through certification. The certified recycled steel will be used in Pirelli tyres made at plants worldwide under a controlled-blending chain of custody. Pirelli discloses no tonnages or recycled-content percentages for the project, and the release carries no executive or ISCC quotes. Certification schemes, not tyre makers' own specifications, are becoming the mechanism by which a recycled input becomes commercially usable, and the first mover gets to shape the requirements its suppliers must meet. Steel cord is roughly a tenth of a truck tyre by weight and has had no recognised recycled-content pathway, so listing it under ISCC PLUS unlocks a claimable share of recycled content that regulation and OEM scorecards increasingly demand. That a Chinese cord maker is the certified supply route matters for anyone sourcing cord: the compliance advantage now sits upstream in China. Controlled blending means physical recycled content in any individual tyre is not guaranteed. Watch for Disclosed recycled-steel volumes or content percentages, whether other cord makers certify under the same listing, and progress against Pirelli's stated 2030 targets of a tyre with over 80 per cent bio-based and recycled material and 40 per cent across total raw-material use.
title_zh: 在倍耐力与中国钢帘线企业 Xingda 的试点之后，再生钢进入 ISCC PLUS 材料清单
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力在米兰发布、日期为 2026 年 6 月 5 日的新闻稿中表示，由其推动的一个试点项目已把用于轮胎增强材料的再生钢加入 ISCC PLUS 材料清单。倍耐力参与界定了技术要求和可持续性指引，并支持其战略供应商 Xingda 以及 Xingda 自身的上游供应商完成认证。经认证的再生钢将在受控掺混的监管链之下，用于倍耐力全球各工厂生产的轮胎。倍耐力未披露该项目的吨位或再生含量百分比，新闻稿中也没有高管或 ISCC 的引述。让一种再生投入品变得在商业上可用的机制，正在变成认证体系而不是轮胎企业自己的规范，而先行者得以塑造其供应商必须满足的要求。钢帘线按重量约占卡车轮胎的十分之一，此前没有被认可的再生含量路径，因此把它列入 ISCC PLUS，就打开了法规和整车厂评分卡日益要求的可申报再生含量份额。经认证的供应路径出自一家中国钢帘线企业，这对任何采购帘线的企业都有意义：合规优势现在位于中国的上游环节。受控掺混意味着任何单条轮胎中的物理再生含量并不能得到保证。后续应关注再生钢用量或含量百分比的披露、其他帘线企业是否在同一清单下取得认证，以及倍耐力所述 2030 年目标（一款生物基与再生材料占比超过百分之 80 的轮胎，以及在全部原材料用量中占比百分之 40）的进展。

title: US opens dumping and subsidy investigations into Chinese CBS accelerator with alleged margins up to 338.51 per cent
companies: US Department of Commerce; LANXESS Corporation
what_happened: Federal Register notices published on 2 June 2026, applicable 27 May 2026, record that the US Department of Commerce initiated antidumping and countervailing duty investigations into N-Cyclohexylbenzothiazole-2-sulfenamide (CBS) from China. LANXESS Corporation, described in the notice as a domestic producer of CBS, filed the petitions on 7 May 2026. The period of investigation is 1 October 2025 to 31 March 2026, China being treated as a non-market economy. Alleged dumping margins after Commerce revisions are 338.51 per cent using Brazil as surrogate, 322.55 per cent using Malaysia and 285.94 per cent using Mexico. The scope covers CBS at 94 to 99 per cent assay under HTSUS 2934.20.8000, including CBS commingled with non-subject material. The ITC must reach a preliminary injury determination within 45 days of the 7 May petition. Trade action against Chinese rubber chemicals, rather than finished tyres, moves the tariff frontier upstream to a single accelerator that tyre and rubber-goods plants worldwide buy from a concentrated Chinese supply base. CBS is a workhorse delayed-action accelerator, and alleged margins above 285 per cent are high enough that an affirmative outcome would reprice or reroute US accelerator supply rather than merely shave it. Buyers outside the US should expect Chinese volume to be redirected toward their markets. Note the stage precisely: these are initiations with petitioner-alleged margins, not findings. Watch for the ITC preliminary injury vote due on or about 21 June 2026, separate-rate applications due 21 days after publication, and Commerce's preliminary determination no later than 140 days after initiation unless postponed.
title_zh: 美国对中国产 CBS 促进剂发起反倾销与反补贴调查，指控幅度最高达百分之 338.51
what_happened_zh: 2026 年 6 月 2 日公布、自 2026 年 5 月 27 日起适用的《联邦公报》通知记载，美国商务部已对自中国进口的 N-Cyclohexylbenzothiazole-2-sulfenamide（CBS）发起反倾销与反补贴税调查。在通知中被描述为美国国内 CBS 生产商的 LANXESS Corporation 于 2026 年 5 月 7 日提交申请。调查期为 2025 年 10 月 1 日至 2026 年 3 月 31 日，中国被作为非市场经济国家对待。经商务部修正后的指控倾销幅度为：以巴西为替代国百分之 338.51，以马来西亚为替代国百分之 322.55，以墨西哥为替代国百分之 285.94。调查范围覆盖 HTSUS 2934.20.8000 项下含量为百分之 94 至 99 的 CBS，包括与非调查对象材料混装的 CBS。美国国际贸易委员会须在 5 月 7 日提交申请之后 45 天内作出初步损害裁定。针对中国橡胶化学品而不是成品轮胎的贸易行动，把关税前沿推向上游，指向全球轮胎和橡胶制品工厂从集中的中国供应基础采购的单一促进剂。CBS 是一种主力后效性促进剂，而指控中超过百分之 285 的幅度足够高，一旦出现肯定性结果，将重新定价或改道美国的促进剂供应，而不只是削减一点。美国以外的买方应当预期中国的供应量会被转向自己的市场。需要准确理解其阶段：这些是带有申请人指控幅度的立案，而不是裁定结果。后续应关注预计在 2026 年 6 月 21 日前后进行的美国国际贸易委员会初步损害表决、公布之后 21 天内到期的分别税率申请，以及商务部不迟于立案后 140 天（除非延期）作出的初步裁定。

title: Chinese rubber futures clear 18,000 yuan while a domestic maker pays dealers 4 points to move all-steel stock
companies: Huadong Rubber; Chinese all-steel tyre makers
what_happened: China Tire Business Network reported in an original piece on 4 June 2026 that the natural rubber futures main continuous contract closed at 18,165 yuan per tonne on 3 June, while Huadong Rubber issued a dealer notice on 1 June covering the whole of June offering a 3 per cent purchase reward against the 1 May price list plus a further 1 per cent for dealers with May purchase records, which the publication characterises as roughly a 4-point disguised price cut. The report describes weak heavy-truck demand, flat low freight-rate indices and slow destocking, with some leading makers still enforcing earlier price-increase letters while smaller factories move the other way to convert inventory into cash. Cost and price are moving in opposite directions in China's all-steel segment, and the split is running along company size rather than region, which is the classic setup for consolidation rather than a general price cycle. When input costs rise and mid-tier makers still discount, the constraint is working capital, not raw materials, and margin compression falls unevenly. Buyers can expect continued discounting from smaller Chinese all-steel suppliers this quarter even as headline rubber prices climb; the same divergence is what would drive exits. Figures are as reported by the publication: the futures close and the dealer notice were not independently confirmed from an exchange record or the company notice. Watch whether other regional Chinese brands publish similar June rebate schemes, and whether leading makers' price-increase letters hold through the quarter.
title_zh: 中国橡胶期货突破 18,000 元，一家国内制造商以 4 个点推动全钢库存出货
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 2026 年 6 月 4 日的原创报道称，天然橡胶期货主力连续合约 6 月 3 日收于每吨 18,165 元，同时华东橡胶 6 月 1 日发布经销商通知，覆盖整个 6 月，针对 5 月 1 日价格表给出百分之 3 的采购奖励，并对有 5 月采购记录的经销商再给百分之 1，该媒体把它形容为大约 4 个点的变相降价。报道描述了重卡需求疲弱、运价指数低位走平以及去库缓慢的情况，部分头部企业仍在执行此前的涨价函，而较小的工厂则反向操作，把库存变成现金。中国全钢板块的成本与价格正在相反方向移动，而分化是沿企业规模而不是地域展开的，这是整合而不是普遍价格周期的典型前置条件。当投入成本上升而中型企业仍在打折时，真正的约束是营运资金而不是原材料，利润压缩也落得并不均匀。买方可以预期中国较小的全钢供应商在本季度继续打折，即使名义橡胶价格在上涨；同样的分化也正是会推动退出的原因。相关数字为该媒体报道所载：期货收盘价和经销商通知没有从交易所记录或公司通知获得独立确认。后续应关注其他中国区域品牌是否公布类似的 6 月返利方案，以及头部企业的涨价函能否在本季度维持。

title: Tyres Europe backs the EUDR timetable but asks the Commission to fix DDS duplication and exclude retreads
what_happened: In a statement dated 1 June 2026, Tyres Europe called for the EU Deforestation Regulation implementation timeline to be maintained and for remaining problems to be handled through targeted refinements and guidance rather than reopening the regulation. It welcomed proposed exclusion of retreaded and test tyres from scope, asked the Commission to confirm that manufacturers act as operators when importing natural rubber and as first downstream operators when selling tyres containing it so that due-diligence statement numbers are not needlessly passed downstream, sought the same treatment for traders of imported tyres, and warned that the EUDR Information System's current technical architecture may undercut the grouping functionality needed when imported and EU-made tyres are mixed in warehouses. Secretary General Adam McCarthy said the sector is ready to implement the regulation and now needs implementation certainty. The industry position has flipped from seeking delay to defending the timetable, which tells you compliance investment is largely sunk and further postponement now destroys value rather than protecting it. The specific asks are the operational tell: the binding constraint is not proving rubber origin but transmitting and aggregating due-diligence statement references through mixed warehouse inventory. Watch whether the Commission's delegated act confirms the operator and first-downstream-operator treatment and the retread and test-tyre exclusions, and whether the EUDR Information System delivers workable aggregation.
title_zh: Tyres Europe 支持 EUDR 时间表，但要求委员会解决 DDS 重复并排除翻新轮胎
what_happened_zh: 在日期为 2026 年 6 月 1 日的一份声明中，Tyres Europe 呼吁维持欧盟零毁林法规的实施时间表，并主张通过有针对性的细化和指引来处理遗留问题，而不是重新打开该法规。该组织欢迎把翻新轮胎和测试轮胎排除出适用范围的提议，要求委员会确认制造商在进口天然橡胶时作为经营者、在销售含天然橡胶的轮胎时作为首个下游经营者，以免尽职调查声明编号被不必要地向下游传递；还为进口轮胎的贸易商争取同样处理，并警告 EUDR 信息系统当前的技术架构可能削弱进口轮胎与欧盟产轮胎在仓库中混放时所需的分组功能。秘书长 Adam McCarthy 表示，该行业已准备好实施这项法规，现在需要的是实施确定性。行业立场已从寻求延期转向维护时间表，这说明合规投入大体已经沉没，进一步推迟如今是在摧毁价值而不是保护价值。具体诉求才是运营层面的实情：真正的约束不是证明橡胶来源，而是在混放的仓库库存中传递和汇总尽职调查声明编号。后续应关注委员会的授权法案是否确认经营者与首个下游经营者的处理方式，以及翻新轮胎和测试轮胎的排除，还有 EUDR 信息系统是否提供可用的汇总功能。

title: A Michelin and Goodyear rubber-chemicals supplier plans its first overseas plant in Cambodia's Qilu zone
what_happened: China Tire Business Network reported on 4 June 2026, citing Jujiao, that Shanghai Qixiang New Materials Technology will build its first overseas production base in the Qilu special economic zone in Cambodia's Tboung Khmum province, disclosed by the provincial governor while attending an event in Zibo, Shandong. The company, founded in 2005 and in Shanghai Stock Exchange IPO coaching since September 2025, supplies green rubber materials including carbon-method silica, environmentally friendly rubber process oil, low-rolling-resistance silane and bio-based plasticisers to tyre makers including Michelin, Goodyear, Sailun and Linglong. It operates bases in Huai'an, Jiangsu and Linyi, Shandong plus a Suzhou R&D centre, and reached 420,000 tonnes of total capacity after a 1.2 billion yuan Shandong project started up in 2025. The report notes the zone already hosts more than ten companies including Sailun Tire, Lutai Textile and Mesnac. Chinese tyre makers' offshore build-out is now pulling their chemical and equipment suppliers into the same industrial zones, which converts a tariff-avoidance move into a transplanted supply cluster. A materials supplier following its customers to Cambodia is what turns an assembly relocation into a genuine local supply chain, and it shortens the lead time for Chinese-owned capacity there to qualify compound changes locally. It also raises the concentration risk: the same zone now holds tyre, textile-reinforcement and equipment suppliers whose exports face the same host-country trade exposure. Stage is an announced plan disclosed by a host-government official, not a permit, contract or construction start. Watch for a Cambodian permit, land or construction record for the Qixiang base, and whether its Shanghai Stock Exchange listing process discloses the project's capacity and capital cost.
title_zh: 一家米其林与固特异的橡胶化学品供应商计划在柬埔寨 Qilu 园区建设首个海外工厂
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 2026 年 6 月 4 日援引 Jujiao 报道，Shanghai Qixiang New Materials Technology 将在柬埔寨 Tboung Khmum 省的 Qilu 经济特区建设其首个海外生产基地，该消息由该省省长在出席山东淄博一场活动时披露。该公司成立于 2005 年，自 2025 年 9 月起接受上海证券交易所上市辅导，向包括米其林、固特异、赛轮和玲珑轮胎在内的轮胎企业供应绿色橡胶材料，产品包括碳法白炭黑、环保橡胶操作油、低滚动阻力硅烷和生物基增塑剂。公司在江苏淮安和山东临沂设有基地，在苏州设有研发中心，在一个 1.2 billion 元的山东项目于 2025 年投产之后，总产能达到 420,000 tonnes。报道提到，该园区已入驻十余家企业，包括赛轮轮胎、Lutai Textile 和 Mesnac。中国轮胎企业的海外布局，如今正把它们的化学品和设备供应商拉入同一批工业园区，这把一次规避关税的举动变成了被移植的供应集群。一家材料供应商跟随客户到柬埔寨，正是把装配环节的搬迁变成真正本地供应链的关键，也缩短了中国资本在当地的产能完成本地胶料变更认证所需的时间。这也提高了集中度风险：同一个园区现在同时容纳轮胎、纺织增强材料和设备供应商，它们的出口面对相同的东道国贸易风险。所处阶段是由东道国政府官员披露的拟建计划，而不是许可、合同或开工。后续应关注 Qixiang 基地在柬埔寨的许可、土地或施工记录，以及其上海证券交易所上市进程是否披露该项目的产能和资本支出。

title: ANRPC puts April natural rubber output at 772,000 tonnes with consumption up 2.3 per cent, and prices firming anyway
companies: Association of Natural Rubber Producing Countries
what_happened: Tyrepress reported on 2 June 2026 that the ANRPC's latest Monthly Natural Rubber Statistical Report estimates global natural rubber production in April 2026 at 772,000 tonnes, with global consumption up 2.3 per cent year on year to 1.235 million tonnes, and prices strengthening across all major grades and trading centres despite production falling against the same month a year earlier. A monthly consumption figure roughly 460,000 tonnes above production, with prices rising as output falls, is the combination that keeps compound costs elevated regardless of tyre demand. For buyers it argues against treating the current firmness as a temporary spike. The figures are as reported: individual grade prices, trading centres, country splits and the report's method fields were behind a subscriber wall and could not be recovered. Watch for the next ANRPC monthly report for whether the production-consumption gap narrows as the seasonal supply recovery arrives, and whether ANRPC revises its April estimate.
title_zh: ANRPC 把 4 月天然橡胶产量定为 772,000 tonnes，消费量上升百分之 2.3，价格仍在走强
what_happened_zh: Tyrepress 在 2026 年 6 月 2 日报道，ANRPC 最新一期《月度天然橡胶统计报告》估计，2026 年 4 月全球天然橡胶产量为 772,000 tonnes，全球消费量同比上升百分之 2.3 至 1.235 million tonnes，而尽管产量相对去年同月下降，各主要牌号和贸易中心的价格仍全面走强。月度消费量比产量高出约 460,000 tonnes，而价格在产量下降时上涨，这一组合会让胶料成本在轮胎需求之外持续维持高位。对买方而言，这不支持把当前的坚挺视为暂时性尖峰。相关数据为报道所载：各牌号价格、贸易中心、国别拆分以及该报告的方法字段位于订阅墙之后，无法取得。后续应关注 ANRPC 的下一期月度报告，以确认季节性供应恢复到来之后产销缺口是否收窄，以及 ANRPC 是否修正其 4 月估计值。

title: Coal tar tightness pushes Chinese carbon black costs up while makers run at 69.5 per cent and cannot pass it on
what_happened: China Tire Business Network republished a Carbon Black Industry Network assessment on 1 June 2026 reporting that coal tar closed May sharply higher with limited further upside expected in June, on tighter coal availability and restricted coking-plant operating rates, with shortages expected to persist in Shanxi and Inner Mongolia. Deep-processing product coal pitch rose 250 yuan to 5,000 yuan per tonne. Carbon black industry operating rate was about 69.5 per cent for the week, up 1.23 percentage points week on week, with some small and mid-sized plants in Shanxi and Shandong under routine maintenance. Leading producers were mainly executing May tyre orders, and with tyre plants' stocking already complete the assessment says cost pass-through was difficult and expects June transaction prices to follow feedstock upward. Carbon black is the second-largest cost line in most tyre compounds, and the sequence here is unhelpful for tyre makers: feedstock up, producer utilisation up, buyer stocks already full. That means the cost increase lands in the following order cycle rather than being absorbed, and it lands on the same mid-tier Chinese makers already discounting to move stock. Coverage is sample-based and the source does not publish its sample definition. Watch for June carbon black transaction prices, whether Shanxi and Inner Mongolia coal tar supply loosens, and whether the industry operating rate holds near 70 per cent through maintenance season.
title_zh: 煤焦油紧张推高中国炭黑成本，企业开工率百分之 69.5 却无法转嫁
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 2026 年 6 月 1 日转载 Carbon Black Industry Network 的评估报告称，煤焦油 5 月收盘大幅上涨，预计 6 月进一步上行空间有限，原因是煤炭供应趋紧和焦化厂开工受限，并预计山西和内蒙古的短缺将持续。深加工产品煤沥青上涨 250 元至每吨 5,000 元。本周炭黑行业开工率约为百分之 69.5，环比上升 1.23 个百分点，山西和山东部分中小装置处于例行检修。头部生产企业主要在执行 5 月的轮胎订单，而由于轮胎厂的备货已经完成，该评估称成本转嫁困难，并预计 6 月成交价格将跟随原料上行。炭黑是多数轮胎胶料中第二大成本项，而这里的顺序对轮胎企业不利：原料上涨、生产企业开工率上升、买方库存已满。这意味着成本上升会落在下一个订单周期，而不是被消化，并且落在那些已经为了出货而打折的中国中型企业身上。该报道基于样本，来源没有公布其样本定义。后续应关注 6 月炭黑成交价格、山西与内蒙古煤焦油供应是否松动，以及行业开工率能否在检修季维持在百分之 70 附近。

title: Russia's State Duma debates end-of-life tyre collection and tougher dumping penalties
what_happened: Tyrepress reported on 2 June 2026 that Russia's State Duma held a discussion on the country's handling of end-of-life tyres, identifying continuing challenges in collection, available recycling technologies and whether penalties for dumping tyres in unsuitable locations should be increased, against concern that Russian processing rates sit well below Western European levels. The article's photo caption states that less than 50 per cent of tyres are currently recycled in Russia. No legislation is described as adopted. Russia is one of the larger tyre markets with no functioning extended-producer-responsibility outcome, and parliamentary attention to collection and penalties is the precursor to obligations landing on producers and importers there. Only the free extract of a subscriber-gated article was readable. It records a parliamentary discussion, not an adopted measure, and no Duma record, committee, date of sitting or deputy was recoverable. The sub-50 per cent recycling figure comes from the article's photo caption with no named source or method. Watch whether a bill on ELT collection obligations or dumping penalties is introduced, and whether an official Russian recycling-rate figure is published.
title_zh: 俄罗斯国家杜马讨论报废轮胎收集与加重乱倾倒处罚
what_happened_zh: Tyrepress 在 2026 年 6 月 2 日报道，俄罗斯国家杜马就该国报废轮胎处理举行了一次讨论，指出在收集和可用回收技术方面持续存在挑战，并讨论是否应加重在不适当场所倾倒轮胎的处罚，背景是对俄罗斯处理率远低于西欧水平的担忧。该文章的图片说明称，俄罗斯目前回收的轮胎不足百分之 50。文中没有描述任何已通过的立法。俄罗斯是较大的轮胎市场之一，却没有切实运转的生产者责任延伸结果，而议会对收集和处罚的关注，是相关义务落到当地生产者和进口商头上的前置信号。只能读到需订阅文章的免费节选。它记录的是一次议会讨论，而不是已通过的措施，而且没有找回任何杜马记录、委员会、开会日期或议员信息。不足百分之 50 的回收数字来自文章图片说明，没有具名来源或方法。后续应关注是否有关于报废轮胎收集义务或倾倒处罚的法案被提出，以及是否会公布官方的俄罗斯回收率数字。

title: Yokohama Rubber keeps CDP's top supplier engagement rating for a second year
what_happened: Yokohama Rubber announced on 3 June 2026 that it was named a Supplier Engagement Leader, the top mark in CDP's Supplier Engagement Assessment 2025, for a second consecutive year. The company states the assessment judges supplier climate engagement across governance and business strategy, targets, Scope 3 emissions, risk management processes and supplier engagement, and cites a net-zero target for CO2 from its own operations by 2050, Scope 3 disclosure since 2013, its Green Procurement Guidelines and annual supplier CSR briefings.
