Supplier engagement ratings are one of the few external, repeatable measures of whether a tyre maker is actually moving its upstream suppliers on emissions rather than only its own plants, which is where most of a tyre's footprint sits. This is a recognition announcement only. It evidences the CDP rating and nothing about measured emission reductions, supplier coverage or programme content, and the underlying CDP assessment method and scoring were not opened. Watch whether Yokohama publishes measured Scope 3 reduction against its disclosed baseline rather than engagement-process scores.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶连续第二年保持 CDP 最高供应商参与评级
what_happened_zh: 横滨橡胶 2026 年 6 月 3 日宣布，公司连续第二年被评为 Supplier Engagement Leader，这是 CDP 供应商参与评估 2025 中的最高标识。公司表示，该评估从治理与业务战略、目标、范围 3 排放、风险管理流程和供应商参与等方面评判供应商气候参与度，并引述了自身运营 CO2 到 2050 年净零排放的目标、自 2013 年起的范围 3 披露、《绿色采购指引》以及每年的供应商 CSR 说明会。供应商参与评级是为数不多的外部、可重复的衡量方式之一，用以判断一家轮胎企业是否真的在推动上游供应商减排，而不只是推动自己的工厂，而轮胎碳足迹的大部分正位于上游。本条仅是一项获奖公告。它能证明 CDP 评级本身，而不能说明已测得的减排量、供应商覆盖面或项目内容，CDP 的评估方法和评分细则也没有被打开。后续应关注横滨橡胶是否公布相对已披露基线的范围 3 实测减排量，而不只是参与流程得分。

title: Linglong commissions a plant-wide energy and carbon platform tied to mixing, curing and building loads
what_happened: Linglong Tire said on 5 June 2026 that its digital energy and carbon management platform has been built and commissioned as a smart energy hub. The system is organised around the energy profile of mixing, curing and building, covers water, electricity, gas and heat, and connects workshop meters and production equipment plant-wide through industrial IoT, fieldbus and edge collection with PLC integration. It replaces manual statistics with real-time monitoring, fault and early warning, and unified carbon-emission data management, links production, equipment and energy data, and mines roughly five years of formula, production and energy records to feed process optimisation and equipment start-stop decisions. Linglong says industry deployment experience suggests total plant energy use can fall 8 to 11 per cent in the first year after full rollout; it publishes no measured result. Chinese tyre makers are wiring carbon accounting into the same data layer as process control, which makes emissions reporting a by-product of scheduling rather than a separate compliance exercise. Mixing and curing dominate tyre-plant energy, so tying utility metering to formula and production records is where an energy platform can actually change unit cost instead of just reporting it. It also positions Linglong to produce auditable product-level carbon data as customers and the EU push for it. Read the 8 to 11 per cent as a target: it is an expectation drawn from industry experience, not a measured saving against a stated baseline. Watch for a measured first-year energy or carbon reduction against a disclosed baseline, and whether the platform is extended to Linglong's overseas plants.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎上线覆盖全厂的能源与碳管理平台，关联密炼、硫化与成型负荷
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎 2026 年 6 月 5 日表示，其数字化能源与碳管理平台已建成并作为智慧能源中心投入运行。该系统围绕密炼、硫化和成型的能耗特征组织，覆盖水、电、气、热，并通过工业物联网、现场总线和边缘采集结合 PLC 集成，把全厂车间计量表与生产设备连接起来。它以实时监测、故障与预警以及统一的碳排放数据管理取代人工统计，打通生产、设备与能源数据，并挖掘约五年的配方、生产和能耗记录，用于支持工艺优化与设备启停决策。玲珑轮胎称，行业部署经验表明全面推广之后第一年全厂能耗可以下降百分之 8 至 11；公司没有公布实测结果。中国轮胎企业正把碳核算接入与过程控制同一个数据层，这使排放报告成为生产排产的副产品，而不是一项单独的合规工作。密炼和硫化在轮胎工厂能耗中占主导，因此把公用工程计量与配方、生产记录绑定，才是能源平台真正能够改变单位成本而不只是用于报告的地方。这也使玲珑轮胎有条件在客户和欧盟的推动下产出可审计的产品级碳数据。应把百分之 8 至 11 读作目标：它是从行业经验得出的预期，而不是相对明确基线的实测节能量。后续应关注相对已披露基线的首年实测能耗或碳减排量，以及该平台是否会扩展到玲珑轮胎的海外工厂。

title: JK Tyre board clears a 49.8 billion rupee, three-phase plan to lift capacity 24 per cent by 2029
what_happened: China Tire Business Network reported on 2 June 2026, citing Jujiao, that JK Tyre & Industries' board has approved a 49.8 billion rupee capacity expansion, about 3.5 billion yuan, to be delivered in three phases with completion expected by December 2029 and full output in fiscal 2030. Phase one takes 50 per cent of spending for completion in August 2028, phase two 40 per cent with production expected in April 2029, and phase three the remaining 10 per cent for finishing work by year end. Funding mixes internal accruals and debt. About 90 per cent goes to the Chennai plant for passenger-car radial capacity, the remainder upgrading a truck-and-bus radial line at the Vikrant plant. Total annual tyre capacity is to rise 24 per cent, with utilisation already past 90 per cent and demand attributed to Indian SUV sales, a recovering commercial-vehicle market and new-energy vehicle growth. India's tyre capex cycle is turning on domestic passenger-car radial demand rather than exports, at the same time as a record export year, which is a different growth basis from the export-driven build-outs of the last decade. A 24 per cent capacity increase from one Indian maker, concentrated in passenger-car radial, is the kind of addition that changes regional supply balance by 2029 and gives Indian producers more room to absorb trade friction in any single export market. Utilisation above 90 per cent explains the timing. This is a board approval reported by trade media, not a filing: no exchange disclosure or company release was recoverable from this environment. Watch for a JK Tyre stock-exchange disclosure or annual-report confirmation of the 49.8 billion rupee approval and phase-one completion progress toward August 2028.
title_zh: JK Tyre 董事会批准 49.8 billion 卢比的三期方案，到 2029 年把产能提高百分之 24
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 2026 年 6 月 2 日援引 Jujiao 报道，JK Tyre & Industries 董事会已批准一项 49.8 billion 卢比（约 3.5 billion 元）的产能扩张，分三期实施，预计 2029 年 12 月完成，并在 2030 财年实现满产。一期占支出的百分之 50，计划 2028 年 8 月完成；二期占百分之 40，预计 2029 年 4 月投产；三期为余下的百分之 10，用于年底之前的收尾工作。资金来自内部积累与债务的组合。约百分之 90 投向 Chennai 工厂用于乘用车子午线轮胎产能，其余用于升级 Vikrant 工厂的全钢子午线产线。轮胎年总产能将提高百分之 24，而产能利用率已经超过百分之 90，需求被归因于印度 SUV 销量、商用车市场回暖和新能源汽车增长。印度的轮胎资本支出周期是由国内乘用车子午线需求而不是出口驱动的，与此同时又恰逢出口创纪录的一年，这与过去十年出口驱动的扩产有不同的增长基础。一家印度制造商百分之 24 的产能增长集中在乘用车子午线领域，这种增量到 2029 年足以改变区域供需平衡，并让印度生产商有更多余地消化任何单一出口市场的贸易摩擦。利用率超过百分之 90 解释了时间点的选择。本条是行业媒体报道的董事会批准，而不是公告文件：在本环境中没有找回交易所披露或公司发布。后续应关注 JK Tyre 的交易所披露或年报，以确认这项 49.8 billion 卢比的批准，以及一期向 2028 年 8 月目标推进的完成进度。

title: Continental's Rayong expansion adds three million car tyres a year and local motorcycle radial output
what_happened: Tyrepress reported on 4 June 2026 that Continental has recently inaugurated the expansion of its tyre plant in Rayong, Thailand, adding capacity for three million passenger-car and light-truck tyres a year and starting local radial motorcycle tyre production. The investment is given as roughly 13 billion Thai baht, about 397 million US dollars, with approximately 600 new jobs. Per the report the motorcycle tyre section covers in-house steps from rubber compound production through to finished tyre delivery. Three million units and a new motorcycle radial line move Rayong from a cost base to a regional product hub, and in-house compounding on the motorcycle line means Continental is localising the value-adding steps rather than assembling imported semi-finished parts. For Southeast Asian competitors, premium capacity is now being added inside the region rather than shipped into it. Investment figure and ceremony date are as reported; no Continental release for the inauguration was recoverable. Watch for Continental confirmation of the Rayong ramp-up profile, and whether the motorcycle radial line supplies OE or replacement demand first.
title_zh: 大陆集团罗勇扩产新增年产三百万条乘用车轮胎并实现摩托车子午线本地化生产
what_happened_zh: Tyrepress 在 2026 年 6 月 4 日报道，大陆集团近期为其泰国罗勇轮胎工厂的扩建举行了投产仪式，新增年产三百万条乘用车和轻卡轮胎的产能，并开始本地生产摩托车子午线轮胎。投资额为约 13 billion 泰铢（折合美元约 397 million），并新增约 600 个岗位。据该报道，摩托车轮胎部分涵盖从胶料生产到成品轮胎交付的自有工序。三百万条的规模加上一条新的摩托车子午线产线，使罗勇从成本基地转为区域产品枢纽，而摩托车产线自产胶料意味着大陆集团在本地化增值环节，而不是组装进口半成品。对东南亚的竞争者而言，高端产能如今是在区域内新增，而不再是运进来。投资数字与仪式日期均为报道所载；没有找回大陆集团关于此次投产的发布。后续应关注大陆集团是否确认罗勇的产能爬坡节奏，以及摩托车子午线产线会先供应原配还是替换需求。

title: A Mesnac rubber-machinery plant appears on Qingdao's 2026 advanced smart-factory list
what_happened: China Tire Business Network reported on 6 June 2026, citing Jujiao, that Qingdao's municipal industry and information technology bureau has published its 2026 advanced-level smart factory public notice and that Qingdao Mesnac Electromechanical Engineering's rubber equipment smart factory is on the list, selected through company application, district and city recommendation and expert review. The report gives no capacity, investment or performance figures. Its headline describes the list as provincial while its text describes a Qingdao municipal list; the municipal description is the one used here. Chinese smart-factory designations are used as gate criteria for local subsidies, procurement preference and further upgrade funding, so the recognition matters commercially even when no performance data is published. That the recipient is a rubber-machinery plant rather than a tyre plant is the point: the equipment tier supplying Chinese tyre capacity is itself being pushed up the digitalisation ladder. Nothing here evidences a measured productivity or quality effect. Watch for Publication of the Qingdao bureau's official 2026 advanced smart factory notice with the full list, and any disclosed performance data behind the designation.
title_zh: 一家 Mesnac 橡胶机械工厂入选青岛 2026 年先进级智能工厂名单
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 2026 年 6 月 6 日援引 Jujiao 报道，青岛市工业和信息化局已公布其 2026 年先进级智能工厂公示名单，Qingdao Mesnac Electromechanical Engineering 的橡胶装备智能工厂位列其中，遴选经过企业申报、区市推荐和专家评审。该报道没有给出产能、投资或绩效数字。其标题把该名单描述为省级，而正文描述为青岛市级名单；此处采用市级表述。中国的智能工厂认定被用作地方补贴、采购倾斜和进一步升级资金的门槛条件，因此即使没有公布绩效数据，这项认定在商业上仍然有意义。获此认定的是一家橡胶机械工厂而不是轮胎工厂，这正是要点所在：为中国轮胎产能供货的设备环节，自身也正被推上数字化阶梯。此处没有任何内容能够证明已测得的生产率或质量效果。后续应关注青岛市主管部门 2026 年先进级智能工厂正式通知及完整名单的公布，以及该认定背后是否披露任何绩效数据。

title: Chinese sample-plant utilisation slips to 74.15 per cent semi-steel and 67.94 per cent all-steel
what_happened: China Tire Business Network published a weekly assessment on 2 June 2026 reporting sample-enterprise capacity utilisation of 74.15 per cent for semi-steel tyres, down 0.97 percentage points week on week and up 1.64 points year on year, and 67.94 per cent for all-steel, down 0.12 points week on week and up 7.14 points year on year. Average inventory turnover days were 45.41 for semi-steel and 40.51 for all-steel. It reports negative theoretical margins as of 28 May of minus 0.70 yuan per kg for a mid-tier 205/55R16 and minus 1.77 yuan per kg for an economy 12R22.5, and expects carbon black new-order prices to keep rising on coal tar cost support. Utilisation drifting down while year-on-year comparisons remain positive, with negative theoretical margins on both mainstream sizes, is the operating backdrop against which Chinese makers are choosing between holding price letters and discounting to move stock. These are sample-enterprise estimates compiled from unnamed sources, with no published sample definition, coverage, revision policy or margin methodology, so they cannot be compared with official statistics. The source page also contains an internal contradiction, describing the theoretical margins as improving while reporting negative values that worsen week on week; the figures are reproduced as published and the contradiction is disclosed here rather than resolved. Watch whether semi-steel utilisation falls further through the planned month-end maintenance period, and whether the publisher clarifies its sample definition.
title_zh: 中国样本企业产能利用率回落至半钢百分之 74.15、全钢百分之 67.94
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 2026 年 6 月 2 日发布的周度评估报告称，样本企业半钢轮胎产能利用率为百分之 74.15，环比下降 0.97 个百分点，同比上升 1.64 个百分点；全钢为百分之 67.94，环比下降 0.12 个百分点，同比上升 7.14 个百分点。平均库存周转天数半钢为 45.41 天、全钢为 40.51 天。报告称，截至 5 月 28 日，理论毛利为负，中端 205/55R16 为每公斤负 0.70 元，经济型 12R22.5 为每公斤负 1.77 元，并预计炭黑新订单价格将在煤焦油成本支撑下继续上涨。产能利用率向下漂移而同比仍为正值，同时两个主流规格的理论毛利均为负，这正是中国制造商在坚守涨价函与打折出货之间作选择的经营背景。这些是来自未具名来源汇总的样本企业估计值，没有公布样本定义、覆盖范围、修订政策或毛利测算方法，因此无法与官方统计相比较。来源页面还存在内部矛盾，一方面把理论毛利描述为改善，另一方面报告的却是环比恶化的负值；此处按原文复现数字，并披露这一矛盾而不予调和。后续应关注半钢产能利用率在计划中的月末检修期是否进一步下降，以及发布方是否澄清其样本定义。

title: USTR proposes 10 to 12.5 per cent duties on 60 economies over forced-labour import bans
companies: Office of the United States Trade Representative
what_happened: USTR announced on 2 June 2026 that it has determined the acts, policies and practices of 60 economies regarding their failure to impose and effectively enforce a ban on imports of goods made with forced labour are unreasonable and burden or restrict US commerce, and are actionable under Section 301(b). Fifty-four economies were found to have failed both to impose and to effectively enforce such a prohibition, including China, Hong Kong, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Malaysia and Turkey; six, including Canada, Mexico, Indonesia and the European Union, were found to have failed to enforce one. The proposed action is an additional duty on all products of the investigated economies except as provided in an annex, at 10 per cent for economies that maintain a ban or have committed to one and 12.5 per cent for all others, plus a textile mechanism allowing a set volume of apparel imports at a reduced rate. The investigations were self-initiated on 12 March 2026. Hearing requests were due 22 June 2026, written comments 6 July 2026, with hearings on 7 July 2026. A duty keyed to the exporting economy's labour-enforcement record rather than to a product or a company breaks the logic of relocating production to avoid country-specific trade remedies, because the new exposure attaches to the host economy itself. Nearly every economy that hosts transplanted tyre capacity is on the list, so origin certificates and offshore plants stop functioning as a hedge in the way they have since the first China tyre cases. Chinese-owned plants in Thailand, Vietnam and Cambodia would face the proposed duty on the same basis as their host-country neighbours, and Japanese, Korean, Indian and European producers are covered too. The stage is a determination plus proposed action in a comment period, not an imposed duty. Watch for the Federal Register notice FR-2026-06-05 document 2026-11296 and its Annex A exclusions, the 7 July 2026 hearings, and whether any final action distinguishes tyre products or the textile-style volume mechanism.

title_zh: USTR 拟对 60 个经济体就强迫劳动进口禁令问题征收百分之 10 至 12.5 的关税
what_happened_zh: USTR 在 2026 年 6 月 2 日宣布，经认定，60 个经济体在未能实施并有效执行对强迫劳动制造货物的进口禁令方面的行为、政策和做法不合理，并对美国商业造成负担或限制，可依第 301(b) 条采取行动。其中五十四个经济体被认定既未实施也未有效执行此类禁令，包括中国、中国香港、印度、日本、韩国、中国台湾、泰国、越南、柬埔寨、马来西亚和土耳其；另有六个经济体，包括加拿大、墨西哥、印度尼西亚和欧盟，被认定未能有效执行其中一项。拟议措施是对被调查经济体的所有产品加征额外关税，附件另有规定者除外，对维持禁令或已承诺建立禁令的经济体为百分之 10，对其他所有经济体为百分之 12.5，同时设置一项纺织品机制，允许一定数量的服装进口适用较低税率。这些调查于 2026 年 3 月 12 日自主发起。听证申请的截止日期为 2026 年 6 月 22 日，书面意见为 2026 年 7 月 6 日，听证会定于 2026 年 7 月 7 日举行。一项按出口经济体的劳工执法记录、而不是按产品或企业设定的关税，打破了把生产迁移以规避国别贸易救济的逻辑，因为新的风险附着在东道经济体本身。几乎每一个承接移植轮胎产能的经济体都在名单上，因此原产地证书和海外工厂不再像第一批中国轮胎案件以来那样起到对冲作用。泰国、越南和柬埔寨的中资工厂将与其东道国同行在同一基础上面对拟议关税，日本、韩国、印度和欧洲的生产商也在覆盖范围内。所处阶段是认定加上处于意见征询期的拟议措施，而不是已实施的关税。后续应关注《联邦公报》通知 FR-2026-06-05、文件号 2026-11296 及其附件 A 的排除清单，2026 年 7 月 7 日的听证会，以及最终措施是否会对轮胎产品或纺织品式的数量机制作出区别处理。

title: A fifth straight weekly freight rise squeezes Chinese tyre exporters without slot contracts
what_happened: In an original piece dated 2 June 2026, China Tire Business Network reported that mid-year container shortages and periodic overbooking hit Europe, North America, Middle East and Red Sea trunk routes at the same time, bringing back booking queues, roll-overs and ad-hoc rate increases. It states the Shanghai Containerized Freight Index stood at 2,571.73 points as of 31 May, up 15.9 per cent on the prior period, a fifth consecutive weekly gain and the highest level since September 2024. The publication argues leading makers can lean on long-term contract rates, regional stocking, overseas warehouses and offshore plants, while smaller exporters without guaranteed slots or overseas inventory risk thin-margin orders turning into losses, and that overseas bases are shifting from a bonus to a buffer. Logistics cost, not just tariffs, is now cited as a reason to hold overseas capacity and inventory, which changes the payback calculation for offshore plants that were justified on trade barriers alone. Freight is one of the few cost lines a Chinese tyre exporter cannot hedge with product mix, and a 15.9 per cent single-period jump on top of higher rubber and carbon black costs is enough to invert margins on already thin export orders. Combined with the proposed US Section 301 duties on host economies, it pushes the advantage further toward makers with overseas warehousing and local channels. The index level is as reported, not taken from the index publisher. Watch whether SCFI gains continue into the third quarter, and whether Chinese makers disclose additional overseas warehousing or inventory positions in half-year reporting.
title_zh: 运价连续第五周上涨，挤压没有舱位合同的中国轮胎出口商
what_happened_zh: 在日期为 2026 年 6 月 2 日的一篇原创报道中，China Tire Business Network 称，年中的集装箱短缺和阶段性超订同时冲击欧洲、北美、中东和红海干线，使订舱排队、甩柜和临时涨价重新出现。报道称，截至 5 月 31 日，上海出口集装箱运价指数为 2,571.73 点，较上一期上涨百分之 15.9，为连续第五周上涨，也是 2024 年 9 月以来的最高水平。该媒体认为，头部企业可以依靠长期合约运价、区域备货、海外仓和海外工厂，而没有保障舱位或海外库存的较小出口商，则面临薄利订单变成亏损的风险，海外基地正从加分项转为缓冲垫。如今被援引为持有海外产能和库存理由的，不只是关税，还有物流成本，这改变了那些仅以贸易壁垒为依据的海外工厂的回报测算。运费是中国轮胎出口商少数无法用产品结构对冲的成本项之一，而在橡胶和炭黑成本上涨之上再加百分之 15.9 的单期跳涨，足以让本已很薄的出口订单利润翻为负值。与拟议中针对东道经济体的美国 301 条款关税结合起来，这把优势进一步推向拥有海外仓储和本地渠道的制造商。指数水平为报道所载，并非取自指数发布方。后续应关注 SCFI 的上涨是否延续到第三季度，以及中国制造商是否在半年报中披露更多海外仓储或库存情况。

title: Hankook signs into JD Auto Care's supply and price commitments for China's 618 season
what_happened: China Tire Business Network reported on 2 June 2026 that JD Auto Care launched a 618 guarantee alliance at its partner conference in Beijing on 28 May 2026 and that Hankook Tire joined it alongside other leading brands, committing across supply and stock, pricing, quality and service. The stated principles are official direct supply, genuine-product assurance, price stability and standardised service, with an aim of keeping non-standard product out of the channel. Products highlighted for the promotion include a JD-exclusive Ventus Prime3 K125D launching in June and the iON electric-vehicle line, with iON ST AS adding 17 sizes in April and 11 large-diameter versions carrying sound-absorbing foam. Chinese e-commerce platforms are moving from selling tyres to underwriting supply, price and authenticity, which makes the platform rather than the distributor the party a maker negotiates channel terms with. Committing to price stability and official direct supply on a platform of this size is a real constraint on how a maker can use grey channels or regional pricing during a promotional season, and a platform-exclusive SKU is a concession of product control. For makers weighing Chinese replacement-market entry, the terms of this alliance are a useful read on what platform access now costs. The source is promotional in tone and no alliance document was recovered. Watch whether the guarantee alliance publishes enforcement outcomes after the 618 season, and whether other international makers accept platform-exclusive SKUs on the same terms.
title_zh: 韩泰加入京东养车面向中国 618 季的供应与价格承诺
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 2026 年 6 月 2 日报道，京东养车于 2026 年 5 月 28 日在北京的合作伙伴大会上发起 618 保障联盟，韩泰轮胎与其他头部品牌一同加入，在供应与库存、定价、质量和服务方面作出承诺。所述原则包括官方直供、正品保障、价格稳定和标准化服务，目标是把非标产品挡在渠道之外。为此次促销重点推出的产品包括 6 月上市的京东专供 Ventus Prime3 K125D，以及 iON 电动车产品线，其中 iON ST AS 在 4 月新增 17 个规格，并有 11 个带吸音棉的大直径版本。中国电商平台正从销售轮胎转向为供应、价格和正品背书，这使制造商谈判渠道条件的对手变成平台而不是经销商。在这种体量的平台上承诺价格稳定和官方直供，对制造商如何在促销季使用灰色渠道或区域定价构成实质约束，而一个平台专供 SKU 则是产品控制权上的让步。对于权衡进入中国替换市场的制造商而言，这一联盟的条款是解读平台准入成本的有用参照。该来源语气偏推广，而且没有取得联盟文件。后续应关注该保障联盟是否在 618 季之后公布执行结果，以及其他国际制造商是否会以同样条款接受平台专供 SKU。

title: Continental completes its French retail exit, keeping 130-plus BestDrive outlets as franchisees
what_happened: Tyrepress reported on 4 June 2026 that Continental has finalised the divestment of ContiTrade France to ASC Investment, a deal first made public in December 2025. The business now trades as Xellent SAS and comprises more than 130 company-owned BestDrive outlets, two retreading facilities and supporting administrative functions, with roughly 1,200 staff. Every transferred service outlet remains within Continental's BestDrive France network through franchising. No financial terms appear in the accessible text. Tyre makers are separating brand control of a service network from ownership of it, keeping the franchise banner and customer relationship while moving the working capital and labour off their own balance sheet. Continental keeps BestDrive distribution in France while shedding 1,200 employees and the retail capital tied to them, which is a template other makers under margin pressure can copy. The two retreading facilities going with the business also moves industrial retread capacity into financial-sponsor hands, which is worth watching for fleet customers who rely on it. Closing is confirmed by trade media rather than a company release recovered here. Watch whether ASC Investment retains the two retreading plants under the Xellent structure, and whether Continental applies the same franchise-retention model in other European markets.
title_zh: 大陆集团完成法国零售业务退出，逾 130 家 BestDrive 门店转为加盟商
what_happened_zh: Tyrepress 在 2026 年 6 月 4 日报道，大陆集团已完成把 ContiTrade France 出售给 ASC Investment 的交易，该交易最早于 2025 年 12 月公开。该业务现在以 Xellent SAS 名义经营，包含 130 多家公司自有的 BestDrive 门店、两座翻新工厂以及配套的行政职能，员工约 1,200 人。所有移交的服务门店都通过加盟方式继续留在大陆集团的 BestDrive France 网络内。可获取的文本中没有财务条款。轮胎企业正在把服务网络的品牌控制权与所有权分开，保留加盟招牌和客户关系，同时把营运资金和人工移出自己的资产负债表。大陆集团在法国保住了 BestDrive 的分销，同时剥离 1,200 名员工和与之绑定的零售资本，这是其他面临利润压力的制造商可以复制的模板。随业务一同转手的两座翻新工厂，也把工业化翻新能力移入财务投资人手中，这对依赖该能力的车队客户值得关注。交割由行业媒体确认，而不是由此处找回的公司发布确认。后续应关注 ASC Investment 是否在 Xellent 架构下保留这两座翻新工厂，以及大陆集团是否会在其他欧洲市场采用同样的加盟保留模式。

title: Dunlop's Chinese D-Drive chain reaches 1,000 stores and puts AI customer service in the network
what_happened: China Tire Business Network reported on 5 June 2026 that Dunlop's D-Drive franchised store network opened its 1,000th outlet in Yongjia County, Wenzhou, Zhejiang, and that the city now has over 60 authorised Dunlop-branded stores of which 14 are D-Drive. The report describes the model as combining standardisation, including star-rated store management, unified technician training and standardised processes and equipment, with digitalisation: AI customer service is live and AI ordering, sell-through and inventory management are planned. Consumer engagement runs through a WeChat mini-programme, and the range promoted includes NEV-specific tyres such as the e.SPORT MAXX series. Chinese tyre retail is consolidating around franchise chains that compete on standardised process and network data rather than on price, which shifts bargaining power toward whoever owns the customer interaction layer. A thousand-store franchise footprint with unified technician training is the asset that lets a maker introduce NEV-specific fitments and service standards at scale, which is exactly the capability the new CCFA chain-store replacement guideline formalises. Extending AI from customer service into ordering and inventory would put demand signal in the maker's hands rather than the distributor's. The AI claims are unquantified: the report gives no method, metric or baseline. Watch whether the planned AI ordering and inventory functions go live with any disclosed inventory-turn or fill-rate effect, and whether other makers publish comparable Chinese franchise store counts.
title_zh: Dunlop 中国 D-Drive 连锁门店达到 1,000 家，并在网络中引入 AI 客服
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 2026 年 6 月 5 日报道，Dunlop 的 D-Drive 加盟门店网络在浙江温州永嘉县开出第 1,000 家门店，该市目前有逾 60 家 Dunlop 品牌授权门店，其中 14 家为 D-Drive。报道把这一模式描述为标准化与数字化的结合：标准化包括门店星级管理、统一的技师培训以及标准化的流程和设备；数字化方面，AI 客服已经上线，AI 订货、分销和库存管理尚在计划中。消费者互动通过微信小程序进行，推广的产品系列包括 e.SPORT MAXX 等新能源专用轮胎。中国轮胎零售正围绕以标准化流程和网络数据、而不是价格竞争的加盟连锁整合，这把议价能力推向掌握客户互动层的一方。1 千家门店的加盟网络规模，配合统一的技师培训，正是制造商能够大规模导入新能源专用配套和服务标准的资产，而这恰好也是新的中国连锁经营协会连锁门店换胎指引所要规范的能力。把 AI 从客服延伸到订货和库存，会把需求信号交到制造商而不是经销商手里。这些 AI 主张未经量化：报道没有给出方法、指标或基线。后续应关注计划中的 AI 订货和库存功能是否上线并披露任何库存周转或满足率效果，以及其他制造商是否公布可比的中国加盟门店数量。

title: USITC opens five-year reviews of the Korea, Taiwan, Thailand and Vietnam car-tyre duty orders
what_happened: A Federal Register notice published 1 June 2026 records that the US International Trade Commission instituted five-year sunset reviews that day, investigations 701-TA-647 and 731-TA-1517 to 1519, to decide whether revoking the passenger vehicle and light truck tyre orders would likely lead to continuation or recurrence of material injury. The orders under review are the countervailing duty order on Vietnam and the antidumping duty orders on South Korea, Taiwan and Thailand, all issued 19 July 2021 at 86 FR 38011. Responses were due by 1 July 2026 and comments on the adequacy of responses by 10 August 2026, with data requested for calendar year 2025. These four orders are the reason a large share of Asian PVLT capacity is priced the way it is into the United States, and a five-year review is the only routine point at which they can lapse. Producers and importers who do not file a response by the deadline forfeit standing in a proceeding that sets their duty exposure to 2031. Institution is procedural: it decides nothing about the outcome. Watch whether the Commission finds the domestic and respondent responses adequate by 10 August 2026, which determines a full review rather than an expedited one.
title_zh: USITC 启动对韩国、中国台湾、泰国和越南乘用车轮胎税令的五年期复审
what_happened_zh: 2026 年 6 月 1 日公布的一份《联邦公报》通知记载，美国国际贸易委员会当日启动五年期日落复审，案号为 701-TA-647 和 731-TA-1517 至 1519，以决定撤销乘用车与轻卡轮胎税令是否可能导致实质损害延续或再度发生。接受复审的税令包括对越南的反补贴税令，以及对韩国、中国台湾和泰国的反倾销税令，四项税令均于 2021 年 7 月 19 日以 86 FR 38011 发布。答复截止日期为 2026 年 7 月 1 日，对答复充分性的意见截止日期为 2026 年 8 月 10 日，所需数据为 2025 日历年度。这四项税令正是亚洲很大一部分乘用车及轻卡轮胎产能对美国定价方式的原因，而五年期复审是它们唯一可能常规失效的节点。未在截止日期前提交答复的生产商和进口商，将在一项决定其关税风险直至 2031 年的程序中失去资格。启动本身属于程序性步骤：它不决定任何结果。后续应关注委员会是否在 2026 年 8 月 10 日之前认定国内方与应诉方的答复充分，这将决定是进行全面复审还是快速复审。

title: US preliminary review finds low single-digit dumping margins for Indian off-the-road tyres
companies: US Department of Commerce; ATC Tires; Mahansaria Tyres; Apollo Tyres; CEAT; JK Tyre; MRF; Balkrishna Industries
what_happened: A Federal Register notice applicable 1 June 2026 sets out preliminary results of the 2024-2025 antidumping administrative review of certain new pneumatic off-the-road tyres from India, case A-533-869, covering 1 March 2024 to 28 February 2025. Commerce preliminarily assigned weighted-average dumping margins of 2.01 per cent to ATC Tires Private Ltd and ATC Tires AP Private Limited, 1.07 per cent to Mahansaria Tyres Private Limited, and a 1.87 per cent review-specific rate to 14 non-selected companies including Apollo Tyres, CEAT, JK Tyre, MRF, TVS Srichakra and Cavendish Industries. The review was rescinded for 25 firms with no reviewable suspended entries during the period, among them Balkrishna Industries. Margins between 1 and 2 per cent are low enough that the order stops being a meaningful barrier for Indian OTR exporters, which matters for buyers of mining and construction tyres who have been treating India as a second-source alternative to Chinese supply. The rescission list is equally informative: Balkrishna Industries, the largest Indian OTR name, had no reviewable suspended entries in the period. Preliminary results can move materially before the final determination. Watch for the final results of this administrative review, and whether the 1.87 per cent review-specific rate holds for the non-selected group.
title_zh: 美国初步复审认定印度非公路轮胎倾销幅度为低单位数
what_happened_zh: 一份自 2026 年 6 月 1 日起适用的《联邦公报》通知列出了针对印度特定新充气非公路轮胎 2024-2025 年度反倾销行政复审的初步结果，案号 A-533-869，覆盖期为 2024 年 3 月 1 日至 2025 年 2 月 28 日。商务部初步为 ATC Tires Private Ltd 和 ATC Tires AP Private Limited 认定百分之 2.01 的加权平均倾销幅度，为 Mahansaria Tyres Private Limited 认定百分之 1.07，并为 14 家未被抽样的公司认定百分之 1.87 的复审专用税率，这些公司包括 Apollo Tyres、CEAT、JK Tyre、MRF、TVS Srichakra 和 Cavendish Industries。对 25 家在期内没有可复审暂停清关进口的企业终止复审，其中包括 Balkrishna Industries。百分之 1 至 2 之间的幅度低到足以让该税令不再对印度非公路轮胎出口商构成有意义的壁垒，这对那些一直把印度视为中国供应第二来源的矿山和工程轮胎买方具有意义。终止清单同样具有信息量：印度最大的非公路轮胎企业 Balkrishna Industries 在期内没有可复审的暂停清关进口。初步结果在最终裁定之前仍可能出现实质变化。后续应关注本次行政复审的最终结果，以及百分之 1.87 的复审专用税率能否为未被抽样的企业群体所维持。

title: India's tyre exports hit a record 273.12 billion rupees in FY2025-26, up 9 per cent
what_happened: Tyrepress reported on 5 June 2026 that Indian tyre exports reached a record in the financial year ending 31 March 2026, at 273.12 billion rupees, about 2.85 billion US dollars, up 9.0 per cent year on year, using Ministry of Commerce and Industry figures reported by ATMA. The article's caption adds that the United States' share of the total declined. A record Indian export year alongside a falling US share suggests Indian producers are diversifying destinations rather than depending on the market most exposed to trade action, which is the same hedge Chinese makers are trying to build through offshore plants. Only the free extract of a subscriber-gated article was readable, and the underlying ATMA and ministry releases were not opened. The figure is an export value on an Indian fiscal-year basis, not a volume, so it mixes price and mix effects with real growth; the extent of the US share decline is not quantified in the accessible text. Watch for ATMA or ministry publication of the destination breakdown and volume figures behind the value increase.
title_zh: 印度轮胎出口在 FY2025-26 创下 273.12 billion 卢比纪录，同比增长百分之 9
what_happened_zh: Tyrepress 在 2026 年 6 月 5 日报道，印度轮胎出口在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的财年创下纪录，达到 273.12 billion 卢比（折合美元约 2.85 billion），同比增长百分之 9.0，所用数据为 ATMA 引用的印度商工部数字。该文章的图片说明补充称，美国在总额中的占比有所下降。印度出口创纪录的一年同时伴随美国占比下降，说明印度生产商正在分散目的地，而不是依赖最易受贸易行动冲击的市场，这与中国制造商试图通过海外工厂建立的对冲是同一种思路。只能读到需订阅文章的免费节选，而且 ATMA 与商工部的原始发布没有被打开。该数字是按印度财年口径的出口金额而不是数量，因此把价格和产品结构效应与真实增长混在一起；美国占比下降的幅度在可获取文本中没有被量化。后续应关注 ATMA 或商工部是否公布该金额增长背后的目的地拆分与数量数据。

title: Guizhou Tyre pushes electric-drive OTR and TBR products at a Tibet construction expo
what_happened: China Tire Business Network reported on 1 June 2026 that Guizhou Tyre exhibited at the 2026 Nyingchi construction expo in Tibet, which opened on 28 May and drew more than 450 exhibitors, showing 17 mass-production models across OTR, TBR, agricultural, industrial and passenger lines including 30.00R51, 26.5R25, 18.00R25, 16.00R25 and 530/95R29 OTR sizes and 12R22.5 and 12.00R20 TBR. The company states, as its own claims, that it is the first Chinese tyre company with a global lighthouse factory and the first to release a full electric-drive new-energy tyre portfolio, that its in-house low-heat-generation technology cuts operating temperature rise by roughly 15 per cent, and that it led or joined 43 national standards over the past three years. High-altitude construction and mining work is a demanding proving ground for OTR heat build-up, and which sizes a maker brings to a regional infrastructure expo is a readable signal of where it expects volume. The claims attached are the company's own. This is event and brand coverage. It evidences participation and the product range shown, not any technical or market-leadership claim; the lighthouse-factory 'first', the full electric-drive portfolio 'first' and the roughly 15 per cent temperature-rise reduction are company statements with no disclosed test method or independent verification. Watch for Published test data behind the 15 per cent temperature-rise reduction claim, and whether Guizhou Tyre reports plateau-market OTR volumes.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎在西藏一场建筑展会上主推电驱动非公路与全钢子午线产品
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 2026 年 6 月 1 日报道，贵州轮胎参加了在西藏举办的 2026 林芝建筑展会，该展会于 5 月 28 日开幕，吸引逾 450 家展商；贵州轮胎展出覆盖非公路、全钢子午线、农用、工程和乘用产品线的 17 款量产型号，其中非公路规格包括 30.00R51、26.5R25、18.00R25、16.00R25 和 530/95R29，全钢子午线规格包括 12R22.5 和 12.00R20。公司以自身主张的形式称，它是首家拥有全球灯塔工厂的中国轮胎企业，也是首家发布全系列电驱动新能源轮胎的企业；其自有低生热技术可以把工作温升降低约百分之 15；过去三年主导或参与了 43 项国家标准。高海拔的工程施工与矿山作业，是检验非公路轮胎生热的严苛试验场，而一家制造商带哪些规格去区域基础设施展会，是其预期销量所在的可读信号。所附主张均为公司自述。本条属于展会与品牌报道。它能证明参展情况和所展出的产品范围，而不能证明任何技术或市场领先主张；灯塔工厂的首创、全系列电驱动产品的首创以及约百分之 15 的温升降低，都是没有披露测试方法或独立验证的公司表述。后续应关注百分之 15 温升降低主张背后的测试数据是否公布，以及贵州轮胎是否报告高原市场的非公路轮胎销量。

title: Hai'an Rubber works mining exhibitions on three continents for giant OTR tyres
what_happened: Hai'an Rubber Group's company news page carries a 2 June 2026 post stating that the group appeared at international mining exhibitions across three continents. A later company recap identifies the events as being in Russia, Ghana and Chile. The post gives no order, customer or volume detail. Giant OTR tyres are the highest-margin segment open to Chinese makers, and Russian, West African and Chilean mining exhibitions map to the three mining regions where Chinese OTR supply has been displacing incumbents. Event-participation coverage published by the company itself, cited from its dated company-news index because the individual post URL was not exposed on that index. It evidences exhibition attendance only; the three named countries come from a later company recap dated 16 June 2026, outside the reporting window, and are therefore presented as company-stated rather than confirmed within the week. Watch whether Hai'an converts these exhibitions into named mine-site supply agreements, and the ramp of its second-phase digital mixing workshop announced in May.
title_zh: Hai'an Rubber 在三大洲的矿业展会上推广巨型非公路轮胎
what_happened_zh: Hai'an Rubber Group 的公司新闻页面载有一篇日期为 2026 年 6 月 2 日的帖文，称集团出现在三大洲的国际矿业展会上。公司后续的一则回顾把这些活动确认为在俄罗斯、加纳和智利举办。该帖文没有给出订单、客户或数量细节。巨型非公路轮胎是中国制造商可进入的利润率最高的细分领域，而俄罗斯、西非和智利的矿业展会，正对应着中国非公路轮胎供应一直在替代既有供应商的三个矿业区域。这是由公司自行发布的参展报道，引自其带日期的公司新闻索引页，因为该索引没有暴露单篇帖文的 URL。它只能证明参展；三个具名国家来自公司一则日期为 2026 年 6 月 16 日、位于报告期之外的后续回顾，因此作为公司表述而不是本周内已确认的内容呈现。后续应关注 Hai'an 是否把这些展会转化为具名矿区的供货协议，以及其 5 月宣布的二期数字化密炼车间的产能爬坡。

title: Zodo Tire counts Nairobi as its fifth trade show of 2026 as it works African channels
what_happened: Zodo Tire's own news page records a 5 June 2026 post describing its appearance at the 2026 Kenya (Nairobi) international auto parts exhibition, which it numbers as the fifth stop on its 2026 global exhibition schedule after Moscow, the Canton Fair, Bangkok and Guangrao. The post gives no order, distributor or volume information. Second-tier Chinese makers are building export channels through a dense trade-show circuit rather than through distributor acquisition, and the sequence of shows a company chooses maps the markets it is prioritising as US and EU access tightens. This is event-participation coverage published by the company itself. It evidences attendance at the exhibition and nothing about orders, distributors, volumes or market entry. Watch whether Zodo announces African distributor appointments, or output from its Cambodian plant serving these channels.
title_zh: Zodo Tire 把内罗毕列为其 2026 年第五场展会，持续经营非洲渠道
what_happened_zh: Zodo Tire 自有新闻页面记录了一篇日期为 2026 年 6 月 5 日的帖文，描述其参加 2026 年肯尼亚（内罗毕）国际汽配展览会，并把它列为 2026 年全球展会日程中莫斯科、广交会、曼谷和广饶之后的第五站。该帖文没有给出订单、经销商或数量信息。中国二线制造商正通过密集的展会巡回、而不是收购经销商来建设出口渠道，而一家公司选择的展会顺序，勾画出在美国和欧盟准入收紧之际它所优先考虑的市场。这是由公司自行发布的参展报道。它能证明参加了该展会，而不能说明订单、经销商、数量或市场进入情况。后续应关注 Zodo 是否宣布非洲经销商任命，或其柬埔寨工厂服务这些渠道的产量。

title: Apollo Tyres wins five advertising awards for a cricket-led brand campaign
what_happened: Apollo Tyres published a release, dated 4 June 2026 on its corporate news index, reporting five awards for its 'Har Safar Mein Dum Hai' campaign: three Golds at the JioStar Reimagine Awards for use of sports talent, TV content integration and multi-screen campaigns, and two Bronzes in the Abby Awards audio-visual category. The company says the campaign avoided conventional celebrity endorsement in favour of cricket as a cultural touchpoint and claims it became the fourth most discussed brand during the T20 World Cup while outperforming rivals spending three times as much on advertising. Advertising recognition is a weak but comparable indicator of how hard a tyre maker is investing in consumer brand pull rather than trade push, which matters in a market where Apollo competes with domestic incumbents on shelf presence. An advertising-award recognition item published by the company. It evidences the awards only; the share-of-conversation ranking and the claim of outspending rivals are the company's own with no disclosed measurement source, and the award organisers' criteria were not opened. The release page itself carries no printed date, so the 4 June 2026 date is taken from the company's own news index, which is cited as the second source.
title_zh: Apollo Tyres 凭借以板球为主线的品牌活动赢得五项广告奖
what_happened_zh: Apollo Tyres 发布了一则在其公司新闻索引上日期为 2026 年 6 月 4 日的消息，称其 Har Safar Mein Dum Hai 活动获得五个奖项：在 JioStar Reimagine Awards 上凭借体育明星运用、电视内容整合和多屏活动获得三项金奖，并在 Abby Awards 视听类别获得两项铜奖。公司称，该活动放弃了传统的名人代言，改以板球作为文化触点，并声称它成为 T20 世界杯期间讨论度第四高的品牌，同时表现优于广告投入为其三倍的竞争对手。广告获奖是一个较弱但可比的指标，用以衡量一家轮胎企业在消费者品牌拉力而不是渠道推力上的投入强度，这在 Apollo 与本土既有企业争夺货架存在感的市场中具有意义。本条是由公司发布的广告获奖信息。它只能证明获奖本身；讨论度排名和投入优于竞争对手的说法都是公司自述，没有披露衡量来源，评奖机构的评审标准也没有被打开。该发布页面本身没有印刷日期，因此 2026 年 6 月 4 日的日期取自公司自有的新闻索引，该索引被作为第二来源引用。

title: Sailun supplies factory fitment for Changan's Nevo Q05 as the model launches in Thailand
what_happened: Sailun Group's official news index records a 2 June 2026 post titled 'Sailun joins Changan Nevo Q05 in landing in Thailand', with the company-written summary stating that Sailun Group, as an important supporting partner, provides the original-fitment tyre solution for the model and describing it as a step in the coordinated overseas expansion of China's automotive supply chain. The post itself is published on Sailun's WeChat public account. Chinese OE tyre supply is travelling with Chinese carmakers into export markets, so fitment wins are increasingly decided in the vehicle programme at home rather than won separately in the destination market. Following a customer into Thailand converts a domestic OE relationship into installed-base and replacement demand in a market where Chinese makers already have plants, which is a more durable position than export shipments. For competitors in Southeast Asia it means the OE decision has already been made upstream. The evidence supports Sailun's own statement of its supply role: no Changan confirmation, fitment size or volume was recovered. Watch for Changan or Thai-market confirmation of the fitment and its sizes, and whether Sailun discloses OE volumes for the Nevo Q05 programme.
title_zh: 赛轮为 Changan Nevo Q05 提供原厂配套，该车型在泰国上市
what_happened_zh: 赛轮集团官方新闻索引记录了一篇日期为 2026 年 6 月 2 日、题为《赛轮与 Changan Nevo Q05 一同登陆泰国》的帖文，公司撰写的摘要称，赛轮集团作为重要配套合作伙伴，为该车型提供原厂配套轮胎方案，并把它描述为中国汽车供应链协同出海的一步。该帖文本身发布在赛轮的微信公众号上。中国原配轮胎供应正随中国车企进入出口市场，因此配套胜负越来越多在国内的整车项目中决定，而不再是在目的地市场单独争取。跟随客户进入泰国，把一段国内原配关系转化为该市场的保有量和替换需求，而中国制造商在当地已有工厂，这比出口发货是更持久的位置。对东南亚的竞争者而言，这意味着原配决策已经在上游作出。证据支持的是赛轮对自身供货角色的表述：没有取得 Changan 方面的确认、配套规格或数量。后续应关注 Changan 或泰国市场是否确认该配套及其规格，以及赛轮是否披露 Nevo Q05 项目的原配数量。

title: China gets a 16-step chain-store tyre replacement guideline, drafted by Michelin and TyrePlus with CCFA
companies: China Chain Store and Franchise Association; Michelin China; TyrePlus
what_happened: China Tire Business Network reported on 5 June 2026, following an earlier 3 June item, that the China Chain Store and Franchise Association released on 29 May 2026 the country's first standardised document covering the full tyre-replacement process in aftermarket chain stores, drafted jointly by Michelin, its TyrePlus service brand and CCFA. The guideline breaks replacement into 16 standardised steps with technical parameters, key operating points and acceptance principles, spanning vehicle pre-inspection, lifting safety, tyre removal and installation, inflation and adjustment, dynamic balancing, wheel fastening and road-test verification. Stores are to explain items such as same-axle tyre matching and model-appropriate inflation pressure to customers, and the report notes recommended pressures differ by automaker and model with new-energy vehicle recommendations generally higher. Michelin China vice-president and TyrePlus general manager Xu Yanwei spoke at the release. A maker writing the service standard its competitors' franchisees will be measured against is a quieter form of channel power than owning stores, and it converts an in-house training system into an industry benchmark. Fitment quality is where independent Chinese chains lose against organised networks, so a published 16-step acceptance standard gives franchise operators a defensible service claim and gives insurers and fleets something to audit against. It also embeds NEV-specific inflation practice into routine service, which matters as heavier electric vehicles reach the aftermarket in volume. This is association guidance, not a mandatory national standard. Watch whether CCFA publishes the guideline text or an adoption list, and whether non-Michelin chains adopt the 16-step flow.
title_zh: 中国出台 16 步连锁门店换胎指引，由米其林与 TyrePlus 联合中国连锁经营协会起草
what_happened_zh: China Tire Business Network 2026 年 6 月 5 日报道（此前 6 月 3 日已有一则相关消息），中国连锁经营协会于 2026 年 5 月 29 日发布了国内首份覆盖售后连锁门店完整换胎流程的标准化文件，由米其林、其 TyrePlus 服务品牌与中国连锁经营协会共同起草。该指引把换胎拆分为 16 个标准化步骤，配有技术参数、关键操作要点和验收原则，涵盖车辆预检、举升安全、轮胎拆装、充气与调整、动平衡、轮辋紧固和路试验证。门店需要向客户说明同轴轮胎匹配、与车型相适应的充气压力等事项，报道还提到推荐胎压因车企和车型而异，新能源车型的推荐值通常更高。米其林中国副总裁、TyrePlus 总经理 Xu Yanwei 在发布会上发言。一家制造商撰写其竞争对手的加盟商将据以被衡量的服务标准，是比自营门店更安静的一种渠道权力，它把一套内部培训体系变成了行业基准。装胎质量是中国独立连锁相对有组织网络的失分处，因此一份公开的 16 步验收标准，既让加盟商有可辩护的服务主张，也给保险公司和车队提供了可审核的依据。它还把新能源车专用的充气实践嵌入日常服务，这在更重的电动车大量进入售后市场时具有意义。本条是协会指引，而不是强制性国家标准。后续应关注中国连锁经营协会是否公布指引全文或采用名单，以及非米其林体系的连锁是否采用这套 16 步流程。

title: Yokohama takes the Land Cruiser FJ fitment for Asia, the Middle East, Latin America and Africa but not Japan
what_happened: Yokohama Rubber announced on 2 June 2026 that its GEOLANDAR A/T G94 all-terrain tyre is factory-equipped on Toyota's new Land Cruiser FJ for units sold in Asia, the Middle East, Latin America and Africa, and stated in a footnote that the tyre will not be fitted to Land Cruiser FJ cars sold in Japan. No tyre sizes are given. Yokohama places the win under its 2024-2026 medium-term plan, in which the consumer tyre unit is targeting a larger share of high-value-added tyres partly through OE promotion of ADVAN and GEOLANDAR for SUVs and pickups. A regional-only fitment on a global nameplate shows OE awards are being split by market rather than won outright, which lets a maker book volume where its plants and replacement channels actually are. The explicit Japan exclusion is the useful detail: it tells competitors where the same programme is still open. No sizes or volumes are disclosed, so the commercial scale is unknown. Watch which supplier takes the Japanese-market Land Cruiser FJ fitment, and whether Yokohama discloses GEOLANDAR OE volume in its medium-term plan reporting.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶拿下 Land Cruiser FJ 在亚洲、中东、拉美和非洲的配套，但不含日本
what_happened_zh: 横滨橡胶 2026 年 6 月 2 日宣布，其 GEOLANDAR A/T G94 全地形轮胎已成为丰田全新 Land Cruiser FJ 在亚洲、中东、拉丁美洲和非洲销售车辆的原厂配套，并在脚注中说明该轮胎不会配装在日本销售的 Land Cruiser FJ 上。未给出轮胎规格。横滨橡胶把这次获取置于其 2024-2026 年中期计划之下，该计划中消费轮胎板块的目标是提高高附加值轮胎占比，途径之一就是为 SUV 和皮卡推广 ADVAN 与 GEOLANDAR 的原配。一个全球车系上只覆盖部分区域的配套，说明原配授予正按市场拆分而不是整体授予，这让制造商可以在自有工厂和替换渠道所在之处确认销量。明确排除日本是有用的细节：它告诉竞争对手，同一项目在哪里仍然敞开。未披露规格或数量，因此商业规模尚不清楚。后续应关注哪家供应商拿下日本市场的 Land Cruiser FJ 配套，以及横滨橡胶是否在中期计划的报告中披露 GEOLANDAR 的原配数量。

title: Guizhou Tyre's severe-road engineering-tire project passes technical appraisal
what_happened: Guizhou Tyre reported that a heavy-duty, high-speed engineering-tire project for harsh roads passed appraisal. The company linked the work to 13 invention patents, two national standards and five new sizes including 16.00R29. The appraisal and disclosed intellectual-property outputs show a development milestone, but claims that durability and temperature performance exceed peer levels are company statements without a recoverable comparative protocol. Watch for Independent test reports, named equipment fitments and serial-production volumes for the five sizes.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎恶路工程轮胎项目通过技术鉴定
what_happened_zh: 贵州轮胎称，一项面向恶劣路面的重载高速工程轮胎项目通过鉴定。公司将该项目与 13 项发明专利、两项国家标准以及包括 16.00R29 在内的五个新规格相关联。此次鉴定与已披露的知识产权成果显示出研发阶段的进展，但关于耐久性和温度性能超过同类水平的说法属于公司表述，并无可复核的对比测试方案。后续应关注独立测试报告、具名的设备配套，以及这五个规格的量产产量。

title: Hankook launches Winter i*cept evo 4 range with a claimed 15% mileage gain
what_happened: Hankook launched Winter i*cept evo 4 and evo 4 SUV products and claimed 15% more mileage than the predecessor. It said the family would exceed 160 sizes spanning 17 to 22 inches. A large size plan makes the successor commercially relevant, but the mileage improvement remains a manufacturer comparison without a recoverable test protocol in the release. Watch for Independent winter testing, EU-label values and actual size availability before the winter season.
title_zh: 韩泰推出 Winter i*cept evo 4 系列，宣称里程提升 15%
what_happened_zh: 韩泰推出 Winter i*cept evo 4 与 evo 4 SUV 产品，并宣称里程比上一代多 15%。公司称该产品家族的规格数将超过 160 个，覆盖 17 至 22 英寸。庞大的规格规划使这一换代产品具有商业意义，但里程改善仍属制造商自行对比，新闻稿中没有可复核的测试方案。后续应关注独立冬季测试、EU 标签数值，以及冬季来临前的实际规格供货情况。

title: Prinx debuts Xelera commercial-vehicle portfolio and X-CHIP monitoring in Europe
what_happened: Prinx introduced three European commercial-vehicle series—Xelera EcoLine, EcoRoute and Route—covering nine tread patterns. It also showed X-CHIP intelligent tire monitoring and announced retread cooperation with Marangoni. The package combines new product architecture, connected monitoring and a named retread partner, but no fleet result or measured total-cost improvement was disclosed. Watch for Country availability, fleet trials, monitoring deployment and casings entering Marangoni retread programs.
title_zh: 浦林成山在欧洲首发 Xelera 商用车产品系列与 X-CHIP 监测技术
what_happened_zh: 浦林成山推出三个面向欧洲的商用车系列——Xelera EcoLine、EcoRoute 和 Route——共覆盖九种花纹。公司同时展示了 X-CHIP 智能轮胎监测，并宣布与 Marangoni 开展翻新合作。该方案把新的产品架构、互联监测和具名的翻新伙伴组合在一起，但没有披露车队运行结果或经量化的总成本改善。后续应关注各国供货情况、车队试用、监测系统部署，以及进入 Marangoni 翻新项目的胎体。

title: Guizhou Tyre receives TÜV SÜD certification for multiple second-generation truck products
what_happened: Guizhou Tyre said multiple second-generation truck and bus tire products received TÜV SÜD certification during The Tire Cologne. Third-party certification is a clearer market-access signal than a product display, although the accessible notice does not disclose the certificate numbers, exact sizes or tested results. Watch for Certificate records, covered sizes and European distributor listings tied to the certified products.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎多款第二代卡客车产品获得 TÜV SÜD 认证
what_happened_zh: 贵州轮胎表示，多款第二代卡车和客车轮胎产品在 The Tire Cologne 展会期间获得 TÜV SÜD 认证。第三方认证是比产品展示更明确的市场准入信号，不过可获取的公告没有披露证书编号、具体规格或测试结果。后续应关注证书记录、覆盖规格，以及与认证产品相关的欧洲经销商名录。

title: Linglong previews Sport Master 2 with 74 European sizes planned for spring 2027
what_happened: Linglong unveiled Sport Master 2 at The Tire Cologne and said its European team led development, testing and production preparation. The range covers 16- to 22-inch fitments, with a first wave of 74 sizes planned for spring 2027. The release gives a bounded commercialization schedule and shows Linglong localizing European product development, but it does not establish current retail availability or independent performance superiority. Watch for EU-label results, independent comparative tests and market-by-market listings when the first sizes arrive in 2027.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎预告 Sport Master 2，计划 2027 年春季推出 74 个欧洲规格
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎在 The Tire Cologne 展会上发布 Sport Master 2，并表示由其欧洲团队主导开发、测试和量产准备。该系列覆盖 16 至 22 英寸配套，首批 74 个规格计划于 2027 年春季推出。该消息给出了有边界的商业化时间表，显示玲珑正在本地化开展欧洲产品开发，但并不能确认当前的零售供货情况或经独立验证的性能优势。后续应关注 EU 标签结果、独立对比测试，以及首批规格 2027 年上市时各市场的产品名录。

title: General Science demonstrates an eucommia-rubber tire with multi-function performance claims
what_happened: At The Tire Cologne, General Science demonstrated an eucommia-rubber tire and claimed more than 30% better wear, front-tire life above 80,000 km, wet braking over four metres shorter, sealing of punctures up to 5 mm and a 9 dB cavity-noise reduction. It also reported more than USD1 million in intended orders. The alternative-rubber and multi-function package is technically notable, but no test protocol, sample size, named baseline or independent confirmation was provided. Intended orders are not booked sales. Watch for a test report naming comparison tires and conditions, plus conversion of intended orders into confirmed shipments.
title_zh: 通用股份展示杜仲胶轮胎并提出多项功能性能宣称
what_happened_zh: 在 The Tire Cologne 展会上，通用股份展示了一款杜仲胶轮胎，并声称磨耗改善超过 30%、前轮使用寿命超过 80,000 km、湿地制动距离缩短四米以上、可自封最大 5 mm 的穿孔，并使腔体噪声降低 9 dB。公司还表示获得超过 USD1 million 的意向订单。这一替代胶种与多功能组合在技术上值得关注，但未提供测试方案、样本量、具名基准或独立验证。意向订单并非已确认的销售。后续应关注列明对比轮胎与测试条件的测试报告，以及意向订单转化为确认发货的情况。

title: Michelin validates a 50% renewable-or-recycled endurance tire over 600-kilometre stints
what_happened: Michelin reported that its Pilot Sport Endurance tire containing 50% renewable or recycled materials completed multiple stints exceeding 600 kilometres at Le Mans while supporting the winning car. The race supplies severe-use validation at a disclosed material-content level, but it does not establish road-tire life-cycle performance, mass-production economics or the exact material recipe. Watch for Transfer to a road product, audited material accounting and standardized wear, grip and rolling-resistance results.
title_zh: 米其林验证 50% 可再生或再生材料耐力轮胎可完成 600 公里赛段
what_happened_zh: 米其林称，其含 50% 可再生或再生材料的 Pilot Sport Endurance 轮胎在勒芒完成了多个超过 600 公里的赛段，并为夺冠赛车提供支持。这场比赛提供了在已披露材料含量水平下的严苛使用验证，但并不能确立公路轮胎的全生命周期表现、量产经济性或确切的材料配方。后续应关注该技术向公路产品的转化、经审核的材料核算，以及标准化的磨耗、抓地力和滚动阻力结果。

title: Giti gives FlexCore airless tire its first public appearance in Singapore
what_happened: Giti presented its FlexCore airless concept publicly for the first time during Singapore Road Safety Month, alongside the GitiComfort F26. A first public appearance moves the airless concept into external demonstration, but the company disclosed no durability, speed, load, comfort or production-readiness data. Watch for Prototype specifications, regulated testing, vehicle integration and a named commercialization path.
title_zh: 佳通 FlexCore 非充气轮胎在新加坡首次公开亮相
what_happened_zh: 佳通在新加坡道路安全月期间首次公开展示其 FlexCore 非充气概念轮胎，同时展出 GitiComfort F26。首次公开亮相把非充气概念推进到对外展示阶段，但公司没有披露耐久性、速度、负荷、舒适性或量产准备方面的数据。后续应关注样胎规格、法规测试、整车集成，以及具名的商业化路径。

title: ZC Rubber sets second-half 2026 timing for new Westlake and Goodride European ranges
what_happened: ZC Rubber set second-half 2026 launch timing for new Westlake and Goodride passenger-car, van and commercial products shown in Cologne, while distinguishing further 2027 previews from nearer-term releases. The disclosure converts part of the European portfolio from a show concept into a dated launch window, but does not provide named country launch dates or comparative test evidence. Watch for Market listings, EU-label data and realized H2 availability for each named range.
title_zh: 中策橡胶将 Westlake 与 Goodride 欧洲新系列定于 2026 年下半年推出
what_happened_zh: 中策橡胶把在科隆展出的 Westlake 和 Goodride 乘用车、轻客与商用车新产品的上市时间定在 2026 年下半年，同时将更远期的 2027 年预告与近期发布区分开来。这一披露把部分欧洲产品线从展会概念转为有明确时间窗口的上市计划，但没有给出具名国家的上市日期或对比测试证据。后续应关注各具名系列的市场名录、EU 标签数据，以及 H2 的实际供货情况。

title: BKT introduces three off-highway products for mining, skid-steer and forklift use
what_happened: BKT used The Tire Cologne to introduce Earthmax SR30M, Skid Max SR720 and Maglift Plus products targeting mining, skid-steer and forklift applications. The releases broaden BKT's application coverage, but accessible reports offer feature claims rather than comparative life, heat or cost-per-hour results. Watch for Dealer availability and instrumented field trials against incumbent products in each application.
title_zh: BKT 推出三款面向矿用、滑移装载机和叉车的非公路产品
what_happened_zh: BKT 借 The Tire Cologne 展会推出 Earthmax SR30M、Skid Max SR720 和 Maglift Plus 产品，分别面向矿用、滑移装载机和叉车应用。这些新产品扩大了 BKT 的应用覆盖范围，但可获取的报道提供的是功能宣称，而非对比寿命、生热或单小时成本结果。后续应关注经销商供货情况，以及在各类应用中与现有产品进行的带测量设备实地试用。

title: Continental expands military-tire portfolio with three application-specific lines
what_happened: Continental announced an expanded military portfolio for Eurosatory, including SOT Traction, HCS and Grabber X3 lines for different tactical and off-road applications. The portfolio broadens Continental's specialty-market offer, but the release provides design descriptions rather than comparative durability, mobility or contract evidence. Watch for Defense qualification, procurement awards and standardized field-test results for the new lines.
title_zh: 大陆集团以三条面向特定应用的产品线扩充军用轮胎系列
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团宣布为 Eurosatory 展会扩充其军用轮胎系列，包括面向不同战术和越野应用的 SOT Traction、HCS 和 Grabber X3 产品线。该系列扩大了大陆集团在特种市场的供应范围，但新闻稿提供的是设计描述，而非对比耐久性、机动性或合同证据。后续应关注国防认证、采购中标，以及新产品线的标准化实地测试结果。

title: Gajah Tunggal launches Zeneos Starize sizes and Champiro GTX Pro 2 at Jakarta Fair
what_happened: Gajah Tunggal launched new 13- and 14-inch Zeneos Starize sizes and the Champiro GTX Pro 2 during the 2026 Jakarta Fair. The launch broadens local replacement-market coverage, especially in small-rim segments, but the release does not disclose comparative tests or sales expectations. Watch for Dealer availability, full size tables, independent testing and early sell-through.
title_zh: Gajah Tunggal 在雅加达博览会推出 Zeneos Starize 新规格与 Champiro GTX Pro 2
what_happened_zh: Gajah Tunggal 在 2026 年雅加达博览会期间推出 13 和 14 英寸的 Zeneos Starize 新规格以及 Champiro GTX Pro 2。此次发布扩大了本地替换市场的覆盖范围，尤其是在小轮辋细分市场，但新闻稿没有披露对比测试或销售预期。后续应关注经销商供货情况、完整规格表、独立测试和早期零售走量。

title: Yokohama Mazda CX-5 fitment resurfaces during the weekly window
what_happened: Tire Review reported that Yokohama's Advan V61 in size 225/65R17 102V was being supplied as original equipment for the 2026 Mazda CX-5 in Japan and other markets including Europe. The in-window trade recap keeps a relevant OE fitment visible, but it traces to Yokohama's May announcement and does not describe an incremental order or new market award during this week. This is a June 8 trade-media recap of an official May fitment announcement. It confirms the stated OE size but adds no new order, geography or production stage. Watch for Additional CX-5 fitment sizes, regional vehicle-volume disclosures or a new Mazda platform nomination.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶马自达 CX-5 配套在本周窗口内再度出现
what_happened_zh: Tire Review 报道称，横滨橡胶的 Advan V61 以 225/65R17 102V 规格为 2026 款马自达 CX-5 提供原厂配套，覆盖日本以及包括欧洲在内的其他市场。这条窗口期内的行业媒体回顾让一项相关的原配配套保持可见，但其源头可追溯至横滨橡胶 5 月的公告，并未描述本周内新增的订单或新的市场获取。这是 6 月 8 日行业媒体对 5 月官方配套公告的回顾报道，它确认了所述原配规格，但没有增加新的订单、地域或生产阶段。后续应关注 CX-5 的更多配套规格、区域车型产量披露，或马自达新平台的提名。

title: Sumitomo Rubber previews another Sensing Core exhibition
what_happened: Sumitomo Rubber announced that it would exhibit its established Sensing Core technology at a forthcoming event. Continued exhibition shows that Sensing Core remains part of the company's external technology narrative, but the announcement does not establish a new technical or customer stage. The source is a reliable company announcement about its own exhibition plan, but it is a preview of established technology and provides no new validation, customer adoption or commercialization result. Watch for a named vehicle, fleet or road-safety deployment with disclosed sensing method and measured performance.
title_zh: 住友橡胶预告 Sensing Core 的又一次展出
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶宣布将在即将举行的一场活动上展出其已有的 Sensing Core 技术。持续展出说明 Sensing Core 仍是该公司对外技术叙事的一部分，但该公告并未确立新的技术或客户阶段。该来源是公司关于自身展出计划的可靠公告，但属于对已有技术的预告，没有提供新的验证、客户采用或商业化结果。后续应关注具名的整车、车队或道路安全部署，并附带公开的传感方法与可量化的性能表现。

title: Hankook schedules EV-tire display at Everything Electric UK
what_happened: Hankook announced participation in Everything Electric UK 2026, where it planned to display existing electric-vehicle tire products and brand positioning. The appearance indicates continued investment in EV-focused consumer outreach, but it is an event preview rather than a product, test, order or sales milestone. The company source reliably establishes planned participation, but the item repeats existing EV positioning and offers no new product, test, customer or sales result. Watch for a new EV-specific product, independent efficiency result, OE nomination or measured customer response following the event.
title_zh: 韩泰计划在 Everything Electric UK 展出电动车轮胎
what_happened_zh: 韩泰宣布参加 Everything Electric UK 2026，并计划在展会上展示现有的电动车轮胎产品与品牌定位。此次参展表明公司在面向电动车的消费者沟通上持续投入，但这属于展会预告，而非产品、测试、订单或销售方面的里程碑。公司来源可靠地确认了参展计划，但该条目重复了既有的电动车定位，没有提供新的产品、测试、客户或销售结果。后续应关注展会之后出现的全新电动车专用产品、独立能效结果、原配提名或可量化的客户反馈。

title: China tire exporters face renewed Asia-Europe container-rate pressure in June
what_happened: CRIA's rubber-media service reported Asia-Europe 40-foot base rates rising from about USD2,000 in February to USD4,300-4,700 in early June, with some carriers considering an additional USD500 surcharge. It also cited five consecutive weeks of SCFI increases. Higher freight directly affects the landed-cost advantage and delivery planning of export tires, but the quoted route prices are indicative ranges rather than a full market average. Watch for SCFI direction, surcharge implementation and tire exporters' pricing or routing responses.
title_zh: 中国轮胎出口商 6 月再度面临亚欧航线集装箱运价压力
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会的橡胶传媒服务报道称，亚欧航线 40 英尺箱基础运价从 2 月的约 USD2,000 升至 6 月初的 USD4,300-4,700，部分船公司还在考虑加收 USD500 附加费。报道同时提到 SCFI 已连续五周上涨。运费上升直接影响出口轮胎的到岸成本优势和交付计划，但所引用的航线价格属于指示性区间，而非完整的市场均价。后续应关注 SCFI 走势、附加费的实际执行，以及轮胎出口企业在定价或航线上的应对。

title: ARLANXEO shifts all chloroprene-rubber production to ISCC Plus-certified chlorine
what_happened: ARLANXEO and Covestro said all ARLANXEO chloroprene-rubber production had used ISCC Plus-certified chlorine under mass balance since January 2026. Depending on grade, they estimated about 20% lower product global-warming potential versus 2025. The change applies across a full production stream rather than a pilot, but the reduction is supplier-calculated, grade-dependent and based on mass-balance accounting rather than physical segregation. Watch for Grade-specific product carbon footprints, assurance statements and customer uptake in rubber compounds.
title_zh: ARLANXEO 将全部氯丁橡胶生产转向使用 ISCC Plus 认证的氯
what_happened_zh: ARLANXEO 与 Covestro 表示，自 2026 年 1 月以来，ARLANXEO 的全部氯丁橡胶生产均在质量平衡体系下使用经 ISCC Plus 认证的氯。两家公司估计，视牌号而定，产品的全球变暖潜值较 2025 年降低约 20%。这一变化覆盖整条生产流而非试点，但减排幅度由供应商自行计算、随牌号而异，并且基于质量平衡核算而非实物隔离。后续应关注分牌号的产品碳足迹、保证声明，以及橡胶胶料客户的采用情况。

title: Waste-tire carbon support yields selective furan catalyst after mild acid treatment
companies: University of Oviedo; Politécnico Colombiano Jaime Isaza Cadavid
what_happened: Researchers made two 1 wt% palladium catalysts from waste-tire carbon supports treated with 1 M or 18.4 M sulfuric acid. The 1 M material showed activity from 200 to 300 degrees Celsius and near-complete furan selectivity at 350 degrees, while the stronger-acid material was inactive. The study demonstrates a non-tire outlet for recovered tire carbon and shows that support treatment controls performance, but it is a laboratory model reaction rather than a scaled recycling or hydrogen-storage process. Watch for Catalyst lifetime, sulfur leaching, mass balance, scale-up economics and performance in a practical hydrogen-storage cycle.
title_zh: 废旧轮胎炭载体经温和酸处理后获得高选择性呋喃催化剂
what_happened_zh: 研究人员以经 1 M 或 18.4 M 硫酸处理的废旧轮胎炭载体，制备了两种 1 wt% 的钯催化剂。经 1 M 处理的材料在 200 至 300 摄氏度区间表现出活性，并在 350 摄氏度下接近完全的呋喃选择性，而经更高浓度酸处理的材料则没有活性。该研究展示了回收轮胎炭在轮胎之外的一条利用途径，并表明载体处理方式决定性能表现，但这属于实验室模型反应，而非规模化的回收或储氢工艺。后续应关注催化剂寿命、硫的溶出、物料平衡、放大经济性，以及在实际储氢循环中的表现。

title: Bivalve study finds stronger intestinal injury under combined 6PPD-Q and TiO2 exposure
what_happened: A peer-reviewed study exposed Mytilus coruscus for 14 days to 6PPD-quinone at 1 or 10 micrograms per litre, TiO2 nanoparticles at 0.1 milligrams per litre, or mixtures. Mixed exposure produced stronger oxidative, inflammatory, apoptotic, microbiome and tissue responses than individual treatments. The work adds mixture-toxicity evidence for a tire-derived transformation product, but laboratory bivalve exposure does not quantify ambient risk, human risk or the performance of an alternative tire formulation. Watch for Field-relevant concentration studies, environmental monitoring and regulatory or formulation responses tied to 6PPD-Q.
title_zh: 贻贝研究发现 6PPD-Q 与 TiO2 联合暴露下肠道损伤更为严重
what_happened_zh: 一项同行评议研究将厚壳贻贝（Mytilus coruscus）暴露 14 天，分别接触浓度为每升 1 或 10 微克的 6PPD-醌、每升 0.1 毫克的 TiO2 纳米颗粒，或二者的混合物。混合暴露引起的氧化、炎症、凋亡、微生物组和组织反应均强于单一处理。该研究为一种轮胎衍生转化产物增加了混合毒性证据，但实验室贻贝暴露并不能量化环境风险、人体风险或替代轮胎配方的性能。后续应关注贴近实际环境浓度的研究、环境监测，以及与 6PPD-Q 相关的监管或配方应对。

title: Malaysia's April rubber output falls 8.8% month on month as exports rise 12.7%
what_happened: Malaysia's statistics department reported April natural-rubber production of 18,515 tonnes, down 8.8% month on month but up 2.8% year on year. Stocks fell 6.2% to 130,698 tonnes, exports rose 12.7% to 37,360 tonnes, and China took 50.8% of exports. The primary dataset shows lower near-term output and inventories alongside stronger export demand, a combination relevant to regional feedstock availability. Watch for May production, stocks, export destinations and producer price movement.
title_zh: 马来西亚 4 月橡胶产量环比下降 8.8%，出口增长 12.7%
what_happened_zh: 马来西亚统计局报告称，4 月天然橡胶产量为 18,515 吨，环比下降 8.8%，同比上升 2.8%。库存下降 6.2% 至 130,698 吨，出口增长 12.7% 至 37,360 吨，其中中国占出口量的 50.8%。这份一手数据显示近期产量和库存下降，同时出口需求增强，这一组合对区域原料供应具有参考意义。后续应关注 5 月产量、库存、出口目的地和生产者价格走势。

title: Qingdao process reports 97.33% extracted insoluble sulfur without a grinding step
companies: Qingdao Institute of Bioenergy and Bioprocess Technology; CRIA
what_happened: CRIA reported a Qingdao-developed cyclonic adiabatic injection and microbubble rapid-quench route that produced continuous powder. Reported extracted insoluble sulfur was 97.33%, and oil-treated thermal stability was 86.49%, while the process removed a grinding step. The results point to process simplification for a critical vulcanization chemical, but the accessible association report does not establish plant-scale throughput, batch variability, economics or tire-compound validation. Watch for Pilot capacity, repeated quality distributions, cost and energy data, and qualification in production rubber compounds.
title_zh: 青岛工艺报告不溶性硫提取率达 97.33% 且省去研磨工序
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会报道称，青岛开发的旋流绝热喷射与微气泡急冷路线可连续制得粉体。报道的不溶性硫提取率为 97.33%，油处理后的热稳定性为 86.49%，同时该工艺省去了研磨工序。这些结果显示一种关键硫化助剂的工艺得到简化，但可获取的协会报道并未确立工厂规模的产能、批次波动性、经济性或轮胎胶料验证。后续应关注中试产能、重复性的质量分布、成本与能耗数据，以及在量产胶料中的认证情况。

title: CRIA publishes a June reference-price snapshot across major tire raw materials
what_happened: CRIA published city-level reference prices covering natural and synthetic rubber, butyl rubber, zinc oxide, stearic acid, accelerators, antioxidants, bead wire, nylon reinforcement and carbon-black grades including N220, N330 and N660. A multi-material snapshot helps identify simultaneous input-cost pressure across tire recipes, but reference quotes are not transaction-weighted prices and should not be generalized beyond the listed cities and dates. Watch for Month-over-month movements, transaction evidence and producer price announcements for the same grades.
title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会发布 6 月主要轮胎原料参考价快照
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会发布了分城市的参考价格，覆盖天然橡胶与合成橡胶、丁基橡胶、氧化锌、硬脂酸、促进剂、防老剂、胎圈钢丝、尼龙骨架材料，以及包括 N220、N330 和 N660 在内的炭黑牌号。多品种快照有助于识别轮胎配方中同时出现的投入成本压力，但参考报价并非以成交量加权的价格，不应推广到所列城市和日期之外。后续应关注环比变动、成交证据，以及相同牌号的生产企业调价公告。

title: China reinforcement-materials conference translates new ISO test methods for tire suppliers
companies: China Rubber Industry Association; Linglong Tire
what_happened: A June 10-12 technical conference with more than 150 participants covered ISO 23475-2:2025 steel-cord adhesion and ISO 16650:2025 bead-wire test methods, Chinese nylon-cord energy standards and a Linglong presentation on glass fiber in passenger tires. The meeting connects recent international test methods to Chinese tire-reinforcement practice, but conference attendance and presentations do not prove supplier qualification or product adoption. Watch for Laboratory accreditation, supplier specification revisions and tire-program qualification using the referenced methods.
title_zh: 中国骨架材料会议为轮胎供应商解读新版 ISO 测试方法
what_happened_zh: 一场于 6 月 10 日至 12 日举行、参会者超过 150 人的技术会议，内容涵盖 ISO 23475-2:2025 钢丝帘线粘合与 ISO 16650:2025 胎圈钢丝测试方法、中国尼龙帘线能耗标准，以及玲珑轮胎关于乘用车轮胎中玻璃纤维应用的报告。该会议把近期的国际测试方法与中国轮胎骨架材料实践联系起来，但参会和报告并不能证明供应商已通过认证或产品已被采用。后续应关注实验室资质认定、供应商规范修订，以及使用上述方法开展的轮胎项目认证。

title: CRIA summarizes first-half tire-material sustainability projects
what_happened: CRIA published a first-half sustainability roundup covering several previously announced projects, including circular-carbon-black feedstock work, ISCC Plus certification and an induction nitrogen-curing energy claim. The roundup is useful as a compact map of activity across Chinese tire materials and processing, even though it does not establish a fresh project milestone during this week. This is an association roundup of older underlying events, not a new primary project announcement. It is included as background context, and the individual claims retain their original company or association provenance. Return to each underlying company or project source for dated capacity, qualification, commissioning and measured energy results.
title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会汇总上半年轮胎材料可持续项目
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会发布了上半年可持续发展综述，覆盖多个此前已公布的项目，包括循环炭黑原料工作、ISCC Plus 认证以及一项电磁感应氮气硫化的能耗宣称。这份综述作为中国轮胎材料与加工领域活动的紧凑图景具有参考价值，尽管它并未确立本周内新的项目里程碑。这是协会对更早期底层事件的综述，而不是新的一手项目公告。本条作为背景信息收录，各项具体宣称仍保留其原有的公司或协会出处。应回到各底层公司或项目来源，查阅带日期的产能、认证、投产和经量化的能耗结果。

title: Reinforcement conference attendance and ceremonies form a duplicate candidate
what_happened: The same CRIA reinforcement-conference page also recorded attendance, opening remarks, committee activity and ceremonial elements around the June 10-12 meeting. The event-level detail helps show the breadth of the Chinese reinforcement-materials network, but it is not separate technical evidence from the standards content already reported in the core story. This context item deliberately repeats the source used by core story CN-MSC-04. Ceremonial and attendance content is not independent evidence and adds no measured technical result. Watch for Published proceedings, supplier specification changes or laboratory adoption attributable to the meeting.
title_zh: 骨架材料会议的参会与仪式内容构成重复候选条目
what_happened_zh: 同一份中国橡胶工业协会骨架材料会议页面还记录了 6 月 10 日至 12 日会议期间的参会情况、开幕致辞、专委会活动和仪式性内容。这些活动层面的细节有助于展现中国骨架材料网络的广度，但相对核心内容中已经报道的标准相关内容，它并不构成独立的技术证据。本条背景信息有意重复使用了核心内容 CN-MSC-04 所用的来源。仪式与参会内容不是独立证据，也没有增加可量化的技术结果。后续应关注会议公开的会议纪要、供应商规范变更，或可归因于本次会议的实验室采纳情况。

title: Prinx Malaysia project reaches a second equipment-contract stage worth RMB116.1 million
what_happened: An in-window industry recap said a second-stage equipment contract worth RMB116.072 million was signed on May 29 for Prinx's Malaysia project, bringing the first two stages to RMB400.16 million. Listed equipment included 55-inch truck-tire and 48-inch passenger-tire curing presses and an open mill. Binding equipment orders are a stronger execution signal than headline capacity plans, but the recap does not establish delivery, installation or commissioning. Watch for Equipment shipment, installation and commissioning against the project's planned 6 million passenger and 0.6 million truck-tire annual capacity.
title_zh: 浦林成山马来西亚项目进入第二阶段设备合同，金额达 RMB116.1 million
what_happened_zh: 一篇窗口期内的行业回顾称，浦林成山马来西亚项目于 5 月 29 日签署了金额为 RMB116.072 million 的第二阶段设备合同，使前两个阶段合计达到 RMB400.16 million。所列设备包括 55 英寸卡车轮胎硫化机、48 英寸乘用车轮胎硫化机和一台开炼机。有约束力的设备订单是比产能规划标题数字更有力的执行信号，但该回顾并未确立交付、安装或投产情况。后续应关注设备发运、安装和投产进度，并对照该项目规划的年产 6 million 条乘用车轮胎与 0.6 million 条卡车轮胎产能。

title: Yanggu Huatai targets 2027 full output for RMB530 million lignin-additives project
what_happened: CRIA reported official visits to Yanggu Huatai's RMB530 million lignin-based rubber-additives project and stated targets of completion in December 2026, full output in 2027 and 176,000 tonnes per year of bio-based additives. If executed, the project would industrialize a large bio-based additives stream, but completion timing, output and environmental benefits remain project targets rather than operating results. Watch for Construction progress, equipment installation, permits, trial production and product qualification before the 2027 ramp.
title_zh: Yanggu Huatai 的 RMB530 million 木质素助剂项目目标 2027 年满产
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会报道了对 Yanggu Huatai 投资 RMB530 million 的木质素基橡胶助剂项目开展的官方考察，并提到该项目的目标是 2026 年 12 月建成、2027 年满产，年产 176,000 吨生物基助剂。若按计划执行，该项目将把一条规模较大的生物基助剂产业链工业化，但建成时间、产量和环境效益仍属项目目标，而非运行结果。后续应关注 2027 年产能爬坡之前的工程进度、设备安装、许可审批、试生产和产品认证。

title: Magna Tyres takes majority stake in Forrez while the founding family remains
what_happened: Magna Tyres became majority shareholder in Forrez, with the Forrez family remaining involved. The parties estimated combined 2026 turnover at EUR275 million and set a EUR650 million goal for 2029. The closed transaction combines tire distribution businesses and preserves operating continuity, but the 2029 turnover figure is a management target rather than a forecast backed by disclosed integration economics. Watch for Legal-entity integration, warehouse and sales-network changes, and progress against audited revenue.
title_zh: Magna Tyres 取得 Forrez 多数股权，创始家族仍将参与
what_happened_zh: Magna Tyres 成为 Forrez 的多数股东，Forrez 家族仍继续参与经营。双方估计 2026 年合并营业额为 EUR275 million，并为 2029 年设定了 EUR650 million 的目标。这笔已完成的交易整合了轮胎分销业务并保持了经营连续性，但 2029 年的营业额数字属于管理层目标，而非有公开整合经济性支撑的预测。后续应关注法人实体整合、仓储与销售网络变化，以及对照经审计营收的进展。

title: Nexen opens Guelph distribution centre to hold year-round Canadian inventory
what_happened: Nexen opened a distribution centre in Guelph, Ontario, intended to maintain local inventory, reduce partner lead times and support dealer training and service. A local warehouse is a concrete channel-capability change, but the sources do not disclose capacity, baseline delivery time or service-level attainment. Watch for Warehouse throughput, fill rate, dealer additions and measured order-to-delivery time.
title_zh: Nexen 开设 Guelph 配送中心以常年储备加拿大库存
what_happened_zh: Nexen 在安大略省 Guelph 开设了一个配送中心，用于维持本地库存、缩短合作伙伴的交付周期，并支持经销商培训与服务。本地仓库是渠道能力的具体变化，但来源没有披露仓储容量、交付时间基线或服务水平达成情况。后续应关注仓库吞吐量、订单满足率、新增经销商数量，以及经量化的从下单到交付时间。

title: Brisa and Goodyear disclose Turkish competition fines totaling TRY1.69 billion
what_happened: In-window company disclosures reported Turkish competition fines of TRY1.019 billion for Brisa and TRY672.293 million for Goodyear Turkey following a June 4 decision. The penalties are material channel-conduct evidence for two tire suppliers, but the edition does not extend the finding to companies whose outcomes were not disclosed by the cutoff. Watch for Reasoned decisions, payment or appeal disclosures and any required changes to dealer or pricing practices.
title_zh: Brisa 与固特异披露土耳其竞争罚款合计 TRY1.69 billion
what_happened_zh: 窗口期内的公司披露显示，在 6 月 4 日的裁决之后，土耳其竞争主管部门对 Brisa 开出 TRY1.019 billion 罚款，对 Goodyear Turkey 开出 TRY672.293 million 罚款。这些处罚是两家轮胎供应商在渠道行为方面的重要证据，但本期报告不会把该结论扩展到截止时间前尚未披露结果的公司。后续应关注裁决理由书、缴款或上诉披露，以及对经销或定价做法的任何必要调整。

title: Zodo positions its Cambodia base as a second supply route for European customers
what_happened: Zodo presented a broad portfolio in Cologne and described China-Cambodia dual production. The company said the Cambodia base was intended to shorten deliveries, navigate trade barriers and support localized service. A second-country supply route can change landed cost and resilience for European buyers, but the release supplies no measured lead-time, volume or tariff comparison. Watch for Export volumes from Cambodia, customer delivery data and product-by-product origin listings.
title_zh: Zodo 将其柬埔寨基地定位为面向欧洲客户的第二条供应路线
what_happened_zh: Zodo 在科隆展出了广泛的产品线，并介绍了中国与柬埔寨的双基地生产模式。公司表示，柬埔寨基地意在缩短交付时间、应对贸易壁垒并支持本地化服务。第二个生产国的供应路线可以改变欧洲买家的到岸成本与供应韧性，但新闻稿没有提供经量化的交付周期、产量或关税对比。后续应关注柬埔寨的出口量、客户交付数据，以及逐个产品的原产地信息。

title: CRIA analysis puts China above half of Australian truck and OTR tire imports in Q1
what_happened: CRIA's Q1 2026 analysis reported 6.0386 million imported tires into Australia with import value of USD708 million, up 14.91% and 15.53% respectively. It calculated Chinese unit shares of 32.46% for passenger tires, 60.80% for truck and bus tires, and 53.08% for OTR tires. The category split gives a measurable view of Chinese supplier penetration, although the association page does not fully expose customs-code mappings or revision policy. Watch for Q2 customs data, average unit values and whether high Chinese shares persist by product class.
title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会分析称，Q1 中国占澳大利亚卡客车与工程轮胎进口量半数以上
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会对 Q1 2026 的分析显示，澳大利亚轮胎进口量为 6.0386 million 条，进口额为 USD708 million，分别增长 14.91% 和 15.53%。分析测算，中国在乘用车轮胎进口量中占 32.46%，在卡客车轮胎中占 60.80%，在工程轮胎中占 53.08%。这一分类拆分提供了可量化的中国供应商渗透视角，不过该协会页面并未完整披露海关编码对应关系或数据修订规则。后续应关注 Q2 海关数据、平均单价，以及中国的高份额能否按产品类别延续。

title: Sailun links its Cologne product push to Egypt output and faster European replenishment
what_happened: Sailun used The Tire Cologne to present EcoPoint3 passenger, EV, winter and truck products and said its Egypt factory was expected to start production in the fourth quarter of 2026. It also described European hubs designed to reach customers within five working days. The combination of product, regional production and logistics claims describes a more localized European operating model, though factory start-up and five-day service performance remain forward-looking company statements. Watch for Egypt commissioning, recurring shipment volumes and measured order-to-delivery performance from the European hubs.
title_zh: 赛轮将其科隆展产品攻势与埃及产能和更快的欧洲补货相联系
what_happened_zh: 赛轮借 The Tire Cologne 展会推出 EcoPoint3 乘用车、电动车、冬季胎和卡车轮胎产品，并表示其埃及工厂预计在 2026 年第四季度投产。公司还介绍了旨在五个工作日内送达客户的欧洲仓储中心。产品、区域生产和物流宣称的组合描绘出一种更为本地化的欧洲运营模式，不过工厂投产和五日服务表现仍属公司的前瞻性表述。后续应关注埃及工厂的投产情况、持续的发货量，以及欧洲仓储中心经量化的从下单到交付表现。

title: Radar's RED dealer network passes 1,000 European locations and adds Poland
what_happened: Radar said its RED affiliated-dealer network exceeded 1,000 locations across Europe and added Poland to the program. A four-digit dealer footprint is measurable distribution evidence, but the report does not disclose active-store criteria, sell-through or comparable prior-period growth. Watch for Country-level dealer counts, retention and sales through RED locations.
title_zh: Radar 的 RED 经销商网络在欧洲突破 1,000 家门店并新增波兰
what_happened_zh: Radar 表示，其 RED 加盟经销商网络在欧洲已超过 1,000 家门店，并把波兰纳入该项目。四位数的门店规模是可量化的分销证据，但该报道没有披露有效门店的认定标准、零售走量或可比的上期增长情况。后续应关注分国家的经销商数量、留存率，以及通过 RED 门店实现的销售。

title: Brand Finance ranks Sailun tenth after a 37% rise in estimated brand value
companies: Brand Finance; Sailun; Michelin; Giti; Apollo Tyres
what_happened: Brand Finance's 2026 tyres ranking estimated Sailun's brand value at USD1.239 billion, up 37% and tenth globally. It valued Michelin at USD10.3 billion, called Giti the fastest-growing brand at 38%, and reported a large year-on-year brand-strength increase for Apollo. The dataset offers one consistent cross-brand measure of commercial positioning, but brand valuation is a model output rather than sales, market share or transaction value. Watch whether the ranking changes are followed by audited regional sales, pricing power or distribution gains.
title_zh: Brand Finance 将赛轮列为第十位，其估算品牌价值上升 37%
what_happened_zh: Brand Finance 的 2026 年轮胎品牌榜把赛轮的品牌价值估算为 USD1.239 billion，上升 37%，位列全球第十。榜单将米其林估值为 USD10.3 billion，称佳通以 38% 的增幅成为增长最快的品牌，并报告 Apollo 的品牌强度同比大幅提升。该数据集提供了一个跨品牌一致的商业定位衡量口径，但品牌估值是模型输出结果，而非销售额、市场份额或交易价值。后续应关注榜单变化之后是否出现经审计的区域销售、定价能力或分销方面的实际提升。

title: Toyo appoints Tire360Europe for DACH and Nordic commercial representation
what_happened: Toyo named Tire360Europe to represent the brand across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Nordic markets. The appointment changes regional channel responsibility across multiple countries, although no volume target, dealer count or exclusivity economics were disclosed. Watch for Country launches, dealer recruitment, inventory footprint and sell-through under the new representation model.
title_zh: 东洋轮胎任命 Tire360Europe 负责 DACH 与北欧地区商务代理
what_happened_zh: 东洋轮胎指定 Tire360Europe 在德国、奥地利、瑞士及北欧市场代理该品牌。此次任命改变了多个国家的区域渠道责任划分，不过并未披露销量目标、经销商数量或独家代理的经济条款。后续应关注新代理模式下的各国上市节奏、经销商招募、库存布局和零售走量。

title: Triangle uses Cologne portfolio launch to reinforce localized European distribution
what_happened: Triangle presented passenger, commercial and specialty tire lines and described a European strategy centered on localized business-to-business distribution and support. The item provides a directional channel signal across three product lines, but contains no new distributor count, contract value or customer adoption metric. Watch for Named distribution agreements, warehouse additions and sales or service metrics tied to the localization plan.
title_zh: 三角轮胎借科隆产品发布强化本地化的欧洲分销
what_happened_zh: 三角轮胎展示了乘用车、商用车和特种轮胎产品线，并介绍了以本地化企业对企业分销与支持为核心的欧洲策略。该内容提供了覆盖三条产品线的方向性渠道信号，但没有新的经销商数量、合同金额或客户采用指标。后续应关注具名的分销协议、新增仓储，以及与本地化计划相关的销售或服务指标。

title: EU tyre-ecodesign study holds stakeholder meeting on draft tasks
what_happened: The European Commission tyre-ecodesign study held a stakeholder meeting on draft analytical tasks covering possible future product-policy work. The meeting is an early regulatory-process signal that can shape future tire requirements, but it does not itself create a Commission proposal, enacted rule or compliance deadline. The study website is an institutional project source, but the meeting concerned draft analysis only. No formal proposal, adopted requirement or near-term compliance obligation resulted. Watch for a final study, Commission consultation, impact assessment or formal legislative proposal with defined product scope and timing.
title_zh: 欧盟轮胎生态设计研究就任务草案召开利益相关方会议
what_happened_zh: 欧盟委员会的轮胎生态设计研究就涉及未来可能的产品政策工作的分析任务草案召开了利益相关方会议。该会议是可能影响未来轮胎要求的早期监管流程信号，但其本身并不构成委员会提案、已生效规则或合规期限。该研究网站属于机构项目来源，但本次会议仅涉及分析草案，没有形成正式提案、已通过的要求或近期的合规义务。后续应关注最终研究报告、委员会征询、影响评估，或具有明确产品范围和时间安排的正式立法提案。

title: Nokian launches a consumer road-trip campaign
what_happened: Nokian Tyres launched a June 8-19 North American Road Trip Guide campaign featuring driver submissions, safety tips, dealer content and a tire-selection quiz. The campaign illustrates Nokian's consumer-engagement and product-guidance approach, though it does not demonstrate a channel expansion, pricing change or measured market response. The official source reliably describes the campaign, but no response metric, sales effect, pricing change or distribution change was disclosed. It is included as low-impact marketing context. Watch for Disclosed participation, lead-generation or dealer-traffic results and whether the campaign converts into a recurring service or channel program.
title_zh: Nokian 推出面向消费者的公路旅行活动
what_happened_zh: Nokian Tyres 推出了为期 6 月 8 日至 19 日的北美 Road Trip Guide 活动，内容包括车主投稿、安全提示、经销商内容和轮胎选型问答。该活动体现了 Nokian 在消费者沟通与产品选型指导方面的做法，但并未显示渠道扩张、价格调整或可量化的市场反馈。官方来源可靠地描述了该活动，但没有披露参与度指标、销售影响、价格变化或分销变化。本条作为影响较小的市场营销背景信息收录。后续应关注公开的参与度、线索获取或经销商客流结果，以及该活动是否转化为常态化的服务或渠道项目。

title: MRF publishes a dematerialisation investor notice
what_happened: MRF published a newspaper notice concerning shareholder dematerialisation procedures. The filing is part of the company's formal investor-administration record, but it has no disclosed effect on tire operations, products, manufacturing or customers. This is an official administrative notice, so the filing itself is reliable. Its decision relevance to tire intelligence is very low and no operating consequence is claimed. No operating follow-up is implied; retain only if a later securities action changes financing, ownership or business execution.
title_zh: MRF 发布股份无纸化投资者公告
what_happened_zh: MRF 就股东持股无纸化程序发布了一则报纸公告。该披露属于公司正式投资者事务记录的一部分，但没有披露对轮胎运营、产品、生产或客户的任何影响。这是一份官方行政性公告，因此披露本身是可靠的。它对轮胎情报的决策相关性很低，也没有主张任何经营层面的后果。本条不隐含需要跟进的经营事项；仅在后续证券行动改变融资、股权或业务执行时才需保留。

title: India Ratings publishes JK Tyre credit-rating action
what_happened: India Ratings published a credit-rating action concerning JK Tyre's debt facilities. The action supplies financing-risk context for a tire maker, but the accessible release does not establish a new plant, capacity, product, channel or customer milestone. The rating agency is authoritative for its own opinion and listed facilities, not for an operating change. This item is included as financing context only. Watch for Any linked refinancing, capital-expenditure commitment, covenant change or project funding disclosed by JK Tyre.
title_zh: India Ratings 发布 JK Tyre 信用评级行动
what_happened_zh: India Ratings 就 JK Tyre 的债务融资额度发布了一项信用评级行动。该行动为一家轮胎制造商提供了融资风险方面的背景，但可获取的公告并未确立新的工厂、产能、产品、渠道或客户里程碑。评级机构对其自身意见和所列融资额度具有权威性，但并不能据此认定经营层面的变化。本条仅作为融资背景信息收录。后续应关注 JK Tyre 披露的任何相关再融资、资本支出承诺、契约条款变更或项目融资。

title: Greentrac reuses earlier ADAC result during Cologne appearance
