what_happened: Greentrac used its Tire Cologne appearance to repeat an earlier ADAC test result and present existing product positioning to show visitors. Repeated use of third-party test recognition shows how the brand is positioning itself in Europe, even though the weekly item does not add a new test, product or commercialization stage. Promotional event coverage from Autohome reused an earlier ADAC result. It is not a new independent test and supplies no new protocol, validation or commercial outcome. Watch for a newly dated independent test, a product change tied to the result, or measurable European distribution and sales follow-through.
title_zh: Greentrac 在科隆展会上重复使用此前的 ADAC 测试结果
what_happened_zh: Greentrac 借 The Tire Cologne 参展之机，向到场观众重复宣传此前的一项 ADAC 测试结果并展示既有产品定位。重复使用第三方测试认可体现了该品牌在欧洲的定位方式，尽管本周的这条内容没有增加新的测试、产品或商业化阶段。汽车之家的推广性展会报道再次使用了此前的 ADAC 结果，这不是一项新的独立测试，也没有提供新的测试方案、验证或商业结果。后续应关注有新日期的独立测试、与该结果相关的产品变更，或可量化的欧洲分销与销售跟进情况。

title: Bridgestone announces routine management changes
what_happened: Bridgestone appointed Masayuki Ishii as Vice President and Senior Officer for corporate governance and human resources, effective July 1, 2026. The appointment records a governance responsibility change, but the one-page release does not connect it to a funded operating program, product decision or customer outcome. The official PDF is reliable for the appointment and effective date only. It gives no evidence of a tire-market, manufacturing, product or customer change. Watch for a later organizational or operating initiative explicitly assigned to the new role.
title_zh: 普利司通宣布常规管理层变动
what_happened_zh: 普利司通任命 Masayuki Ishii 为负责公司治理与人力资源的副总裁兼高级执行役员，自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起生效。该任命记录了一项治理职责变化，但这份一页篇幅的公告并未将其与有预算支持的经营项目、产品决策或客户结果联系起来。这份官方 PDF 仅对任命本身和生效日期具有可靠性，并不能提供轮胎市场、生产、产品或客户方面发生变化的证据。后续应关注日后明确交由该职位负责的组织或经营举措。

title: Later report says Doublestar began an order-management-system project on June 12
what_happened: A June 17 association article reported that Doublestar and Futong Technology held a June 12 kickoff for a customized order-management system covering order entry, approvals, allocation, inventory, logistics, channels, dashboards, reconciliation and access control. The described scope suggests a broad commercial-operations digitization project, but the source appeared after this edition's cutoff and therefore was not evidence available during the reporting week. Post-cutoff context only. The source was first published June 17, three days after the June 14 cutoff, and attributes the item to another outlet; no in-window official or counterparty page was recovered. It is not counted as weekly evidence. Watch for an official Doublestar or Futong project page, implementation milestones, user acceptance and measured order-cycle or inventory results.
title_zh: 后续报道称双星于 6 月 12 日启动订单管理系统项目
what_happened_zh: 一篇 6 月 17 日的协会文章报道称，双星与 Futong Technology 于 6 月 12 日为一套定制化订单管理系统举行启动会，系统覆盖订单录入、审批、分配、库存、物流、渠道、看板、对账和权限控制。所述范围显示这是一个覆盖面较广的商务运营数字化项目，但该来源出现在本期报告的证据截止时间之后，因此并非报告周内可获得的证据。本条仅为截止后背景信息。该来源首次发布于 6 月 17 日，即 6 月 14 日截止时间之后三天，并将内容归于另一家媒体；报告期内未能找到窗口期内的官方或合作方页面。本条不计入每周证据。后续应关注双星或 Futong 的官方项目页面、实施里程碑、用户验收，以及经量化的订单周期或库存结果。

title: FIA and ACO extend Goodyear's exclusive LMGT3 tire supply through 2029
companies: Goodyear; FIA; Automobile Club de l'Ouest
what_happened: FIA, ACO and Goodyear extended Goodyear's exclusive LMGT3 supply role through 2029. New Racing Eagle specifications are planned for 2027, and Goodyear said they will contain the line's highest sustainable-material content to date. The multi-year renewal is direct customer-contract evidence and creates a defined validation platform, while the sustainable-material statement lacks a disclosed percentage or recipe. Watch for the 2027 specification, material-content accounting and race performance after introduction.
title_zh: FIA 与 ACO 将固特异 LMGT3 独家供胎延长至 2029 年
what_happened_zh: FIA、ACO 与固特异将固特异在 LMGT3 的独家供胎角色延长至 2029 年。新的 Racing Eagle 规格计划于 2027 年推出，固特异表示新规格将含有该产品线迄今最高的可持续材料含量。这项多年期续约是直接的客户合同证据，并形成了明确的验证平台，不过可持续材料的表述没有披露具体百分比或配方。后续应关注 2027 年的规格、材料含量核算，以及投入使用后的赛场表现。

title: Pirelli extends exclusive Formula 1 tire supply through 2028
what_happened: Pirelli, Formula 1 and the FIA extended Pirelli's exclusive tire-supply role for Formula 1, Formula 2, Formula 3 and F1 Academy through 2028. The renewal is direct multi-series customer evidence and preserves a high-visibility development platform, although it does not disclose contract value or incremental volume. Watch for New specification milestones, test programs and technical-rule changes during the extension term.
title_zh: 倍耐力将 Formula 1 独家供胎延长至 2028 年
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力、Formula 1 与 FIA 将倍耐力在 Formula 1、Formula 2、Formula 3 和 F1 Academy 的独家供胎角色延长至 2028 年。此次续约是覆盖多个系列赛的直接客户证据，并保留了一个高曝光度的开发平台，不过没有披露合同金额或增量供货量。后续应关注延长期内的新规格节点、测试项目和技术规则变化。

title: Aeolus-linked study reports a 7.57% lower durability proxy in a model checked against static contact pressure
what_happened: A peer-reviewed study modeled a 12.00R22.5 all-steel radial truck tire, parameterized its carcass contour with Bézier curves, and optimized nine design schemes with Gaussian-process regression and a multi-island genetic algorithm. The best numerical design reduced maximum shoulder strain-energy density by 7.57% versus the original contour. The work connects an industrial tire maker to a reproducible digital contour-design method and reports a quantified result against a stated baseline. The evidence remains a durability proxy: static contact-pressure validation does not establish physical drum or road endurance. Watch for a built-tire endurance test comparing the optimized and original contours under the same load, pressure, speed, and failure criterion.

sources.publisher: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, Part D: Journal of Automobile Engineering
sources.link_label: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, Part D: Journal of Automobile Engineering

title_zh: Aeolus 关联研究称，经静态接地压力校核的模型中耐久性代理指标降低 7.57%
what_happened_zh: 一项同行评审研究对一条 12.00R22.5 全钢子午线卡车轮胎建立模型，用 Bézier 曲线对其胎体轮廓进行参数化，并以高斯过程回归和多岛遗传算法对九种设计方案进行优化。数值计算中的最优设计使胎肩最大应变能密度相对原始轮廓降低 7.57%。这项工作把一家工业轮胎制造商与一套可复现的数字化轮廓设计方法联系起来，并给出了相对明确基线的量化结果。相关证据仍属耐久性代理指标：以静态接地压力进行的验证并不能确立实际的转鼓或道路耐久性。后续应关注在相同载荷、气压、速度和失效判据下，对优化轮廓与原始轮廓实物轮胎进行的耐久性试验。

title: Continental and Renault show a prototype tire 35% below the EU label A rolling-resistance threshold
what_happened: Continental developed a Futurama prototype for Renault's innovation team by modifying the EcoContact 7 tread compound, sidewall and construction. It reports rolling resistance up to 35% below the maximum allowed for EU label A and estimates about 30 km of added range for a vehicle with a 500 km battery range. The project sets a quantified technical target below the best label class and ties it to an OEM development relationship. The 30 km figure is a modeled vehicle-range translation, not an independent road-test result. Watch for a standardized rolling-resistance coefficient, wear and wet-grip data, followed by an OE nomination or serial-production decision.
title_zh: 大陆集团与 Renault 展示滚动阻力低于 EU 标签 A 级门槛 35% 的原型轮胎
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团通过改动 EcoContact 7 的胎面胶配方、胎侧和结构，为 Renault 创新团队开发了 Futurama 原型轮胎。公司称其滚动阻力最多比 EU 标签 A 级允许的上限低 35%，并估计可为电池续驶里程 500 km 的车辆增加约 30 km 续驶里程。该项目设定了低于最佳标签等级的量化技术目标，并将其与一项整车厂开发合作关系联系起来。30 km 这一数字是经建模得出的整车续驶里程折算结果，而非独立道路测试结果。后续应关注标准化的滚动阻力系数、磨耗和湿地抓地数据，以及随后的原配提名或量产决策。

title: General Science demonstrates an eucommia-rubber tire with multi-function performance claims
what_happened: At The Tire Cologne, General Science presented an eucommia-rubber product and claimed more than 30% better wear, front-tire life above 80,000 km, wet braking shortened by over four metres, sealing of punctures up to 5 mm, and a 9 dB reduction in cavity noise. It also reported more than USD1 million in intended orders. The combination of alternative rubber, self-sealing and acoustic functions is technically notable, but the release provides no protocol, sample size, named baseline, or independent confirmation. Intent orders are not booked sales. Watch for a test report naming the comparison tire, conditions, sample count, units for each result, and conversion of intended orders into confirmed shipments.
title_zh: 通用股份展示带有多功能性能主张的杜仲胶轮胎
what_happened_zh: 在 The Tire Cologne 展会上，通用股份展示了一款杜仲胶产品，并称其耐磨性提升超过 30%、前轮使用寿命超过 80,000 km、湿地制动距离缩短四米以上、可密封最大 5 mm 的穿刺、空腔噪声降低 9 dB。公司还表示获得超过 USD1 million 的意向订单。替代橡胶、自修复密封与声学功能的组合在技术上值得关注，但该发布未提供测试方案、样本量、具名基线或独立确认。意向订单并不等于已入账的销售。后续应关注说明对比轮胎、测试条件、样本数量以及各项结果单位的测试报告，以及意向订单转化为确认出货的情况。

title: ZC Rubber sets a second-half 2026 European launch window for new passenger-tire lines
what_happened: ZC Rubber used The Tire Cologne to set second-half 2026 launch timing for new European passenger-car products, while stating that the WSL2 steer-position and WDL2+ drive-position truck tires were already available. It separately previewed additional products for 2027. The disclosure converts part of ZC Rubber's European portfolio from an undated showcase into a launch schedule and distinguishes products already on sale from later previews. Performance statements remain design claims without comparative test data. Watch for Named H2 launch dates, market-by-market listings, and independent label or test results for the new products.
title_zh: 中策橡胶将新乘用车轮胎产品线的欧洲上市窗口定在 2026 年下半年
what_happened_zh: 中策橡胶在 The Tire Cologne 展会上把面向欧洲的新乘用车产品上市时间定在 2026 年下半年，同时表示 WSL2 转向轮位和 WDL2+ 驱动轮位卡车轮胎已可供货。公司另外预告了面向 2027 年的更多产品。该披露把中策橡胶欧洲产品组合的一部分从没有时间表的展示转变为上市计划，并区分了已经在售的产品与之后才预告的产品。相关性能表述仍属设计主张，缺少对比测试数据。后续应关注具名的 H2 上市日期、逐个市场的产品清单，以及新产品的独立标签或测试结果。

title: General Science reports its first 305/25R28 UHP tire off line at the Thailand plant
what_happened: General Science reported that its Thailand plant had recently produced its first 305/25R28 ultra-high-performance tire using a one-step forming process. The same release said May shipments from the plant exceeded one million tires. A first article shows the plant has reached a new product-industrialization step in a large-rim size, but it is not proof of homologation, serial orders, or sustained production. The shipment figure is company-reported and not tied to this size. Watch for Homologation, a named customer or distributor order, and repeat production volumes for the 305/25R28 size.
title_zh: 通用股份称泰国工厂首条 305/25R28 UHP 轮胎下线
what_happened_zh: 通用股份表示，其泰国工厂近期以一次法成型工艺生产出首条 305/25R28 超高性能轮胎。同一份发布称，该工厂 5 月出货量超过一百万条。首件产品表明该工厂在大轮辋规格上达到了新的产品工业化阶段，但这并不能证明型号认证、批量订单或持续生产。出货数据由公司自行报告，且未与该规格直接对应。后续应关注型号认证、具名客户或经销商订单，以及 305/25R28 规格的重复生产量。

title: Michelin sets a September UK launch for the X Multi D2 drive-axle truck tire
what_happened: Michelin announced that the 295/80 R22.5 X Multi D2 drive-axle tire will launch in the United Kingdom in September. The company claims 15% more mileage than its predecessor and 7% lower rolling resistance than the first-generation X Multi D. The item provides a named size, market and launch month plus explicit—but different—comparison baselines. Those claims should not be read as one combined comparison or as independently verified results. Watch for UK availability and test data that compare mileage and rolling resistance against the same named baseline under stated conditions.
title_zh: 米其林将 X Multi D2 驱动轮位卡车轮胎的英国上市时间定在 9 月
what_happened_zh: 米其林宣布，295/80 R22.5 X Multi D2 驱动轮位轮胎将于 9 月在英国上市。公司称其里程比上一代产品高 15%，滚动阻力比第一代 X Multi D 低 7%。该条目给出了具名规格、市场和上市月份，并给出了明确但各不相同的对比基线。这些主张不应被理解为一项合并对比，也不应被视为经独立验证的结果。后续应关注英国的供货情况，以及在明确条件下以同一具名基线对里程和滚动阻力进行比较的测试数据。

title: General Tire launches the Grabber AT3 Plus for European all-terrain use
what_happened: General Tire introduced the Grabber AT3 Plus as the European successor to the Grabber AT3, with changes to tread blocks, grooves and compound intended to balance off-road traction, wet braking and road comfort. This is a commercial replacement-cycle event with a defined predecessor and market, but the manufacturer release does not provide a quantified comparison or independent test. Watch for Independent wet-braking, noise, wear and off-road traction results against the Grabber AT3 and direct competitors.
title_zh: General Tire 推出面向欧洲全地形使用的 Grabber AT3 Plus
what_happened_zh: General Tire 推出 Grabber AT3 Plus，作为 Grabber AT3 在欧洲的后继产品，并对胎面花纹块、沟槽和配方进行了调整，以兼顾越野牵引力、湿地制动和公路舒适性。这是一起具有明确前代产品和目标市场的商业换代事件，但制造商发布的信息没有提供量化对比或独立测试。后续应关注相对 Grabber AT3 及直接竞品的独立湿地制动、噪声、磨耗和越野牵引力测试结果。

title: Trans-polyoctenamer improves toughness and failure stability in recycled-tire-rubber thermoplastics
companies: Budapest University of Technology and Economics
what_happened: A peer-reviewed ACS Omega study added 2%, 4% or 6% trans-polyoctenamer to polypropylene thermoplastic dynamic vulcanizates containing 60 wt% compounded dGTR-based rubber mixture. Mechanical, morphology and acoustic-emission tests showed better interfacial behavior, toughness, abrasion resistance, elastic recovery and more gradual failure than the no-TOR reference. The study provides a continuous twin-screw route for turning devulcanized tire rubber into higher-value thermoplastic elastomers and identifies 4–6% TOR as the best tested balance. Results are laboratory-scale and do not yet establish production economics, long-term aging or end-use qualification. Watch for Pilot-scale compounding, aging and fatigue data, product qualification, and a cost or lifecycle comparison against virgin-rubber thermoplastic elastomers.
title_zh: 反式聚辛烯橡胶提升再生轮胎胶热塑性材料的韧性与破坏稳定性
what_happened_zh: 一项发表于 ACS Omega 的同行评审研究，在含 60 wt% 复配 dGTR 基橡胶混合物的聚丙烯热塑性动态硫化胶中加入 2%、4% 或 6% 的反式聚辛烯橡胶。力学、形貌与声发射测试显示，相对不含 TOR 的参比样，其界面行为、韧性、耐磨性和弹性回复均更优，破坏过程也更为渐进。该研究提供了一条把脱硫轮胎胶转化为更高附加值热塑性弹性体的连续双螺杆路线，并确认 4–6% 的 TOR 为测试范围内的最佳平衡点。结果属实验室规模，尚未确立生产经济性、长期老化表现或终端应用认证。后续应关注中试规模混炼、老化与疲劳数据、产品认证，以及相对原生橡胶热塑性弹性体的成本或生命周期对比。

title: Tire Industry Project pilots wastewater treatment as a route to remove tire-and-road-wear particles
what_happened: The Tire Industry Project announced a pilot examining how wastewater-treatment processes can capture tire-and-road-wear particles before treated water is released. The work moves the issue from environmental characterization toward testing an intervention pathway. A removal pilot can generate operational evidence for municipalities and regulators, but the announcement does not yet provide removal efficiency, influent concentration, particle-size coverage, cost or sludge-disposal consequences. Watch for a protocol and results showing capture efficiency by particle size, mass balance, energy and operating cost, and handling of particles retained in sludge.
title_zh: Tire Industry Project 启动污水处理试点，探索去除轮胎道路磨损颗粒的路径
what_happened_zh: Tire Industry Project 宣布启动一项试点，考察污水处理工艺能否在处理后的水体排放之前捕集轮胎道路磨损颗粒。这项工作把该议题从环境特征描述推向对一条干预路径的检验。去除试点可以为市政部门和监管机构提供运行层面的证据，但该公告尚未给出去除效率、进水浓度、粒径覆盖范围、成本或污泥处置方面的影响。后续应关注给出按粒径计的捕集效率、物料平衡、能耗与运行成本，以及污泥中滞留颗粒处理方式的方案和结果。

title: China's tire association details an operating response to the insoluble-sulfur price spike
companies: China Rubber Industry Association; Yanggu Huatai
what_happened: CRIA described daily coordination with tire companies and suppliers as insoluble-sulfur prices rose to about RMB22,000 per tonne from roughly RMB9,000. It outlined supply and formulation responses intended to limit disruption. Insoluble sulfur is a critical curing input, so a roughly two-and-a-half-fold price reference and daily coordination signal material cost and continuity pressure. The price and response scenarios are association-reported rather than audited transaction data. Watch for Producer price notices, tire-maker procurement disclosures, substitution trials, or evidence that the price increase flows into tire prices or production schedules.
title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会详述针对不溶性硫黄涨价的运行应对
what_happened_zh: 随着不溶性硫黄价格由约 RMB9,000 升至每吨约 RMB22,000，中国橡胶工业协会表示其与轮胎企业及供应商保持每日协调，并提出了旨在控制影响的供应与配方应对措施。不溶性硫黄是关键的硫化原料，因此约两倍半的价格参照以及每日协调，反映出明显的成本与供应连续性压力。价格与应对情景由协会报告，而非经审计的成交数据。后续应关注生产商调价通知、轮胎企业采购披露、替代试验，或涨价向轮胎价格和生产排产传导的证据。

title: Enviro discloses an Infiniteria court action over recycling-technology licence exclusivity
what_happened: Scandinavian Enviro Systems said it received notice that Infiniteria had brought a declaratory action before Sweden's Patent and Market Court concerning the exclusivity of a technology licence. Licence scope can affect where and by whom tire-pyrolysis capacity is developed, so the dispute is a material scale-up risk. A filed action establishes the existence of a dispute, not which party's interpretation is correct or whether projects will be delayed. Watch for the defendants' response, interim orders, a settlement or judgment, and any disclosed change to planned plant ownership, territory or commissioning schedules.
title_zh: Enviro 披露 Infiniteria 就回收技术许可独占性提起的法院诉讼
what_happened_zh: Scandinavian Enviro Systems 表示，公司已收到通知，Infiniteria 已就一项技术许可的独占性，向瑞典专利与市场法院提起确认之诉。许可范围会影响轮胎热解产能在何地、由何方开发，因此该争议构成实质性的规模化风险。提起诉讼只能确立争议的存在，并不能说明哪一方的解释正确，也不能说明项目是否会延误。后续应关注被告方的答辩、临时裁定、和解或判决，以及规划中工厂在所有权、地域范围或投产时间表方面是否出现已披露的变化。

title: Evonik opens an ISCC Plus mass-balance route for circular tire-material inputs
what_happened: Evonik announced ISCC Plus-certified mass-balance options across selected products, allowing attributed renewable or circular feedstock to replace fossil inputs in existing production chains. The portfolio includes materials relevant to tire compounds, including silica- and silane-related value chains. Mass balance can lower attributed product footprints without segregating every molecule, which makes adoption easier in existing tire supply chains. The announcement does not disclose tire-customer volumes, product-level reductions or premiums. Watch for Named certified tire-grade SKUs, independently verified product carbon footprints, contracted tire customers and allocated volumes.
title_zh: Evonik 为循环轮胎材料投入开通 ISCC Plus 质量平衡路径
what_happened_zh: Evonik 宣布在部分产品上提供经 ISCC Plus 认证的质量平衡方案，使归属的可再生或循环原料能够在现有生产链中替代化石原料。相关产品组合包含与轮胎配方相关的材料，其中包括白炭黑和硅烷相关价值链。质量平衡无需对每一个分子进行物理隔离即可降低产品的归属碳足迹，这使其在现有轮胎供应链中更易采用。该公告未披露轮胎客户用量、产品层面的降幅或溢价。后续应关注具名的认证轮胎级 SKU、经独立核验的产品碳足迹、已签约的轮胎客户及其分配量。

title: Linglong closes phase one of its Yunnan natural-rubber traceability project
what_happened: Linglong reported phase-one completion of its Yunnan sustainable-natural-rubber project, transfer of an ecological collection station to a village group, participation by more than 50 households and 300 farmers, over 1,500 hectares of FSC-certified land, and training for 20 core farmers. The completion and handover create an operating local traceability asset rather than a new pledge. However, Linglong's 2025 ESG material had already reported 1,564.12 certified hectares, so the acreage is a recap, not a first disclosure. Watch for Traceable purchase volumes, farmer income or yield data, audit outcomes, and use of the material in named tire products or export supply chains.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎完成云南天然橡胶可追溯项目一期
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎报告其云南可持续天然橡胶项目一期完工，并将一座生态收胶站移交给当地村组，项目有超过 50 户农家和 300 名胶农参与，涉及超过 1,500 公顷 FSC 认证土地，并为 20 名核心胶农提供了培训。项目完工与移交形成的是一项在当地运行的可追溯资产，而不是新的承诺。不过，玲珑轮胎 2025 年 ESG 材料此前已报告 1,564.12 公顷认证面积，因此该面积属于回顾，而非首次披露。后续应关注可追溯采购量、胶农收入或产量数据、审核结果，以及该原料在具名轮胎产品或出口供应链中的使用情况。

title: Sailun's board approves a USD1.14 billion Egypt tire-capacity proposal
what_happened: Sailun's board approved a proposed USD1.14131 billion Egypt investment covering 27 million passenger-car tires, 1.65 million truck-and-bus tires and 20,000 tonnes of off-road tires per year, with stated construction periods of 15 and 24 months. The scale would materially enlarge Sailun's localized capacity for Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Board approval is not construction: shareholder, host-country and other regulatory approvals remained pending in the filing. Watch for Shareholder and regulatory approvals, land and contractor notices, financing, construction start and the first independently verifiable commissioning milestone.
title_zh: 赛轮董事会批准 USD1.14 billion 埃及轮胎产能方案
what_happened_zh: 赛轮董事会批准了一项拟议的 USD1.14131 billion 埃及投资，覆盖年产 27 million 条乘用车轮胎、1.65 million 条卡客车轮胎和 20,000 tonnes 非公路轮胎，公告列明的建设期分别为 15 个月和 24 个月。该规模将显著扩大赛轮面向欧洲、中东和非洲的本地化产能。董事会批准并不等于开工建设：公告中股东大会批准、东道国批准及其他监管批准均仍待取得。后续应关注股东大会与监管批准、土地与承包商公告、融资安排、开工建设，以及首个可独立验证的投产节点。

title: Industry reporting says a Zibo filing covers a six-million-unit smart-chip and self-sealing tire project
what_happened: A June 17 industry repost attributed to JuJiao says a June 12 Zibo filing describes a project designed for six million tires a year and products incorporating embedded chips, self-sealing functions and acoustic treatment. The filing combines meaningful scale with several higher-value tire functions, but it remains an administrative project signal. The sponsor's identity and operating history require continued verification, and there is no evidence of construction or commissioned capacity. Watch for Authoritative sponsor identity, environmental approval, land or equipment procurement, construction start and a first production or qualification record.

sources.publisher: China Natural Rubber Association repost attributed to JuJiao
sources.link_label: China Natural Rubber Association repost attributed to JuJiao

title_zh: 行业报道称淄博一份备案涉及年产六百万条智能芯片与自修复密封轮胎项目
what_happened_zh: 一则 6 月 17 日的行业转载文章援引 JuJiao 的报道称，6 月 12 日的一份淄博备案描述了一个设计年产六百万条轮胎的项目，产品包含内置芯片、自修复密封功能和声学处理。该备案把有一定意义的规模与若干更高附加值的轮胎功能结合起来，但它仍只是一个行政层面的项目信号。项目主体的身份与经营历史仍需持续核实，目前没有建设或已投产产能的证据。后续应关注权威的项目主体身份、环保审批、土地或设备采购、开工建设，以及首个生产或认证记录。

title: Nexen completes a 51-meter automated warehouse at its Žatec tire plant
what_happened: Nexen completed a 7,104-square-meter automated warehouse at its Žatec plant with automated inbound and outbound handling, RFID tracking and a height of 51 meters. Storage capacity increased from 530,000 to 830,000 tires. The 57% storage-capacity increase improves the plant's logistics buffer and shipment flexibility, but it is warehouse capacity, not tire-production capacity. The release provides no before-and-after logistics cost, accuracy or delivery-time result. Watch for Measured inventory accuracy, throughput, labor and delivery-time changes, plus any separate disclosure of production-capacity expansion.
title_zh: Nexen 在 Žatec 轮胎工厂建成 51 米高自动化仓库
what_happened_zh: Nexen 在其 Žatec 工厂建成一座 7,104 平方米的自动化仓库，配备自动化出入库搬运和 RFID 跟踪，高度为 51 米。库存能力从 530,000 条提升至 830,000 条。库存能力提升 57% 改善了该工厂的物流缓冲与发货灵活性，但这属于仓储能力，而不是轮胎生产能力。该发布未提供物流成本、准确率或交付时间的前后对比结果。后续应关注经测量的库存准确率、吞吐量、人工和交付时间变化，以及任何关于生产产能扩张的单独披露。

title: Shandong proposes four tire-related plants for its smart-factory recognition list
companies: Sailun Dongying; Yongsheng; Pirelli Jining; Shandong Dongyue Technology Development Co., Ltd.
what_happened: A Shandong small-enterprise public-service platform published a proposed smart-factory list that includes tire-related operations associated with Sailun in Dongying, Yongsheng, Pirelli in Jining and Shandong Dongyue Technology Development Co., Ltd. The list is a public indicator that multiple Shandong tire sites have reached the province's recognition process, but it does not by itself prove new equipment, a production increase or independently measured productivity. Watch for Final recognition, project descriptions and plant-level measures for yield, downtime, labor productivity, energy or quality before and after deployment.
title_zh: 山东将四家轮胎相关工厂列入智能工厂认定拟定名单
what_happened_zh: 山东一个中小企业公共服务平台公布了一份智能工厂拟定名单，其中包括与赛轮东营、Yongsheng、倍耐力济宁以及 Shandong Dongyue Technology Development Co., Ltd. 相关的轮胎业务。该名单是一个公开指标，表明山东多家轮胎企业已进入该省的认定流程，但它本身并不能证明新增设备、产量提升或经独立测量的生产率改善。后续应关注最终认定、项目说明，以及工厂层面在合格率、停机时间、劳动生产率、能耗或质量方面部署前后的具体指标。

title: China's May tire output grows while inventories rise and exports soften month on month
companies: China Rubber Industry Association tire-industry sample
what_happened: CRIA's May sample reported 39.91 million tires produced, up 6.9% year on year, while inventory rose 4.1% from April. Exports were 20.76 million tires, down 4.6% month on month and up 0.5% year on year; reported price increases of 2–5% did not fully offset input costs. The combination points to output growth without equivalent channel relief and continued margin pressure. The association does not fully specify the sample universe or methodology, so the figures should not be treated as total national production. Watch for June output, inventory days, export mix, raw-material prices and whether additional tire price increases hold in distributor transactions.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association Tire Branch
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association Tire Branch

title_zh: 中国 5 月轮胎产量增长，库存上升、出口环比走弱
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会的 5 月样本显示，轮胎产量为 39.91 million 条，同比增长 6.9%，库存较 4 月上升 4.1%。出口为 20.76 million 条，环比下降 4.6%，同比上升 0.5%；报告中 2–5% 的涨价未能完全抵消投入成本。上述组合说明产量增长并未带来同等的渠道压力缓解，利润率压力仍在延续。协会没有完整说明样本范围与统计方法，因此这些数据不应被视为全国总产量。后续应关注 6 月产量、库存天数、出口结构、原料价格，以及新一轮轮胎涨价能否在经销商成交中落实。

title: Doublestar begins an order-management-system implementation project
what_happened: Industry reporting on a June 12 project kickoff says the implementation scope covers order entry, approval and allocation, inventory and logistics visibility, channel dashboards, reconciliation, data migration, legacy-system links and staged acceptance for Doublestar's tire-distribution workflow. The technology partner is named only as Futong Keji and its legal identity remains unresolved. The project targets the operational layer between production and channel fulfillment, but a kickoff is not proof of adoption or better service. No baseline, user count, cycle-time reduction, inventory result or customer outcome was reported. Watch for a production go-live with dealer coverage, order-cycle time, fill rate, inventory accuracy and reconciliation performance against the legacy process.

sources.publisher: China Natural Rubber Association industry-information repost
sources.link_label: China Natural Rubber Association industry-information repost

title_zh: 双星启动订单管理系统实施项目
what_happened_zh: 行业媒体对 6 月 12 日项目启动会的报道称，实施范围覆盖订单录入、审批与分配、库存与物流可视化、渠道看板、对账、数据迁移、与既有系统的对接，以及面向双星轮胎分销流程的分阶段验收。技术合作方仅被称为 Futong Keji，其法律主体身份仍未明确。该项目针对的是生产与渠道履约之间的运营环节，但启动会并不能证明系统已被采用或服务水平已改善。报道未给出基线、用户数量、周期缩短、库存结果或客户层面的成效。后续应关注包含经销商覆盖范围、订单周期时间、满足率、库存准确率以及相对既有流程对账表现的正式上线。

title: Renault selects Continental's 18-inch EcoContact 7 exclusively for the electric Twingo
what_happened: Renault approved the Continental EcoContact 7 in size 205/45 R18 90H XL FR as the exclusive standard tire for the new electric Twingo worldwide. Continental identifies Smart Energy Casing, an Aerodimple sidewall and a Silent Pattern as the main efficiency and noise features. An exclusive worldwide standard fitment is direct customer-adoption evidence and gives the product a defined vehicle platform and size. The release does not disclose vehicle volumes, contract value or tire-level performance beyond label ratings. Watch for Twingo production volume, replacement-channel availability and standardized wear, wet-grip and rolling-resistance results for the approved size.
title_zh: Renault 为纯电 Twingo 独家选用大陆集团 18-inch EcoContact 7
what_happened_zh: Renault 批准大陆集团 EcoContact 7 的 205/45 R18 90H XL FR 规格，作为新款纯电 Twingo 在全球范围内的独家标配轮胎。大陆集团称 Smart Energy Casing、Aerodimple 胎侧和 Silent Pattern 是其主要的效率与噪声特性。全球独家标配是直接的客户采用证据，并为该产品确定了明确的车型平台与规格。该发布未披露整车产量、合同金额，也未披露除标签等级之外的轮胎性能数据。后续应关注 Twingo 的生产量、替换市场供货情况，以及该批准规格的标准化磨耗、湿地抓地和滚动阻力结果。

title: Nexen retains Hyundai Grandeur OE business with the N'Fera Supreme S
what_happened: Nexen was selected to supply the N'Fera Supreme S for Hyundai's facelifted New Grandeur, continuing its fitment on the seventh-generation flagship sedan. The tire uses sound-absorbing material and Nexen's noise-reduction system. The renewed nomination is customer evidence that Nexen retained a premium-sedan application through a model update. The announcement does not state size, volume, contract value or comparative performance data. Watch for Fitment sizes, vehicle production volumes, regional scope and independent cabin-noise, wear and rolling-resistance results.
title_zh: Nexen 以 N'Fera Supreme S 保住 Hyundai Grandeur 原配业务
what_happened_zh: Nexen 被选定为 Hyundai 改款 New Grandeur 供应 N'Fera Supreme S，延续其在这款第七代旗舰轿车上的配套。该轮胎采用吸音材料和 Nexen 的降噪系统。此次重新提名是客户层面的证据，表明 Nexen 在车型改款后保住了一个高端轿车应用。该公告未说明规格、数量、合同金额或对比性能数据。后续应关注配套规格、整车产量、区域范围，以及独立的车内噪声、磨耗和滚动阻力结果。

title: MRF extends its Australian Rally Championship control-tire role through 2030
what_happened: Trade reporting says MRF's control-tire engagement with the Australian Rally Championship has been extended through 2030, lengthening a customer relationship that already supplies competitors through the championship's appointed channel. A multiyear control-tire role is concrete institutional demand and creates a recurring field-use environment. Public information does not disclose contract value, committed tire volumes or whether the arrangement is exclusive across every class and event. Watch for Updated championship regulations, annual tire volumes, distributor terms and any compounds or constructions developed from competition data.
title_zh: MRF 将其澳大利亚拉力锦标赛指定轮胎角色延续至 2030 年
what_happened_zh: 行业媒体报道称，MRF 与澳大利亚拉力锦标赛的指定轮胎合作已延长至 2030 年，从而拉长了一段已经通过赛事指定渠道向参赛者供胎的客户关系。多年期的指定轮胎角色是具体的机构性需求，并形成了持续的实地使用环境。公开信息未披露合同金额、承诺供胎数量，也未说明该安排是否覆盖所有级别和赛事的独家供应。后续应关注锦标赛规则更新、年度供胎量、经销条款，以及任何依据比赛数据开发出的配方或结构。

title: CT-derived tire model improves validation of tire-soil simulation inputs
what_happened: A study built a finite-element tire from CT-derived geometry and a Yeoh visco-hyperelastic material model, then compared validation metrics and two soil-interaction approaches for sandy loam across 5% to 40% slip. The paper links higher-fidelity tire geometry and constitutive modeling with systematic sensitivity analysis for deformable-soil traction. Reported CORA validation scores reached 0.989 for radial deflection, 0.999 for loaded radius, 0.947 for footprint and 0.985 for contact pressure. More defensible digital tire-soil models can reduce physical iteration for agricultural and off-road tires, but the results remain tied to the tested tire, soil model and conditions.
title_zh: 基于 CT 的轮胎模型提升轮胎-土壤仿真输入的验证水平
what_happened_zh: 一项研究基于 CT 扫描获得的几何结构和 Yeoh 粘-超弹性材料模型构建了有限元轮胎，随后针对砂质壤土在 5% 至 40% 滑转率区间比较了验证指标与两种土壤相互作用方法。该论文把更高保真度的轮胎几何与本构建模同面向可变形土壤牵引力的系统性敏感性分析结合起来。所报告的 CORA 验证得分达到径向变形 0.989、负荷半径 0.999、接地印痕 0.947 和接地压力 0.985。更可信的数字化轮胎-土壤模型可以减少农用和非公路轮胎的实物迭代，但相关结果仍局限于所测试的轮胎、土壤模型和工况。

title: Researchers demonstrate a vehicle-mounted route for collecting tire-road wear particles near the source
what_happened: An open-access study presented an autonomous electric-vehicle platform for controlled near-field recovery and characterization of tire-road wear particles, including optical-scattering measurements. Mounting collection and measurement on the vehicle creates a controlled bridge between laboratory abrasion work and exposure-oriented field research. The paper demonstrates an experimental approach, not a validated estimate of real-world fleet emissions. Better source-resolved samples can support material screening, particle characterization and future regulatory test methods without relying only on distant roadside measurements.
title_zh: 研究人员展示在源头附近采集轮胎-道路磨损颗粒的车载方案
what_happened_zh: 一项开放获取研究提出了一个自主电动汽车平台，用于在近场受控条件下回收和表征轮胎-道路磨损颗粒，并包含光散射测量。把采集与测量装载到车辆上，在实验室磨损研究与面向暴露评估的现场研究之间建立了受控的桥梁。该论文展示的是一种实验方法，而不是对真实道路车队排放量的验证性估算。更好的源头可分辨样品，能够在不仅依赖远距离路边测量的情况下，支撑材料筛选、颗粒表征以及未来的法规测试方法。

title: Qingdao forum moves tire-dynamics AI from isolated models toward full-condition data fusion
companies: GTTF participants; Jilin University; Sailun Group
what_happened: At the Global Tire Technology Forum in Qingdao, Jilin University researcher Lu Dang proposed a vertical tire-dynamics AI model combining UniTire, measured data and simulation data across operating conditions. Sailun separately described a tiered AI system spanning formulation prediction, visual quality inspection and lifecycle monitoring. The useful shift is from single-point AI tools toward connected model, test and production data layers. The forum evidence shows the architecture being specified and discussed; it does not establish validated production performance. This matters because simulation-to-test data continuity can shorten calibration cycles and make tire models reusable across design, manufacturing and in-service monitoring. Watch for a published validation dataset, named production deployment or quantified cycle-time result from the participants.
title_zh: 青岛论坛推动轮胎动力学 AI 从孤立模型走向全工况数据融合
what_happened_zh: 在青岛举行的全球轮胎技术论坛上，吉林大学研究人员卢荡提出了一种纵向轮胎动力学 AI 模型，把 UniTire、实测数据和跨工况仿真数据结合起来。赛轮另行介绍了一套分层 AI 体系，覆盖配方预测、视觉质量检测和全生命周期监测。真正有意义的转变，是从单点 AI 工具走向彼此连通的模型、试验与生产数据层。论坛证据显示的是该架构正在被提出和讨论，并未确立经过验证的量产表现。这一点之所以重要，是因为仿真到试验的数据连续性可以缩短标定周期，并使轮胎模型在设计、制造和在役监测之间复用。后续应关注参与方是否公布验证数据集、具名的量产部署或量化的周期时间结果。

title: ADAC test exposes a wide safety spread in small-car all-season tires
what_happened: ADAC tested 16 all-season tires in size 185/65 R15. Continental AllSeasonContact 2 was the only model rated good at 2.3; Pirelli Cinturato All Season SF 3 and Michelin CrossClimate 2 scored 2.6, while eight models received no purchase recommendation. The test makes balanced, multi-season performance the differentiator rather than the 3PMSF marking alone. It also shows that older-generation products still sold in small-car sizes can diverge sharply from newer portfolios. Independent evidence across dry, wet, winter and environmental criteria can change product positioning and replacement demand more credibly than maker claims. Watch whether manufacturers replace the lowest-rated small-size products or publish corrective evidence in the same dimension.
title_zh: ADAC 测试揭示小型车四季轮胎在安全性上的巨大差距
what_happened_zh: ADAC 测试了 16 条 185/65 R15 规格的四季轮胎。大陆集团 AllSeasonContact 2 是唯一评级为良好的产品，得分 2.3；倍耐力 Cinturato All Season SF 3 和米其林 CrossClimate 2 得分 2.6，另有八款产品未获得购买推荐。该测试让均衡的多季节性能成为差异化所在，而不再只看 3PMSF 标识。它还显示，仍在小型车规格中销售的上一代产品，可能与更新的产品系列出现明显分化。覆盖干地、湿地、冬季和环保指标的独立证据，比制造商自身的宣称更有说服力地改变产品定位和替换需求。后续应关注制造商是否会替换评级最低的小规格产品，或在同一维度上公布纠正性证据。

title: ANRPC raises the tension between slower rubber output and firmer consumption
companies: Association of Natural Rubber Producing Countries
what_happened: ANRPC's May statistical report forecast 2026 natural-rubber output at 15.337 million tonnes, up 2.4%, and consumption at 15.550 million tonnes, up 1.3%. May output was reported at 997,000 tonnes, down 4.7% year on year, while consumption was 1.310 million tonnes, up 4.6%. The monthly data point to a narrow annual supply-demand balance alongside stronger May physical prices: ANRPC reported month-on-month gains of 7.37% for SMR20, 9.56% for STR20, 6.25% for RSS3, 7.17% for RSS4 and 1.88% for latex. Tire makers face both volume and price risk when weather-sensitive output weakens while large consuming markets continue drawing material. China was material at 617,000 tonnes of May consumption, although its imports fell 12.88% month on month. Watch ANRPC's next monthly revision to the 2026 forecasts and whether physical prices hold their May gains.
title_zh: ANRPC 凸显橡胶产量放缓与消费偏强之间的张力
what_happened_zh: ANRPC 的 5 月统计报告预计 2026 年天然橡胶产量为 15.337 million tonnes，增长 2.4%；消费量为 15.550 million tonnes，增长 1.3%。报告称 5 月产量为 997,000 tonnes，同比下降 4.7%，而消费量为 1.310 million tonnes，增长 4.6%。月度数据表明全年供需处于紧平衡，同时 5 月现货价格走强：ANRPC 报告 SMR20 环比上涨 7.37%、STR20 上涨 9.56%、RSS3 上涨 6.25%、RSS4 上涨 7.17%、胶乳上涨 1.88%。当对天气敏感的产量走弱、而大型消费市场继续抽取原料时，轮胎制造商同时面临数量和价格风险。中国 5 月消费量达 617,000 tonnes，影响不容忽视，尽管其进口量环比下降 12.88%。后续应关注 ANRPC 对 2026 年预测的下一次月度修订，以及现货价格能否保持 5 月的涨幅。

title: Liberia bans exports of unprocessed natural rubber to force more domestic processing
what_happened: President Joseph Boakai issued an executive order prohibiting exports of unprocessed natural rubber, including latex, coagulum, cup lump, tree lace and rubber scrap, for an indefinite period. Implementing regulations were due within 30 days. The policy moves value-chain intervention upstream: export access is conditioned on local processing rather than only farm production. The legal action is immediate, while the scale of new processing investment and farmer-market effects remain unproven. Liberia is an important producing market, so the order can redirect trade flows, processor utilization and procurement risk for international buyers. Watch the implementing regulations, enforcement date, licensed processing capacity and any farmer-price or export-volume response.
title_zh: 利比里亚禁止未加工天然橡胶出口，以推动更多本地加工
what_happened_zh: 总统 Joseph Boakai 签署行政命令，无限期禁止出口未加工天然橡胶，包括胶乳、凝块胶、杯凝胶、胶线和废胶。配套实施细则须在 30 天内出台。该政策把价值链干预推向上游：出口准入以本地加工为条件，而不再只取决于农场产出。法律行动立即生效，但新增加工投资的规模以及对胶农市场的影响仍未得到证实。利比里亚是重要的产胶市场，因此这项命令可能改变贸易流向、加工厂开工率，并影响国际买家的采购风险。后续应关注实施细则、执行日期、获得许可的加工能力，以及胶农价格或出口量方面的反应。

title: Chinese industry group plans Laos rubber due diligence around direct sourcing and compliance
what_happened: CRIA announced a July 27-August 2 research mission to Laos for 15-20 participants, covering plantations, processors and logistics. The agenda includes quality, direct purchasing, custom processing, joint investment, EUDR readiness and transport routes. The planned mission treats cross-border sourcing as a combined commercial, traceability and compliance design problem rather than a simple spot purchase. Laos had zero-tariff access to China for natural rubber from December 1, 2024, and CRIA estimated 2025 output near 600,000 tonnes. For Chinese buyers, Laos offers supply diversification, but the economics depend on quality consistency, chain-of-custody evidence and logistics. The announcement is a due-diligence plan, not a purchase agreement. Watch whether CRIA publishes mission findings or participants announce direct-purchase, processing or investment agreements after August 2.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association Rubber Materials Committee
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association Rubber Materials Committee

title_zh: 中国行业协会计划围绕直接采购与合规开展老挝橡胶尽职调查
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会宣布，将于 7 月 27 日至 8 月 2 日组织 15-20 名参与者赴老挝考察，内容涵盖种植园、加工厂和物流。议程包括质量、直接采购、来料加工、合作投资、EUDR 准备情况和运输路线。这项计划中的考察把跨境采购视为商业、可追溯性与合规三者结合的设计问题，而不是简单的现货采购。自 2024 年 12 月 1 日起，老挝天然橡胶对中国享有零关税待遇，中国橡胶工业协会估计 2025 年产量接近 600,000 tonnes。对中国买家而言，老挝提供了供应多元化，但其经济性取决于质量稳定性、监管链证据和物流条件。该公告是一项尽职调查计划，而不是采购协议。后续应关注中国橡胶工业协会是否公布考察结论，或参与方在 8 月 2 日之后宣布直接采购、加工或投资协议。

title: Weekly recycling coverage returns Bolder's Antwerp rCB project to view after final permitting
what_happened: Weibold reported on June 23 that Bolder Industries had received final permitting for its first European facility in the Port of Antwerp-Bruges NextGen District. The two-phase site has 86,000 tonnes of design capacity, with 43,000 tonnes in phase one, and is planned to produce recovered carbon black and tire-derived oil from end-of-life tires. The permit moves a proposed circular-material plant through a regulatory gate toward contractor selection. Full-scale claims of about 6 million tires processed annually and lifecycle emissions reductions remain company projections; the plant is not yet constructed or operating. If built and qualified, the project would add European supply of recovered carbon black and tire-derived oil close to tire and rubber customers. Commercial impact depends on financing, construction, product consistency and offtake. Watch final investment and financing decisions, contractor awards, construction start, customer qualifications and commissioning.
title_zh: 本周回收报道让 Bolder 的安特卫普 rCB 项目在完成最终许可后重回视野
what_happened_zh: Weibold 于 6 月 23 日报道，Bolder Industries 已就其位于 Port of Antwerp-Bruges NextGen District 的首座欧洲工厂获得最终许可。该两期项目设计产能为 86,000 tonnes，其中一期为 43,000 tonnes，计划以报废轮胎为原料生产再生炭黑和轮胎热解油。这项许可使一个拟建的循环材料工厂通过了一道监管关口，进入承包商选择阶段。关于满负荷下每年处理约 6 million 条轮胎以及全生命周期减排的说法仍属公司预测；该工厂尚未建成或投产。如果建成并通过认证，该项目将在靠近轮胎和橡胶客户的地方增加欧洲的再生炭黑与轮胎热解油供应。商业影响取决于融资、建设、产品一致性和承购安排。后续应关注最终投资与融资决策、承包商中标、开工建设、客户认证和投料试车。

title: Review maps controlled routes from natural rubber to functional liquid oligomers
what_happened: A new open-access review compared mechanical, thermal, oxidative and photochemical routes for converting high-molecular-weight natural rubber into liquid natural rubber and telechelic derivatives, generally below 50,000 g/mol. Controlled chain scission can create hydroxyl-, carbonyl- and other functional end groups for coatings, blends, fillers, adhesives, foams and processing aids. The review highlights greener oxidants and photocatalytic approaches but also documents reaction-control, color, toxicity and purification limitations. This broadens natural rubber from bulk elastomer feedstock toward functional bio-based intermediates, while making process selectivity and cleanup the industrialization bottlenecks.
title_zh: 综述梳理从天然橡胶到功能性液体低聚物的可控路径
what_happened_zh: 一篇新的开放获取综述比较了机械、热、氧化和光化学路径，用于把高分子量天然橡胶转化为液体天然橡胶及遥爪型衍生物，分子量一般低于 50,000 g/mol。可控链断裂可以生成羟基、羰基及其他官能端基，用于涂料、共混物、填料、胶粘剂、泡沫和加工助剂。该综述强调了更环保的氧化剂和光催化方法，但同时也记录了反应控制、色泽、毒性和提纯方面的局限。这把天然橡胶从大宗弹性体原料拓展为功能性生物基中间体，同时使工艺选择性和后处理成为产业化的瓶颈。

title: Linglong's Yunnan rubber story brings plantation traceability into the weekly sourcing debate
what_happened: Tyre News reported on June 24 that Linglong's Yunnan sustainable-natural-rubber project was moving into a stronger demonstration phase through an ecological collection station in Xishuangbanna. According to the company claims carried by the report, the programme supports about 2,000 farmers and 10,000 hectares and combines smart weighing, data collection, farmer payments, wastewater treatment and forest-to-factory traceability. The model integrates physical collection, smallholder interaction, environmental controls and digital chain-of-custody at the first aggregation point rather than adding traceability only at the factory gate. Natural-rubber due diligence is difficult because supply is fragmented across smallholders. A functioning collection-station model could improve sourcing evidence for tire customers and regulators, but coverage figures, certification progress and outcomes remain company-origin claims. Watch FSC certification evidence, auditable lot-level data and measured farmer, biodiversity or wastewater outcomes.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎的云南橡胶项目把种植园可追溯性带入本周采购讨论
what_happened_zh: Tyre News 于 6 月 24 日报道，玲珑轮胎的云南可持续天然橡胶项目正通过西双版纳的一座生态收胶站进入更有力的示范阶段。根据该报道所引述的公司说法，该项目服务约 2,000 名胶农和 10,000 公顷胶园，并把智能称重、数据采集、胶农付款、废水处理以及从林地到工厂的可追溯性结合起来。该模式在第一个归集环节就整合了实物收胶、与小农的互动、环境控制和数字化监管链，而不是只在工厂门口才加上可追溯性。天然橡胶尽职调查之所以困难，是因为供应分散在众多小农手中。一个运转良好的收胶站模式可以为轮胎客户和监管机构改善采购证据，但覆盖数据、认证进展和实际成效仍属公司来源的说法。后续应关注 FSC 认证证据、可审计的批次级数据，以及经过测量的胶农、生物多样性或废水方面的成效。

title: China rubber-equipment roadmap sets 2030 scale and automation targets
companies: China Rubber Industry Association machinery and mold sector
what_happened: CRIA published five-year targets for China's rubber machinery and mold sector: sales of RMB27 billion by 2030 and a global share above 50%, alongside a 35-second passenger-tire building cycle, AI diagnosis, digital twins and mixer energy savings above 40%. The roadmap links equipment export growth with faster tire-building, AI-assisted maintenance and energy efficiency. It records sector sales rising from RMB11.5 billion in 2020 to RMB20.6 billion in 2025 and export delivery value from USD360 million to USD1.08 billion. Equipment capability is becoming a competitive lever for plant economics and overseas expansion, but the 2030 figures and performance thresholds are goals rather than achieved industry averages. Watch annual sector sales, export delivery value and named factory validations against the 35-second and energy-saving targets.
title_zh: 中国橡胶装备路线图设定 2030 年规模与自动化目标
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会公布了中国橡胶机械与模具行业的五年目标：到 2030 年销售额达到 RMB27 billion、全球份额超过 50%，同时实现 35 秒的乘用车轮胎成型周期、AI 诊断、数字孪生以及密炼机节能超过 40%。该路线图把设备出口增长与更快的轮胎成型、AI 辅助维护和能效联系起来。文件记录了行业销售额从 2020 年的 RMB11.5 billion 升至 2025 年的 RMB20.6 billion，出口交货值从 USD360 million 升至 USD1.08 billion。设备能力正成为影响工厂经济性和海外扩张的竞争杠杆，但 2030 年的数字和性能门槛属于目标，而不是已经实现的行业平均水平。后续应关注行业年度销售额、出口交货值，以及对照 35 秒和节能目标的具名工厂验证。

title: Wanli Tire's accepted IPO filing ties RMB2 billion raise to overseas and smart-capacity projects
what_happened: Wanli Tire's Shenzhen main-board IPO application was accepted with RMB2 billion of proposed proceeds. The filing allocates funds to Cambodia, a 6-million-unit passenger-tire expansion and intelligence upgrade in Conghua, a Malaysian high-performance green-tire base, an R&D-center upgrade and working capital. The filing combines domestic intelligent capacity with a second overseas manufacturing node. Of the proposed proceeds, RMB930 million is allocated to Malaysia, RMB310 million to R&D and RMB180 million each to Cambodia and the Conghua expansion. The structure shows how a Chinese tire maker is seeking capital for both supply-chain regionalization and factory modernization. Acceptance is an audit stage; it is not financing completion or project commissioning. Watch Shenzhen Stock Exchange inquiries, updated prospectuses, registration and project-specific environmental approvals.
title_zh: 万力轮胎 IPO 申请获受理，RMB2 billion 募资投向海外与智能产能项目
what_happened_zh: 万力轮胎的深交所主板 IPO 申请已获受理，拟募集资金 RMB2 billion。申报文件把资金投向柬埔寨项目、从化 6-million 条乘用车轮胎扩产及智能化升级、马来西亚高性能绿色轮胎基地、研发中心升级和补充流动资金。该方案把国内智能产能与第二个海外制造节点结合在一起。在拟募集资金中，RMB930 million 投向马来西亚，RMB310 million 投向研发，柬埔寨项目和从化扩产各 RMB180 million。这一结构显示出一家中国轮胎制造商如何同时为供应链区域化和工厂现代化寻求资本。受理属于审核阶段，并不意味着融资完成或项目投产。后续应关注深圳证券交易所的问询、更新后的招股说明书、注册程序以及各项目的环保审批。

title: Yunnan demonstration puts automatic tapping and field robotics in front of rubber growers
companies: Yunnan Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
what_happened: A June 25 field event demonstrated more than ten sets of equipment from eight suppliers, including automatic rubber-tapping robots, electric tapping knives, automated weeders and drones, and published a demand list for the natural-rubber production area. The event packages tapping, field maintenance and aerial work as a mechanization stack for plantation labor constraints. It is evidence of demonstration and demand definition, not broad adoption or commercial performance. Upstream labor and consistency affect the cost and availability of tire-grade natural rubber; a coordinated equipment demand list can turn isolated prototypes into procurement-ready trials. Watch for public procurement, deployment counts and measured labor, yield or quality results from participating production areas.

sources.publisher: Yunnan Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
sources.link_label: Yunnan Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

title_zh: 云南示范活动把自动割胶与田间机器人带到胶农面前
what_happened_zh: 6 月 25 日的一场田间活动展示了来自八家供应商的十多套装备，包括自动割胶机器人、电动割胶刀、自动除草机和无人机，并发布了面向天然橡胶产区的需求清单。该活动把割胶、田间管理和航空作业打包成应对种植园劳动力约束的机械化组合。这是示范和需求界定的证据，而不是广泛采用或商业化表现的证明。上游劳动力和作业一致性会影响轮胎级天然橡胶的成本与可得性；一份统筹的装备需求清单可以把零散的样机转化为可供采购的试用项目。后续应关注参与产区的公共采购、部署数量，以及经过测量的劳动力、产量或质量结果。

title: Michelin will consolidate most BFGoodrich U.S. output at Fort Wayne and wind down Tuscaloosa
what_happened: Michelin announced that nearly all BFGoodrich production will move to Fort Wayne, Indiana. Tire production and rubber mixing at Tuscaloosa, Alabama, are scheduled to wind down in phases from early 2027 through year-end 2028, affecting about 1,200 employees. This is a network-utilization response rather than a new-capacity move: Michelin said both plants were well below designed capacity and cited structural inefficiency plus intensifying competition in recreation and off-road tires. The decision concentrates a major U.S. brand's manufacturing footprint and signals that underused legacy capacity is being rationalized even in differentiated segments. Watch the early-2027 phase-down, Fort Wayne transfer milestones and any announced new mission for the Tuscaloosa site.
title_zh: 米其林将把 BFGoodrich 在美国的大部分产量集中到 Fort Wayne，并逐步关停 Tuscaloosa
what_happened_zh: 米其林宣布，BFGoodrich 几乎全部产量将转移至印第安纳州 Fort Wayne。位于阿拉巴马州 Tuscaloosa 的轮胎生产和橡胶密炼计划从 2027 年初至 2028 年底分阶段逐步停止，涉及约 1,200 名员工。这是针对产能网络利用率的应对措施，而不是新增产能之举：米其林表示两座工厂都远低于设计产能，并提到结构性低效以及休闲和非公路轮胎领域竞争加剧。该决定使一个主要美国品牌的制造布局更加集中，并表明即使在差异化细分市场，利用不足的存量产能也正在被整合优化。后续应关注 2027 年初的分阶段减产、Fort Wayne 的转移节点，以及 Tuscaloosa 厂区是否获得公布的新定位。

title: In-week coverage revisits Jinma Rubber's Malaysia phase-II smart-factory start
what_happened: A June 22 China Rubber Magazine report via Sohu said Jinma Rubber's Malaysia phase-II smart factory began trial operations on June 18. It reported investment above MYR500 million, extensive use of industrial robots and digital management systems, and combined annual capacity above 7 million tires. The weekly signal connects a Chinese tire maker's overseas-capacity expansion with automation, data capture and process traceability rather than a low-cost production move alone. The operating date and capacity are media-reported and do not establish stable utilization or quality performance. The project shows a Shandong manufacturer combining overseas market access, Malaysian natural-rubber proximity and digitally managed production. Its commercial value will depend on ramp-up, product mix and customer qualification. Watch verified output, utilization, product qualifications and whether the reported digital systems produce measurable quality or efficiency gains.
title_zh: 周内报道回顾 Jinma Rubber 马来西亚二期智能工厂启动
what_happened_zh: 6 月 22 日中国橡胶杂志经搜狐发布的报道称，Jinma Rubber 马来西亚二期智能工厂已于 6 月 18 日开始试运行。报道称投资超过 MYR500 million，大量使用工业机器人和数字化管理系统，合计年产能超过 7 million 条轮胎。本周信号把一家中国轮胎制造商的海外产能扩张与自动化、数据采集和过程可追溯性联系起来，而不仅是单纯的低成本生产转移。投产日期和产能均为媒体报道，并不能确立稳定的产能利用率或质量表现。该项目显示一家山东制造商把海外市场准入、贴近马来西亚天然橡胶资源与数字化管理生产结合起来。其商业价值将取决于产能爬坡、产品结构和客户认证。后续应关注经核实的产量、产能利用率、产品认证，以及所报道的数字化系统是否带来可衡量的质量或效率提升。

title: Qingdao tire-logistics supplier clears Beijing Stock Exchange listing-committee review
what_happened: Qingdao's securities regulator reported that Huaseng Intelligent's public-offering and Beijing Stock Exchange listing application passed the exchange listing committee on June 22. Filing materials describe intelligent logistics systems used in rubber and tire production among several industries. The review milestone advances a specialist automation supplier toward public-market funding for equipment manufacturing, R&D and commercial expansion. It does not mean registration, issuance or listing has occurred. Tire factories increasingly depend on integrated warehouse, line-logistics, software and scheduling suppliers; supplier access to capital can expand delivery capacity for that automation layer. Watch CSRC registration, offering documents and project implementation after any capital raise.
title_zh: 青岛轮胎物流供应商通过北京证券交易所上市委员会审议
what_happened_zh: 青岛证券监管部门披露，Huaseng Intelligent 的公开发行并在北京证券交易所上市的申请已于 6 月 22 日通过交易所上市委员会审议。申报材料描述了用于橡胶和轮胎生产等多个行业的智能物流系统。这一审议节点使一家专业自动化供应商更接近通过公开市场为设备制造、研发和商业扩张融资，但并不意味着注册、发行或上市已经完成。轮胎工厂越来越依赖集成仓储、线边物流、软件和调度的供应商；供应商获得资本有助于扩大该自动化环节的交付能力。后续应关注中国证监会注册、发行文件，以及任何募资之后的项目实施情况。

title: JETRO coverage keeps Sailun's enlarged Egypt manufacturing plan in the weekly signal set
what_happened: JETRO reported on June 25 that Sailun had announced on June 18 an additional USD1.14131 billion investment in its under-construction Egypt base. The report said a new company would be added alongside the existing subsidiary, taking combined planned investment above USD1.718 billion and planned capacity to 36 million passenger tires, 3.3 million truck-and-bus tires and 20,000 tonnes of off-road tires a year. The scale turns Egypt from a single overseas project into a potential regional manufacturing platform across passenger, commercial and off-road segments. All investment and capacity figures remain plans, not installed or operating output. For a Shandong tire maker, Egypt can provide a production and market-access node for the Middle East, Africa and nearby export markets. Execution risk rises with the plan's scale and multi-company structure. Watch local permits, financing, construction milestones, equipment installation and the first independently confirmed production line.
title_zh: JETRO 的报道使赛轮扩大后的埃及制造计划留在本周信号集中
what_happened_zh: JETRO 于 6 月 25 日报道，赛轮已于 6 月 18 日宣布对在建的埃及基地追加 USD1.14131 billion 投资。报道称将在现有子公司之外新增一家公司，使合计规划投资超过 USD1.718 billion，规划产能达到每年 36 million 条乘用车轮胎、3.3 million 条卡客车轮胎和 20,000 tonnes 非公路轮胎。这一规模使埃及从单一海外项目转变为覆盖乘用、商用和非公路板块的潜在区域制造平台。所有投资和产能数字仍属计划，而不是已建成或运行的产出。对一家山东轮胎制造商而言，埃及可以成为面向中东、非洲及周边出口市场的生产与市场准入节点。随着计划规模扩大和多公司结构，执行风险也随之上升。后续应关注当地许可、融资、建设节点、设备安装，以及首条经独立确认的生产线。

title: In-week reporting brings Haohua's Qingdao R&D-center plan into focus
what_happened: A June 25 report by Tire News via Sina Finance said Qingdao's Laoshan district had posted pre-publicity on June 22 for the LS0603054 plot plan. It reported that Shandong Haohua Technology plans a 47,800-square-meter R&D center on about 15,600 square meters of land, including R&D and laboratory buildings. The signal is a spatial-separation model: manufacturing remains in a lower-cost production base while R&D and related functions are placed in Qingdao. The evidence establishes an attributable media report about planning pre-publicity, not an approved permit, construction start or completed center. A Qingdao R&D node could give a Shandong tire maker better access to technical talent and collaboration while keeping production economics elsewhere. The bounded media evidence makes the plan relevant without overstating its official or execution stage. Watch for the exact Laoshan planning record, land or construction approvals, and a company-confirmed implementation timetable.
title_zh: 周内报道让 Haohua 的青岛研发中心计划进入视野
what_happened_zh: Tire News 经新浪财经于 6 月 25 日发布的报道称，青岛市崂山区已于 6 月 22 日对 LS0603054 地块规划方案进行批前公示。报道称 Shandong Haohua Technology 计划在约 15,600 平方米用地上建设一座 47,800 平方米的研发中心，包括研发楼和实验楼。该信号体现的是一种空间分离模式：制造环节留在成本较低的生产基地，而研发及相关职能布置在青岛。相关证据确立的是一则可归属的媒体报道，涉及规划批前公示，而不是已获批准的许可、开工建设或建成的中心。青岛的研发节点可以让一家山东轮胎制造商更好地获取技术人才和合作机会，同时把生产经济性保留在别处。有界的媒体证据让该计划具有相关性，同时不夸大其官方或执行阶段。后续应关注崂山区确切的规划记录、用地或建设审批，以及经公司确认的实施时间表。

title: In-week reporting advances ZC Rubber's Vietnam plant from investment plan to outbound filing
what_happened: Economic Observer reported on June 27 that ZC Rubber's planned Vietnam project had obtained a Zhejiang development-and-reform filing on June 18. The report described RMB1.04 billion of investment, annual capacity for 5 million passenger-car radial tires, a planned July start and a 12-month construction period. The in-week signal is an administrative step between a previously announced overseas investment and physical execution. It supports a move toward localized Southeast Asian capacity, but it is not a Vietnamese construction permit or evidence that work has started. A Vietnam plant could diversify ZC Rubber's manufacturing footprint and trade exposure while adding passenger-tire capacity near regional markets. The timing and economics remain plans reported by media. Watch Vietnamese local approvals, site activity, a confirmed groundbreaking and any revision to the July 2027 completion target.
title_zh: 周内报道把中策橡胶越南工厂从投资计划推进到境外投资备案
what_happened_zh: 经济观察报于 6 月 27 日报道，中策橡胶计划中的越南项目已于 6 月 18 日取得浙江省发展改革部门备案。报道描述了 RMB1.04 billion 的投资额、年产 5 million 条乘用车子午线轮胎的产能、计划 7 月开工以及 12 个月的建设周期。周内信号是此前宣布的海外投资与实际执行之间的一个行政步骤。它支持向东南亚本地化产能推进，但既不是越南的建设许可，也不是工程已经开工的证据。越南工厂可以分散中策橡胶的制造布局和贸易风险，同时在区域市场附近增加乘用车轮胎产能。时间安排和经济性仍属媒体报道的计划。后续应关注越南当地审批、现场动态、确认的破土动工，以及 2027 年 7 月竣工目标是否出现调整。

title: TireSpec turns a sidewall photo into an embedded replacement-tire quote
what_happened: TraXtion launched TireSpec, a hardware-free website widget that uses computer vision and optical character recognition to read a smartphone photo of a tire sidewall, identify specifications and return replacement recommendations with inventory and pricing. The tire itself becomes the search input, removing vehicle, VIN and tire-size form fields while keeping the shopper inside the dealer or repairer's website. The workflow connects recognition directly to distributor inventory and quote generation. This is a concrete AI-enabled sales model for reducing friction between tire identification and a bookable replacement transaction. Accuracy and conversion improvement remain company claims without published field metrics. Watch named retailer deployments, quote-to-appointment conversion data and the two patent-pending applications cited by the company.
title_zh: TireSpec 把一张胎侧照片变成嵌入式的替换轮胎报价
what_happened_zh: TraXtion 推出 TireSpec，这是一款无需硬件的网站插件，利用计算机视觉和光学字符识别读取智能手机拍摄的轮胎胎侧照片，识别规格并返回带有库存和价格的替换轮胎推荐。轮胎本身成为搜索输入，省去了车型、VIN 和轮胎规格表单字段，同时把消费者留在经销商或维修商的网站内。该流程把识别环节直接连接到分销商库存和报价生成。这是一种具体的 AI 驱动销售模式，用于减少从轮胎识别到可预约替换交易之间的摩擦。准确率和转化率提升仍属公司说法，没有公开的实地数据。后续应关注具名零售商的部署、从报价到预约的转化数据，以及公司提到的两项待批专利申请。

title: Kumho balances U.S. direct dealers, associate dealers and regional warehouses
what_happened: In an original Modern Tire Dealer interview, Kumho's U.S. sales president described growth in direct dealers alongside the Premium Fuel associate-dealer program, plus added warehouse capacity in Dallas and Georgia. The company is also targeting last-mile, government, bus and regional fleets in TBR. The distribution model combines channel diversification, closer inventory positioning and dealer education through the EDGE platform. It is a resilience response to consumer trade-down, tariffs and the residual supply effects of the 2025 Gwangju plant fire. Shorter regional lead times and a balanced dealer mix can protect fill rates while giving a Korean maker more routes into U.S. replacement and fleet demand. Watch disclosed fill-rate or delivery-time evidence and the September introduction of Road Venture HT and Crugen GT Pro.
title_zh: 锦湖在美国直营经销商、加盟经销商与区域仓库之间寻求平衡
what_happened_zh: 在 Modern Tire Dealer 的一篇原创访谈中，锦湖美国销售总裁介绍了直营经销商的增长、Premium Fuel 加盟经销商计划，以及在达拉斯和佐治亚新增的仓储能力。公司同时瞄准全钢子午线轮胎领域的末端配送、政府、客车和区域车队客户。该渠道模式结合了渠道多元化、更贴近市场的库存布局，以及通过 EDGE 平台开展的经销商培训。这是对消费降级、关税以及 2025 年光州工厂火灾残留供应影响的一种韧性应对。更短的区域交付周期和均衡的经销商结构可以保护订单满足率，同时为这家韩国制造商提供更多进入美国替换市场和车队需求的路径。后续应关注公开披露的订单满足率或交付时间证据，以及 9 月推出的 Road Venture HT 和 Crugen GT Pro。

title: U.S. preliminary review assigns divergent subsidy rates to Indian OTR tire exporters
companies: U.S. Department of Commerce; ATC Tires; Balkrishna Industries
what_happened: The U.S. Department of Commerce published preliminary results for its 2024 administrative review of countervailing duties on certain off-the-road tires from India: 9.30% for ATC Tires, 0.50% for Balkrishna Industries and 4.90% for non-selected companies. Company-specific trade-remedy rates create different landed-cost and channel constraints within the same origin country. The notice covers radial and non-radial OTR tires for original-equipment and replacement uses. The preliminary rates can alter pricing, sourcing and distributor decisions in a specialized tire market, but they are subject to comments and final determination. Watch case briefs, the final review results and any change in company-specific rates.
title_zh: 美国初裁对印度 OTR 轮胎出口商给出差异明显的补贴税率
what_happened_zh: 美国商务部公布了针对印度部分非公路（OTR）轮胎反补贴税 2024 年度行政复审的初步结果：ATC Tires 为 9.30%，Balkrishna Industries 为 0.50%，未被抽样企业为 4.90%。按企业分别确定的贸易救济税率，会在同一原产国内部形成不同的到岸成本和渠道约束。该通知涵盖用于原配和替换市场的子午线及非子午线 OTR 轮胎。初裁税率可能改变这一专业轮胎市场中的定价、采购和分销决策，但仍需经过评论程序和最终裁定。后续应关注案件意见书、复审最终结果，以及各企业税率是否发生变化。

title: Dunlop signs a three-year presenting partnership with Goodwood Revival
what_happened: Sumitomo Rubber Industries announced that Dunlop will serve as presenting partner of the Goodwood Revival for up to three years, beginning with the September 18-20, 2026 event. Plans include a 600-square-meter booth and three 1966 Ford GT40 cars on Dunlop tires. The partnership uses authenticated motorsport heritage as a market-reentry and premium-brand platform after Sumitomo acquired the Dunlop trademark rights for Europe, North America and Oceania in 2025. It links brand investment to a distinctive product story and a concentrated enthusiast audience rather than a broad sponsorship buy. Watch the September activation, product launches tied to the event and subsequent Dunlop distribution expansion in Europe.
title_zh: Dunlop 与 Goodwood Revival 签署三年冠名合作
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶宣布，Dunlop 将担任 Goodwood Revival 的冠名合作伙伴，期限最长三年，自 2026 年 9 月 18-20 日的赛事开始。计划包括一个 600 平方米的展位和三辆使用 Dunlop 轮胎的 1966 年 Ford GT40 赛车。该合作把经过认证的赛车运动传承用作重返市场和高端品牌的平台，此前住友橡胶已于 2025 年取得 Dunlop 在欧洲、北美和大洋洲的商标权。它把品牌投入与独特的产品故事和高度集中的爱好者受众联系起来，而不是一次泛泛的赞助采购。后续应关注 9 月的落地活动、与该赛事绑定的产品发布，以及 Dunlop 随后在欧洲的渠道扩张。

title: Continental expands Tour de France product proof through six teams and retail-linked race tires
what_happened: Continental said six teams, more than one quarter of the peloton, would race its road-bike tires at the 2026 Tour de France. About 1,000 tires were produced and tested at Korbach, with four product options also commercially available. The program turns elite team supply into a product-demonstration channel linked directly to retail SKUs, while giving teams a menu for road and weather conditions. For a tire maker, visible customer use plus commercial availability can make sports sponsorship more measurable than brand exposure alone, although race results do not independently validate consumer performance. Watch team tire selections and whether race-derived changes appear in subsequent retail products.
title_zh: 大陆集团通过六支车队和与零售挂钩的比赛轮胎扩大环法产品验证
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团表示，将有六支车队、占车手总数四分之一以上，在 2026 年环法自行车赛上使用其公路自行车轮胎。约有 1,000 条轮胎在 Korbach 生产并测试，其中四个产品选项同时在市场上有售。该项目把顶级车队供胎变成直接与零售 SKU 挂钩的产品演示渠道，同时为车队提供应对不同路面和天气条件的选择菜单。对轮胎制造商而言，可见的客户使用加上商业可得性，可以让体育赞助比单纯的品牌曝光更可衡量，不过比赛成绩并不能独立验证民用产品性能。后续应关注车队的轮胎选择，以及源自比赛的改进是否出现在后续的零售产品中。

title: Dunlop's first NLS overall win gives its European brand relaunch a motorsport proof point
companies: Sumitomo Rubber Industries; Dunlop Tyre Europe
what_happened: Sumitomo Rubber Industries reported on June 26 that Dunlop Motorsport had taken its first overall Nürburgring Endurance Series victory in the June 20 sixth round. The first-year team won with the No. 17 Porsche 911 GT3 R driven by Nico Menzel and Sven Müller, finishing 0.319 seconds ahead. The result gives Dunlop a competition-use proof point as it unifies brand communication in 2026. It is a credible brand and market-positioning signal, while the company's grip and wear claims cannot isolate the tire contribution from drivers, team execution, vehicle and pit strategy. A visible first overall win strengthens the story behind Dunlop's European motorsport return and can feed premium-product positioning, even though one race does not establish consumer-tire superiority or sales impact. Watch later NLS and Nürburgring 24-hour results, disclosed tire development changes and any transfer into named road-tire products.
title_zh: Dunlop 首夺 NLS 总冠军，为其欧洲品牌重启提供赛车运动佐证
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶于 6 月 26 日报道，Dunlop Motorsport 在 6 月 20 日举行的第六回合比赛中首次夺得纽伯格林耐力赛系列赛总冠军。这支首年参赛的车队以 Nico Menzel 和 Sven Müller 驾驶的 17 号 Porsche 911 GT3 R 夺冠，领先 0.319 秒完赛。该成绩为 Dunlop 在 2026 年统一品牌传播之际提供了一个竞赛使用层面的佐证。这是一个可信的品牌与市场定位信号，而公司关于抓地力和磨耗的说法无法把轮胎的贡献与车手、车队执行、赛车和进站策略区分开来。一次引人注目的首个总冠军强化了 Dunlop 重返欧洲赛车运动背后的叙事，并可以支撑高端产品定位，尽管一场比赛并不能确立民用轮胎的优越性或销售影响。后续应关注后续的 NLS 和纽伯格林 24 小时赛结果、已公开的轮胎开发变化，以及是否转化到具名的公路轮胎产品中。

title: Hankook's three Red Dot wins reinforce functional-design positioning across premium, EV and value tiers
what_happened: Hankook announced 2026 Red Dot Product Design Winner awards for the Ventus evo ultra-high-performance tire, the iON AT all-terrain EV tire for SUVs and pickup trucks, and the Laufenn S FIT2. Red Dot's official project record separately confirms the Ventus evo award. Recognition across a premium performance line, an upcoming EV all-terrain product and a value brand is a market-positioning signal: mainstream design evaluation is rewarding products that combine visual identity with claimed steering, noise, range, wear and usability considerations. Awards can shape product storytelling, portfolio coherence and channel attention even before sales evidence appears. They indicate design preference and brand positioning, not independently validated tire performance, customer adoption or revenue impact. Watch the iON AT launch, how Hankook uses the awards in retail and EV-channel campaigns, and whether the design language carries into later products.
title_zh: 韩泰三项 Red Dot 获奖强化其在高端、电动与入门层级的功能性设计定位
what_happened_zh: 韩泰宣布，其 Ventus evo 超高性能轮胎、面向 SUV 和皮卡的 iON AT 全地形电动车轮胎，以及 Laufenn S FIT2 获得 2026 年 Red Dot 产品设计奖。Red Dot 的官方项目记录另行确认了 Ventus evo 的获奖。在高端性能产品线、一款即将推出的电动车全地形产品和一个入门品牌上同时获得认可，是一种市场定位信号：主流设计评价正在奖励那些把视觉识别与所宣称的转向、噪声、续航、磨耗和易用性考量结合起来的产品。即使在销售证据出现之前，奖项也能影响产品叙事、产品组合的一致性和渠道关注度。它们表明的是设计偏好和品牌定位，而不是经过独立验证的轮胎性能、客户采用或收入影响。后续应关注 iON AT 的上市、韩泰如何在零售和电动车渠道活动中使用这些奖项，以及该设计语言是否延续到后续产品中。

title: TreadSense brings LiDAR tire inspection onto existing fleet Apple devices
what_happened: TreadSense introduced a mobile platform that uses LiDAR in compatible iPhone Pro and iPad Pro devices to capture tread-depth measurements and create a tire-level service record. Meiborg Companies was identified as a fleet implementing it. The model replaces dedicated inspection hardware with devices already present in fleet workflows, then connects measurements to yard, preventive-maintenance and trip inspections. Wear recognition, replacement forecasting and casing analytics were described as expansion features. A named fleet implementation moves mobile tire intelligence beyond a product concept, while consistent digital records could improve maintenance timing and casing decisions. Watch independent measurement-accuracy results, fleet deployment scale and release of the announced predictive features.
title_zh: TreadSense 把激光雷达轮胎检测带到车队现有的 Apple 设备上
what_happened_zh: TreadSense 推出一个移动平台，利用兼容的 iPhone Pro 和 iPad Pro 设备中的激光雷达采集胎面花纹深度数据，并建立单胎级服务记录。Meiborg Companies 被确认为正在实施该方案的车队。该模式用车队工作流程中已有的设备替代专用检测硬件，再把测量结果连接到场院检查、预防性维护和出车检查。磨耗识别、更换预测和胎体分析被描述为后续扩展功能。一家具名车队的实施使移动化轮胎智能超越了产品概念阶段，而一致的数字记录有望改善维护时机和胎体处置决策。后续应关注独立的测量准确性结果、车队部署规模，以及已宣布的预测功能的发布。

title: China's tire volume rises through May while export value and May shipments weaken
companies: China tire industry; National Bureau of Statistics and Customs data
what_happened: CRIA's compilation of official statistics reported January-May rubber-tire casing output of 501.71 million units, up 1.9%. Tire exports reached 4.03 million tonnes, up 3.5%, but export value fell 2.4% to RMB67.408 billion; May export weight and value fell 4.9% and 10.4% year on year. Volume growth is not translating into value growth, and the May reversal suggests weaker shipment momentum or mix/price pressure. New pneumatic-tire exports were 3.87 million tonnes, up 3.3%, with value down 2.5%. For manufacturers and distributors, the divergence between tonnage and value is a stronger commercial signal than output alone and points to margin and market-mix pressure. Watch June customs volume, value and unit counts to see whether the May decline persists.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association data compilation
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association data compilation

title_zh: 中国轮胎产量前五个月增长，而出口金额与 5 月出货走弱
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会汇编的官方统计显示，今年 1 月至 5 月橡胶轮胎外胎产量为 501.71 million 条，增长 1.9%。轮胎出口量达 4.03 million tonnes，增长 3.5%，但出口金额下降 2.4% 至 RMB67.408 billion；5 月出口重量和金额同比分别下降 4.9% 和 10.4%。产量增长没有转化为金额增长，5 月的逆转说明出货动能走弱或存在产品结构与价格压力。新的充气轮胎出口为 3.87 million tonnes，增长 3.3%，金额下降 2.5%。对制造商和分销商而言，吨位与金额之间的分化比单看产量更具商业信号意义，并指向利润率和市场结构压力。后续应关注 6 月的海关数量、金额和条数，以判断 5 月的下降是否延续。

title: EU registrations shift further toward electrified powertrains through May
what_happened: ACEA reported that EU new-car registrations rose 4% in the first five months of 2026. Battery-electric registrations reached 950,521 and 20.0% share, hybrids 1,795,071 and 37.8%, and plug-in hybrids 460,217 and 9.7%; petrol plus diesel fell to 30.1% from 38.0% a year earlier. The installed base feeding future tire replacement demand is changing faster than total vehicle growth, increasing exposure to EV weight, torque, efficiency and noise requirements. Registration mix is a customer-demand signal for OE and replacement portfolio planning, but it is not a direct measure of tire sales. Watch monthly revisions and whether BEV share continues to expand across the four largest EU markets.
title_zh: 欧盟新车注册量在前五个月进一步向电动化动力转移
what_happened_zh: 欧洲汽车制造商协会报告称，2026 年前五个月欧盟新车注册量增长 4%。纯电动车注册量达到 950,521 辆、份额 20.0%，混合动力车为 1,795,071 辆、37.8%，插电式混合动力车为 460,217 辆、9.7%；汽油加柴油车的份额从一年前的 38.0% 降至 30.1%。为未来替换轮胎需求提供基础的保有量结构，变化速度快于整体汽车保有量的增长，从而加大了对电动车重量、扭矩、能效和噪声要求的暴露。注册结构是原配和替换市场产品规划的客户需求信号，但并不是轮胎销量的直接度量。后续应关注月度数据修订，以及纯电动车份额是否在欧盟四个最大市场继续扩大。

title: Continental secures 19-inch EcoContact 7 fitment on China's Nissan N7
what_happened: Continental announced that the Nissan N7 is factory-fitted in China with the 235/45 R19 99Y XL FR EcoContact 7. The supplier describes a Smart Energy Casing, revised compound, Aero Dimples and a low-noise tread pattern. The fitment packages efficiency, cabin-noise and high-load requirements for a battery-electric sedan in a single China-market OE specification. A named factory fitment is direct evidence of customer adoption and places a European supplier's EV-focused tire technology into a major Chinese OEM channel. Watch N7 production volumes, additional approved sizes and any independent efficiency or noise testing of this exact fitment.
title_zh: 大陆集团获得中国日产 N7 的 19 英寸 EcoContact 7 配套
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团宣布，日产 N7 在中国以 235/45 R19 99Y XL FR EcoContact 7 作为原厂配套。该供应商介绍了 Smart Energy Casing 胎体、改良配方、Aero Dimples 以及低噪声胎面花纹。此次配套把能效、车内噪声和高负荷要求整合进面向一款纯电动轿车的单一中国市场原配规格。具名的工厂配套是客户采用的直接证据，并把一家欧洲供应商面向电动车的轮胎技术带入一家主要中国车企的渠道。后续应关注 N7 的产量、新增的认证规格，以及针对这一确切配套的独立能效或噪声测试。

title: Bridgestone becomes exclusive tire partner for the 15-car Lamborghini Fenomeno Roadster
what_happened: Bridgestone was selected as exclusive tire partner for Lamborghini's Fenomeno Roadster, limited to 15 cars. Bespoke Potenza Sport road tires and optional semi-slick products use 21-inch front and 22-inch rear fitments; a run-flat option is also offered. The fitment combines a very-low-volume OE validation with virtual tire development and multiple use cases. Bridgestone says its Virtual Tyre Development process helped tailor the tires and that the run-flat can continue for 80 km at up to 80 km/h under specified conditions. Although commercially small, the program shows how premium OE projects can serve as rapid development and technology-demonstration platforms. Watch vehicle deliveries and whether the developed constructions or virtual methods transfer to higher-volume Potenza products.
title_zh: 普利司通成为限量 15 辆 Lamborghini Fenomeno Roadster 的独家轮胎合作伙伴
what_happened_zh: 普利司通被选为 Lamborghini Fenomeno Roadster 的独家轮胎合作伙伴，该车型限量 15 辆。定制的 Potenza Sport 公路轮胎和可选的半热熔产品采用前 21 英寸、后 22 英寸配套，同时提供缺气保用选项。该配套把极小批量的原配验证与虚拟轮胎开发及多种使用场景结合起来。普利司通表示，其 Virtual Tyre Development 流程有助于针对性地开发这些轮胎，并称在规定条件下缺气保用轮胎可以在时速最高 80 km/h 的情况下继续行驶 80 km。尽管商业规模很小，该项目显示出高端原配项目可以作为快速开发和技术演示平台。后续应关注车辆交付情况，以及所开发的结构或虚拟方法是否会转移到产量更大的 Potenza 产品上。

title: Pirelli agrees to acquire 24.99% of RIDEsense to combine physical and virtual tire sensors
what_happened: Pirelli agreed to license RIDEsense's virtual-sensor technology and acquire a 24.99% equity stake, with an option to increase its holding to 100%. The partners plan to integrate RIDEsense algorithms with Pirelli Cyber Tyre's embedded physical sensors. The smart-tire stack is expanding from tire-mounted hardware into hybrid physical-and-virtual sensing, using production-vehicle ECU data and physics-based algorithms to strengthen aquaplaning detection and add tire and vehicle diagnostics. The deal gives Pirelli a faster route from a university spinout into ADAS and autonomous-driving functions, showing how tire makers are using licensing plus minority investment to capture software capability around the tire.
title_zh: 倍耐力同意收购 RIDEsense 24.99% 股权，融合物理与虚拟轮胎传感
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力同意获得 RIDEsense 虚拟传感技术的许可，并收购其 24.99% 股权，同时拥有将持股增至 100% 的选择权。双方计划把 RIDEsense 算法与倍耐力 Cyber Tyre 内置的物理传感器整合。智能轮胎体系正从胎内硬件扩展到物理与虚拟混合传感，利用量产车 ECU 数据和基于物理的算法强化水滑探测，并增加轮胎与整车诊断功能。该交易让倍耐力更快地从一家高校衍生企业切入 ADAS 和自动驾驶功能，显示出轮胎制造商正通过许可加少数股权投资来获取围绕轮胎的软件能力。

title: South Korea funds a five-year push to raise recycled-carbon-black content in new tires
companies: South Korea Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment; Korea Environmental Industry & Technology Institute
what_happened: South Korea's climate ministry and KEITI launched a 2026-2030 circular-use R&D program that allocates KRW 48 billion specifically to waste-tire technology. The work covers pretreatment before pyrolysis, higher-quality recovered carbon black, commercialization, and technologies intended to let new tires use more than 15% recycled carbon black. Public circular-economy funding is moving beyond tire-derived fuel toward tire-to-material pathways, with an explicit recovered-carbon-black loading target tied to commercial tire production. The program targets the quality barrier that the ministry says currently limits recycled material to roughly 5% in new tires and prepares the domestic value chain for future EU ecodesign requirements.

sources.publisher: South Korea Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment
sources.link_label: South Korea Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment

title_zh: 韩国出资推动为期五年的新轮胎再生炭黑含量提升计划
what_happened_zh: 韩国气候主管部门与 KEITI 启动了 2026-2030 年循环利用研发计划，其中专门向废旧轮胎技术拨款 KRW 48 billion。该计划涵盖热解前预处理、更高质量的再生炭黑、商业化，以及使新轮胎再生炭黑用量超过 15% 的相关技术。公共循环经济资金正从轮胎衍生燃料转向轮胎到材料的路径，并把明确的再生炭黑添加量目标与商业化轮胎生产挂钩。该计划针对的是质量瓶颈：该部门称这一瓶颈目前使新轮胎中的再生材料占比仅约 5%；该计划同时为国内价值链应对未来 EU 生态设计要求做准备。

title: Chinese and Thai researchers map natural rubber's built-in reinforcement system
companies: CATAS Rubber Research Institute; Mahidol University
what_happened: Researchers proposed a multiscale framework explaining how natural rubber's small non-rubber fraction, including proteins, phospholipids, lipids, carbohydrates, and metals, influences structure and performance from molecular interactions through bulk behavior. Natural-rubber research is shifting from treating non-rubber constituents as impurities toward engineering them as an intrinsic reinforcement system. A better mechanistic model could improve control of stability, viscoelasticity, vulcanization, filler dispersion, and mechanical performance in tire compounds.

sources.publisher: CATAS Rubber Research Institute; Industrial Crops and Products
sources.link_label: CATAS Rubber Research Institute; Industrial Crops and Products

title_zh: 中泰研究人员梳理天然橡胶内在的增强体系
what_happened_zh: 研究人员提出了一个多尺度框架，解释天然橡胶中占比很小的非橡胶组分，包括蛋白质、磷脂、脂类、碳水化合物和金属，如何从分子相互作用一直影响到本体行为层面的结构与性能。天然橡胶研究正从把非橡胶组分视为杂质，转向把它们作为一种内在增强体系加以设计利用。更好的机理模型有望改善轮胎胶料在稳定性、黏弹性、硫化、填料分散和力学性能方面的控制。

title: Sumitomo Rubber packages acquired AI into manufacturing and failure-prediction tools
what_happened: Sumitomo Rubber said it would demonstrate two Viaduct-based AI solutions: one integrating development, production, sales, and quality data for cross-functional equipment root-cause analysis, and another learning from specifications, sensor, repair, and warranty data to identify failure patterns and estimate future risk. Tire-company data platforms are moving from isolated factory dashboards toward cross-lifecycle diagnostic models that connect manufacturing, product use, quality, and warranty signals. If deployed successfully, the tools could shorten troubleshooting and support predictive maintenance and quality decisions, while creating a commercialization path for technology acquired with Viaduct in 2025.
title_zh: 住友橡胶将收购所得 AI 技术封装为制造与失效预测工具
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶表示将演示两套基于 Viaduct 的 AI 方案：一套整合研发、生产、销售和质量数据，用于跨职能的设备根因分析；另一套从规格、传感器、维修和质保数据中学习，以识别失效模式并估计未来风险。轮胎企业的数据平台正从孤立的工厂看板转向跨生命周期的诊断模型，把制造、产品使用、质量和质保信号连接起来。如果部署成功，这些工具可以缩短排查时间，支持预测性维护和质量决策，同时为 2025 年随 Viaduct 一并收购的技术开辟商业化路径。

title: China tire forum links virtual sensing, new materials, and flexible automation
companies: CRIA forum participants; ZC Rubber; DoubleStar; Chinese universities and suppliers
what_happened: CRIA's organizer recap of its June 25 technology forum described software-only virtual tire sensing, data-mechanism hybrid estimation, low-hysteresis carbon black, liquid butyl rubber, partitioned curing, and flexible belt automation. China's tire-development stack is converging across materials, simulation, sensing, curing, and factory automation instead of optimizing each layer separately. The combined approach can shorten development cycles and connect tire performance with manufacturing control, although most disclosed results remain presenter claims.
title_zh: 中国轮胎技术论坛把虚拟传感、新材料与柔性自动化串联起来
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会作为主办方发布的回顾介绍了其 6 月 25 日技术论坛的内容，包括纯软件虚拟轮胎传感、数据与机理混合估计、低生热炭黑、液体丁基橡胶、分区硫化以及柔性带束自动化。中国的轮胎开发体系正在材料、仿真、传感、硫化和工厂自动化之间形成整体协同，而不是单独优化每一层。这种组合方式可以缩短开发周期，并把轮胎性能与制造控制联系起来，不过多数公布的结果仍属演讲者主张。

title: Aeolus and Qingdao University of Science and Technology establish a tire-materials research partnership
companies: Aeolus Tyre; Qingdao University of Science and Technology; China National Tire & Rubber
what_happened: Qingdao University of Science and Technology reported a July 3 strategic cooperation signing with Aeolus and China National Tire & Rubber covering university-industry research and transfer of tire-material and engineering results. Chinese tire makers are formalizing university links to move material research into industrial development programs. The partnership can accelerate applied work and talent transfer, but value will depend on named projects, intellectual-property terms, and production adoption.

sources.publisher: Qingdao University of Science and Technology
sources.link_label: Qingdao University of Science and Technology

title_zh: 风神轮胎与青岛科技大学建立轮胎材料研究合作
what_happened_zh: 青岛科技大学报道称，该校于 7 月 3 日与风神轮胎及 China National Tire & Rubber 签署战略合作，内容涵盖产学研合作以及轮胎材料和工程成果的转化。中国轮胎制造商正在把校企联系制度化，以把材料研究推进到产业化开发项目。该合作有助于加快应用研究和人才流动，但其价值将取决于具体立项、知识产权条款和生产端的采用情况。

title: India recommends five-year duties on a tire-antioxidant feedstock from China
companies: India Directorate General of Trade Remedies; Chinese PX-13 exporters
what_happened: India's trade-remedy authority issued a final affirmative recommendation on PX-13 imports from China, the EU, South Korea, and Thailand, with proposed Chinese duties of USD 511 to USD 930 per tonne and named Sennics entities at the lower rate. Trade remedies for tire chemicals are becoming producer-specific, increasing the value of localized supply and traceable exporter economics. If implemented, the measure would change landed cost and sourcing choices for a 6PPD-type tire antidegradant in India.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association; India DGTR
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association; India DGTR

title_zh: 印度建议对来自中国的一种轮胎防老剂原料征收为期五年的税
what_happened_zh: 印度贸易救济主管部门就自中国、EU、韩国和泰国进口的 PX-13 作出最终肯定性建议，拟对中国产品征收每吨 USD 511 至 USD 930 的税，其中具名的 Sennics 实体适用较低税率。针对轮胎化学品的贸易救济正变得按生产商区分，这提高了本地化供应和可追溯出口商经济性的价值。若最终实施，该措施将改变印度 6PPD 类轮胎防老剂的到岸成本和采购选择。

title: Australia's mining-tire rules leave almost all OTR casings outside recycling loops
what_happened: ATRA published a commissioned review of waste-mining-tire regulations and licensing in Western Australia, New South Wales and Queensland. It says current settings still permit disposal pathways that leave only about 2% of off-the-road mining tires recovered, despite installed domestic recycling capacity. End-of-life OTR tires are emerging as a high-quality circular feedstock, but regulation and disposal economics—not processing technology alone—are determining whether their rubber and steel return to tire and materials supply chains. Mine tires can weigh roughly 3-7 tonnes, so reforming on-site burial and recovery rules could unlock concentrated natural-rubber and steel feedstock for higher-value recycling, including tire-to-tire uses.
title_zh: 澳大利亚矿用轮胎监管使几乎所有工程机械轮胎胎体留在回收循环之外
what_happened_zh: ATRA 发布了一份受托完成的评估，内容涉及西澳大利亚州、新南威尔士州和昆士兰州的废旧矿用轮胎法规与许可制度。该报告称，现行制度仍允许某些处置途径，导致只有约 2% 的非公路矿用轮胎得到回收，尽管国内已建成回收处理能力。报废工程机械轮胎正成为一种高品质的循环原料，但决定其橡胶和钢材能否回到轮胎与材料供应链的，是监管和处置经济性，而不只是处理技术本身。矿用轮胎单条重量约为 3-7 tonnes，因此改革现场填埋与回收规则有望释放集中的天然橡胶和钢材原料，用于更高价值的回收，包括轮胎到轮胎的用途。

title: Michelin completes Tex-Tech acquisition to deepen coated-textile and polymer-composite reach
what_happened: Michelin said it completed the acquisition of Tex-Tech after receiving required approvals. Tex-Tech designs and manufactures specialized textiles and coated fabrics, employs about 300 people, operates five U.S. plants and one U.K. plant, and reported 2025 revenue of USD 128 million. Large tire groups are using adjacent polymer-composite acquisitions to diversify materials capabilities and end markets beyond tires.
