Tex-Tech adds manufacturing sites and coated-fabric know-how to Michelin's Polymer Composite Solutions business and marks its third PCS acquisition in a year after Cooley and Flexitallic.
title_zh: 米其林完成对 Tex-Tech 的收购，深化涂层织物与高分子复合材料布局
what_happened_zh: 米其林表示，在取得所需批准后已完成对 Tex-Tech 的收购。Tex-Tech 设计并生产特种织物和涂层面料，拥有约 300 名员工，运营五家美国工厂和一家英国工厂，2025 年收入为 USD 128 million。大型轮胎集团正通过相邻的高分子复合材料并购，在轮胎之外拓展材料能力和终端市场。Tex-Tech 为米其林的 Polymer Composite Solutions 业务增加了生产基地和涂层面料技术积累，也是其在一年内继 Cooley 和 Flexitallic 之后的第三笔 PCS 收购。

title: Zhongtian signs an Egypt project for tire steel cord and bead wire
what_happened: A China Rubber report said Zhongtian signed a project in Egypt's Ain Sokhna TEDA zone for planned annual output of 120,000 tonnes of steel cord and 50,000 tonnes of bead wire, with stated investment of USD 300 million. Chinese tire-material suppliers are following tire makers overseas and building reinforcement capacity closer to Middle East, European, and African customers. If the project advances beyond signing, it could localize two critical reinforcement inputs and reshape regional supply lead times.
title_zh: 中天钢铁签约埃及轮胎钢丝帘线与胎圈钢丝项目
what_happened_zh: 《中国橡胶》的一篇报道称，中天钢铁在埃及 Ain Sokhna TEDA 园区签约一个项目，规划年产 120,000 tonnes 钢丝帘线和 50,000 tonnes 胎圈钢丝，公布投资额为 USD 300 million。中国轮胎材料供应商正跟随轮胎制造商走向海外，在更靠近中东、欧洲和非洲客户的区域建设骨架材料产能。若该项目在签约之后继续推进，有望实现两种关键骨架材料的本地化，并重塑区域供应的交付周期。

title: Orion starts tire-pyrolysis-oil carbon black production in Qingdao
what_happened: Orion said its ISCC PLUS-certified Qingdao plant began producing ECORAX Circular 200, 210, and 215 carbon blacks using tire-pyrolysis oil, with grades positioned for tires and other rubber goods. China is becoming a production node for mass-balance circular tire carbon black rather than only a consumer of imported sustainable grades. Local production can reduce supply-chain distance for Chinese tire plants and provide a route for tire-pyrolysis oil back into new compounds.

sources.publisher: CRIA Carbon Black Branch citing Orion
sources.link_label: CRIA Carbon Black Branch citing Orion

title_zh: Orion 在青岛启动以轮胎热解油为原料的炭黑生产
what_happened_zh: Orion 表示，其通过 ISCC PLUS 认证的青岛工厂已开始以轮胎热解油生产 ECORAX Circular 200、210 和 215 炭黑，这些牌号面向轮胎及其他橡胶制品。中国正在成为质量平衡法循环轮胎炭黑的生产节点，而不再只是进口可持续牌号的消费地。本地生产可以缩短中国轮胎工厂的供应链距离，并为轮胎热解油回到新胶料提供一条路径。

title: Tolins subsidiary agrees to buy reclaimed-rubber machinery for backward integration
what_happened: Tolins Tyres disclosed that its wholly owned Terra Rubber subsidiary signed a July 1 agreement to acquire identified plant and machinery from Cochin Reclaim and Rubbers for capacity expansion and backward integration. Equipment is to be removed within 60 days, with title passing after payment and removal. Smaller tire and tread-rubber producers are using second-hand or transferred assets to add upstream reclaimed-rubber capability without buying an entire company. The deal could increase Terra Rubber's supply control and recycling capacity, although its economic significance cannot be assessed without purchase value, equipment list, or incremental output.
title_zh: Tolins 子公司签约购买再生橡胶设备以实现向上游一体化
what_happened_zh: Tolins Tyres 披露，其全资子公司 Terra Rubber 于 7 月 1 日签署协议，从 Cochin Reclaim and Rubbers 购买已确定的厂房和设备，用于产能扩张和向上游一体化。设备须在 60 天内搬离，所有权在付款并完成搬离后转移。规模较小的轮胎和胎面胶生产商正利用二手或转让资产来增加上游再生橡胶能力，而无需收购整家公司。该交易可以提升 Terra Rubber 的供应掌控力和回收处理能力，但在没有购买金额、设备清单或新增产量的情况下，其经济意义无法评估。

title: Continental signs ContiTech sale and sets a path to become a pure-play tire maker
what_happened: Continental announced a signed agreement to sell ContiTech to a Lone Star affiliate for EUR 4.0 billion plus up to EUR 250 million in performance-based components. It expects about EUR 3.1 billion of cash after transferred liabilities; all ContiTech operations worldwide would transfer once approvals are obtained. Tire-sector conglomerates are separating industrial rubber and thermoplastic operations from tire manufacturing to sharpen capital allocation and strategic focus. The transaction would create an independent 22,000-employee materials company with about EUR 4.4 billion in 2025 sales and turn Continental into a pure-play tire manufacturer, changing ownership across a major industrial-rubber supply network.
title_zh: 大陆集团签署 ContiTech 出售协议，为转型纯轮胎业务铺路
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团宣布已签署协议，将 ContiTech 以 EUR 4.0 billion 的价格出售给 Lone Star 旗下关联公司，另有最高 EUR 250 million 的业绩对价。公司预计在转移相关负债后获得约 EUR 3.1 billion 现金；一旦取得各项批准，ContiTech 全球业务将全部转移。轮胎行业的多元化集团正把工业橡胶和热塑性业务与轮胎制造分离，以提高资本配置效率和战略聚焦度。该交易将形成一家拥有 22,000 名员工、2025 年销售额约 EUR 4.4 billion 的独立材料公司，并使大陆集团成为纯轮胎制造商，同时改变一个重要工业橡胶供应网络的所有权归属。

title: Continental plans its first owned wind farm for direct tire-plant power
what_happened: Continental approved three wind turbines about eight kilometers from its Korbach tire plant. With existing solar, the project is intended to cover around two-thirds of plant electricity demand and generate about 55 GWh annually; permits are obtained, construction is scheduled in 2026, and commissioning is planned roughly 18 months later. Tire plants are moving from renewable certificates and purchased electricity toward owned, site-linked generation as both a decarbonization and energy-cost hedge. The mid-double-digit-million-euro project offers a measurable test of whether direct generation can lower exposure to volatile power markets and serve as a repeatable model for energy-intensive mixing and component production.
title_zh: 大陆集团规划首座自有风电场，为轮胎工厂直接供电
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团批准在距其 Korbach 轮胎工厂约八公里处建设三台风力发电机。结合现有光伏，该项目拟覆盖工厂约三分之二的用电需求，年发电量约 55 GWh；许可已获得，施工计划在 2026 年进行，投运预计在约 18 个月之后。轮胎工厂正从可再生能源证书和外购电力转向自有、与厂址直连的发电，既作为脱碳手段，也作为能源成本对冲。这一投资额为中双位数百万欧元的项目，提供了一次可衡量的检验：直接发电能否降低对波动电力市场的敞口，并成为能耗密集的密炼和部件生产可复制的模式。

title: Guizhou Tyre moves the third stage of its OTR project into trial production
what_happened: Guizhou Tyre said the third-stage supporting environmental facilities for its 380,000-unit annual all-steel OTR radial tire intelligent-manufacturing project were completed on July 2, with trial production and testing scheduled from July 4 to October 4. Chinese OTR expansions are advancing through staged environmental acceptance and trial runs rather than a single plant-completion milestone. The step brings another Chinese high-spec OTR program closer to usable capacity and creates a concrete commissioning window for equipment, process, and emissions performance.

sources.title: Phase-three OTR radial tire project environmental facilities enter trial production

title_zh: 贵州轮胎工程机械轮胎项目三期进入试生产
what_happened_zh: 贵州轮胎称，其年产 380,000 条全钢工程机械子午线轮胎智能制造项目的三期配套环保设施已于 7 月 2 日建成，试生产与测试安排在 7 月 4 日至 10 月 4 日。中国工程机械轮胎扩产正通过分阶段环保验收和试运行推进，而不是以单一的工厂建成节点推进。这一步让又一个中国高规格工程机械轮胎项目更接近可用产能，并为设备、工艺和排放表现划定了明确的调试窗口。

title: Apollo Tyres closes tire production at its Enschede plant
what_happened: Apollo Tyres filed that its Netherlands subsidiary discontinued tire production and production-related operations at Enschede at the close of business on June 30 after obtaining works-council and supervisory-board approvals. European tire manufacturing footprints continue to be consolidated as producers shift output away from higher-cost or less-specialized sites. The filing converts a previously proposed closure into a completed manufacturing event and removes Enschede production from Apollo's European network, with implications for sourcing, labor, and capacity allocation.
title_zh: Apollo Tyres 关闭其 Enschede 工厂的轮胎生产
what_happened_zh: Apollo Tyres 提交公告称，在取得职工委员会和监事会批准后，其荷兰子公司已于 6 月 30 日营业结束时停止 Enschede 的轮胎生产及生产相关业务。欧洲轮胎制造布局仍在继续整合，生产商正把产量从成本较高或专业化程度较低的基地转移出去。该公告把此前提出的关闭方案转为已完成的制造事件，并将 Enschede 产能从 Apollo 的欧洲网络中移除，对采购、用工和产能分配都有影响。

title: Triangle takes a five-pattern EV-tire range to Brazil's local channel
what_happened: Triangle presented five EV-oriented passenger-tire patterns at two Brazilian industry events and said the range was localized for Latin American roads and use preferences. Chinese tire makers are using region-specific EV assortments to build distributor pull in Latin America. Brazil provides a practical test of whether EV positioning can translate into dealer education, replacement coverage, and stronger Chinese-brand acceptance.
title_zh: 三角轮胎将五款电动车轮胎产品带入巴西本地渠道
what_happened_zh: 三角轮胎在巴西两场行业活动上展示了五款面向电动车的乘用车轮胎花纹，并称该系列针对拉丁美洲路况和使用偏好做了本地化。中国轮胎制造商正通过区域专属的电动车产品组合，在拉丁美洲建立经销商拉动。巴西将实际检验电动车定位能否转化为经销商培训、替换市场覆盖以及更强的中国品牌接受度。

title: Michelin adds conversational AI to fleet operations and tire-maintenance queries
what_happened: Michelin integrated an AI assistant into MyConnectedFleet so managers can query live fleet data and generate operational answers, including which trucks require tire maintenance, vehicle downtime, fuel use, and driver-efficiency reports. Michelin says the tool operates in a closed environment and is available in ten European and North American countries. Fleet service is moving from dashboards and manual reports toward natural-language decision support tied to maintenance and operating data. The assistant can make tire needs more visible within broader fleet workflows, potentially accelerating service decisions across a platform Michelin says covers 660,000 vehicles and 70,000 customers.
title_zh: 米其林为车队运营与轮胎维护查询引入对话式 AI
what_happened_zh: 米其林在 MyConnectedFleet 中集成了 AI 助手，使管理者可以查询实时车队数据并生成运营答案，包括哪些卡车需要轮胎维护，以及车辆停机、燃油消耗和司机效率报告。米其林称该工具在封闭环境中运行，目前在十个欧洲和北美国家可用。车队服务正从看板和人工报表转向与维护及运营数据相连的自然语言决策支持。该助手可以让轮胎需求在更广泛的车队工作流中更为可见，从而可能加快服务决策；米其林称该平台覆盖 660,000 辆车和 70,000 家客户。

title: Overseas factories and EV OE accounts emerge as Chinese tire makers' profit levers
what_happened: An industry-association analysis of 16 listed or quoted Chinese tire makers found nine overseas production bases and described overseas plants as disproportionately important to profit. It also documented a broader push toward higher-value original-equipment and new-energy-vehicle accounts. Chinese tire globalization is moving from export volume toward overseas manufacturing economics and higher-end OE mix. The analysis suggests that location, tariff exposure, utilization, and vehicle-platform access are becoming as important as headline domestic capacity in explaining earnings quality.

sources.title: Overseas factories and high-end OE business reshape Chinese tire-company profitability

title_zh: 海外工厂与电动车原配客户成为中国轮胎企业的利润杠杆
what_happened_zh: 一项行业协会分析覆盖 16 家上市或挂牌的中国轮胎制造商，发现其拥有九个海外生产基地，并把海外工厂描述为对利润的贡献不成比例地重要。该分析还记录了向更高价值的原配和新能源汽车客户推进的更广泛趋势。中国轮胎的全球化正从出口量转向海外制造经济性和更高端的原配结构。该分析提示，在解释盈利质量时，选址、关税敞口、产能利用率和车型平台准入正变得与国内名义产能同样重要。

title: China's tire sector grows sales value while profit pressure persists through May
companies: China Rubber Industry Association member companies
what_happened: CRIA published January-May operating indicators for its reporting member companies, showing the sector's output, sales, export, and profit direction at the latest available monthly cutoff. China tire demand and production must be read through value, export exposure, and profitability together rather than through unit or revenue growth alone. The association series provides a recurring early indicator for utilization and pricing pressure, while its member sample is not the entire Chinese industry.
title_zh: 截至 5 月，中国轮胎行业销售额保持增长，利润压力依然存在
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会发布了其报送会员企业 1 月至 5 月的运行指标，展示了行业在最新可得月度节点上的产量、销售、出口和利润方向。中国轮胎需求与产量需要结合产值、出口敞口和盈利能力一并解读，而不能只看数量或收入增长。该协会的系列数据为产能利用率和价格压力提供了一个持续的先行指标，但其会员样本并不等于中国全行业。

title: Goodyear locks in ELMS supply through 2029 as racing tires carry up to 66% sustainable materials
companies: Goodyear; Automobile Club de l'Ouest; European Le Mans Series
what_happened: Goodyear and ACO extended Goodyear's exclusive tire-supply role for the ELMS LMP2 and LMGT3 categories through 2029. Goodyear said its current LMGT3 specification contains up to 66% sustainable materials and that its latest LMP2 slick completed five consecutive Le Mans stints, close to 700 km, while maintaining competitive pace and degradation control. Long-term control-tire contracts are combining customer lock-in, cost control, and a track-development pathway for higher renewable and recycled content. The deal gives Goodyear a multi-year customer and test platform across two strategically important endurance categories while linking sustainable-material claims to demanding use conditions.

sources.publisher: Goodyear EMEA Newsroom; European Le Mans Series
sources.link_label: Goodyear EMEA Newsroom; European Le Mans Series

title_zh: 固特异锁定 ELMS 供胎至 2029 年，赛车轮胎可持续材料占比最高达 66%
what_happened_zh: 固特异与 ACO 将固特异在 ELMS LMP2 和 LMGT3 级别的独家供胎角色延长至 2029 年。固特异称，其当前 LMGT3 规格的可持续材料占比最高达 66%，其最新 LMP2 光头胎在保持有竞争力的速度和磨耗控制的同时，完成了连续五个勒芒赛段、接近 700 km 的行驶。长期控制轮胎合同正把客户锁定、成本控制与提升可再生和再生材料占比的赛道开发路径结合起来。该协议为固特异在两个具有战略意义的耐力赛级别中提供了多年期客户与测试平台，同时把可持续材料主张与严苛使用条件联系起来。

title: Michelin flags a split tire market as premium replacement demand offsets OE weakness
what_happened: In its H1 pre-close script, Michelin described global passenger and light-truck OE demand as down about 3% through May while replacement was roughly flat, with China replacement strong and U.S. demand declining. It said its own second-quarter tire volumes were broadly stable and premium Michelin replacement sales offset pressure on lower tiers from cheap imports. Global tire demand is fragmenting by region, channel, and price tier rather than moving in one cycle, increasing the value of premium mix and local inventory visibility. The management signal helps distributors and suppliers distinguish weak OE and North American conditions from stronger Chinese replacement and mining demand, while highlighting ongoing imported-tier pressure in Europe and the United States.
title_zh: 米其林指出轮胎市场分化，高端替换需求抵消原配疲弱
what_happened_zh: 米其林在其 H1 业绩发布前的电话会议文稿中表示，截至 5 月，全球乘用车及轻卡原配需求下降约 3%，替换市场大体持平，其中中国替换需求强劲、美国需求走弱。公司称自身第二季度轮胎销量总体稳定，米其林高端替换市场销售抵消了低端层级来自低价进口产品的压力。全球轮胎需求正按地区、渠道和价格层级分化，而不是沿单一周期运行，这提升了高端产品结构和本地库存可见性的价值。管理层的这一信号有助于分销商和供应商把疲弱的原配与北美状况，同更强的中国替换和矿业需求区分开来，同时也凸显了欧洲和美国市场持续存在的进口层级压力。

title: Bridgestone moves AirFree from trials into a regular autonomous transit service
what_happened: Bridgestone and Higashiomi City announced Japan's first practical deployment of the airless AirFree tire in the city's regularly operated low-speed autonomous mobility service, beginning July 8 after earlier limited municipal trials. Airless tires are crossing from demonstrations into a constrained commercial-service environment where uptime and reduced pressure maintenance have clear operating value. The deployment is small and low speed, but it creates real service data and a concrete adoption pathway for autonomous community transport before broader road applications.
title_zh: 普利司通把 AirFree 从试验推进为常规自动驾驶接驳服务
what_happened_zh: 普利司通与 Higashiomi City 宣布，无气轮胎 AirFree 将在该市常规运营的低速自动驾驶出行服务中实现日本首次实用化部署，自 7 月 8 日起开始，此前仅进行过有限的市政试验。无气轮胎正从示范走向受限的商业服务环境，在那里运行时间和减少气压维护具有明确的运营价值。此次部署规模小、速度低，但能产生真实的服务数据，并在更广泛的道路应用之前为自动驾驶社区交通提供一条具体的采用路径。

title: EU safety rules make worn-tire performance a vehicle-market requirement
companies: European Union vehicle and tire manufacturers
what_happened: The European Commission confirmed that the next phase of the General Safety Regulation took effect on July 7 for newly registered passenger cars and vans, including new tests for worn tires. Regulation is shifting tire validation from new-tire performance toward whole-life wet-safety behavior, forcing tread, compound and test-development choices to account for progressive wear. A lifecycle safety requirement changes the product-development gate for the EU market and raises the value of worn-state testing, durable wet grip and traceable compliance evidence.
title_zh: EU 安全法规把磨损轮胎性能变为整车市场的准入要求
what_happened_zh: 欧盟委员会确认，General Safety Regulation 的下一阶段已于 7 月 7 日对新注册的乘用车和厢式车生效，其中包括针对磨损轮胎的新测试。法规正把轮胎验证从新胎性能转向全寿命湿地安全表现，迫使胎面、配方和测试开发的选择把渐进磨耗考虑在内。全生命周期安全要求改变了面向 EU 市场的产品开发关口，并提升了磨损状态测试、持久湿地抓地力和可追溯合规证据的价值。

title: ZC Rubber and HIT win a state award for an integrated tire technology stack
what_happened: The High-performance Tire Key Technology and Its Green Intelligent Manufacturing project received second prize in China's State Science and Technology Progress Awards. HIT disclosed a multi-information-fusion tire design method, digital analysis and optimization software, SiO2/C and CNT/C micro-nano composites, green manufacturing processes and core equipment, including aviation-tire application. This is a rare full-stack advance spanning materials, digital design, software, equipment and production rather than treating product and factory R&D separately.

title_zh: 中策橡胶与哈尔滨工业大学凭一体化轮胎技术体系获国家科技进步奖
what_happened_zh: “高性能轮胎关键技术及其绿色智能制造”项目获得中国国家科学技术进步奖二等奖。哈尔滨工业大学披露了多信息融合轮胎设计方法、数字化分析与优化软件、SiO2/C 与 CNT/C 微纳复合材料、绿色制造工艺及核心装备，并包括航空轮胎应用。这是一项罕见的全栈式进展，横跨材料、数字化设计、软件、装备与生产，而不是把产品研发与工厂研发分开对待。

title: Toyo patent targets lower heat generation from reclaimed rubber without sacrificing fracture performance
what_happened: A Toyo Tire patent application published July 9 describes tire compounds containing 1-15 mass percent reclaimed rubber with controlled natural-rubber content, gel fraction and molecular-weight distribution. The application targets lower heat generation while limiting deterioration in fracture properties, particularly for heavy-duty base treads. The formulation uses mechanically desulfurized truck-and-bus tread rubber and defines measurable polymer, tensile, elongation, ash and carbon-black ranges to manage the performance variability that constrains reclaimed-rubber use. A workable balance between heat build-up and durability would make reclaimed rubber more credible in performance-sensitive tire components, but the publication establishes an intellectual-property claim rather than commercial readiness.
title_zh: 东洋专利力求降低再生橡胶生热而不牺牲断裂性能
what_happened_zh: 东洋轮胎于 7 月 9 日公布的一件专利申请描述了含 1-15 质量百分比再生橡胶的轮胎胶料，并对天然橡胶含量、凝胶率和分子量分布加以控制。该申请旨在降低生热，同时限制断裂性能的下降，尤其面向重载基部胶。该配方使用经机械脱硫的卡客车胎面胶，并界定了可测量的聚合物、拉伸、伸长、灰分和炭黑范围，以管理制约再生橡胶使用的性能波动。生热与耐久性之间可行的平衡，会让再生橡胶在对性能敏感的轮胎部件中更具可信度，但该公布建立的是知识产权主张，而非商业化就绪。

title: Triangle Tire publishes RFID-barcode binding and rejection patent application
what_happened: Patent application CN122347166A was published for automatically linking an RFID tag embedded in a green tire with its production barcode after curing. Panoramic barcode scanning and RFID reading send both identities to MES; rule validation creates a one-to-one record and failed matches trigger automatic line rejection. The method closes a traceability gap between the physical tire, embedded digital identity and manufacturing record, supporting automated quality control and future product passports.

sources.title: 轮胎RFID芯片和条码自动绑定方法
sources.link_label: Spanish Patent and Trademark Office technology alert

title_zh: 三角轮胎公布 RFID 与条码绑定及剔除专利申请
what_happened_zh: 专利申请 CN122347166A 已公布，用于在硫化后自动把嵌入生胎的 RFID 标签与其生产条码关联起来。全景条码扫描与 RFID 读取把两种标识同时送入 MES；规则校验生成一对一记录，匹配失败则触发自动下线剔除。该方法弥合了实体轮胎、嵌入式数字身份与制造记录之间的追溯缺口，支持自动化质量控制和未来的产品护照。

title: China tire forum points to bio-materials, electric curing, and AI-assisted R&D
companies: CRIA forum participants including Linglong, Aeolus, Double Coin, and suppliers
what_happened: CRIA published technical disclosures from its Global Tire Technology Forum covering epoxidized natural rubber, itaconic-acid bio-rubber, renewable fillers, low-hysteresis carbon black, AI material simulation, laser wear scanning, and electric curing. Sustainability work is moving from isolated substitutions toward coordinated changes in compounds, curing, testing, and digital formulation. A portfolio view shows which Chinese technologies may combine into lower-carbon tires, while individual performance claims still require independent validation.
title_zh: 中国轮胎论坛指向生物基材料、电加热硫化与 AI 辅助研发
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会发布了其全球轮胎技术论坛的技术披露内容，涵盖环氧化天然橡胶、衣康酸生物基橡胶、可再生填料、低滞后炭黑、AI 材料模拟、激光磨耗扫描和电加热硫化。可持续工作正从孤立的材料替代转向胶料、硫化、测试和数字化配方的协同改变。组合视角显示出哪些中国技术可能叠加形成更低碳的轮胎，而个别性能主张仍需独立验证。

title: Maxxis uses independent worn-tire testing to support premium positioning in China
what_happened: Maxxis China said a 235/35 R19 Victra Sport 6 specification received TÜV SÜD's Premium Tire Mark after testing that included dry, wet, worn wet-grip, rolling-resistance, high-speed, and noise criteria. Premium tire claims in China are expanding from new-tire performance toward independently assessed lifecycle performance. Worn-state validation can strengthen dealer confidence and export credibility as regulators and buyers pay more attention to performance throughout tread life.
title_zh: Maxxis 以独立的磨损轮胎测试支撑其在中国的高端定位
what_happened_zh: Maxxis 中国表示，一款 235/35 R19 Victra Sport 6 规格在经过干地、湿地、磨损湿地抓地力、滚动阻力、高速和噪声等项目测试后，获得 TÜV SÜD 的 Premium Tire Mark。中国市场的高端轮胎主张正从新胎性能扩展到经独立评估的全生命周期性能。随着监管机构和买方更加关注整个胎面寿命期内的性能，磨损状态验证有助于增强经销商信心和出口可信度。

title: Linglong's midyear R&D review centers its move from scale to higher-value technology
what_happened: Linglong's July 9 research review summarized first-half technical programs and framed the company's development path as a shift from scale catch-up toward higher-end products and technology-led competition. Chinese tire makers are making R&D portfolio governance and commercialization discipline more explicit as they target premium segments. The meeting signals management priority, but the commercial test will be named platforms, validated performance, patents, and revenue from the reviewed programs.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎年中研发评审聚焦从规模转向更高价值技术
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎 7 月 9 日的研发评审总结了上半年的技术项目，并把公司的发展路径界定为从规模追赶转向高端产品和技术主导的竞争。中国轮胎企业在瞄准高端细分市场时，正把研发组合治理和商业化纪律表述得更为明确。该会议体现了管理层的优先方向，但商业层面的检验将是具名平台、经验证的性能、专利，以及所评审项目带来的收入。

title: Michelin and Axens prepare global licensing of bio-based 5-HMF chemistry
what_happened: Michelin ResiCare and Axens entered exclusive discussions to industrialize and commercialize Michelin-IFPEN technology for producing bio-based 5-HMF. Michelin's first French unit is designed for approximately 3,000 tonnes per year and is scheduled to start in early 2027. A tire maker is moving a renewable platform molecule from joint R&D into a licensable industrial process that can replace some fossil-derived inputs, including formaldehyde, in resins and polymers. The partnership connects Michelin's materials research with Axens' engineering and licensing network, potentially extending tire-sector bio-material innovation into a broader global chemicals supply chain.
title_zh: 米其林与 Axens 筹备生物基 5-HMF 化学技术的全球许可
what_happened_zh: 米其林 ResiCare 与 Axens 就 Michelin-IFPEN 用于生产生物基 5-HMF 的技术进入独家谈判，以推进其工业化和商业化。米其林在法国的首座装置设计产能约为每年 3,000 tonnes，计划于 2027 年初投产。轮胎制造商正把一种可再生平台分子从联合研发推进为可许可的工业工艺，用以替代树脂和聚合物中的部分化石基原料，其中包括甲醛。该合作把米其林的材料研究与 Axens 的工程和许可网络相连接，有可能把轮胎行业的生物材料创新延伸到更广泛的全球化学品供应链。

title: Bekaert and CITIC Special Steel launch closed-loop tire-steel project
what_happened: The companies signed a technical-cooperation agreement to test whether steel recovered from end-of-life tires can be remade into wire rod and then new tire-reinforcement products. The early proof of concept combines joint studies, industrial trials and material evaluation for high shares of closed-loop steel without sacrificing required quality or performance. Successful tire-to-tire steel recovery would move recycling beyond downcycling, reduce virgin-steel demand and give tire makers a traceable circular reinforcement input.

sources.title: Bekaert and CITIC Special Steel sign strategic cooperation agreement to explore tire-to-tire circularity
Bekaert, Chinese group launch steel cord recycling project

title_zh: Bekaert 与中信特钢启动闭环轮胎钢项目
what_happened_zh: 双方签署技术合作协议，检验从报废轮胎中回收的钢材能否重新制成盘条、并进一步制成新的轮胎增强材料产品。这一早期概念验证结合了联合研究、工业试验和材料评估，目标是在不牺牲所需质量或性能的前提下实现高比例闭环钢材。轮胎到轮胎的钢材回收若能成功，将使回收超越降级利用，减少原生钢材需求，并为轮胎制造商提供可追溯的循环增强材料原料。

title: Chinese PA66 reinforcement reaches industrial-scale aviation-tire application
companies: Shuguang Rubber Industry Research & Design Institute
what_happened: A project on continuous-polymerization melt direct-spinning of high-performance PA66 industrial filament and its use in premium tires received a national science and technology progress second prize. The team linked industrial-scale high-viscosity PA66 direct spinning to cord fabric adapted for aircraft tires, reporting higher load and impact performance with lower tire weight. Localized, safety-critical aviation-tire reinforcement strengthens China's materials supply chain and demonstrates transfer from polymer process engineering into a validated tire application.

title_zh: 中国 PA66 增强材料实现工业规模的航空轮胎应用
what_happened_zh: 一项关于高性能 PA66 工业丝连续聚合熔体直纺及其在高端轮胎中应用的项目获得国家科学技术进步二等奖。该团队把工业规模的高黏度 PA66 直纺与适配飞机轮胎的帘子布相衔接，报告称在轮胎重量更低的同时获得更高的承载和冲击性能。本土化的安全关键型航空轮胎增强材料强化了中国的材料供应链，也展示了从聚合物工艺工程向经验证的轮胎应用的转化。

title: Chinese tire export orders weaken under trade and freight pressure
what_happened: Longzhong's surveyed producers reported weaker export-order direction for both semi-steel and all-steel tires amid trade barriers, freight costs, and soft domestic demand. Export friction is translating into production restraint and attempts to redirect Chinese tire sales toward alternative markets. The direction affects utilization and near-term demand for rubber, carbon black, chemicals, reinforcement, and logistics, even though the visible survey lacks a complete sampling method.
title_zh: 贸易与运费压力下中国轮胎出口订单转弱
what_happened_zh: 隆众调研的生产企业反映，在贸易壁垒、运费成本和国内需求偏弱的背景下，半钢和全钢轮胎的出口订单方向均转弱。出口摩擦正转化为生产端的克制，以及把中国轮胎销售转向替代市场的尝试。尽管可见的调研缺少完整的抽样方法，这一方向仍会影响产能利用率，以及橡胶、炭黑、化学品、增强材料和物流的近期需求。

title: Enviro draws fresh equity financing while reorganizing its tire-recycling business
what_happened: Enviro approved a directed issue of 20 million shares at SEK0.1785 each and 1.785 million warrants under an existing equity investment agreement, raising SEK3.57 million before transaction costs to support its ongoing reorganization. Early-stage tire-pyrolysis and recovered-material businesses are relying on flexible, dilutive financing while they bridge technology development, industrial ramp-up and cash needs. The small drawdown is a useful counterweight to circularity announcements: access to capital and shareholder dilution can be as decisive as process performance in determining whether recovered-carbon and oil platforms scale.
title_zh: Enviro 在重组轮胎回收业务的同时获得新一轮股权融资
what_happened_zh: Enviro 批准在现有股权投资协议下定向发行 20 million 股股份、每股 SEK0.1785，并发行 1.785 million 份认股权证，在扣除交易费用前筹资 SEK3.57 million，用于支持其正在进行的重组。处于早期阶段的轮胎热解和回收材料业务，在跨越技术开发、工业化爬坡与资金需求时，仍依赖灵活且具有摊薄效应的融资。这笔小额提款是对各类循环经济公告的有益对照：在决定再生炭黑和回收油平台能否规模化方面，资本可获得性和股东摊薄可能与工艺性能同样关键。

title: Wanli and Berjaya plan a $320 million Malaysia tire hub
what_happened: The partners signed a joint-venture agreement for a 67.9-acre plant in Bukit Tagar, Selangor, with planned annual capacity of 5 million PCR tires and 1.2 million TBR tires and more than 1,000 jobs. Wanli is moving from a single overseas site toward a multi-hub ASEAN manufacturing network built around high-performance, eco-friendly and NEV tires. The proposed 6.2-million-tire export hub is material new capacity and shows how Chinese producers are localizing production for market access and supply-chain resilience.

sources.title: WANLI TIRE AND BERJAYA PROPERTY Sign $320 MILLION JOINT VENTURE AGREEMENT TO ESTABLISH HIGH-PERFORMANCE TIRE MANUFACTURING HUB IN MALAYSIA
Berjaya Property teams up with China's Wanli Tire for RM1.3b plant in Selangor

title_zh: 万力与 Berjaya 规划 $320 million 马来西亚轮胎基地
what_happened_zh: 双方签署合资协议，将在 Selangor 的 Bukit Tagar 建设一座 67.9-acre 的工厂，规划年产能为 5 million 条乘用车子午线（PCR）轮胎和 1.2 million 条全钢子午线（TBR）轮胎，并提供 1,000 多个岗位。万力正从单一海外基地转向以高性能、环保和新能源（NEV）轮胎为核心的多基地东盟制造网络。拟建的 6.2-million-tire 出口基地构成实质性新增产能，并显示中国生产商如何为获得市场准入和供应链韧性而推进生产本地化。

title: EU duties reset the economics of Chinese PCR and light-truck tire exports
what_happened: The EU imposed definitive anti-dumping duties of 4.3% to 45.3% on China-origin passenger-car and light-lorry tires; the measures took effect on July 8 and a parallel anti-subsidy case remains open. Trade barriers are accelerating localized production, market diversification, higher-value products and lower dependence on price-led direct exports from China. China supplied almost 93 million covered tires worth more than EUR 2.5 billion in 2024, so the duties have immediate consequences for pricing, margins, channels and volume.

sources.title: Commission imposes anti-dumping duties on passenger-car and light-lorry tyres from China

title_zh: EU 关税重塑中国乘用车与轻型卡车轮胎出口的经济性
what_happened_zh: EU 对中国原产乘用车和轻型载货汽车轮胎征收 4.3% 至 45.3% 的最终反倾销税；措施自 7 月 8 日起生效，另一起反补贴案件仍在进行。贸易壁垒正在加快本地化生产、市场多元化和更高附加值产品，并降低对来自中国的价格导向型直接出口的依赖。2024 年中国供应了近 93 million 条受涉轮胎，价值超过 EUR 2.5 billion，因此这些关税对定价、利润率、渠道和销量产生即时影响。

title: Continental turns a roadshow into a multi-year European fleet channel
what_happened: Continental expanded its commercial-vehicle showtruck program through 2027 after stops in the Czech Republic and Denmark, with Norway, Finland and further European destinations planned. The mobile platform combines Generation 5 truck and trailer tires, ContiConnect digital monitoring, consultation and demonstrations in fleet customers' local markets. Bringing products, digital services and technical advice directly to fleets, dealers and logistics companies is a route-to-market model built around total cost of ownership and ongoing service rather than product display alone.
title_zh: 大陆集团把巡展转化为多年期欧洲车队渠道
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团在捷克和丹麦的站点之后，把其商用车展示卡车项目延长至 2027 年，并计划前往挪威、芬兰及更多欧洲目的地。该移动平台把 Generation 5 卡车与挂车轮胎、ContiConnect 数字监测、咨询和演示带到车队客户所在的本地市场。把产品、数字服务和技术建议直接带给车队、经销商和物流企业，是一种围绕总拥有成本和持续服务、而非单纯产品展示构建的市场进入模式。

title: ZC Rubber combines premium OE wins with data-enabled deep distribution
what_happened: ZC said first-half domestic PCR replacement sales exceeded 10.8 million units, up more than 15%, and cited exclusive OE nominations for the Maextro S800 and AITO M6 plus more than six planned second-half premium-model launches. Its channel plan combines regional service distributors, fast offline fulfillment, BI models and chips across core channel products while it moves into higher-value Chinese EV OE programs. The model links premiumization, digital product identity and local inventory execution; it could strengthen both dealer control and consumer service speed.

sources.title: 2026中策橡胶集团PCR年中会议圆满召开
sources.link_label: ZC Rubber official WeChat preserved by 10jqka

title_zh: 中策橡胶把高端原配突破与数据驱动的深度分销结合起来
what_happened_zh: 中策橡胶表示，上半年国内乘用车（PCR）替换市场销量超过 10.8 million 条，同比增长超过 15%，并提到获得 Maextro S800 和 AITO M6 的独家原配提名，另有六款以上计划在下半年推出的高端车型配套。其渠道方案在核心渠道产品上结合区域服务型经销商、快速的线下履约、BI 模型和芯片，同时向附加值更高的中国电动车原配项目推进。该模式把高端化、数字化产品身份与本地库存执行连接起来，有可能同时强化经销商管控与消费者服务速度。

title: Bartrums puts Michelin's four-life tire model into a 450-asset fleet contract
what_happened: Bartrums adopted a full-service contract with Michelin Connected Solutions across more than 450 trucks and trailers, using daily tire management, regrooving and Remix retreads; the operator reports an estimated 55.7 tonnes of CO2 savings in the first 11 months. The offer combines tire-as-a-service with casing management: a new tire is regrooved, retreaded at Michelin's Stoke Remix plant and potentially regrooved again, linking fleet service, circular material use and domestic retread manufacturing. The case shows how tire makers can create recurring service value beyond the initial sale while keeping casings in use longer; Michelin says each retread requires about 50 kg less raw material than a new truck tire.
title_zh: Bartrums 把米其林四段寿命轮胎模式用于 450 台资产的车队合同
what_happened_zh: Bartrums 为超过 450 辆卡车和挂车采用了与 Michelin Connected Solutions 的全服务合同，内容包括日常轮胎管理、刻槽翻新和 Remix 翻新胎；该运营商报告称，前 11 个月估计减少 55.7 tonnes 的 CO2 排放。该方案把轮胎即服务与胎体管理结合起来：新胎先经刻槽，再在米其林的 Stoke Remix 工厂翻新，并有可能再次刻槽，从而把车队服务、循环材料利用与本土翻新制造连接起来。该案例显示轮胎制造商如何在首次销售之外创造持续的服务价值，同时让胎体保持更长的使用周期；米其林称，每条翻新胎所需的原材料比一条新卡车轮胎约少 50 kg。

title: Falken wins Porsche Cayenne Electric factory fitment with an EV-specific UHP package
companies: Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Dunlop Tyre Europe, Falken and Porsche
what_happened: Dunlop Tyre Europe began supplying the Falken Azenis FK520 NG0 as original equipment for the Porsche Cayenne Electric. Porsche approved a staggered 20-inch package using 255/55 R20 tires at the front and 305/45 R20 at the rear. The homologated tire combines an optimized compound, staggered geometry and vehicle-specific tuning to balance rolling resistance, high-speed stability, torque transfer and handling on a heavy performance EV. The win places Falken in a premium electric-SUV OE program and shows how vehicle-specific tire engineering and homologation are becoming routes into higher-value market positions.
title_zh: Falken 以电动车专属 UHP 产品组合赢得 Porsche Cayenne Electric 原配
what_happened_zh: Dunlop Tyre Europe 开始为 Porsche Cayenne Electric 供应作为原厂配套的 Falken Azenis FK520 NG0。Porsche 批准了一套前后规格不同的 20-inch 配置，前轮使用 255/55 R20 轮胎，后轮使用 305/45 R20。这款通过型号认证的轮胎结合优化配方、前后差异化几何形状和针对车型的调校，以在一款重型高性能电动车上平衡滚动阻力、高速稳定性、扭矩传递和操控。此次获配使 Falken 进入高端电动 SUV 原配项目，并显示针对具体车型的轮胎工程与型号认证正成为通往更高价值市场地位的路径。

title: Japan's June replacement-tire rebound outpaces its OE recovery
what_happened: JATMA's June data show total replacement-tire sales of 4.949 million units, up 21.6% year over year, including a 23.8% increase in passenger-car tires. OE sales totaled 3.676 million units, up 10.2%, while first-half totals were only 2.5% higher for replacement tires and 2.4% higher for OE tires. The simultaneous monthly rebound across passenger, light-truck and truck-and-bus categories contrasts with much slower first-half growth, indicating a sharp June acceleration rather than uniformly strong demand throughout 2026. The split between a 21.6% replacement increase and 10.2% OE increase provides a direct demand signal for manufacturers, distributors and service networks operating in Japan.
title_zh: 日本 6 月替换轮胎回升快于其原配恢复
what_happened_zh: JATMA 的 6 月数据显示，替换轮胎销量合计 4.949 million 条，同比增长 21.6%，其中乘用车轮胎增长 23.8%。原配销量合计 3.676 million 条，增长 10.2%；而上半年累计增幅仅为替换轮胎 2.5%、原配轮胎 2.4%。乘用车、轻型卡车和卡客车类别在当月同步回升，与明显更慢的上半年增长形成对比，表明这是 6 月的一次陡然加速，而不是 2026 年全年需求均强。替换增长 21.6% 与原配增长 10.2% 之间的差距，为在日本经营的制造商、分销商和服务网络提供了直接的需求信号。

title: Pirelli maps its renewed P Zero range across more than 300 premium homologations
companies: Pirelli; Ferrari; Pagani; other premium OEMs
what_happened: Pirelli used Goodwood to disclose that its renewed P Zero products have secured more than 300 homologations. Examples include a bespoke 24-inch P Zero E for the Ferrari Luce with more than 55% bio-based and recycled materials and the Pagani Utopia Roadster as the first vehicle adopting Cyber Tyre. Premium tire development is combining vehicle-specific homologation, larger EV-ready sizes, sustainable-material content and connected-tire functions in one product family. The portfolio demonstrates how a tire maker can turn R&D into high-value OE positions across multiple premium customers, although the release does not break out volumes or timing by homologation.
title_zh: 倍耐力把焕新的 P Zero 系列对应到 300 多项高端型号认证
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力借 Goodwood 披露，其焕新的 P Zero 产品已获得 300 多项型号认证。示例包括为 Ferrari Luce 定制的 24-inch P Zero E，其生物基和再生材料占比超过 55%，以及作为首款采用 Cyber Tyre 车型的 Pagani Utopia Roadster。高端轮胎开发正把针对具体车型的型号认证、更大的适配电动车规格、可持续材料含量和互联轮胎功能整合到一个产品家族中。该产品组合显示轮胎制造商如何把研发转化为面向多个高端客户的高价值原配地位，不过该发布并未按型号认证拆分数量或时间安排。

title: Backbone-rigid functionalization makes natural rubber stronger and mechanically deconstructable
what_happened: Researchers reported a catalyst- and additive-free photochemical route that introduces rigid bicyclic cyclobutane units into natural rubber, with rapid functionalization and a tested formulation showing large strength and toughness gains plus force-triggered deconstruction. Polymer design is combining high performance with programmed end-of-life behavior directly in the natural-rubber backbone. The chemistry points toward elastomers tunable across processing and service behavior while retaining a route to mechanical deconstruction.

sources.publisher: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Angewandte Chemie
sources.link_label: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Angewandte Chemie

title_zh: 主链刚性功能化让天然橡胶更强韧且可机械解构
what_happened_zh: 研究人员报告了一种无需催化剂和添加剂的光化学路线，可把刚性双环环丁烷单元引入天然橡胶，功能化速度快，经测试的配方显示出大幅的强度和韧性提升，并具备力触发解构能力。聚合物设计正把高性能与程序化的报废行为直接结合到天然橡胶主链之中。该化学路线指向一类在加工和使用性能上均可调控、同时保留机械解构途径的弹性体。

title: Jining Black Cat plans a 50,000-tonne carbon-black feedstock recycling upgrade
companies: Jiangxi Black Cat; Jining Black Cat
what_happened: Jiangxi Black Cat disclosed a planned CNY 49.96 million Jining project to process 50,000 tonnes per year of carbon-based material for use as feedstock in its existing carbon-black lines. Chinese carbon-black producers are investing in internal feedstock recovery to reduce raw-material exposure and raise circular input use. The project could improve resilience for tire-grade carbon-black supply, but its yield, emissions, product-grade allocation, and economics require follow-up after construction.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association citing company announcement
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association citing company announcement

title_zh: 济宁黑猫计划实施 50,000-tonne 炭黑原料回收升级项目
what_happened_zh: 江西黑猫披露了一项计划投资 CNY 49.96 million 的济宁项目，每年处理 50,000 tonnes 含碳材料，用作其现有炭黑生产线的原料。中国炭黑生产商正在投资内部原料回收，以降低原材料敞口并提高循环投入比例。该项目可能提升轮胎级炭黑供应的韧性，但其收率、排放、产品牌号分配和经济性需要在建成之后继续跟踪。

title: Genan agrees to sell Houston as Liberty consolidates its Gulf Coast position
what_happened: Liberty Tire Recycling announced three Gulf Coast acquisitions, including Genan's U.S. subsidiary and Houston tire-recycling plant; Genan described its transaction as an agreement to divest the facility and refocus on Europe. If completed, the transactions would bring regional collection and recycled-rubber processing assets under one U.S. operator. End-of-life tire collection and material processing are consolidating regionally as global recyclers sharpen their geographic portfolios. Integrated collection and processing may improve feedstock control and market reach for recycled rubber, but ownership consolidation alone does not prove higher recovery volumes or better economics.
title_zh: Genan 同意出售休斯敦工厂，Liberty 巩固其墨西哥湾沿岸地位
what_happened_zh: Liberty Tire Recycling 宣布了三项墨西哥湾沿岸收购，其中包括 Genan 的美国子公司及休斯敦废旧轮胎回收工厂；Genan 则把自身的交易描述为出售该设施并重新聚焦欧洲的协议。若交易完成，区域性的收集与再生橡胶加工资产将归入同一家美国运营商。随着全球回收企业各自收紧地域布局，报废轮胎的收集与材料加工正在区域层面整合。收集与加工一体化可能改善再生橡胶的原料掌控和市场覆盖，但仅凭所有权整合并不能证明回收量提高或经济性改善。

title: U.S. Commerce advances a preliminary review of China PVLT tire duties
what_happened: Commerce published preliminary results of its 2024-2025 antidumping-duty administrative review for passenger-vehicle and light-truck tires from China. It preliminarily found reviewed producers or exporters sold below normal value and rescinded the review for 19 companies, while inviting comments before final results. Trade-remedy exposure remains company-specific and administratively fluid, adding a regulatory cost layer to cross-border tire sourcing. Importers and manufacturers need to model provisional company treatment and cash-deposit risk, but commercial effects cannot be treated as final until Commerce completes the review.

sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Commerce via GovInfo; Federal Register mirror
sources.link_label: U.S. Department of Commerce via GovInfo; Federal Register mirror

title_zh: 美国商务部推进对中国 PVLT 轮胎关税的初步复审
what_happened_zh: 美国商务部公布了针对中国乘用车及轻卡轮胎 2024-2025 年反倾销税行政复审的初步结果。商务部初步认定，被复审的生产商或出口商以低于正常价值的价格销售，并对 19 家公司终止复审，同时在最终结果公布前征求意见。贸易救济风险仍然因企业而异并在行政程序中不断变化，为跨境轮胎采购增加了一层监管成本。进口商和制造商需要测算临时性的企业待遇和现金保证金风险，但在美国商务部完成复审之前，商业影响还不能被视为最终结果。

title: China's July reference table shows why tire-chemical prices require grade-level sourcing
what_happened: CRIA published its July regional reference table for rubber-industry raw materials, displaying separately quoted city and grade observations for sulfur, insoluble sulfur, BR, SBR, and other tire inputs. Chinese procurement benchmarks are becoming more granular, but regional and specification differences prevent a single national price from representing compound cost. Buyers can use the table as a sourcing checklist only when grade, supplier, location, delivery basis, and date match; unsupported cross-row spreads are not reported here.
title_zh: 中国 7 月参考价格表说明轮胎化学品价格为何需要按牌号采购
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会发布了 7 月橡胶行业原材料地区参考价格表，分别列出硫磺、不溶性硫磺、BR、SBR 等轮胎原料按城市和牌号报出的观察值。中国的采购基准正变得更加细化，但地区和规格差异使单一的全国价格无法代表配方成本。只有在牌号、供应商、地点、交货方式和日期都匹配时，买方才能把该表用作采购核对清单；本文不报告缺乏依据的跨行价差。

title: Hankook turns spent curing bladders into a designed secondary-material stream
what_happened: Hankook said its Bladder Upcycling Series won Gold at the 2026 A' Design Award. The re:move project repurposes spent tire-curing bladders into furniture, bricks, and lifestyle goods rather than treating the factory consumables solely as waste. Tire-factory circularity is expanding beyond end-of-life tires toward higher-value uses for process consumables and manufacturing by-products. The project broadens the recoverable material map inside tire plants, but its supply-chain relevance depends on repeatable processing, demand, economics, and disclosed scale.
title_zh: 韩泰把废旧硫化胶囊变成经过设计的二次材料流
what_happened_zh: 韩泰表示，其 Bladder Upcycling Series 在 2026 A' Design Award 中获得金奖。re:move 项目把用过的轮胎硫化胶囊改造成家具、砖材和生活用品，而不是把这些工厂耗材单纯当作废弃物处理。轮胎工厂的循环化正从报废轮胎延伸到工艺耗材和制造副产品的高值化利用。该项目拓宽了轮胎工厂内部可回收材料的范围，但其供应链意义取决于可重复的加工、需求、经济性和已披露的规模。

title: U.S. Commerce delays its preliminary China CBS countervailing decision
companies: U.S. Department of Commerce; Chinese CBS exporters
what_happened: The U.S. Commerce Department moved the preliminary countervailing-duty determination for rubber accelerator CBS from July 31 to October 5, extending uncertainty for Chinese suppliers and U.S. tire-material buyers. Trade-remedy timing itself is becoming a supply-chain variable for tire chemicals, delaying visibility on deposits and landed costs. Buyers and exporters gain more preparation time but face a longer period of pricing, inventory, and sourcing uncertainty.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association citing U.S. Commerce
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association citing U.S. Commerce

title_zh: 美国商务部推迟对中国 CBS 的反补贴初步裁定
what_happened_zh: 美国商务部把橡胶促进剂 CBS 的反补贴税初步裁定从 7 月 31 日推迟至 10 月 5 日，延长了中国供应商和美国轮胎材料买方面临的不确定性。贸易救济的时间安排本身正在成为轮胎化学品的一个供应链变量，推迟了保证金和到岸成本的可见性。买方和出口商获得了更多准备时间，但也要面对更长时期的价格、库存和采购不确定性。

title: China proposes tighter and broader air-emission controls for tire plants
counterparties: China Ministry of Ecology and Environment
what_happened: China's environment ministry opened consultation on a draft national rubber-products air-pollutant emission standard. The proposal broadens process and pollutant coverage, explicitly encompasses tire manufacturing, tightens organized-emission limits, and adds fugitive-emission and monitoring requirements. Environmental control is moving from narrow end-of-pipe limits toward plant-wide process, fugitive-emission, and monitoring obligations. If adopted, the standard could require tire plants to reassess capture systems, treatment capacity, monitoring points, operating records, and capital plans.

sources.publisher: China Ministry of Ecology and Environment
sources.title: Request for comments on the Rubber Products Industry Air Pollutant Emission Standard
sources.link_label: China Ministry of Ecology and Environment; China Rubber Industry Association

sources.title: Rubber-products air-emission standard draft broadens controls for the industry

title_zh: 中国拟对轮胎工厂实施更严格、更广泛的大气排放管控
what_happened_zh: 中国生态环境部就一项橡胶制品大气污染物排放国家标准的征求意见稿公开征求意见。该征求意见稿扩大了工序和污染物的覆盖范围，明确涵盖轮胎制造，收紧有组织排放限值，并增加无组织排放和监测要求。环境管控正从狭义的末端排放限值，转向覆盖全厂工序、无组织排放和监测的义务。若最终发布，该标准可能要求轮胎工厂重新评估收集系统、治理能力、监测点位、运行记录和资本支出计划。

title: CEAT approves INR 12.05 billion for two-wheeler tire capacity expansion
what_happened: CEAT's board approved an INR 12.05 billion investment to expand two-wheeler tire manufacturing capacity as the company reported first-quarter revenue growth alongside a sharp profit decline. The authorization signals continued capacity investment despite raw-material and foreign-exchange pressure on near-term earnings. High utilization and demand expectations are sustaining capacity commitments even when input costs and currency movements compress margins. The program is a material India two-wheeler capacity signal, but its competitive effect depends on project phasing, site execution, incremental output, and market absorption.
title_zh: CEAT 批准 INR 12.05 billion 用于扩建两轮车轮胎产能
what_happened_zh: CEAT 董事会批准一项 INR 12.05 billion 的投资，用于扩大两轮车轮胎制造产能；同期公司报告第一季度营业收入增长，但利润大幅下滑。该授权表明，尽管原材料和汇率对近期盈利构成压力，产能投资仍在继续。即使投入成本和汇率波动压缩利润率，高产能利用率和需求预期仍在支撑产能承诺。该计划是印度两轮车产能的一个重要信号，但其竞争效果取决于项目分期、现场执行、新增产量和市场消化能力。

title: Rizhao clears Haomai's green tire-curing equipment project at the EIA stage
what_happened: Public reporting said Rizhao Development Zone approved the environmental assessment for Haomai's high-end tire green-curing equipment and key-parts industrialization project, with a full-project target of 20,000 mold-shell units and 6,000 key components annually. Chinese tire-equipment suppliers are pairing curing-efficiency upgrades with dedicated industrial-scale component capacity. The project could strengthen domestic curing-equipment supply, but commercial effect depends on construction, installation, qualification, and customer demand after permitting.

sources.publisher: Sina Finance; China Natural Rubber Association
sources.link_label: Sina Finance; China Natural Rubber Association

title_zh: 日照在环评阶段放行 Haomai 绿色轮胎硫化装备项目
what_happened_zh: 公开报道称，日照开发区已批准 Haomai 高端轮胎绿色硫化装备及关键零部件产业化项目的环境影响评价，项目全部建成后目标为年产 20,000 套模壳和 6,000 件关键零部件。中国轮胎装备供应商正把硫化效率升级与专门的工业化零部件产能结合起来。该项目可能增强国内硫化装备供应，但商业效果取决于取得许可之后的建设、安装、认证和客户需求。

title: U.S. tire output rises into June while synthetic-rubber output stays flat
what_happened: The Federal Reserve's July G.17 release put the seasonally adjusted U.S. tire production index at 80.7 in June, up from 80.0 in May, while the synthetic-rubber index remained at 79.8. The tire series has risen from 73.0 in January, although June is preliminary. Downstream tire production improved while the upstream synthetic-rubber series did not move in the latest monthly reading. The divergence is a useful utilization and procurement signal, but it cannot establish causation because synthetic rubber serves other markets and the indices measure output rather than physical tire or rubber volumes.

sources.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System; FRED
sources.link_label: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System; FRED

title_zh: 美国轮胎产量 6 月回升，合成橡胶产量持平
what_happened_zh: 美联储 7 月 G.17 数据显示，经季节调整的美国轮胎生产指数 6 月为 80.7，高于 5 月的 80.0，而合成橡胶指数维持在 79.8。轮胎序列已从 1 月的 73.0 回升，但 6 月为初步数据。在最新的月度读数中，下游轮胎生产有所改善，而上游合成橡胶序列没有变动。这一分化是有用的产能利用率与采购信号，但不能据此确立因果关系，因为合成橡胶还服务于其他市场，且这些指数衡量的是产出而非轮胎或橡胶的实物量。

title: Big Brand's Belle Tire deal would create a 530-plus-site service network
companies: Big Brand Tire & Service; Belle Tire
what_happened: Big Brand Tire & Service announced a definitive agreement to acquire Belle Tire, with closing expected in the third quarter subject to customary conditions. The companies say the combination would operate more than 530 locations and generate more than USD 1.5 billion in revenue. Independent tire retail and automotive service platforms are consolidating across U.S. regions to gain purchasing scale, brand reach, and denser service networks. The combination would materially reshape independent retail coverage, but the network and revenue effects depend on closing, integration, and retention of local customers and staff.

sources.publisher: Big Brand Tire & Service; Modern Distribution Management
sources.link_label: Big Brand Tire & Service; Modern Distribution Management

title_zh: Big Brand 收购 Belle Tire 将形成 530 家以上门店的服务网络
what_happened_zh: Big Brand Tire & Service 宣布已就收购 Belle Tire 签署最终协议，预计在第三季度完成交割，并需满足惯例条件。双方表示，合并后将运营 530 家以上门店，并实现超过 USD 1.5 billion 的收入。独立轮胎零售与汽车服务平台正在美国各区域整合，以获得采购规模、品牌覆盖和更密集的服务网络。此次合并将实质性改变独立零售的覆盖格局，但网络和收入方面的效果取决于交割、整合以及本地客户和员工的留存。

title: Nordic Tyre Group agrees to buy a Romanian distribution platform
what_happened: Nordic Tyre Group signed an agreement to acquire Romanian tire distributor Dinamic 92, its first entry into Romania. Dinamic 92 says it serves more than 5,000 business customers, distributes about 700,000 tires annually, and operates from five locations, with the existing team remaining in place. Regional tire distributors are using platform acquisitions to cross borders while retaining local management, customer relationships, and logistics assets. If completed, the deal would give Nordic Tyre Group immediate Eastern European channel density rather than requiring a greenfield build, but closing and integration remain ahead.
title_zh: Nordic Tyre Group 同意收购一家罗马尼亚分销平台
what_happened_zh: Nordic Tyre Group 签署协议，收购罗马尼亚轮胎分销商 Dinamic 92，这是其首次进入罗马尼亚。Dinamic 92 称，公司服务 5,000 多家企业客户，每年分销约 700,000 条轮胎，并在五个地点运营，现有团队将继续留任。区域性轮胎分销商正在用平台型收购实现跨境扩张，同时保留本地管理层、客户关系和物流资产。若交易完成，Nordic Tyre Group 将直接获得东欧的渠道密度，而不必新建网络，但交割和整合仍有待完成。

title: Dunlop scales its Malaysian dealer reset from 150 to about 250 outlets
what_happened: Toyotsu Binter told Malaysian media that Dunlop's dealer network had grown to about 250 outlets from roughly 150 since May, alongside availability through UMW Toyota dealerships and a broader replacement-tire portfolio. The distributor is also exploring dedicated performance centers. A legacy brand is rebuilding a national replacement channel through rapid dealer onboarding, OEM-affiliated retail access, and a possible branded-service format. Faster physical availability can restore consideration and service reach in Malaysia, although network quality, sell-through, and the performance-center concept still need evidence.
title_zh: Dunlop 把马来西亚经销网络从 150 家扩大到约 250 家
what_happened_zh: Toyotsu Binter 向马来西亚媒体表示，自 5 月以来，Dunlop 的经销网络已从约 150 家门店增加到约 250 家，同时产品还可通过 UMW Toyota 经销店获得，替换轮胎产品线也有所拓宽。该分销商还在探索设立专门的性能中心。一个传统品牌正通过快速招募经销商、借助与整车厂关联的零售渠道以及可能的品牌服务业态，重建全国性替换市场渠道。更快的实物可获得性能够在马来西亚恢复品牌考虑度和服务覆盖，但网络质量、终端销售以及性能中心这一概念仍需证据支持。

title: Currency swings overwhelm Linglong's first-half operating improvement
what_happened: Linglong preliminarily estimated first-half attributable net profit of CNY 110 million, down 87 percent, and adjusted net profit of CNY 9 million, down 99 percent. It attributed the decline mainly to a swing from CNY 691 million of foreign-exchange gains a year earlier to about CNY 342 million of losses, while saying operations improved before foreign exchange. For globally expanding Chinese tire makers, currency management can now outweigh plant and sales execution in reported earnings. The roughly CNY 1.03 billion year-on-year foreign-exchange swing shows why investors and operators need to separate operating progress from translation and settlement effects.
