Linglong Tire expects first-half profit to fall as foreign exchange reverses

title_zh: 汇兑波动盖过玲珑轮胎上半年的经营改善
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎初步预计上半年归属于股东的净利润为 CNY 110 million，同比下降 87%，扣非后净利润为 CNY 9 million，同比下降 99%。公司将下滑主要归因于汇兑从上年同期 CNY 691 million 的收益转为约 CNY 342 million 的损失，同时表示在计入汇兑影响之前经营已有改善。对于全球扩张中的中国轮胎企业而言，汇率管理在报告利润中的作用如今可能超过工厂与销售执行。汇兑损益同比约 CNY 1.03 billion 的变动说明，投资者和经营者需要把经营层面的进展与折算和结算影响区分开来。

title: General Science forecasts a sharp first-half profit increase as overseas capacity ramps
what_happened: General Science forecast first-half attributable net profit of CNY 138 million to CNY 178 million, up about 115% to 177%, while continuing to emphasize its China, Thailand, and Cambodia production network. Chinese tire earnings are increasingly tied to utilization and market access at overseas plants rather than domestic export volume alone. The forecast offers an early profitability signal, but the full report must separate volume, price, mix, tariffs, foreign exchange, and one-time effects.
title_zh: 通用股份预告上半年利润大幅增长，海外产能进入爬坡
what_happened_zh: 通用股份预计上半年归属于股东的净利润为 CNY 138 million 至 CNY 178 million，同比增长约 115% 至 177%，并继续强调其在中国、泰国和柬埔寨的生产网络。中国轮胎企业的盈利越来越与海外工厂的产能利用率和市场准入相关，而不再只取决于国内出口量。该预告提供了早期的盈利信号，但完整报告还必须把销量、价格、产品结构、关税、汇兑和一次性因素区分开来。

title: Goodyear adds 66 winter-tire fitments, mostly for 19-inch-and-larger wheels
what_happened: Goodyear expanded the UltraGrip Performance 3 range by 66 stock-keeping units to 344, with more than 90 percent of the additions sized 19 inches or larger. The expansion includes 59 replacement-market sizes and seven new original-equipment fitments for the BMW iX3, Porsche Cayenne Electric, and Mercedes-Benz GLC EQ. Winter-tire range growth is shifting toward larger wheel diameters and electric-vehicle applications while one tread family spans both replacement and OE demand. Broader fitment coverage can improve dealer availability and capture higher-value vehicle applications, although stock-keeping-unit breadth does not by itself demonstrate sales or profitability.
title_zh: 固特异新增 66 个冬季轮胎配套，多数面向 19 英寸及以上轮辋
what_happened_zh: 固特异把 UltraGrip Performance 3 产品线的库存单位增加 66 个至 344 个，其中 90% 以上的新增规格为 19 英寸及以上。此次扩充包括 59 个替换市场规格，以及面向 BMW iX3、Porsche Cayenne Electric 和 Mercedes-Benz GLC EQ 的七个全新原配配套。冬季轮胎产品线的增长正在向更大轮辋直径和电动车应用倾斜，而同一胎面家族可同时覆盖替换市场与原配需求。更广的配套覆盖能够改善经销商的供货可获得性并切入价值更高的车型应用，但库存单位的数量本身并不能证明销量或盈利能力。

title: Japan's tire-demand revision pairs a stronger first half with a sharp second-half slowdown
what_happened: JATMA revised its 2026 domestic automotive-tire demand forecast to 103.67 million units, down 2% from 2025. The association recorded first-half demand 3% higher but assumes a 5% second-half decline; four-wheel original-equipment demand is forecast flat at 37.05 million units while replacement manufacturer shipments fall 2% to 64.48 million. Japan's market signal is a split-year pattern: early gains are not carrying into the second-half outlook, and replacement weakness is broader than original-equipment demand. The revision provides a source-owned planning baseline for production, inventory, and channel decisions, with truck-and-bus replacement shipments forecast down 3% even as truck-and-bus OE demand rises 2%.
title_zh: 日本轮胎需求修订：上半年走强，下半年急剧放缓
what_happened_zh: JATMA 将 2026 年日本国内汽车轮胎需求预测下调至 103.67 million 条，较 2025 年下降 2%。协会记录上半年需求增长 3%，但假设下半年下降 5%；四轮车原配需求预计持平于 37.05 million 条，而替换市场的制造商出货量下降 2% 至 64.48 million 条。日本的市场信号呈现半年分化格局：前期增长并未延续到下半年展望，且替换市场的疲弱范围比原配需求更广。该修订为生产、库存和渠道决策提供了来源方自有的规划基准，其中卡客车替换出货量预计下降 3%，而卡客车原配需求上升 2%。

title: DoubleStar's preliminary first-half result highlights Kumho integration as the earnings lever
what_happened: DoubleStar's preliminary disclosure said first-half profit improved after its Kumho transaction, with the companies combining procurement, logistics, compounds, product lines, factories, and OE relationships. A Chinese tire group's value creation is shifting from ownership of an overseas brand toward operational integration across the global network. The integration may broaden product and customer reach, but preliminary company claims should be checked against the full interim report and segment cash generation.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association citing DoubleStar announcement
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association citing DoubleStar announcement

title_zh: 双星上半年初步业绩把锦湖整合列为盈利杠杆
what_happened_zh: 双星的初步披露称，在完成锦湖交易之后上半年利润有所改善，双方在采购、物流、胶料、产品线、工厂和原配客户关系等方面进行了整合。中国轮胎集团的价值创造正从持有海外品牌，转向在全球网络范围内的运营整合。该整合可能扩大产品和客户覆盖，但公司的初步说法仍应与完整的半年度报告和分部现金生成情况相互核对。

title: Volume, pricing and lower factory costs lift Nokian's profitability
what_happened: Nokian Tyres reported second-quarter net sales of EUR 379.9 million, up 10.6 percent, and operating profit of EUR 34.8 million versus EUR 14.8 million a year earlier. It attributed the profitability improvement to higher sales volumes, enhanced pricing, and lower manufacturing and material costs. Commercial recovery is being supported by a combination of volume, pricing discipline, and factory-cost normalization rather than demand growth alone. The result shows improving earnings leverage during Nokian's capacity transition, but negative quarterly operating cash flow and uncertain demand temper the headline profit gain.
title_zh: 销量、价格与工厂成本下降提升 Nokian 的盈利能力
what_happened_zh: Nokian Tyres 报告第二季度净销售额为 EUR 379.9 million，同比增长 10.6%，营业利润为 EUR 34.8 million，上年同期为 EUR 14.8 million。公司把盈利能力的改善归因于销量提高、价格改善以及制造和材料成本下降。商业复苏由销量、价格纪律和工厂成本正常化共同支撑，而不仅仅依靠需求增长。该业绩显示 Nokian 在产能转型期间的盈利杠杆正在改善，但季度经营现金流为负、需求前景不确定，削弱了表观利润增长的说服力。

title: China's tire exports continue growing in volume through June
what_happened: A trade-data report citing China Customs said first-half rubber-tire exports reached 4.94 million tonnes, up 4.9% year on year, with export value of CNY 82.6 billion. Export tonnage is still growing even as price, product mix, trade remedies, and overseas localization complicate the value story. External demand remains central to Chinese utilization, but tonnage alone cannot establish margin, unit, or mix improvement.
title_zh: 截至 6 月，中国轮胎出口量继续保持增长
what_happened_zh: 一份引用中国海关数据的贸易数据报告称，上半年橡胶轮胎出口量达到 4.94 million tonnes，同比增长 4.9%，出口金额为 CNY 82.6 billion。即使价格、产品结构、贸易救济和海外本地化让价值端的情况变得复杂，出口吨位仍在增长。外部需求对中国的产能利用率依然关键，但仅凭吨位无法证明利润率、单价或产品结构的改善。

title: Techking and Breton link tire data to an autonomous-mine control model
what_happened: Techking and autonomous-mining specialist Breton expanded cooperation covering electric mining-truck tires, joint R&D, smart-mine data, and lifecycle service. The companies plan to feed tire parameters into Breton's autonomous-driving model and combine vehicle, tire, road, and cloud data for monitoring and fleet optimization. Industrial tires are becoming sensed and modeled assets inside autonomous fleet-control systems rather than standalone consumables. Tire-condition and performance data can improve dispatch, energy use, maintenance timing, and safety in high-load mining operations if the integration works in production fleets.

sources.title: Techking and Breton deepen strategic cooperation on intelligent mining

title_zh: Techking 与 Breton 把轮胎数据接入自动驾驶矿山控制模型
what_happened_zh: Techking 与自动驾驶矿山领域的专业企业 Breton 扩大合作，内容覆盖电动矿用卡车轮胎、联合研发、智能矿山数据和全生命周期服务。双方计划将轮胎参数输入 Breton 的自动驾驶模型，并把车辆、轮胎、路面和云端数据结合起来，用于状态监测和车队优化。工业轮胎正成为自动驾驶车队控制系统内部被感知、被建模的资产，而不再只是独立的消耗品。如果这种集成能在实际运营车队中奏效，轮胎状态与性能数据可以改善高负荷矿山作业中的调度、能耗、维护时机和安全性。

title: Linglong and Dawn move DVA innerliner material into small-batch production
what_happened: Linglong disclosed that a dynamically vulcanized alloy gas-barrier material entered small-batch production after work on adhesion, online film application, and a 2025 batch road test. The partners report gas impermeability seven to ten times that of a traditional innerliner material, with potential weight and rolling-resistance benefits. Thermoplastic-elastomer barrier films are moving from laboratory development toward manufacturable tire innerliners. If durability, adhesion, process stability, and economics hold at scale, DVA could reduce innerliner mass and support lower rolling resistance without abandoning conventional tire architectures.

sources.title: Linglong and Dawn advance DVA gas-barrier material into small-batch production

title_zh: 玲珑轮胎与 Dawn 推动 DVA 气密层材料进入小批量生产
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎披露，一种动态硫化合金（DVA）气体阻隔材料在完成粘合、在线贴膜应用以及 2025 年批次道路测试等工作后，已进入小批量生产。双方称，该材料的气体不渗透性达到传统气密层材料的七至十倍，并有望带来减重和降低滚动阻力的收益。热塑性弹性体阻隔膜正从实验室开发走向可量产的轮胎气密层。如果耐久性、粘合性、工艺稳定性和经济性在规模化条件下得以保持，DVA 有望降低气密层重量、支持更低的滚动阻力，而无需放弃传统轮胎结构。

title: Bridgestone launches Potenza Sport Evo in Thailand with EV-ready construction
what_happened: Bridgestone Thailand launched the Potenza Sport Evo for high-performance cars and EVs. It lists 71 sizes from 18 to 22 inches for 2026 and says 37 became available in July, with the remainder planned for the fourth quarter. The design combines curved tread blocks, differentiated grooves, nylon-and-aramid reinforcement, and a lightweight construction intended to balance grip, wear, and EV efficiency. A broad size rollout in an Asian replacement market shows premium manufacturers adapting established ultra-high-performance architectures for heavier, torque-rich EVs rather than treating EV tires as a separate niche.
title_zh: 普利司通在泰国推出具备电动车适配结构的 Potenza Sport Evo
what_happened_zh: 普利司通泰国面向高性能轿车和电动车推出 Potenza Sport Evo。该产品 2026 年列出 71 个规格，覆盖 18 至 22 英寸，并称其中 37 个规格已于 7 月上市，其余计划在第四季度推出。设计上结合了弧形胎面花纹块、差异化沟槽、尼龙与芳纶增强材料以及轻量化结构，意在平衡抓地力、耐磨性和电动车能效。在亚洲替换市场进行大范围规格铺开，显示高端制造商正把成熟的超高性能轮胎架构适配到更重、高扭矩的电动车上，而不是把电动车轮胎当作独立的小众品类。

title: Pirelli, Pyrum, BASF, and Synthos assemble a European tire-to-tire material loop
what_happened: The partners launched a chain that collects end-of-life and factory-scrap tires in Germany, converts them into recovered carbon black and tire-pyrolysis oil, upgrades the carbon black for Pirelli, and uses the oil through BASF and Synthos mass-balance routes to make certified synthetic rubber for new Pirelli tires. Circular tire programs are moving from isolated recycling trials toward coordinated, traceable multi-company systems spanning collection, pyrolysis, chemicals, polymers, and tire production. The project creates an industrial route for replacing two important virgin inputs and, if volumes and economics scale, could become a template for closed-loop procurement rather than downcycling.
title_zh: 倍耐力、Pyrum、BASF 与 Synthos 搭建欧洲轮胎到轮胎的材料闭环
what_happened_zh: 合作各方启动了一条产业链：在德国收集报废轮胎和工厂废胎，将其转化为再生炭黑和轮胎热解油，把炭黑提质后供应倍耐力，并通过 BASF 和 Synthos 的质量平衡路线利用热解油制造经认证的合成橡胶，用于倍耐力的新轮胎。循环轮胎项目正从孤立的回收试验，走向覆盖收集、热解、化学品、聚合物和轮胎生产的协同、可追溯的多企业体系。该项目为替代两种重要的原生原料开辟了工业化路线；如果产量和经济性能够放大，它可能成为闭环采购而非降级回收的样板。

title: Longxing moves tire-pyrolysis-oil carbon black into European batch supply
what_happened: Longxing said selected sustainable-carbon-black grades made with tire-pyrolysis oil passed certification at an unnamed large European tire maker and entered batch supply, with a first order near 10,000 tonnes. The company began the program in 2024 and completed environmental assessment work for the product line in late 2025. Recovered tire-pyrolysis oil is being used as carbon-black feedstock in certified tire supply, creating a distinct circular pathway from directly recovered carbon black. If customer confirmation and repeat deliveries follow, this route could scale circular carbon content through existing carbon-black manufacturing and qualification systems.

sources.publisher: Longxing Chemical announcement via Sina Finance
sources.title: Longxing Chemical announcement on sustainable carbon black made with tire-pyrolysis oil
sources.link_label: Longxing Chemical announcement via Sina Finance

title_zh: Longxing 将轮胎热解油炭黑推入欧洲批量供应
what_happened_zh: Longxing 表示，以轮胎热解油生产的部分可持续炭黑牌号已通过一家未具名的欧洲大型轮胎制造商认证并进入批量供应，首批订单接近 10,000 tonnes。公司于 2024 年启动该项目，并在 2025 年末完成该产品线的环境评价工作。回收所得的轮胎热解油正被用作认证轮胎供应链中的炭黑原料，形成一条与直接回收炭黑不同的循环路径。如果客户确认和复购交付随之而来，这条路线有望借助现有炭黑制造与认证体系扩大循环碳含量的规模。

title: Binhua approves a phased 70,000-tonne halobutyl-rubber project in Shandong
companies: Binhua Group; Shandong Binhua New Material
what_happened: Binhua disclosed a planned CNY 1.82 billion, two-phase project in Binzhou for 70,000 tonnes per year of chlorobutyl and bromobutyl rubber, with the first phase scheduled to start construction in 2027. Shandong's tire cluster is adding domestic high-barrier elastomer capacity and integrating it with local C4 feedstock and planned green power. The project could reduce import exposure for tire innerliner materials, but it remains an investment plan rather than built or qualified capacity.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association citing Binhua announcement
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association citing Binhua announcement

title_zh: Binhua 批准山东一个分期推进的 70,000-tonne 卤化丁基橡胶项目
what_happened_zh: Binhua 披露了一个位于滨州、投资 CNY 1.82 billion 的两期项目，规划年产 70,000 tonnes 氯化丁基橡胶和溴化丁基橡胶，其中一期计划于 2027 年开工建设。山东轮胎产业集群正在增加国产高阻隔弹性体产能，并将其与本地 C4 原料及规划中的绿电整合起来。该项目有望降低轮胎气密层材料的进口依赖，但目前仍是投资计划，而非已建成或已通过认证的产能。

title: German rubber producers report better availability but no raw-material cost relief
what_happened: A third-quarter survey by Germany's rubber-industry association found that immediate shortage concerns had eased, but raw-material prices remained high. Its index for a typical natural-rubber mix reached the highest level in about two years, while export business was more positive than domestic demand. The supply-chain problem is shifting from physical availability toward sustained input-cost pressure, energy exposure, and weak domestic demand. This distinction matters for tire and technical-rubber margins: materials may be obtainable without being affordable, increasing pressure for pricing, formulation changes, sourcing diversification, and efficiency gains.
title_zh: 德国橡胶生产企业称供应有所改善，但原料成本未见缓解
what_happened_zh: 德国橡胶工业协会的第三季度调查发现，短期短缺担忧已经缓解，但原料价格依然高企。其针对典型天然橡胶配方的指数达到约两年来的最高水平，同时出口业务的表现好于国内需求。供应链问题正从实物可获得性，转向持续的投入成本压力、能源风险和疲弱的国内需求。这一区别对轮胎和工业橡胶制品的利润率具有意义：材料可能买得到却买不起，从而加大在定价、配方调整、采购多元化和效率提升方面的压力。

title: Michelin ResiCare appoints IMCD to distribute French-made bio-based 5-HMF
what_happened: Michelin ResiCare signed IMCD Europe to distribute 5-hydroxymethylfurfural across Europe from 2027, adding logistics and local technical support beyond direct strategic accounts. Michelin says its Peage-de-Roussillon unit is scheduled to start in early 2027 with 3,000 tonnes of annual capacity. Tire-company polymer expertise is expanding upstream into renewable chemical intermediates and technical distribution models for multiple industries. 5-HMF can serve as an input for lower-impact resins and other formulations, while the distribution agreement tests whether Michelin can commercialize materials know-how beyond tires at industrial scale.
title_zh: 米其林 ResiCare 委任 IMCD 分销法国产生物基 5-HMF
what_happened_zh: 米其林 ResiCare 与 IMCD Europe 签约，自 2027 年起在欧洲分销 5-羟甲基糠醛，在直接战略客户之外增加物流和本地技术支持。米其林称，其 Peage-de-Roussillon 装置计划于 2027 年初投产，年产能为 3,000 tonnes。轮胎企业的聚合物技术能力正向上游延伸至可再生化学中间体，并进入面向多个行业的技术分销模式。5-HMF 可作为低环境影响树脂及其他配方的原料，而这项分销协议则在检验米其林能否在工业规模上把轮胎以外的材料技术实现商业化。

title: Quanzhou moves a CNY 600 million high-performance rubber project toward EIA approval
what_happened: Quanzhou's ecology authority published a proposed EIA approval for a first-phase project with two lines and planned annual output of 2,000 tonnes of RS-01 high-performance rubber. Chinese specialty-elastomer investment is targeting smaller, higher-value capacity rather than only commodity-scale synthetic rubber. The project may broaden domestic tire-material options, but the public summary does not establish the exact chemistry, tire qualification, economics, or production date.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association citing Quanzhou EIA notice
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association citing Quanzhou EIA notice

title_zh: 泉州一个 CNY 600 million 高性能橡胶项目进入环评批准环节
what_happened_zh: 泉州市生态环境主管部门公示了一项拟批准的环评意见，涉及一个设有两条生产线、规划年产 2,000 tonnes RS-01 高性能橡胶的一期项目。中国特种弹性体投资正瞄准规模较小、附加值更高的产能，而不只是大宗规模的合成橡胶。该项目可能拓宽国产轮胎材料的选择，但公开摘要并未确定具体化学体系、轮胎认证、经济性或投产时间。

title: Goodyear files plan to close Fayetteville and remove 1,750 jobs
what_happened: Goodyear told the US Securities and Exchange Commission that it agreed with the United Steelworkers and approved permanent closure of its Fayetteville, North Carolina plant. The plan covers about 1,750 job reductions, is expected to be substantially complete by the end of 2027, and carries estimated pretax charges of $535 million to $565 million. Western tire manufacturing is undergoing capacity rationalization aimed at lowering regional cost per tire rather than adding volume. The closure is a material North American footprint decision. Goodyear forecasts about $270 million in annual Americas operating-income improvement from 2028, but it also removes skilled jobs and concentrates production elsewhere.
title_zh: 固特异提交关闭 Fayetteville 工厂、裁减 1,750 个岗位的计划
what_happened_zh: 固特异向美国证券交易委员会报告，公司已与美国钢铁工人联合会达成一致，并批准永久关闭其位于北卡罗来纳州 Fayetteville 的工厂。该计划涉及约 1,750 个岗位削减，预计到 2027 年底基本完成，并将产生估计 $535 million 至 $565 million 的税前费用。西方轮胎制造正在推进以降低区域单胎成本、而非增加产量为目标的产能合理化。此次关闭是北美产能布局上的一项重大决定。固特异预计从 2028 年起，美洲区年度经营利润将因此改善约 $270 million，但这同时也减少了熟练岗位，并使生产进一步集中到其他地区。

title: Weifang Jinyuan proposes electric curing in a 600,000-unit OTR tire retrofit
what_happened: An EIA pre-filing disclosure described a CNY 110 million retrofit that would replace two mixers and shift curing from steam to electric heating while keeping annual OTR tire capacity at 600,000 units. Chinese tire-plant decarbonization is moving toward electrified curing and equipment replacement without requiring headline capacity expansion. The project tests whether existing plants can reduce process-energy emissions and improve control while holding output constant.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association citing EIA disclosure
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association citing EIA disclosure

title_zh: Weifang Jinyuan 拟在 600,000-unit OTR 轮胎改造项目中采用电硫化
what_happened_zh: 一份环评报批前公示介绍了一项投资 CNY 110 million 的技术改造，内容包括更换两台密炼机，并把硫化由蒸汽加热改为电加热，同时将 OTR 轮胎年产能保持在 600,000 条。中国轮胎工厂的脱碳路径正转向电气化硫化和设备更新，而不必以产能扩张为前提。该项目在检验现有工厂能否在产量保持不变的情况下降低工艺能耗排放并改善控制水平。

title: CEAT's annual report shifts attention to Camso integration and global off-highway execution
what_happened: CEAT posted its FY2025-26 integrated annual report and described Camso integration as a central execution program across products, markets, channels, OEM customers, manufacturing, and customer engagement. The report lists consolidated revenue of INR156.78 billion, nearly 19 percent above the prior year, while flagging input-cost inflation and supply disruption for FY2026-27. Indian tire makers are using acquisitions and integrated manufacturing-channel programs to move into higher-value global off-highway segments. Camso gives CEAT a wider technology and customer base, but realizing the value depends on manufacturing integration, cross-selling, and cost control during a period of raw-material inflation.
title_zh: CEAT 年报把关注点转向 Camso 整合与全球非公路业务执行
what_happened_zh: CEAT 发布了 FY2025-26 综合年度报告，并把 Camso 整合描述为贯穿产品、市场、渠道、OEM 客户、制造和客户互动的核心执行项目。报告列出合并营业收入 INR156.78 billion，较上年增长近 19%，同时提示 FY2026-27 的投入成本通胀和供应中断风险。印度轮胎制造商正借助并购以及制造与渠道一体化项目，进入附加值更高的全球非公路板块。Camso 为 CEAT 带来了更广的技术和客户基础，但价值的实现取决于制造整合、交叉销售，以及在原材料通胀期内的成本控制。

title: Prinx turns its Kedah factory plan toward site works and local supply-chain execution
what_happened: Prinx reported discussions with Kedah officials on its Malaysia factory, local supply-chain coordination, electricity, and approvals, then opened a tender for first-stage landscaping work at the Kedah Rubber City site. Chinese tire projects in Southeast Asia are shifting from investment announcements into local permitting, utilities, supplier integration, and early site packages. The combination provides a concrete execution signal for the Malaysia project and shows which local dependencies must be resolved before manufacturing can begin.

sources.title: Kedah government delegation discusses Malaysia factory execution with Prinx Chengshan
Tender for first-stage landscaping work at the Prinx Tire Malaysia factory

title_zh: 浦林成山把吉打工厂计划推进到场地工程与本地供应链执行阶段
what_happened_zh: 浦林成山表示，公司就马来西亚工厂、本地供应链协同、电力和各项审批与吉打州官员进行了磋商，随后在 Kedah Rubber City 园区为一期绿化工程发布招标。东南亚的中国轮胎项目正从投资公告，转入本地许可、公用工程、供应商整合和早期场地工程包。上述组合为马来西亚项目提供了具体的执行信号，并显示出在生产开始之前必须解决哪些本地依赖条件。

title: Yuanxing opens building tenders for its first overseas tire factory in Indonesia
what_happened: Public reporting said Yuanxing opened building-work tenders for a phased tire-factory project at the Batang Integrated Industrial Estate in Central Java, which would become its first overseas tire factory. Mid-sized Chinese two-wheel tire manufacturers are joining the overseas-capacity wave through Indonesian industrial estates and phased procurement. Tendering is an early execution signal that could shorten delivery to Southeast Asian customers, but it does not establish construction award or production.
title_zh: Yuanxing 为其印尼首座海外轮胎工厂启动建筑工程招标
what_happened_zh: 公开报道称，Yuanxing 已为中爪哇 Batang 一体化工业园内的一个分期轮胎工厂项目启动建筑工程招标，该工厂将成为公司首座海外轮胎工厂。中型中国两轮车轮胎制造商正通过印尼工业园区和分期采购，加入海外产能扩张的浪潮。招标属于早期执行信号，有可能缩短对东南亚客户的交付周期，但并不能确立施工中标或投产。

title: CRIA translates China's draft rubber-emission standard into plant-level compliance priorities
companies: China Rubber Industry Association; Chinese tire and rubber plants
what_happened: CRIA's in-window technical interpretation detailed proposed controls covering tire manufacturing, including new carbon-disulfide and combustion limits, tighter particulate limits, plant-level fugitive VOC monitoring, and added collection requirements for cooling, warehouses, and wastewater treatment. China's environmental rulemaking is shifting from a general consultation signal toward specific plant-wide monitoring and capture obligations. The interpretation gives tire plants a concrete checklist for capital planning and comments, while the underlying standard remains a draft that may change.

sources.publisher: China Ministry of Ecology and Environment
sources.title: Request for comments on the Rubber Products Industry Air Pollutant Emission Standard

title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会把橡胶行业排放标准征求意见稿解读为工厂层面的合规重点
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会在报告期内发布的技术解读，详细说明了覆盖轮胎制造的拟定控制要求，包括新增的二硫化碳和燃烧排放限值、更严格的颗粒物限值、厂区层面的 VOC 无组织排放监测，以及针对冷却、仓库和废水处理环节新增的收集要求。中国的环保立法正从笼统的征求意见信号，转向具体的全厂监测与收集义务。该解读为轮胎工厂的资本支出规划和意见反馈提供了具体清单，而作为依据的标准仍是可能发生变化的征求意见稿。

title: Germany fines Maxxis and wholesalers EUR 11.9 million over resale-price restrictions
companies: Bundeskartellamt; Maxxis International; Best4Tires Berlin; Reifen Mueller
what_happened: Germany's Bundeskartellamt imposed fines totaling EUR 11.9 million on Maxxis International, Best4Tires Berlin, Reifen Mueller, and one responsible individual. The authority said margin-guarantee agreements restricted dealer pricing for Maxxis and CST tires, particularly on the Tyre24 platform, while Maxxis monitored selling prices and intervened when it considered them too low. Online price transparency is increasing both the commercial temptation and competition-law risk around resale-price monitoring in tire wholesale channels. Tire makers, importers, and distributors should audit margin support, recommended-price communications, and marketplace-monitoring practices while preserving dealers' independent pricing.
title_zh: 德国就限制转售价格对 Maxxis 及批发商开出 EUR 11.9 million 罚款
what_happened_zh: 德国联邦卡特尔局对 Maxxis International、Best4Tires Berlin、Reifen Mueller 以及一名责任个人合计处以 EUR 11.9 million 罚款。该机构称，保证毛利的协议限制了 Maxxis 和 CST 轮胎的经销商定价，在 Tyre24 平台上尤为明显，同时 Maxxis 还监控销售价格，并在其认为价格过低时进行干预。线上价格透明度正同时放大轮胎批发渠道中转售价格监控的商业诱因和竞争法风险。轮胎制造商、进口商和分销商应审查毛利支持、建议价格沟通以及平台监控做法，同时保留经销商的独立定价权。

title: Mavis agrees to buy Pep Boys for $700 million and expand westward
companies: Mavis Tire Express Services; Pep Boys; Icahn Enterprises
what_happened: Mavis agreed to acquire Pep Boys for about $700 million in cash, subject to adjustments and closing conditions. Pep Boys operates nearly 800 service locations; Mavis says the deal would take its network above 4,400 locations across the United States and Canada, while Icahn retains specified real estate, AAMCO, and Precision Tune Auto Care. North American tire retail and automotive service are consolidating into larger omnichannel networks with broader procurement, distribution, fitting, and customer reach. The transaction could change tire-brand access and bargaining power across the replacement channel, especially in the western United States, but effects depend on closing and post-deal integration.
title_zh: Mavis 同意以 $700 million 收购 Pep Boys 并向西部扩张
what_happened_zh: Mavis 同意以约 $700 million 现金收购 Pep Boys，交易仍受价格调整和交割条件约束。Pep Boys 运营近 800 家服务门店；Mavis 称该交易将使其在美国和加拿大的网络扩大到 4,400 家以上，而 Icahn 将保留特定房地产资产、AAMCO 和 Precision Tune Auto Care。北美轮胎零售和汽车服务正整合为规模更大的全渠道网络，具备更广的采购、分销、安装和客户触达能力。该交易可能改变替换渠道中的轮胎品牌接入和议价能力，在美国西部尤为明显，但实际影响取决于交割以及交易后的整合。

title: Sailun enters ATU's nationwide German workshop and retail network
what_happened: Trade reporting said ATU will carry Sailun passenger-car, SUV, and van tires through more than 500 German branches, connecting product sales with fitting, service advice, stores, and online purchasing. Asian tire brands are building European replacement share through workshop-led omnichannel distribution rather than relying only on independent wholesalers. ATU provides national visibility and physical fitting capacity, but the commercial result will depend on size coverage, inventory, staff familiarity, sell-through, and supply reliability.
title_zh: 赛轮进入 ATU 覆盖德国全国的维修门店与零售网络
what_happened_zh: 行业媒体报道称，ATU 将通过德国超过 500 家门店销售赛轮的乘用车、SUV 和厢式车轮胎，把产品销售与安装、服务咨询、门店和线上购买连接起来。亚洲轮胎品牌正通过以维修门店为主导的全渠道分销，而不是仅依赖独立批发商，来扩大欧洲替换市场份额。ATU 提供了全国范围的曝光度和实体安装能力，但商业结果仍取决于规格覆盖、库存、员工熟悉程度、终端销售以及供应可靠性。

title: Transense appoints Hamaton and Tyresure to distribute digital tire-inspection tools
what_happened: Transense appointed Hamaton and Tyresure as authorized distributors for Translogik inspection devices and TireTask software across Europe and the Middle East, adding its first partner with dedicated mainland-European operations while retaining direct sales. Digital tire-management vendors are pairing hardware and software with regional TPMS distributors, warehousing, multilingual support, and aftermarket relationships. The arrangement can lower adoption friction for fleets and service providers as commercial-vehicle TPMS, RFID tires, and prospective digital-product-passport requirements increase data-management needs.
title_zh: Transense 委任 Hamaton 与 Tyresure 分销数字化轮胎检测工具
what_happened_zh: Transense 任命 Hamaton 和 Tyresure 为 Translogik 检测设备及 TireTask 软件在欧洲和中东地区的授权分销商，在保留直销的同时，首次引入在欧洲大陆设有专门运营的合作伙伴。数字化轮胎管理厂商正把硬件和软件与区域性 TPMS 分销商、仓储、多语言支持和售后市场关系结合起来。随着商用车 TPMS、RFID 轮胎以及未来可能实施的数字产品护照要求提高数据管理需求，这一安排有助于降低车队和服务商的采用门槛。

title: Hankook wins its first factory fitment on the Porsche 911 Carrera
what_happened: Hankook announced that Porsche will factory-fit the Ventus S1 evo Z to the 911 Carrera for the first time, using NA2-homologated 235/40 ZR19 front and 295/35 ZR20 rear tires developed specifically for the vehicle. Korean tire makers continue moving into high-value European performance-car OE programs that demand model-specific development and homologation. The fitment strengthens Hankook's premium credentials and embeds its engineering in a demanding vehicle platform, although volumes and commercial terms were not disclosed.
title_zh: 韩泰首次赢得 Porsche 911 Carrera 的原厂配套
what_happened_zh: 韩泰宣布，Porsche 将首次为 911 Carrera 原厂配装 Ventus S1 evo Z，采用专为该车型开发、通过 NA2 型号认证的前轮 235/40 ZR19 和后轮 295/35 ZR20 轮胎。韩国轮胎制造商正持续进入高价值的欧洲性能车原配项目，这类项目要求针对具体车型进行开发和型号认证。此次配套强化了韩泰的高端定位，并把其工程能力嵌入要求严苛的整车平台，不过配套数量和商业条款均未披露。

title: Prinx pairs Thailand-made OE fitments with local-rubber sourcing
what_happened: Prinx said its Thailand-made Aquila Pro tires secured fitments on the MG5 PRO, MG S5 EV, and Changan NEVO Q05 in Thailand. It also signed a memorandum with an unnamed upstream partner to strengthen local natural-rubber sourcing. Chinese-owned overseas tire plants are combining local vehicle fitment wins with host-country raw-material integration. The pairing can improve plant utilization, shorten supply chains, and embed the Thailand operation more deeply in regional automotive and rubber ecosystems.

sources.title: Prinx reports Thailand-made OE fitments and local natural-rubber sourcing cooperation

title_zh: 浦林成山把泰国产原配配套与本地天然橡胶采购结合起来
what_happened_zh: 浦林成山表示，其泰国工厂生产的 Aquila Pro 轮胎在泰国获得 MG5 PRO、MG S5 EV 和 Changan NEVO Q05 的配套。公司还与一家未具名的上游合作伙伴签署备忘录，以加强本地天然橡胶采购。中资海外轮胎工厂正把本地整车配套的获取与东道国原材料整合结合起来。这种组合有助于提升工厂产能利用率、缩短供应链，并使泰国业务更深入地嵌入区域汽车和橡胶生态体系。

title: Autotech and Autogem launch certified TPMS training for UK workshops
what_happened: Autotech Training and Autogem launched an Institute of the Motor Industry-certified course covering TPMS sensor replacement, diagnostics, relearn procedures, and resets. Delivery is planned through both companies' facilities as part of a wider UK aftermarket rollout. Tire service is becoming a software-and-sensor competency, creating demand for formal technician accreditation alongside equipment sales. Training can reduce diagnostic errors and improve workshop confidence as TPMS becomes routine service work, though the launch did not disclose enrollment, completion, or repair-quality outcomes.
title_zh: Autotech 与 Autogem 为英国维修门店推出认证 TPMS 培训
what_happened_zh: Autotech Training 与 Autogem 推出一门经英国汽车工业学会认证的课程，内容涵盖 TPMS 传感器更换、诊断、重新学习程序和复位。课程计划通过两家公司的场地交付，并作为更大范围英国售后市场推广的一部分。轮胎服务正在变成一项软件与传感器能力，从而在设备销售之外催生对技师正式资质认证的需求。随着 TPMS 成为常规服务项目，培训有助于减少诊断错误、提升门店信心，不过此次发布未披露报名人数、完课情况或维修质量结果。

title: General Science says its 6PPD-free OTR compound entered mass production
companies: General Science; Otsuka Materials; Qingdao University; Dazhan Nano
what_happened: CRIA reported that General Science launched an OTR tire compound the company says fully replaces 6PPD, improves durability by more than 10 percent, and greatly reduces aquatic toxicity. General Science reported a 505/95R29 XR992 mine-road test and said the product entered mass production. Tire makers are moving 6PPD-alternative development from passenger-tire research into severe-service OTR applications. A scalable alternative that survives mining duty could materially accelerate antidegradant substitution, but comparative safety and durability must be independently verified.
title_zh: 通用股份称其不含 6PPD 的工程机械轮胎胶料已进入量产
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会报道，通用股份推出一款工程机械轮胎胶料，公司称其可完全替代 6PPD、使耐久性提升 10% 以上，并大幅降低水生毒性。通用股份报告了一项 505/95R29 XR992 矿山路面测试，并表示该产品已进入量产。轮胎企业正把 6PPD 替代品的开发从乘用车轮胎研究推向重载工况的工程机械轮胎应用。一种能够承受矿山工况且可规模化的替代品，有望显著加快防老剂替代进程，但其安全性与耐久性的对比结果仍须由独立方验证。

title: Isuzu makes SRI wheel-detachment warning standard on the new Erga
what_happened: Sumitomo Rubber Industries said the wheel-detachment early-warning function of SENSING CORE became standard equipment on Isuzu's updated Erga large route and shuttle bus, which Isuzu released for sale on July 27. The system analyzes wheel-speed and vehicle CAN data to flag abnormal wheel-nut loosening. Tire and wheel intelligence is moving from demonstrations into standard OEM integration on commercial vehicles, using vehicle data to detect maintenance-related risk. Standard fitment creates a concrete fleet deployment path for tire-derived safety analytics, but it does not yet establish real-world incident reduction.
title_zh: Isuzu 在新款 Erga 上将住友橡胶车轮脱落预警功能设为标准配置
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶表示，SENSING CORE 的车轮脱落早期预警功能已成为 Isuzu 改款 Erga 大型线路客车及通勤客车的标准配置，该车型由 Isuzu 于 7 月 27 日上市销售。该系统通过分析轮速和整车 CAN 数据，识别车轮螺母的异常松动。轮胎与车轮智能化正从示范走向商用车上的标准化 OEM 集成，利用整车数据来发现与维护相关的风险。标准配套为源自轮胎的安全分析功能提供了具体的车队部署路径，但尚不能证明实际道路事故的减少。

title: Bridgestone sets a September launch for BLIZZAK ICEPEAK with higher-load winter performance claims
what_happened: Bridgestone announced that BLIZZAK ICEPEAK will go on sale in Japan on September 1 in 57 sizes for SUVs, CUVs, EVs, hybrids, and other high-load or high-torque vehicles. In disclosed company comparisons with BLIZZAK DM-V3, it reported an 11 percent shorter ice-braking distance and 14 percent longer wear life, plus greater modeled edge effect in snow. Winter-tire development is adapting grip, wear, and load capability together for larger and electrified vehicles rather than treating EV suitability as a separate niche. A 57-size rollout by a major manufacturer indicates broad commercialization, and simultaneously improving ice braking and wear could reduce a traditional winter-tire tradeoff; however, sales had not begun during the reporting week and the performance evidence is manufacturer-generated.
title_zh: 普利司通定于 9 月上市 BLIZZAK ICEPEAK，宣称可承受更高负荷的冬季性能
what_happened_zh: 普利司通宣布，BLIZZAK ICEPEAK 将于 9 月 1 日在日本上市，共 57 个规格，面向 SUV、CUV、电动车、混动车以及其他高负荷或高扭矩车型。在公司披露的与 BLIZZAK DM-V3 的对比中，其冰面制动距离缩短 11%、磨耗寿命延长 14%，并在雪地中表现出更强的模拟边缘效应。冬季轮胎开发正把抓地力、磨耗与承载能力一并适配更大型和电动化车辆，而不再把电动车适用性视为独立的细分需求。由大型制造商推出覆盖 57 个规格的产品，表明其商业化范围广泛，而冰面制动与磨耗同时改善有可能缓解冬季轮胎的传统取舍；但在报告期内该产品尚未开始销售，且性能证据由制造商自行产生。

title: Nano-silica strengthens natural-rubber tire sealant in simulated puncture tests
companies: Tsinghua University; Zhejiang Liming Fortune Technical Co., Ltd.; Zhejiang University of Technology
what_happened: Researchers dispersed hydrophobic nano-silica in natural-rubber latex using SDBS and ultrasonication; in simulated puncture testing, the authors report a roughly 3 km shorter critical repair distance and more than 75 percent less pressure loss than the reference formulation. Latex-stage nano-silica dispersion for faster, lower-leakage self-sealing tire compounds. The result points to a potentially more reliable puncture-sealant formulation, but it remains laboratory evidence rather than road or fleet validation.
title_zh: 纳米二氧化硅在模拟穿刺测试中强化天然橡胶轮胎密封胶
what_happened_zh: 研究人员借助 SDBS 和超声处理，将疏水性纳米二氧化硅分散于天然橡胶胶乳中；在模拟穿刺测试中，作者报告临界修复距离缩短约 3 km，压力损失比参比配方减少 75% 以上。这属于胶乳阶段的纳米二氧化硅分散，用于更快、泄漏更少的自密封轮胎胶料。该结果指向一种可能更可靠的穿刺密封配方，但仍属实验室证据，而非道路或车队验证。

title: Microwave drying and TDH cut a rolling-resistance proxy in natural rubber
companies: Qingdao University of Science and Technology; National Engineering Laboratory of Advanced Tire Equipment and Key Materials; Hubei Institute of Aerospace Chemotechnology
what_happened: A Chinese team combined terephthalic dihydrazide interfacial modification with microwave drying in natural-rubber compounds. At 0.75 phr TDH, tan delta at 60 degrees C fell 46.53 percent, tensile strength rose 17.3 percent, and abrasion volume fell 22.6 percent versus the control. Coupled chemical-interface modification and microwave processing for lower-hysteresis, better-dispersed filled rubber. The combination could improve the rolling-resistance, strength, and wear balance sought in tires, but tan delta is a laboratory proxy rather than direct tire performance.
title_zh: 微波干燥与 TDH 降低天然橡胶的滚动阻力替代指标
what_happened_zh: 一支中国团队在天然橡胶胶料中把对苯二甲酰二肼（TDH）界面改性与微波干燥结合起来。在 0.75 phr TDH 下，60 摄氏度时的 tan delta 下降 46.53%，拉伸强度提升 17.3%，磨耗体积下降 22.6%。这是把化学界面改性与微波加工耦合，用于获得滞后更低、分散更好的填充橡胶。该组合可能改善轮胎所追求的滚动阻力、强度与磨耗平衡，但 tan delta 是实验室替代指标，而非直接的轮胎性能。

title: High-molecular-weight plasticizer slows antioxidant migration in NR/BR
companies: Beijing University of Chemical Technology; State Key Laboratory of Organic-Inorganic Composites
what_happened: Researchers partially replaced TDAE oil with polyester polyol D1050 in an NR/BR compound. At 7 phr D1050, antioxidant 4020 migration fell 21.27 percent and the aging coefficient rose 18.5 percent, with mechanical properties reported as essentially unchanged. High-molecular-weight plasticization to retain antidegradant within rubber and reduce surface bloom. Slower antioxidant loss may extend ozone-aging protection and improve appearance, but the result has not been validated in tires or long-duration service.
title_zh: 高分子量增塑剂减缓 NR/BR 中防老剂的迁移
what_happened_zh: 研究人员在 NR/BR 胶料中用聚酯多元醇 D1050 部分替代 TDAE 油。在 7 phr D1050 下，防老剂 4020 的迁移量下降 21.27%，老化系数提升 18.5%，而力学性能据报基本保持不变。这是以高分子量增塑的方式把防老剂保留在橡胶内部，并减少表面喷霜。防老剂流失变慢可能延长抗臭氧老化保护并改善外观，但该结果尚未在轮胎上或长期使用中得到验证。

title: CRIA says Smithers will add high-temperature tire durability simulation in Suzhou
what_happened: CRIA reported that Smithers Materials Science and Engineering Asia-Pacific announced a new high-temperature environmental simulation capability for tire durability testing at its Suzhou laboratory, scheduled to enter service in August 2026. Tire validation is expanding from standard laboratory conditions toward climate-specific durability simulation for global products. A China-based hot-environment test service can support tire development, durability optimization, quality verification, and export-market adaptation closer to Asia-Pacific programs, but the capability had not yet entered service at publication.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association / China Rubber magazine
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association / China Rubber magazine

title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会称 Smithers 将在苏州增加高温轮胎耐久性模拟能力
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会报道，Smithers 材料科学与工程亚太公司宣布在其苏州实验室新增用于轮胎耐久性测试的高温环境模拟能力，计划于 2026 年 8 月投入使用。轮胎验证正从标准实验室条件扩展到面向全球产品的特定气候耐久性模拟。设在中国的高温环境测试服务可以更贴近亚太项目，支持轮胎开发、耐久性优化、质量验证和出口市场适配，但在发布时该能力尚未投入使用。

title: China input-price board shows divergent costs while benchmark tire quotes hold flat
companies: China rubber and tire supply chain
what_happened: Across consecutive CRIA and Longzhong weekly boards, the reported average reference value for antidegradant 4020 rose from 17,660 to 18,700 and butadiene from 10,365 to 10,840, while N330 carbon black fell from 7,460 to 7,300. The listed 205/55R16 passenger-tire and 12R22.5 truck-tire references remained at 198 and 850. Selected tire inputs moved in different directions while two benchmark finished-tire quotes did not change week to week. The divergence points to possible margin pressure if chemical costs rise faster than tire quotes; however, the boards do not state units, sampling, transaction basis, or weighting and therefore show directional reference movement rather than realized market prices.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association / Longzhong Information
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association / Longzhong Information

title_zh: 中国投入品价格表显示成本走势分化，而基准轮胎报价保持平稳
what_happened_zh: 在连续两期中国橡胶工业协会与隆众资讯的周度价格表中，防老剂 4020 的报告平均参考值从 17,660 上升至 18,700，丁二烯从 10,365 上升至 10,840，而 N330 炭黑从 7,460 下降至 7,300。所列 205/55R16 乘用车轮胎和 12R22.5 卡车轮胎参考值仍为 198 和 850。部分轮胎投入品价格走势不一，而两项基准成品轮胎报价周环比没有变化。如果化工原料成本涨幅快于轮胎报价，这种分化可能意味着利润承压；不过，这些价格表没有说明单位、取样方式、成交基准或权重，因此只能体现方向性的参考变动，而不是实际成交的市场价格。

title: Surface modification raises recycled carbon black adhesion in natural rubber
companies: Qingdao University of Science and Technology; South China University of Technology; Shuangqian Group (Jiangsu) Tire Co., Ltd.
what_happened: Researchers treated end-of-life-tire pyrolysis carbon black with three surface modifiers before blending it into natural rubber. The best-balanced 10 wt percent pentaerythritol tetraacrylate treatment improved self-adhesion by 224 percent, while diethyl maleate was identified as the more economical option. Chemical surface treatment to upgrade recycled carbon black performance in natural-rubber compounds. Better dispersion and adhesion could increase recycled-carbon-black feasibility in tire compounds, although finished-tire performance and economics remain unproven.
title_zh: 表面改性提升再生炭黑在天然橡胶中的粘合性能
what_happened_zh: 研究人员先用三种表面改性剂处理报废轮胎热解炭黑，再将其掺入天然橡胶。综合表现最佳的 10 wt% 季戊四醇四丙烯酸酯处理使自粘性提升 224%，而马来酸二乙酯被认为是更经济的选择。这是通过化学表面处理来提升再生炭黑在天然橡胶胶料中的性能。更好的分散与粘合可能提高再生炭黑在轮胎胶料中的可行性，不过成品轮胎性能与经济性仍未得到证实。

title: Twin-screw desulfurization improves crumb-rubber asphalt rheology
companies: Gansu Highway Traffic Construction Group; Lanzhou Jiaotong University; Gansu Transportation Planning Survey & Design Institute; Lanzhou University of Technology
what_happened: Researchers used twin-screw extrusion to produce desulfurized rubber powders at different solubilities and blended them with three asphalt binders. The modified powders improved compatibility, while the Shell 90# system showed the strongest high-temperature rutting and permanent-deformation resistance. Controlled twin-screw desulfurization of waste-tire rubber for more compatible asphalt modifiers. The process offers another value route for end-of-life tire rubber, but binder-scale rheology does not establish field pavement life or environmental performance.
title_zh: 双螺杆脱硫改善胶粉改性沥青的流变性能
what_happened_zh: 研究人员采用双螺杆挤出制备了不同溶解度的脱硫胶粉，并将其与三种沥青结合料共混。改性胶粉改善了相容性，其中 Shell 90# 体系在高温车辙和永久变形抵抗方面表现最强。这是对废旧轮胎橡胶进行可控的双螺杆脱硫，以获得相容性更好的沥青改性剂。该工艺为报废轮胎橡胶提供了又一条增值路径，但结合料层面的流变结果并不能确定现场路面寿命或环境表现。

title: BKT commissions carbon-black Phase 2 as OHT volume reaches a record
what_happened: BKT reported record quarterly off-highway-tire sales volume of 93,770 metric tons in Q1 FY2027, up 16 percent, and said Phase 2 of its carbon-black project was commissioned, taking total capacity to 360,000 metric tons per year. It also said commercial-vehicle radial supplies began in April 2026. BKT is pairing off-highway scale with upstream carbon-black integration and early expansion into on-highway commercial tires. The combination can improve supply control and diversify demand, but nameplate capacity does not prove utilization and the on-highway program remains at an early commercial stage.
title_zh: BKT 炭黑项目 Phase 2 建成投产，非公路轮胎销量创纪录
what_happened_zh: BKT 报告 Q1 FY2027 非公路轮胎销量达到创纪录的 93,770 metric tons，增长 16%，并表示其炭黑项目的 Phase 2 已建成投产，使总产能达到每年 360,000 metric tons。公司还表示，商用车子午线轮胎供货已于 2026 年 4 月开始。BKT 正把非公路轮胎规模、上游炭黑一体化以及向公路商用轮胎的早期扩张结合起来。这一组合可以改善供应控制并分散需求，但铭牌产能不能证明实际开工率，公路轮胎项目也仍处于商业化早期阶段。

title: CRIA reports Sinopec's Tianjin high-end rubber project entered equipment installation
what_happened: CRIA reported that a core solvent-removal tower was lifted into place at Sinopec Yanshan's Tianjin Nangang green high-end rubber project, marking a shift from civil works to equipment installation. The project targets annual capacity of 100,000 tonnes of solution-polymerized styrene-butadiene rubber and 100,000 tonnes of butadiene rubber for high-end tires. China is localizing higher-value synthetic-rubber capacity through proprietary process technology and integrated chemical-park projects. The project could expand domestic supply for advanced tire compounds, but its effect on availability depends on completion, commissioning, qualification, and operating rates.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association / China Rubber magazine
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association / China Rubber magazine

title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会报道中国石化天津高端橡胶项目进入设备安装阶段
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会报道，中国石化燕山石化天津南港绿色高端橡胶项目的一座核心脱溶剂塔完成吊装，标志着项目从土建转入设备安装阶段。该项目规划年产 100,000 tonnes 溶聚丁苯橡胶和 100,000 tonnes 顺丁橡胶，用于高端轮胎。中国正通过自主工艺技术和一体化化工园区项目，推进更高附加值合成橡胶产能的本地化。该项目可能扩大先进轮胎胶料的国内供应，但其对供应可得性的影响取决于建成、投料试车、认证和开工率。

title: Straightaway enters the Carolinas through The Shop @ 160 acquisition
what_happened: Straightaway announced its acquisition of The Shop @ 160 in Fort Mill, South Carolina, its first location in greater Charlotte and entry into the North and South Carolina market. The company said the site establishes a regional platform and takes its network above 95 locations. Automotive-service consolidators are using anchor acquisitions to enter new regions and test operating concepts near corporate support hubs before wider rollout. The transaction creates a new tire-and-service channel foothold in the Carolinas, but the platform thesis remains prospective and financial terms were not disclosed.

sources.publisher: Straightaway Tire & Auto via PR Newswire
sources.link_label: Straightaway Tire & Auto via PR Newswire

title_zh: Straightaway 通过收购 The Shop @ 160 进入南北卡罗来纳市场
what_happened_zh: Straightaway 宣布收购位于南卡罗来纳州 Fort Mill 的 The Shop @ 160，这是其在大夏洛特地区的首家门店，也标志着进入北卡罗来纳州和南卡罗来纳州市场。公司表示，该门店确立了一个区域平台，并使其网络规模超过 95 家。汽车服务连锁整合者正利用锚点收购进入新区域，并在总部支持中心附近检验经营模式，然后再更大范围推广。该交易在卡罗来纳地区建立了新的轮胎与服务渠道据点，但平台设想仍属前瞻性内容，且交易财务条款未予披露。

title: ZC Rubber formalizes Indonesia distributor coordination as MTI's second phase enters operation
what_happened: ZC Rubber said its first Indonesia Distributor Conference brought together about 140 company, MTI and distributor representatives and created an Indonesia Marketing Committee with members from four national distributors; it also reported that MTI Phase I had reached planned capacity and Phase II had entered operation. The company is linking localized Indonesian manufacturing to a formal distributor-feedback loop for product planning across road, rainfall, temperature and commercial-duty conditions. A standing four-distributor committee can shorten demand sensing and coordinate localized products, marketing and sales as ZC Rubber expands its Southeast Asian manufacturing-and-channel model.
title_zh: 中策橡胶确立印尼经销商协调机制，MTI 二期进入运行
what_happened_zh: 中策橡胶表示，其首届印尼经销商大会汇集了约 140 名公司、MTI 及经销商代表，并成立了由四家全国性经销商成员组成的印尼市场委员会；公司还报告 MTI 一期已达到规划产能，二期已进入运行。该公司正把印尼本地化制造与正式的经销商反馈机制联系起来，用于围绕路况、降雨、温度和商用工况进行产品规划。随着中策橡胶推广其东南亚制造与渠道模式，一个常设的四家经销商委员会可以缩短需求感知链条，并协调本地化产品、营销和销售。

title: Pirelli holds a 16 percent H1 margin as High Value reaches 82 percent of sales
what_happened: Pirelli reported H1 revenue of EUR 3.4945 billion, down 0.1 percent reported but up 2.5 percent organically; adjusted EBIT was EUR 557.8 million at a 16 percent margin and profit rose 13.3 percent to EUR 299 million. High Value products reached 82 percent of sales, and the company said about 200 new homologations were obtained. Value continues to migrate toward high-inch premium products and electrified-vehicle homologations, supporting margins despite nearly flat reported revenue. Pirelli's mix and homologation pipeline reinforce the economics of premium OE access, while currency, governance, and conversion of homologations into volume remain risks.
title_zh: 倍耐力 H1 利润率保持 16%，High Value 产品占销售额 82%
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力报告 H1 营业收入为 EUR 3.4945 billion，按报告口径下降 0.1%，但按有机口径增长 2.5%；调整后 EBIT 为 EUR 557.8 million，利润率为 16%，利润增长 13.3% 至 EUR 299 million。High Value 产品占销售额的 82%，公司表示已取得约 200 项新的型号认证。价值重心持续向大尺寸高端产品和电动车型号认证迁移，在报告收入接近持平的情况下支撑了利润率。倍耐力的产品结构与型号认证储备强化了高端原配渠道的经济性，而汇率、治理以及型号认证能否转化为销量仍是风险。

title: Monro holds tire units flat as customers trade down
what_happened: Monro reported fiscal Q1 sales of USD 287.1 million, down 4.6 percent, and comparable sales at continuing stores down 1.7 percent. Tire comparable sales fell 1 percent while units were flat; management said customers deferred larger purchases and traded down, while lower-cost tier-four expansion and promotions supported unit volume. Affordability pressure is shifting replacement-tire demand toward value tiers and promotion-led unit retention in the U.S. service channel. The results provide a direct downstream read on consumer behavior, but the trade-down explanation is management commentary and profitability comparisons are affected by prior-year store closures.
title_zh: Monro 轮胎销量持平，消费者转向低价产品
what_happened_zh: Monro 报告其财年 Q1 销售额为 USD 287.1 million，下降 4.6%，持续经营门店的同店销售下降 1.7%。轮胎同店销售下降 1%，而销量持平；管理层称消费者推迟了较大金额的消费并转向低价产品，同时成本更低的四线品牌扩张和促销支撑了销量。可负担性压力正把替换轮胎需求推向价值档次，并在美国服务渠道中依靠促销维持销量。该业绩为消费者行为提供了直接的下游参照，但转向低价的解释属于管理层评论，且盈利对比受到上一年度门店关闭的影响。

title: Michelin lifts H1 operating income and cash flow despite OE weakness
what_happened: Michelin reported H1 revenue of EUR 12.7 billion, down 2.6 percent reported but up 0.5 percent at constant exchange rates; segment operating income reached EUR 1.45 billion at an 11.4 percent margin, and free cash flow before acquisitions improved to EUR 282 million. Replacement volumes rose while OE and Tier-3 demand declined, and the company reaffirmed its 2026 guidance. Premium replacement demand, mix management, and polymer-composite diversification are helping offset weaker original-equipment demand and adverse currency effects. The result indicates resilience in replacement tires and adjacent materials, but durability depends on second-half demand, currency, and acquisition integration.
title_zh: 米其林 H1 营业利润与现金流提升，尽管原配需求疲弱
what_happened_zh: 米其林报告 H1 营业收入为 EUR 12.7 billion，按报告口径下降 2.6%，但按固定汇率计算增长 0.5%；分部营业利润达到 EUR 1.45 billion，利润率为 11.4%，收购前自由现金流改善至 EUR 282 million。替换市场销量增长，而原配和 Tier-3 需求下降，公司重申了其 2026 年业绩指引。高端替换需求、产品结构管理以及聚合物复合材料业务多元化，正在帮助抵消原配需求走弱和不利的汇率影响。该业绩表明替换轮胎及相邻材料业务具有韧性，但其持续性取决于下半年需求、汇率和收购整合。

title: CRIA chair warns China's tire output-value growth is not restoring profit
companies: China Rubber Industry Association member companies
what_happened: In a July 29 interview, the association chair said data from 389 member companies for January through May showed gross output value up 4.39 percent while profit fell 8.97 percent. Tire export delivery value fell 4.3 percent, including 8.5 percent in May, even though the sector remained heavily export dependent. China's tire challenge is shifting from chasing scale to restoring price discipline and profit quality amid capacity, trade, procurement, and online-pricing pressure. The divergence between current-price output value and profit indicates that higher reported output value alone will not resolve low-price competition or improve returns on new capacity.
title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会会长警示：中国轮胎产值增长并未恢复利润
what_happened_zh: 在 7 月 29 日的一次访谈中，该协会会长表示，389 家会员企业 1 月至 5 月的数据显示，工业总产值增长 4.39%，而利润下降 8.97%。轮胎出口交货值下降 4.3%，其中 5 月下降 8.5%，尽管该行业仍高度依赖出口。中国轮胎业的挑战正从追求规模，转向在产能、贸易、采购和线上价格压力下恢复价格纪律与利润质量。按当期价格计算的产值与利润之间的背离说明，仅靠报告产值的提高并不能解决低价竞争，也不会改善新增产能的回报。

title: EU commercial-vehicle registrations rebound as electrified fleets gain share
what_happened: ACEA reported that first-half EU registrations rose 1.9 percent to 742,759 vans, 9.8 percent to 171,933 trucks, and 22.7 percent to 22,590 buses. Electrically chargeable registrations grew 41.6 percent for vans, 47.7 percent for trucks, and 56.8 percent for buses, while diesel still held 92.1 percent of the truck market. Commercial-vehicle demand is recovering from a low base while electrification gains share fastest in buses and remains early in heavier vehicles. A larger and increasingly electrified commercial-vehicle pipeline supports tire OE and replacement demand while raising the importance of load, torque, range, wear, and fleet-service performance; vehicle registrations are not the same as tire sales.
title_zh: 欧盟商用车注册量回升，电动化车队份额提升
what_happened_zh: ACEA 报告，上半年欧盟注册量中，货车增长 1.9% 至 742,759 辆，卡车增长 9.8% 至 171,933 辆，客车增长 22.7% 至 22,590 辆。可充电电动车型注册量中，货车增长 41.6%，卡车增长 47.7%，客车增长 56.8%，而柴油车仍占卡车市场的 92.1%。商用车需求正从低基数回升，电动化在客车领域份额提升最快，在更重车型上仍处于早期。规模更大、电动化程度更高的商用车保有量管道支撑轮胎原配和替换需求，同时提升了负荷、扭矩、续航、磨耗和车队服务表现的重要性；但车辆注册量并不等同于轮胎销量。

title: Nexen's Q2 revenue rises 10.8 percent as Europe tops KRW 400 billion
what_happened: Nexen Tire reported Q2 revenue of KRW 891.3 billion, up 10.8 percent year over year, and operating profit of KRW 34.3 billion. The company said quarterly European revenue exceeded KRW 400 billion for the first time, supported by OE expansion and replacement-market diversification. European growth, broader OE participation, and replacement-channel diversification are becoming central to Nexen's scale-up strategy. The European milestone shows geographic momentum, but modest operating-profit conversion means mix, tariffs, logistics, and pricing require continued scrutiny.
title_zh: Nexen Q2 营业收入增长 10.8%，欧洲收入突破 KRW 400 billion
what_happened_zh: Nexen Tire 报告 Q2 营业收入为 KRW 891.3 billion，同比增长 10.8%，营业利润为 KRW 34.3 billion。公司表示，季度欧洲营业收入首次超过 KRW 400 billion，得益于原配业务扩张和替换市场多元化。欧洲增长、更广泛的原配参与以及替换渠道多元化，正成为 Nexen 扩大规模战略的核心。欧洲里程碑显示了地域增长动能，但营业利润转化有限，意味着产品结构、关税、物流和定价仍需持续关注。

title: Titan raises Q2 sales and EBITDA while agriculture declines
what_happened: Titan reported Q2 net sales of USD 484 million, up 5.2 percent, adjusted EBITDA of USD 34 million, up 13.3 percent, and free cash flow of USD 26 million. Consumer segment sales rose 27 percent and Earthmoving/Construction rose 1.4 percent, while Agriculture declined 5 percent; the company reaffirmed full-year guidance. Off-highway suppliers are relying on portfolio diversification and consumer-channel growth to counter uneven agricultural-equipment demand. The mix shift and cash generation support near-term resilience, but weaker agriculture and company-defined adjusted measures limit how broadly the improvement can be read.
title_zh: Titan Q2 销售额与 EBITDA 提升，农业板块下滑
what_happened_zh: Titan 报告 Q2 净销售额为 USD 484 million，增长 5.2%，调整后 EBITDA 为 USD 34 million，增长 13.3%，自由现金流为 USD 26 million。消费板块销售额增长 27%，土方与工程机械板块增长 1.4%，而农业板块下降 5%；公司重申了全年业绩指引。非公路轮胎供应商正依靠产品组合多元化和消费渠道增长，来对冲农机需求的不均衡。产品结构转变与现金创造支撑了短期韧性，但农业板块走弱以及公司自定义的调整后指标，限制了这一改善可被推广解读的范围。

title: Continental receives Skoda Elroq OE approval for EcoContact 7
what_happened: Continental said its EcoContact 7 was approved as standard equipment for the all-electric Skoda Elroq, in 235/50 R20 front and 255/45 R20 rear sizes. EV programs continue to use model-specific tire tuning, energy-efficiency positioning, and differentiated front/rear sizing as OE selection criteria. The fitment expands Continental's exposure to European battery-electric OE programs, although performance and efficiency statements remain supplier claims.
title_zh: 大陆集团 EcoContact 7 获得 Skoda Elroq 原配认证
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团表示，其 EcoContact 7 已获批作为纯电动 Skoda Elroq 的原厂标准配套，前轮规格为 235/50 R20，后轮规格为 255/45 R20。电动车项目仍在把车型专属的轮胎调校、能效定位以及前后不同规格作为原配选择标准。该配套扩大了大陆集团在欧洲纯电原配项目中的参与，不过性能与能效表述仍属供应商主张。

title: SRI reports a 70% cut in material-search time from its AI-enabled tire-development platform
what_happened: SRI's R.I.S.E. 2035 progress report says its development platform now joins evaluation and simulation data with material-search and generative design tools. It reports a 70% reduction in candidate-material search time and development capacity at roughly 1.3 times its 2024 level. The claim connects a technical method to operating R&D work and flagship-product application. The report does not provide sample counts, model error, or an externally audited time study, so the figures remain company-reported. Watch for a product case with model accuracy, elapsed development time, prototype count, and a pre-platform baseline.
title_zh: 住友橡胶称其 AI 赋能的轮胎开发平台使材料检索时间减少 70%
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶的 R.I.S.E. 2035 进展报告称，其开发平台现已把评价与仿真数据同材料检索及生成式设计工具连接起来。报告称候选材料检索时间减少 70%，开发能力约为 2024 年水平的 1.3 倍。该主张把一种技术方法与正在运行的研发工作及旗舰产品应用联系起来。报告未提供样本数量、模型误差或经外部审计的时间研究，因此这些数字仍属公司自行报告。后续应关注一个产品案例，包含模型精度、实际开发耗时、原型数量以及平台应用前的基线。

title: Pirelli and Abet move Cyber Tyre sensing into a signed rescue-vehicle development program
what_happened: Pirelli and Abet High Tech Solutions signed an agreement to jointly develop remote-controlled electric ground-rescue vehicles. Pirelli will supply a dedicated Run Forward tire, Cyber Tyre sensing, and real-time data integration; the partners plan predictive models for onboard functions. This is a contracted development program rather than a concept-only demonstration, but the release gives no measured performance or baseline. Its value is the attempt to connect tire-state data directly to control of vehicles operating where human access is dangerous. Watch for a prototype test disclosing terrain, load, speed, failure criteria, and performance against a vehicle without Cyber Tyre.
title_zh: 倍耐力与 Abet 将 Cyber Tyre 传感技术纳入已签约的救援车辆开发项目
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力与 Abet High Tech Solutions 签署协议，将联合开发遥控电动地面救援车辆。倍耐力将提供专用的 Run Forward 轮胎、Cyber Tyre 传感技术以及实时数据集成；双方计划为车载功能开发预测模型。这是一个已签约的开发项目，而非仅停留在概念阶段的演示，但该发布未给出任何实测性能或基线。其价值在于尝试把轮胎状态数据直接用于控制那些在人员难以进入的危险环境中作业的车辆。后续应关注披露地形、载荷、速度、失效判据，以及与未配备 Cyber Tyre 车辆对比表现的原型测试。

title: A 3 phr graphene-oxide loading improves silica-filled SSBR strength in laboratory tests
companies: Qingdao University of Science and Technology and partners
what_happened: Researchers tested 0–6 phr graphene oxide in silica-filled solution-polymerized styrene-butadiene rubber and compared four hyperelastic models. At 3 phr, tensile strength rose 19.72% and elongation at break 19.87% against the graphene-oxide-free compound; an Ogden N=3 model gave the closest fit. The work couples a tread-compound formulation result with constitutive modeling that can support finite-element analysis. It remains laboratory evidence: no tire was built, and rolling resistance, wet grip, abrasion, durability, scale-up, and cost were not tested. Watch for a tire or tread prototype using the 3 phr formulation with abrasion, rolling-resistance, wet-grip, and aging results.
title_zh: 3 phr 氧化石墨烯添加量在实验室测试中提升白炭黑填充 SSBR 的强度
what_happened_zh: 研究人员在白炭黑填充的溶聚丁苯橡胶中测试了 0–6 phr 氧化石墨烯，并比较了四种超弹性模型。在 3 phr 时，相对不含氧化石墨烯的胶料，拉伸强度提高 19.72%，断裂伸长率提高 19.87%；Ogden N=3 模型拟合效果最佳。该研究把一项胎面胶配方结果与可支撑有限元分析的本构建模结合起来。这仍属实验室证据：没有制造轮胎，滚动阻力、湿地抓地力、耐磨性、耐久性、放大生产和成本均未经测试。后续应关注采用 3 phr 配方的轮胎或胎面原型，并给出耐磨、滚动阻力、湿地抓地力和老化结果。

title: Pirelli uses an all-virtual first design phase for six Porsche Cayenne Electric fitments
what_happened: Pirelli said it developed six marked fitments for the Porsche Cayenne Electric entirely in a virtual environment before producing physical prototypes. The set spans P Zero, P Zero R, winter, and all-season products, with separate front and rear compounds and contact-patch tuning. The release documents virtual development reaching a multi-season OE fitment portfolio, not just an isolated simulation study. The cited 0–100 km/h time of 2.5 seconds is a whole-vehicle result and cannot be attributed to the tire alone. Watch for Independent or standardized tire-level data for wet grip, rolling resistance, wear, and development-cycle reduction.
title_zh: 倍耐力为 Porsche Cayenne Electric 的六款配套轮胎采用全虚拟的首轮设计阶段
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力表示，其为 Porsche Cayenne Electric 开发的六款标记配套轮胎，在制作实物原型之前完全在虚拟环境中完成设计。该系列涵盖 P Zero、P Zero R、冬季和全季产品，前后轮采用不同配方并对接地印痕进行调校。该发布记录的是虚拟开发已延伸到跨季节的原配配套产品组合，而不只是一项孤立的仿真研究。所引用的 0–100 km/h 加速时间 2.5 秒属于整车结果，不能单独归因于轮胎。后续应关注独立或标准化的轮胎层面数据，涵盖湿地抓地力、滚动阻力、磨耗以及开发周期缩短。

title: Fuzhou team couples learned road-friction estimates with tire-force limits in HIL tests
companies: Fuzhou University; Xiamen Golden Dragon Bus
what_happened: Researchers combined a fuzzy broad learning system for real-time tire-road friction recognition with a square-root cubature Kalman filter for lateral-force estimation. The estimates dynamically constrain torque distribution inside a combined longitudinal–lateral tire-force boundary; numerical and hardware-in-the-loop tests reported improved stability, but the abstract provides no numerical effect size. The work moves a learned friction estimator beyond stand-alone prediction by connecting it to tire-force-constrained vehicle control. Hardware-in-the-loop validation and a bus-maker coauthor strengthen application relevance, but they do not establish road deployment or customer performance. Watch for Road and fleet trials with disclosed friction-estimation error, stability metrics, compute latency, failure behavior, and comparison against a production controller.

sources.publisher: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, Part D: Journal of Automobile Engineering
sources.link_label: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, Part D: Journal of Automobile Engineering

title_zh: 福州团队在 HIL 测试中把学习得到的路面摩擦估计与轮胎力极限耦合
what_happened_zh: 研究人员将用于实时识别轮胎与路面摩擦的模糊广义学习系统，与用于侧向力估计的平方根容积卡尔曼滤波相结合。这些估计值在纵向–侧向联合轮胎力边界内动态约束扭矩分配；数值仿真与硬件在环测试报告稳定性有所改善，但摘要未给出数值效果量。该工作把学习型摩擦估计器从单独预测推进到与受轮胎力约束的整车控制相连接。硬件在环验证以及一位客车制造商合著者增强了应用相关性，但二者并不能证明道路部署或客户实际表现。后续应关注道路与车队试验，并披露摩擦估计误差、稳定性指标、计算时延、失效行为，以及与量产控制器的对比。

title: Chinese researchers simplify a Stribeck-aware brush tire model while retaining test-data accuracy
companies: Beijing Institute of Technology; Hefei University of Technology
what_happened: Researchers derived a semi-physical brush tire model that separates dynamic-friction characteristics from the force and moment equations. Under typical load and speed ranges, the residual-force contribution reached about 3% and residual-moment contribution 10%; for the tested tire A, residual-force contribution stayed below 1.5% in pure longitudinal slip and below 3% in pure lateral slip. The simplification is intended to retain physical tire behavior with less complexity for high-precision, real-time force control. The evidence is bounded to the reported tire-force data and typical operating ranges, not yet a vehicle-control deployment. Watch for Real-time controller, hardware-in-the-loop, or vehicle validation across additional tires, road surfaces, and combined-slip conditions.
title_zh: 中国研究者在保留试验数据精度的同时简化了考虑 Stribeck 效应的刷子轮胎模型
what_happened_zh: 研究人员推导出一种半物理刷子轮胎模型，将动摩擦特性与力和力矩方程分离。在典型载荷与速度范围内，残余力贡献最高约 3%，残余力矩贡献为 10%；对于受测的 A 号轮胎，纯纵向滑移下残余力贡献低于 1.5%，纯侧向滑移下低于 3%。这一简化旨在以更低的复杂度保留轮胎的物理行为，用于高精度实时力控制。相关证据仅限于所报告的轮胎力数据和典型工况范围，尚未形成整车控制的实际部署。后续应关注实时控制器、硬件在环或整车验证，覆盖更多轮胎、路面和联合滑移工况。

title: Jilin framework uses tire capacity to adapt trajectory and stability control in co-simulation
companies: Jilin University State Key Laboratory of Automotive Chassis Integration and Bionics
what_happened: A Jilin University team proposed a stability framework that combines tire capacity and slip angle, dynamically adjusts the stability boundary without requiring friction-coefficient estimation, and coordinates trajectory tracking with stability control. CarSim–Simulink co-simulation reported accurate tracking, smoother control action, lower tire-saturation risk, and tire capacity kept within a safe region. The framework addresses a gap in vehicle-level stability indices that can appear acceptable while individual tires approach saturation. Results remain simulation evidence: the abstract reports no numerical improvement and no hardware or road validation. Watch for Hardware-in-the-loop and vehicle tests with disclosed trajectory error, control effort, saturation margin, and road-friction transitions.

sources.link_label: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, Part D: Journal of Automobile Engineering

title_zh: 吉林团队的框架在联合仿真中利用轮胎能力自适应协调轨迹跟踪与稳定性控制
what_happened_zh: 吉林大学团队提出一种稳定性框架，将轮胎能力与侧偏角结合，在无需估计摩擦系数的情况下动态调整稳定性边界，并协调轨迹跟踪与稳定性控制。CarSim–Simulink 联合仿真报告了精确的轨迹跟踪、更平滑的控制动作、更低的轮胎饱和风险，以及始终保持在安全区域内的轮胎能力。该框架针对的是整车层面稳定性指标存在的一处缺口：在单个轮胎接近饱和时，这些指标仍可能显示为可接受。结果仍属仿真证据：摘要未报告数值改进，也没有硬件或道路验证。后续应关注硬件在环与整车试验，并披露轨迹误差、控制量、饱和裕度以及路面摩擦突变工况。

title: Cabot's carbon-black volumes rise 5% while 2026 customer agreements compress unit margins
what_happened: Cabot's SEC-filed quarterly release says Reinforcement Materials volumes rose 5% year over year, including 10% in Asia-Pacific and 4% in the Americas, while segment EBIT fell 24% to $97 million. It attributes lower gross profit per ton principally to 2026 customer agreements. Higher physical volume alongside weaker unit economics shows that demand and supplier profitability are moving differently. Added Indonesian capacity and the Mexico acquisition supported volume, while rising raw-material costs also increased working capital. Watch for the next quarter's reinforcement-materials margin per ton, regional volume, and contract-price response to raw-material inflation.

title_zh: Cabot 炭黑销量增长 5%，而 2026 年客户协议压缩单位利润
what_happened_zh: Cabot 向美国证券交易委员会提交的季度公告称，增强材料业务销量同比增长 5%，其中亚太地区增长 10%、美洲地区增长 4%，而该分部 EBIT 下降 24% 至 $97 million。公司将每吨毛利下降主要归因于 2026 年客户协议。实物销量上升与单位经济性走弱并存，说明需求与供应商盈利能力正朝不同方向变动。印度尼西亚新增产能和墨西哥收购支撑了销量，同时原材料成本上升也增加了营运资金占用。后续应关注下一季度增强材料业务的每吨利润、各地区销量，以及合同价格对原材料通胀的反应。

title: Continental warns of a second-half raw-material cost reversal after stronger tire margins
what_happened: Continental reported first-half results showing its Tires business benefited from raw-material effects and a higher share of 18-inch-and-larger products. Management said raw-material costs are expected to rise substantially in the second half. The warning changes the near-term cost picture for tire manufacturing after input benefits supported the first-half margin. The release does not isolate the amount by natural rubber, synthetic rubber, carbon black, or other input. Watch for Second-half tire margin and any quantified split of natural-rubber, synthetic-rubber, carbon-black, energy, freight, and tariff effects.
title_zh: 大陆集团警告：在轮胎利润率改善之后，下半年原材料成本将出现反转
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团公布的上半年业绩显示，其轮胎业务受益于原材料因素以及 18-inch 及以上规格产品占比提升。管理层表示，预计下半年原材料成本将大幅上升。在投入成本红利支撑上半年利润率之后，这一警告改变了轮胎制造的近期成本图景。该发布没有按天然橡胶、合成橡胶、炭黑或其他投入分别列出具体金额。后续应关注下半年轮胎利润率，以及天然橡胶、合成橡胶、炭黑、能源、运费和关税影响的量化拆分。

title: Five-percent sawdust keeps reclaimed-rubber properties within specification and cuts modeled factory cost
what_happened: A peer-reviewed study blended 0–20 wt% wood sawdust into whole-truck-tire reclaimed rubber under factory conditions. At 5 wt%, it reported 4.4 MPa tensile strength, 148.7% elongation, Shore A hardness of 63.5, less than 4% Mooney-viscosity growth, 8% seven-day water absorption, and a modeled annual cost reduction of about $62,000 without new capital equipment. The work adds factory-scale economics to mechanical screening of a low-cost circular filler. Its demonstrated use is reclaimed-rubber goods, not a new-tire compound, and long-term aging, fatigue, and weathering remain untested. Watch for Independent production batches plus aging, dynamic-fatigue, weathering, and customer-qualification results for the 5 wt% formulation.
title_zh: 百分之五木屑可使再生橡胶性能保持在规格范围内并降低模型测算的工厂成本
what_happened_zh: 一项同行评议研究在工厂条件下将 0–20 wt% 木屑混入整条卡车轮胎再生橡胶中。在 5 wt% 时，研究报告拉伸强度 4.4 MPa、伸长率 148.7%、邵氏 A 硬度 63.5、门尼粘度增幅低于 4%、七天吸水率 8%，并在不新增资本设备的情况下测算出年度成本下降约 $62,000。该研究为这种低成本循环填料的力学筛选补充了工厂规模的经济性分析。其已验证的用途是再生橡胶制品，而非新胎胶料，长期老化、疲劳和耐候性仍未经测试。后续应关注独立生产批次，以及 5 wt% 配方的老化、动态疲劳、耐候和客户认证结果。

title: Southwest China model identifies a 4.8–5.0% rubber-plantation water reduction with trade-offs
companies: Yunnan University; Kunming University; Yunnan Academy of Agricultural Sciences
what_happened: Researchers embedded age-dependent crop coefficients derived from Bowen ratio–energy balance measurements in an NSGA-III water–carbon–economy optimization, generated wet-, normal-, and dry-year Pareto fronts, and ranked 500 non-dominated solutions. Estimated annual ecological water requirement was 871.3–1098.4 mm with dry-season deficits; selected optimization schemes reduced modeled water requirement 4.8–5.0% across hydrological years. The model quantifies water constraints and management trade-offs in a major Chinese natural-rubber region, making plantation resilience a supply-chain variable. These are modeled Pareto outcomes, not measured reductions from an implemented plantation program. Watch for Prospective plantation trials comparing modeled and observed water use, carbon, yield, farmer economics, and drought resilience over multiple hydrological years.
title_zh: 中国西南地区模型测算出橡胶种植园 4.8–5.0% 的需水下降及其权衡
what_happened_zh: 研究人员把由波文比与能量平衡观测推导的随树龄变化的作物系数嵌入 NSGA-III 水–碳–经济优化，生成湿润年、正常年和干旱年的帕累托前沿，并对 500 个非支配解进行排序。估算的年生态需水量为 871.3–1098.4 mm，且旱季存在亏缺；所选优化方案在各水文年份使模型测算的需水量下降 4.8–5.0%。该模型量化了中国一个主要天然橡胶产区的水资源约束与管理权衡，使种植园韧性成为供应链变量。这些是模型得出的帕累托结果，而非某个已实施种植园项目的实测下降量。后续应关注前瞻性的种植园试验，在多个水文年份比较模型与实测的用水量、碳、产量、农户经济性和抗旱能力。

title: China confirms a new rubber-tree stem and leaf pathogen and screens metalaxyl response
what_happened: Field surveys in Yunnan and Hainan found brown, water-soaked necrotic lesions on tender rubber-tree stems and leaves. Researchers identified Phytopythium vexans through morphology and ITS, LSU, coxI, and coxII sequencing, fulfilled Koch’s postulates on seedlings, and found metalaxyl had the strongest in-vitro inhibition, with EC50 values as low as 0.04 μg/mL. This first reported association creates a new diagnosis and surveillance target for China’s natural-rubber supply base. Seedling pathogenicity and laboratory fungicide sensitivity do not yet establish plantation incidence, yield loss, or field-control performance. Watch for Plantation-scale incidence surveys, isolate diversity, mature-tree yield effects, resistance monitoring, and replicated field-control trials.
title_zh: 中国确认一种新的橡胶树茎叶病原菌并筛选甲霜灵的抑制效果
what_happened_zh: 在云南和海南的田间调查中，发现橡胶树嫩茎和叶片上出现褐色、水渍状坏死病斑。研究人员通过形态学以及 ITS、LSU、coxI 和 coxII 测序鉴定出 Phytopythium vexans，在幼苗上完成了柯赫氏法则验证，并发现甲霜灵的离体抑制作用最强，EC50 值低至 0.04 μg/mL。这一首次报道的关联，为中国天然橡胶供应基础带来了新的诊断与监测对象。幼苗致病性和实验室杀菌剂敏感性尚不能确定种植园发病率、产量损失或田间防治效果。后续应关注种植园规模的发病率调查、菌株多样性、成龄树产量影响、抗性监测以及重复性田间防治试验。

title: Thermo-oxidative aging shifts the Payne effect in carbon-black-filled rubber
companies: Hunan University of Science and Technology
what_happened: Researchers combined accelerated thermo-oxidative aging, equilibrium swelling, and dynamic mechanical analysis of carbon-black-filled rubber across multiple temperatures. Fitting the Payne effect with the Maier–Göritz model produced network-density trends that agreed qualitatively with swelling-based crosslink-density trends as aging temperature and time increased. The agreement offers a route to connect dynamic mechanical response with network evolution in aged filled rubber, relevant to service-life modeling. The accessible abstract provides no tire compound, field exposure, component-fatigue result, or numerical prediction accuracy. Watch for Validation on tire compounds and components under combined oxygen, heat, cyclic strain, and real service histories, with quantitative life-prediction error.
title_zh: 热氧老化改变炭黑填充橡胶的 Payne 效应
what_happened_zh: 研究人员将加速热氧老化、平衡溶胀与动态力学分析相结合，在多个温度下考察炭黑填充橡胶。用 Maier–Göritz 模型拟合 Payne 效应得到的网络密度趋势，与基于溶胀的交联密度趋势在老化温度和时间上升时呈现定性一致。这种一致性为把动态力学响应与老化填充橡胶中的网络演化联系起来提供了途径，与使用寿命建模相关。可获取的摘要未提供轮胎胶料、现场暴露、部件疲劳结果或数值预测精度。后续应关注在氧、热、循环应变和真实使用历程共同作用下对轮胎胶料与部件的验证，并给出定量的寿命预测误差。

title: Fine rubber aggregate raises damping ratio 110% in Chinese mass-concrete tests
companies: Anhui and Huaihe River Institute of Hydraulic Research and partner
what_happened: Researchers replaced 5%, 10%, or 20% of sand with 40- or 100-mesh rubber aggregate and combined mechanical, thermal, dynamic, FTIR, pore-structure, and nanoindentation tests. The maximum damping ratio rose from 1.43% to 3.01%, adiabatic temperature rise fell 32%, and linear expansion coefficient fell 88%; the recommended 20% fine-rubber mix reached 26.6 MPa at 90 days. The results quantify a non-tire downstream application for rubber aggregate where damping and thermal-crack mitigation are valued alongside adequate strength. The study does not establish the rubber’s feedstock origin, field durability, lifecycle benefit, leaching behavior, or commercial adoption. Watch for Full-scale mass-concrete demonstrations with feedstock traceability, fatigue and aging, bond durability, leaching, lifecycle assessment, and installed cost.
title_zh: 细橡胶集料在中国大体积混凝土试验中使阻尼比提高 110%
what_happened_zh: 研究人员以 40 目或 100 目橡胶集料替代 5%、10% 或 20% 的砂，并结合力学、热学、动力学、FTIR、孔结构和纳米压痕测试。最大阻尼比由 1.43% 升至 3.01%，绝热温升下降 32%，线膨胀系数下降 88%；推荐的 20% 细橡胶配比在 90 天时达到 26.6 MPa。该结果量化了橡胶集料在轮胎之外的一种下游应用，在这类应用中，阻尼和温度裂缝控制与足够的强度同样受到重视。该研究未确定橡胶的原料来源、现场耐久性、全生命周期收益、浸出行为或商业化应用情况。后续应关注全尺寸大体积混凝土示范工程，涵盖原料可追溯性、疲劳与老化、粘结耐久性、浸出、生命周期评价和安装成本。

title: SRI's Miyazaki AI maintenance trial cuts reported repair time from 81 to 43 minutes
what_happened: SRI reported a Miyazaki-factory demonstration in which a system joining equipment and maintenance data suggested repair methods. Maintenance time fell from 81 to 43 minutes and analysis time from 545 to 120 minutes. The case supplies a factory baseline and measured operating result, which many industrial-AI announcements omit. It is still a company-reported pilot; the report does not disclose the number of incidents, equipment classes, false recommendations, or sustained uptime effect. Watch for a multi-line rollout with incident count, recurrence rate, recommendation accuracy, downtime avoided, and evidence from an external manufacturer.
title_zh: 住友橡胶宫崎工厂 AI 维护试点将报告的维修时间从 81 分钟降至 43 分钟
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶报告了在宫崎工厂的一次示范：一套整合设备与维护数据的系统给出维修方法建议。维护时间从 81 分钟降至 43 分钟，分析时间从 545 分钟降至 120 分钟。该案例提供了工厂基线和实测运行结果，而许多工业 AI 公告并不提供这些内容。这仍是公司自行报告的试点；报告未披露故障次数、设备类别、错误建议情况或持续的设备可用率影响。后续应关注多生产线推广，并给出故障次数、复发率、建议准确率、避免的停机时间，以及来自外部制造商的证据。

title: China-led review finds digital twins promising but still under-validated for rubber extrusion
what_happened: A structured critical narrative review synthesized 180 sources from 1972–2026 and identified five persistent rubber-extrusion gaps: formulation-dependent nonlinear rheology, incomplete filler-network and wall-slip representation, limited cross-machine and cross-formulation validation, computational cost, and missing standard datasets and reporting protocols. It judged digital twins, physics-informed neural networks, and neural operators promising but insufficiently validated for industrial rubber extrusion. The review turns enthusiasm for data-enabled extrusion into a validation roadmap focused on benchmarks, uncertainty, latency, multimodal sensing, and transferability. It is a synthesis, not evidence that a digital twin has improved a production line. Open benchmark datasets and factory trials reporting cross-formulation transfer, latency, uncertainty, quality yield, energy use, and downtime against current controls.
title_zh: 中国主导的综述认为数字孪生前景可期，但在橡胶挤出中仍缺乏充分验证
what_happened_zh: 一篇结构化的批判性叙述综述综合了 1972–2026 年的 180 篇文献，识别出橡胶挤出领域五个长期存在的缺口：依赖配方的非线性流变行为、填料网络与壁面滑移表征不完整、跨设备与跨配方验证有限、计算成本高，以及缺少标准数据集和报告规范。综述认为数字孪生、物理信息神经网络和神经算子前景可期，但对工业橡胶挤出而言验证尚不充分。该综述把对数据驱动挤出的热情转化为一份验证路线图，聚焦基准测试、不确定性、时延、多模态传感和可迁移性。它是一项综合研究，而不是数字孪生已改善某条生产线的证据。后续应关注开放基准数据集和工厂试验，报告跨配方迁移、时延、不确定性、质量合格率、能耗，以及相对现有控制方式的停机时间。

title: Goodyear sets an August 15 public opening for its first Motor City Garage retail concept
what_happened: Goodyear announced its first Motor City Garage in Detroit, combining a branded retail location with its Mobile Garage service. The company set the public opening for August 15, after this reporting window. The site is a concrete channel experiment linking fixed retail and mobile installation under one concept. The August 3 disclosure did not provide investment, capacity, expected traffic, conversion, or plans for a second location. Watch for Opening-date confirmation and later disclosure of service volume, customer mix, mobile-versus-store usage, and replication beyond Detroit.
title_zh: 固特异将其首个 Motor City Garage 零售概念店的公开开业定在 8 月 15 日
what_happened_zh: 固特异宣布在底特律设立其首个 Motor City Garage，把品牌零售门店与自有的 Mobile Garage 服务结合在一起。公司将公开开业定于 8 月 15 日，晚于本报告期。该门店是把固定零售与移动安装纳入同一概念的具体渠道试验。8 月 3 日的披露没有提供投资额、服务能力、预期客流、转化率或第二家门店的计划。后续应关注开业日期确认，以及之后披露的服务量、客户结构、移动服务与门店使用对比，以及在底特律之外的复制情况。

title: Goodyear's Q2 shows replacement weakness beside OE growth and an Asia-Pacific recovery
what_happened: Goodyear reported tire volume of 36.5 million units, down 4.0% year over year but improved from a 12% decline in Q1. Americas replacement volume fell 13% while OE rose 8.7%; EMEA replacement fell 7.1% while OE rose 8.3%; Asia-Pacific replacement and OE volumes rose 6.4% and 4.2%, respectively, led by China and Japan. The regional split shows that total volume masks sharply different demand channels. Goodyear says OE share grew in every region, while replacement pressure remained concentrated in the Americas and EMEA. Watch for Third-quarter replacement volume in the Americas and EMEA, and whether Asia-Pacific's China- and Japan-led recovery persists.
title_zh: 固特异 Q2 显示替换市场疲弱，同时原配增长、亚太复苏
what_happened_zh: 固特异报告轮胎销量 36.5 million 条，同比下降 4.0%，但好于 Q1 的 12% 降幅。美洲替换市场销量下降 13%，原配增长 8.7%；EMEA 替换市场下降 7.1%，原配增长 8.3%；亚太替换与原配销量分别增长 6.4% 和 4.2%，由中国和日本带动。这一区域拆分说明，总销量掩盖了差异显著的需求渠道。固特异称各地区原配份额均有提升，而替换市场压力仍集中在美洲和 EMEA。后续应关注美洲和 EMEA 的第三季度替换市场销量，以及亚太由中国和日本带动的复苏能否持续。

title: Bridgestone outgrows weak North American replacement demand while China OE and India replacement sales advance
what_happened: Bridgestone's first-half presentation indexed North American passenger replacement demand at 92 versus the prior year and its sales at 97; truck-and-bus demand was 88 and its sales 99. It also reported passenger OE growth in China, replacement growth in India, and continued premium-tire expansion in Europe. The indexed comparison supports a bounded share-gain inference in a weak North American market and shows different demand engines in China and India. It does not disclose absolute units for the indexed North American series. Watch for Second-half indexed demand and sales, plus whether more than ¥60 billion of estimated Middle East-related raw-material and other cost pressure changes pricing or mix.
title_zh: 普利司通跑赢疲弱的北美替换市场需求，同时中国原配与印度替换市场销量增长
what_happened_zh: 普利司通的上半年演示材料将北美乘用车替换市场需求以上年为基准指数化为 92，其自身销量为 97；卡客车需求为 88，其销量为 99。公司还报告了中国乘用车原配增长、印度替换市场增长，以及欧洲高端轮胎业务持续扩张。这一指数化对比支持在疲弱的北美市场中作出有限度的份额提升推断，并显示中国与印度存在不同的需求驱动力。该材料未披露指数化北美数据对应的绝对数量。后续应关注下半年的指数化需求与销量，以及预计超过 ¥60 billion 的中东相关原材料及其他成本压力是否会改变定价或产品结构。

title: European replacement demand rises in Q2 as all-season and truck tires lead
what_happened: European Rubber Journal reported Tyres Europe data showing Q2 consumer replacement shipments up 3% to 51.978 million units and truck-and-bus shipments up 13% to 2.704 million. All-season consumer shipments rose 15%, while agricultural tire shipments fell 7%. The segment detail distinguishes a broad replacement recovery from uniform strength: all-season and truck categories drove growth while agriculture contracted. The accessible source is a trade-publication account of association data rather than the association's original table. Watch for Tyres Europe's next published table and whether import growth changes member shipments, especially in all-season and truck categories.

sources.link_label: European Rubber Journal, citing Tyres Europe

title_zh: 欧洲替换市场需求在 Q2 回升，全季与卡客车轮胎领涨
what_happened_zh: European Rubber Journal 报道的 Tyres Europe 数据显示，Q2 乘用替换市场出货量增长 3% 至 51.978 million 条，卡客车出货量增长 13% 至 2.704 million 条。全季乘用轮胎出货量增长 15%，而农业轮胎出货量下降 7%。这一细分数据把广泛的替换市场复苏与各类别一致走强区分开来：全季和卡客车类别推动增长，农业轮胎则在收缩。可获取的来源是行业媒体对协会数据的报道，而非协会原始数据表。后续应关注 Tyres Europe 下一期公布的数据表，以及进口增长是否会改变成员企业出货量，特别是在全季和卡客车类别中。

title: Cord-rubber fatigue study finds static tensile strength is a poor life predictor
companies: Opole University of Technology and University of Ljubljana
what_happened: Fully reversed three-point bending tests showed plus/minus 45-degree layups outlasted 0/90-degree designs under strain control. Walker-model sensitivity shifted from maximum strain in single-layer systems to strain amplitude in double layers, and extra rubber thickness helped single layers but hurt double layers. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The result challenges simple strength-based design rules for tire-relevant laminates and supplies model parameters for architecture-specific fatigue design, but it is not a finished-tire durability trial. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: 帘线-橡胶疲劳研究发现静态拉伸强度不是良好的寿命预测指标
what_happened_zh: 完全反向的三点弯曲试验表明，在应变控制条件下，±45 度铺层的寿命长于 0/90 度设计。Walker 模型的敏感性在单层体系中取决于最大应变，在双层体系中则转为应变幅值；增加橡胶厚度对单层有利，对双层不利。产品开发正朝着面向具体应用的性能表现和更快的验证推进。该结果对轮胎相关层压结构中基于强度的简单设计规则提出了挑战，并为特定结构的疲劳设计提供了模型参数，但它不是成品轮胎的耐久性试验。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: Numerical acoustic transfer functions reproduce indoor and outdoor tire-noise tests
what_happened: The team modelled acoustic transfer functions for equivalent monopole sources in indoor and outdoor tire-test environments, validated them against measurements and then compared predicted coast-by levels with experimental data. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. A validated numerical transfer path can reduce repeated acoustic measurement effort in tire development, but the abstract does not disclose a universal error bound or production-program cycle-time result. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
