title_zh: 数值声学传递函数再现室内与室外轮胎噪声试验
what_happened_zh: 该团队为室内和室外轮胎试验环境中的等效单极子声源建立了声学传递函数模型，用实测数据加以验证，再将预测的滑行通过噪声水平与试验数据进行比较。产品开发正朝着面向具体应用的性能表现和更快的验证推进。经验证的数值传递路径可以减少轮胎开发中重复的声学测量工作，但摘要没有公布普适的误差范围，也没有给出量产项目的开发周期结果。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: Liquid-crystal domains make nitrile elastomer stiffen sixfold with loading frequency
what_happened: A phase-separated carboxylated nitrile rubber with liquid-crystalline domains increased modulus 6.2-fold from 0.01 to 100 Hz versus about 2.2-fold for neat XNBR. The authors also report 77.4% less abrasive mass loss, 83.7% less repeated-impact damage and more than 30,000 notch-loading cycles. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. Frequency-adaptive reinforcement could protect dynamically loaded rubber components without permanently raising low-speed stiffness, but the evidence is at material-specimen rather than tire-component scale. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: 液晶微区使丁腈弹性体刚度随加载频率提高六倍
what_happened_zh: 一种带有液晶微区的相分离羧基丁腈橡胶，在 0.01 至 100 Hz 区间内的模量增长倍数达到 6.2，而纯 XNBR 约为 2.2。作者还报告磨耗质量损失减少 77.4%、反复冲击损伤减少 83.7%，缺口加载循环超过 30,000 次。产品开发正朝着面向具体应用的性能表现和更快的验证推进。频率自适应增强有望在不长期提高低速刚度的前提下保护动态受载的橡胶部件，但相关证据仍停留在材料试样尺度，而非轮胎部件尺度。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: Four Chinese tire-test standards reach approval-draft consultation
what_happened: CRIA opened consultation on approval drafts for a vehicle-method passenger-tire debeading test after rapid deflation, calibration tires and quality grading for truck-tire out-of-roundness equipment, and indoor reliability testing of objects attached to wheel-tire assemblies. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The package moves safety and measurement methods toward standardized industry use, but consultation drafts are not yet final standards and public evidence does not show adoption by makers or regulators. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: 四项中国轮胎试验标准进入报批稿征求意见阶段
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会（CRIA）就报批稿公开征求意见，内容涵盖快速失压后乘用车轮胎脱圈的整车试验方法、载重轮胎不圆度检测设备用标准轮胎与质量分级，以及车轮-轮胎总成附加物的室内可靠性试验。产品开发正朝着面向具体应用的性能表现和更快的验证推进。这组标准推动安全与测量方法走向行业标准化应用，但征求意见稿尚不是正式标准，公开证据也未显示制造商或监管机构已经采用。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: N330 outperforms N550 in a 75:25 NR/SBR laboratory tread compound
what_happened: At fixed 50 phr carbon black, the 75:25 natural-rubber/SBR blend filled with N330 exceeded its N550 counterpart in tensile strength, modulus, elongation, toughness, tear strength and hardness by 17.53%, 5.5%, 13.42%, 43.29%, 46.3% and 22.2%, respectively. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The study quantifies filler-grade effects in a tire-tread formulation, while laboratory mechanical gains do not by themselves establish wear, wet grip or rolling resistance in a finished tire. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: 在 75:25 的 NR/SBR 实验室胎面胶料中 N330 表现优于 N550
what_happened_zh: 在炭黑用量固定为 50 phr 的条件下，以 N330 填充的 75:25 天然橡胶/SBR 共混胶料在拉伸强度、模量、伸长率、韧性、撕裂强度和硬度上分别比对应的 N550 胶料高出 17.53%、5.5%、13.42%、43.29%、46.3% 和 22.2%。产品开发正朝着面向具体应用的性能表现和更快的验证推进。该研究量化了填料牌号在胎面配方中的作用，而实验室力学性能的提升本身并不能确立成品轮胎的磨耗、湿地抓地力或滚动阻力。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

what_happened: Westlake said it would present a second-generation commercial-vehicle tire range at IAA Transportation in September. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The preview signals product positioning, but the tires had not yet been publicly demonstrated and no independent test protocol or customer deployment was disclosed. This is an event preview; launch specifications, test data and market availability were not yet public. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: Westlake 为 9 月 IAA 展会预告 Gen II 商用车轮胎产品线
what_happened_zh: Westlake 表示将在 9 月的 IAA Transportation 展会上展出第二代商用车轮胎产品线。产品开发正朝着面向具体应用的性能表现和更快的验证推进。该预告显示了产品定位，但这些轮胎尚未公开展示，也没有披露独立测试方案或客户应用。这属于展会预告；上市规格、测试数据和市场供货情况尚未公开。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: Pirelli-Abet uncrewed rescue project resurfaces inside target window
what_happened: Tyrepress republished the Pirelli-Abet collaboration on tires and materials for remotely operated rescue vehicles after the origin family had already been covered in the August 3-9 edition. Product development is moving toward application-specific performance and faster validation. The item is retained to prevent a false new-story classification; it adds no new prototype test, customer or deployment stage. This origin family was already covered in the August 3-9 edition; no new execution stage is disclosed here. Watch for independent performance data, size expansion or a named commercial fitment.
title_zh: 倍耐力与 Abet 的无人救援项目在目标报告期内再次出现
what_happened_zh: Tyrepress 重新发布了倍耐力与 Abet Laminati 面向远程操作救援车辆的轮胎与材料合作，而该来源族此前已在 8 月 3-9 日那一期中报道过。产品开发正朝着面向具体应用的性能表现和更快的验证推进。保留该条目是为了避免被错误归类为新内容；它没有增加新的样品测试、客户或部署阶段。该来源族已在 8 月 3-9 日那一期中报道；此处未披露新的执行阶段。后续应关注独立性能数据、规格扩展或具名的商业配套。

title: China-wide model maps three decades of tire-derived 6PPD emissions and fate
companies: South China Normal University research team
what_happened: Researchers estimated tire-wear 6PPD emissions across 333 Chinese prefecture-level cities and 58 secondary river basins. Modelled national emissions rose from 0.0064 Mt in 2000 to 0.045 Mt in 2020; rural roads supplied 56.5% and soil received 57.0% of the environmental loading. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The work turns 6PPD from a localized water-quality issue into a national road, soil and watershed exposure map, but its projections remain model-based and do not substitute for basin-by-basin monitoring. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 全国尺度模型刻画三十年间轮胎来源 6PPD 的排放与归趋
what_happened_zh: 研究团队估算了中国 333 个地级市和 58 个二级流域的轮胎磨损 6PPD 排放量。模型显示，全国排放量从 2000 年的 0.0064 Mt 上升至 2020 年的 0.045 Mt；其中农村公路贡献了 56.5%，土壤承接了环境负荷的 57.0%。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。这项工作把 6PPD 从局部水质问题扩展为覆盖全国道路、土壤与流域的暴露图景，但其预测仍以模型为基础，不能替代逐流域的实测监测。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Solar UV changes the toxicity profile of tire-wear leachate in two estuarine fish species
companies: University of Texas at Austin and collaborators
what_happened: A factorial exposure study compared tire-wear-particle leachate under indoor light and simulated solar UV-A in early-life red drum and southern flounder. Red drum mortality rose independently with dose and UV, while southern flounder were sensitive regardless of UV; sublethal growth and edema effects differed by species. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The work shows that tire-wear risk assessment can miss phototoxic pathways in sunny nursery habitats, but it does not isolate a single causal chemical or establish field population effects. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 太阳紫外线改变轮胎磨损浸出液对两种河口鱼类的毒性特征
what_happened_zh: 一项全因子暴露研究比较了室内光照和模拟太阳 UV-A 条件下轮胎磨损颗粒浸出液对早期生活史阶段红鼓鱼和南方牙鲆的影响。红鼓鱼的死亡率随剂量和紫外线独立升高，而南方牙鲆无论有无紫外线都表现敏感；亚致死的生长和水肿效应在物种间存在差异。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。这项工作表明，轮胎磨损风险评估可能遗漏阳光充足育幼栖息地中的光毒性途径，但它没有分离出单一的致因化学物质，也没有确立野外种群层面的效应。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Pre-adsorption cuts scrap-tire devulcanization time and energy by more than half
what_happened: Pre-soaking scrap-tire rubber with TMTD before open-mill processing achieved devulcanization in 21.5 minutes using 24.04 million joules, versus 57-60 minutes and more than 63 million joules for conventional batches. The recovered rubber reached 8.31 MPa tensile strength and 176% elongation. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The process directly targets recycling energy and polymer-backbone damage, but solvent handling, recovery, continuous throughput and economics remain unproven at industrial scale. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 预吸附使废胎脱硫的时间和能耗减少一半以上
what_happened_zh: 在开炼机加工前用 TMTD 对废胎橡胶进行预浸渍，使脱硫在 21.5 分钟内完成、能耗为 24.04 million 焦耳，而常规批次需要 57-60 分钟和超过 63 million 焦耳。回收胶的拉伸强度达到 8.31 MPa，伸长率为 176%。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。该工艺直接针对回收能耗和聚合物主链损伤，但溶剂处理、回收、连续产能和经济性在工业规模上仍未得到验证。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Chinese natural-rubber price reaches CNY16,830 per tonne as tire cost pressure persists
companies: China tire and rubber supply chain
what_happened: An in-window Chinese market snapshot put natural rubber at CNY16,830 per tonne on August 10, with steel-cord pricing broadly stable and carbon-black conditions still transmitting upstream cost pressure into tire economics. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The data provide a dated input-cost signal for Chinese producers, but they are a secondary market snapshot rather than audited procurement prices for any named company. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 中国天然橡胶价格达到 CNY16,830 每吨，轮胎成本压力持续
what_happened_zh: 一份报告期内的中国市场快照显示，8 月 10 日天然橡胶价格为 CNY16,830 每吨，钢丝帘线价格大体稳定，炭黑行情仍在把上游成本压力传导到轮胎经济性之中。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。这些数据为中国生产企业提供了有明确日期的投入成本信号，但它们属于二手市场快照，而不是任何具名公司经审计的采购价格。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Qingdao team cuts modeled rolling-resistance indicator with deep-eutectic solvent modified sepiolite
companies: Qingdao University of Science and Technology
what_happened: A ternary choline-chloride, glycerol and aspartic-acid deep-eutectic solvent improved sepiolite dispersion in natural rubber. At 2 phr, the paper reports tensile strength of 20.15 MPa and a 54% reduction in its rolling-resistance indicator versus unmodified sepiolite/NR, alongside shorter cure time and better aging resistance. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The Shandong work offers a low-dose interface treatment for mineral-filled natural-rubber compounds, but compound-level dynamic-mechanical results are not a complete tire rolling-resistance test. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 青岛团队以低共熔溶剂改性海泡石降低模型计算的滚动阻力指标
what_happened_zh: 一种由氯化胆碱、甘油和天冬氨酸组成的三元低共熔溶剂改善了海泡石在天然橡胶中的分散。论文称，在 2 phr 用量下，拉伸强度达到 20.15 MPa，滚动阻力指标相对未改性海泡石/NR 体系下降 54%，同时硫化时间缩短、耐老化性能更好。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。这项山东的工作为矿物填充天然橡胶胶料提供了一种低用量的界面处理方法，但胶料层面的动态力学结果并不等于完整的轮胎滚动阻力测试。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Waterborne natural-rubber bioelastomer recovers more than 92% of strength and toughness after healing
what_happened: A cellulose-nanofibre and ZnO interfacial-reinforcement strategy produced natural-rubber-latex bioelastomers with 9.68 MPa tensile strength, 15.30 MJ/m3 toughness and, after 48 hours at room temperature, 96.9% strength and 92.8% toughness recovery; fracture energy reached 32.5 kJ/m2. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The waterborne route shows a strong multi-property package without solvent processing, but the target applications are broad and no tire compound or manufacturing qualification was reported. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 水性天然橡胶生物弹性体在自修复后强度与韧性恢复超过 92%
what_happened_zh: 一种纤维素纳米纤维与 ZnO 界面增强策略制备出天然胶乳生物弹性体，拉伸强度为 9.68 MPa，韧性为 15.30 MJ/m3，在室温下放置 48 小时后强度恢复 96.9%、韧性恢复 92.8%，断裂能达到 32.5 kJ/m2。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。这条水性路线在不使用溶剂加工的条件下展现出很强的综合性能组合，但目标应用范围宽泛，且未报告任何轮胎胶料或制造认证。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Large waste-tire rubber particles create temperature-adaptive damping in asphalt
what_happened: Researchers compared conventional AC-16 asphalt with AC-16-4 containing 4-mesh waste-tire rubber using accelerated loading, Burgers modelling, frequency analysis and molecular dynamics. The rubber mix showed stronger damping over 0-20 C and the study connected interfacial anchoring with chain mobility and energy dissipation. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The multiscale mechanism strengthens the case for higher-value waste-tire use in pavements, but asphalt damping performance is not closed-loop tire-to-tire recycling. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 大粒径废胎橡胶颗粒使沥青具备温度自适应阻尼
what_happened_zh: 研究人员采用加速加载、Burgers 模型、频域分析和分子动力学方法，比较了常规 AC-16 沥青与掺入 4 目废胎橡胶颗粒的 AC-16-4 沥青。掺胶混合料在 0-20 C 区间表现出更强的阻尼，研究还把界面锚固与链段迁移性、能量耗散联系起来。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。这一多尺度机理为废旧轮胎在路面中的高值化利用提供了更有力的支撑，但沥青阻尼性能并不等同于轮胎到轮胎的闭环回收。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Rubber-tree study identifies four GATA candidates tied to cold response
companies: Yunnan Dehong Institute of Tropical Agriculture Science
what_happened: Researchers identified 44 GATA transcription-factor genes in Hevea brasiliensis and tested the cold-tolerant cultivar Yunyan 77-2 at 4 C for 0, 2, 8 and 24 hours. HbGATA10, HbGATA13 and HbGATA27 rose at 24 hours while HbGATA44 fell. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The candidates could support cold-tolerance breeding and northern production resilience, but gene-expression response is not yet evidence of yield or survival improvement in plantations. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 橡胶树研究锁定四个与低温响应相关的 GATA 候选基因
what_happened_zh: 研究人员在巴西橡胶树（Hevea brasiliensis）中鉴定出 44 个 GATA 转录因子基因，并对耐寒品种 Yunyan 77-2 在 4 C 下处理 0、2、8 和 24 小时。HbGATA10、HbGATA13 和 HbGATA27 在 24 小时时表达上升，而 HbGATA44 下降。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。这些候选基因可能支撑耐寒育种和北部产区的生产韧性，但基因表达响应还不能证明种植园中的产量或存活率改善。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Single-cell atlas resolves rubber-tree xylem growth pathways across two cultivars
what_happened: A Chinese team combined single-cell RNA sequencing and ATAC sequencing for two rubber-tree cultivars with different girth-growth rates, resolved 10 cell clusters and traced two developmental trajectories, highlighting candidate regulatory factors in fibre and vessel development. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The first single-cell xylem atlas in rubber tree gives breeders a more precise target map for growth and biomass traits, but it does not yet connect those targets to latex yield or field performance. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: 单细胞图谱解析两个橡胶树品种的木质部生长路径
what_happened_zh: 一个中国团队对两个围径生长速率不同的橡胶树品种开展了单细胞 RNA 测序与 ATAC 测序，解析出 10 个细胞簇并追踪到两条发育轨迹，指出了纤维与导管发育中的候选调控因子。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。这是橡胶树首个单细胞木质部图谱，为育种者提供了更精确的生长与生物量性状靶点图，但尚未把这些靶点与胶乳产量或田间表现联系起来。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

what_happened: Struktol previewed FM 126 ahead of an industry event and attributed processing and dispersion benefits to the additive. Material security, certification and circularity are becoming commercial as well as technical constraints. The lead is relevant to compound processing but remains a supplier preview without a public comparative protocol, customer trial or scale result. Benefits are supplier claims in an event preview; no independent test or named commercial use is public. Watch for certification scope, contracted volumes, regulatory decisions or measured material performance.
title_zh: Struktol 预告面向轮胎与橡胶胶料的 FM 126 加工助剂
what_happened_zh: Struktol 在一场行业活动前预告了 FM 126，并把加工与分散方面的益处归功于这款助剂。材料保障、认证与循环利用正在同时成为商业约束和技术约束。该线索与胶料加工相关，但仍属供应商预告，没有公开的对比方案、客户试用或规模化结果。这些益处是活动预告中的供应商说法；没有公开的独立测试或具名的商业应用。后续应关注认证范围、合同量、监管决定或经实测的材料性能。

title: Guizhou Tyre completes China-side approvals for six-million-tire Morocco project
what_happened: Guizhou Tyre said its investment subsidiary received the provincial outbound-investment certificate on August 11, completing all required Chinese approvals for the planned six-million-unit passenger-radial plant in Morocco. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The filing advances the project through its China approval gate, but Moroccan park permission, subsidiary establishment, construction and commissioning are still future stages. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎完成六百万条摩洛哥轮胎项目的中国境内审批
what_happened_zh: 贵州轮胎称，其投资子公司已于 8 月 11 日取得省级境外投资证书，完成了摩洛哥规划中六百万条乘用车子午线轮胎工厂所需的全部中国境内审批。制造企业正把产能动作与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律更严格的关注结合起来。该公告使项目通过了中国审批这一关口，但摩洛哥园区许可、子公司设立、工程建设和投产调试仍属后续阶段。后续应关注许可、工程进度、投产调试、产能利用率以及经审计的财务落地情况。

title: Kumho approves collateral structure for up to EUR300 million Poland-plant borrowing
what_happened: A Korean disclosure approved collateral supporting Kumho Tire Poland borrowings of up to EUR300 million, with the parent pledging its Polish shares and setting a collateral ceiling of EUR450 million through 2036. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The structure is a material financing step for Kumho's planned first European tire plant, but it does not establish loan drawdown, construction start or operating capacity. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: 锦湖批准为波兰工厂最高 EUR300 million 借款提供的担保结构
what_happened_zh: 一份韩国披露文件批准了为 Kumho Tire Poland 最高 EUR300 million 借款提供的担保，母公司将质押其持有的波兰公司股份，并把担保上限设定为 EUR450 million，期限至 2036 年。制造企业正把产能动作与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律更严格的关注结合起来。该结构是锦湖规划中首座欧洲轮胎工厂的一项重要融资步骤，但它并不能确立贷款提取、开工建设或运营产能。后续应关注许可、工程进度、投产调试、产能利用率以及经审计的财务落地情况。

title: Pyrum signs first external thermolysis-plant order for fully financed Czech joint venture
what_happened: Pyrum and SUAS reTire signed the purchase agreement for a three-reactor thermolysis plant in Vresova, Czech Republic. The joint venture also completed bank loan agreements; the facility is designed for more than 22,000 tonnes of end-of-life tires per year and targets spring 2028 commissioning. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The binding order and financing move tire pyrolysis from development toward replicable external-plant sales, while construction, feedstock, output qualification and commissioning remain future risks. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: Pyrum 为已完成全额融资的捷克合资项目签下首个外部热解装置订单
what_happened_zh: Pyrum 与 SUAS reTire 就位于捷克 Vresova 的三反应器热解装置签署了采购协议。该合资公司同时完成了银行贷款协议；该装置设计年处理报废轮胎超过 22,000 tonnes，目标在 2028 年春季投产。制造企业正把产能动作与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律更严格的关注结合起来。这笔有约束力的订单和融资安排使轮胎热解从开发阶段走向可复制的外部装置销售，而工程建设、原料、产物认证和投产调试仍是未来的风险。后续应关注许可、工程进度、投产调试、产能利用率以及经审计的财务落地情况。

title: Weifang process forum puts APS scheduling and AI appearance inspection on factory agenda
what_happened: The conference agenda listed Shandong Hongsheng's APS-based tire-factory scheduling and Jiangsu General Science's AI-enabled tire-appearance inspection, alongside case sessions on curing time, sidewall defects, dynamic balance and exposed wire. Manufacturers are combining capacity moves with tighter attention to utilization, quality and capital discipline. The agenda identifies practical Chinese factory priorities but publishes session titles only, without methods, baselines, results or independent validation. Session titles prove topic coverage only; no quantitative industrial result or implementation scope was published. Watch for permits, construction progress, commissioning, utilization and audited financial follow-through.
title_zh: 潍坊工艺论坛把 APS 排产与 AI 外观检测列入工厂议题
what_happened_zh: 会议议程列出了 Shandong Hongsheng 基于 APS 的轮胎工厂排产，以及江苏通用股份支持 AI 的轮胎外观检测，并安排了围绕硫化时间、胎侧缺陷、动平衡和露线的案例分享。制造企业正把产能动作与对产能利用率、质量和资本纪律更严格的关注结合起来。该议程指出了中国工厂的实际优先事项，但只公布了议题名称，没有方法、基线、结果或独立验证。议题名称只能证明话题覆盖；没有公布量化的工业结果或实施范围。后续应关注许可、工程进度、投产调试、产能利用率以及经审计的财务落地情况。

title: US Commerce finalizes changed antidumping margins for Chinese passenger tires
what_happened: The US Department of Commerce published final results for the 2023-2024 review, changed calculations for Qingdao Transamerica and Shandong Haohua, retained separate-rate eligibility for those companies and Triangle, and left the China-wide rate at 76.46%. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The final review changes market-access economics for named Shandong exporters and preserves a high residual rate for the China-wide entity; the notice does not measure subsequent shipment or pricing effects. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.
title_zh: 美国商务部终裁调整中国乘用车轮胎反倾销税率
what_happened_zh: 美国商务部公布了 2023-2024 年期复审的终裁结果，调整了对 Qingdao Transamerica 和 Shandong Haohua 的计算方式，保留了这两家公司以及三角轮胎的单独税率资格，并将中国普遍税率维持在 76.46%。轮胎制造商正在需求不均和贸易压力下调整价格、定位和进入市场的渠道。此次终裁改变了具名山东出口商的市场准入经济性，并为中国普遍实体保留了较高的剩余税率；该公告并未衡量后续的出货或价格影响。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、终端销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Linglong becomes first Chinese full member of global tire-data standards group
what_happened: GDSO announced Linglong as its fourteenth member and first Chinese tire manufacturer with full-member status, committing the company to supply reliable standardized tire data and participate in applications for digital data exchange. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. Membership gives a Chinese maker a formal role in interoperable tire-data infrastructure, but it does not yet prove product-level data completeness or downstream adoption. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.

sources.publisher: Global Data Service Organization for Tyres and Automotive Components
sources.link_label: Global Data Service Organization for Tyres and Automotive Components

title_zh: 玲珑轮胎成为全球轮胎数据标准组织首家中国正式会员
what_happened_zh: GDSO 宣布玲珑轮胎成为其第十四家会员，也是首家获得正式会员资格的中国轮胎制造商，公司由此承诺提供可靠的标准化轮胎数据，并参与数字化数据交换的相关应用。轮胎制造商正在需求不均和贸易压力下调整价格、定位和进入市场的渠道。会员资格让一家中国制造商在可互操作的轮胎数据基础设施中获得正式角色，但尚不能证明产品层面的数据完整性或下游采用情况。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、终端销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Kumho opens TirePro stores to Continental tires in South Korea
what_happened: Under a memorandum with Continental Tire Korea, Kumho began selling Continental products through its TirePro network, the first time the retail chain offered a non-Kumho tire brand. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The move changes a manufacturer-controlled retail network into a broader multi-brand channel and may improve store traffic and choice, but volumes, store coverage and commercial terms were not disclosed. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.
title_zh: 锦湖在韩国向大陆集团轮胎开放 TirePro 门店
what_happened_zh: 根据与 Continental Tire Korea 签署的备忘录，锦湖开始通过其 TirePro 门店网络销售大陆集团产品，这是该零售连锁首次提供非锦湖品牌的轮胎。轮胎制造商正在需求不均和贸易压力下调整价格、定位和进入市场的渠道。此举把一个由制造商控制的零售网络变成更广泛的多品牌渠道，可能提升门店客流和选择面，但销量、门店覆盖范围和商业条款均未披露。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、终端销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Delticom improves margin and EBIT while first-half tire-retail revenue falls
what_happened: The online tire retailer reported revenue of EUR214 million versus EUR237 million, gross margin of 24.9% versus 24.3%, operating EBITDA of EUR5.8 million versus EUR5.5 million and EBIT of EUR0.9 million versus a EUR0.6 million loss. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The figures show a measurable shift from volume toward profitability in European online tire retail; the company also flagged uncertainty from July antidumping duties on China-made consumer tires. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.
title_zh: Delticom 上半年轮胎零售收入下滑，但毛利率与 EBIT 改善
what_happened_zh: 这家在线轮胎零售商公布收入为 EUR214 million，对比数为 EUR237 million；毛利率为 24.9%，对比数为 24.3%；经营性 EBITDA 为 EUR5.8 million，对比数为 EUR5.5 million；EBIT 为 EUR0.9 million，对比数则是 EUR0.6 million 的亏损。轮胎制造商正在需求不均和贸易压力下调整价格、定位和进入市场的渠道。这些数字显示欧洲在线轮胎零售正从销量导向可测量地转向盈利能力；公司同时提示了 7 月对中国产消费类轮胎征收反倾销税带来的不确定性。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、终端销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Magna's Fennell Tyres expands Western Australia service footprint through Bunbury acquisition
what_happened: Fennell Tyres International, part of Magna Tyres Group, acquired Bunbury's Tyre Specialists and said the operation would join its network on August 17, extending OTR and commercial-tire service coverage into Western Australia's South West. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The acquisition broadens regional mining, transport and industrial service reach, while the public record omits purchase price, revenue and customer-retention metrics. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.
title_zh: Magna 旗下 Fennell Tyres 通过收购 Bunbury 企业扩大西澳服务网络
what_happened_zh: 隶属 Magna Tyres Group 的 Fennell Tyres International 收购了 Bunbury's Tyre Specialists，并表示该业务将于 8 月 17 日并入其网络，把工程机械（OTR）和商用车轮胎服务覆盖范围延伸到西澳大利亚州西南地区。轮胎制造商正在需求不均和贸易压力下调整价格、定位和进入市场的渠道。此次收购扩大了区域性矿业、运输和工业服务的覆盖，但公开记录未披露收购价格、收入和客户留存指标。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、终端销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Turkey opens the final review window before bicycle-tire antidumping measures expire
what_happened: Turkey's official gazette stated that antidumping measures on bicycle inner and outer tires from China, Indonesia, India, Malaysia and Thailand would expire on January 20, 2027 unless a properly supported sunset-review request was filed. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The notice creates a defined decision point for Chinese bicycle-tire market access; it does not itself terminate the measure or predict the outcome of any review request. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.
title_zh: 土耳其在自行车轮胎反倾销措施到期前启动最后的复审窗口
what_happened_zh: 土耳其官方公报称，针对来自中国、印度尼西亚、印度、马来西亚和泰国的自行车内胎与外胎的反倾销措施将于 2027 年 1 月 20 日到期，除非有依据充分的日落复审申请提出。轮胎制造商正在需求不均和贸易压力下调整价格、定位和进入市场的渠道。该公告为中国自行车轮胎的市场准入设定了明确的决策时点，但它本身并不终止该措施，也不能预判任何复审申请的结果。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、终端销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Linglong's new president restates staged globalization model after China Brand Festival
what_happened: An August 11 article recapped Linglong's August 8 China Brand Festival appearance and a four-stage path from exports to localized production, localized operations and global brand management. Tire makers are adjusting price, positioning and routes to market amid uneven demand and trade pressure. The remarks are useful strategy context but the underlying appearance predates the window and adds no new plant, order or operating metric. The in-window article is a recap of an August 8 appearance and provides strategy framing rather than a new execution stage. Watch for effective dates, dealer uptake, sell-through and any change in market-access conditions.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎新任总裁在中国品牌节后重申分阶段全球化模式
what_happened_zh: 一篇 8 月 11 日的文章回顾了玲珑轮胎 8 月 8 日在中国品牌节上的亮相，以及从出口到本地化生产、本地化运营和全球品牌管理的四阶段路径。轮胎制造商正在需求不均和贸易压力下调整价格、定位和进入市场的渠道。这些表述是有用的战略背景，但相关亮相本身早于报告期，也没有增加新的工厂、订单或运营指标。报告期内的这篇文章是对 8 月 8 日亮相的回顾，提供的是战略框架而非新的执行阶段。后续应关注生效日期、经销商接受度、终端销售，以及市场准入条件的任何变化。

title: Hankook says EV replacement demand in China helps deliver record tire revenue
what_happened: Hankook's tire division reported record quarterly sales of KRW2.8073 trillion, up 11.8%, and operating profit of KRW483.2 billion, up 39.5%. Large-rim tires were 49.5% of PCLT sales and EV tires 31.8% of PCLT OE sales; the company specifically cited rising China replacement sales as EVs entered replacement cycles. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. The disclosure is rare measured evidence that China's EV parc is translating into replacement demand, although the company did not publish China volumes or separate price and mix effects. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: 韩泰称中国电动车替换需求助推轮胎业务收入创纪录
what_happened_zh: 韩泰轮胎业务公布季度销售额创纪录，达到 KRW2.8073 trillion，增长 11.8%；营业利润为 KRW483.2 billion，增长 39.5%。大轮辋尺寸轮胎占 PCLT 销售的 49.5%，电动车轮胎占 PCLT 原配销售的 31.8%；公司特别提到，随着电动车进入替换周期，中国替换市场销售正在上升。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场接受度最清晰的公开证据。此次披露是中国电动车保有量正在转化为替换需求的难得实测证据，不过公司没有公布中国销量，也没有区分价格与产品结构效应。后续应关注推广量、更多整车项目、续约证据以及实际使用表现。

title: Doublestar-Kumho platform reports RMB13.83 billion revenue after consolidation
what_happened: Qingdao Doublestar's first post-restructuring half-year report showed RMB13.829 billion revenue, RMB1.141 billion total profit and RMB142.95 million attributable net profit. Passenger-tire revenue was RMB11.4 billion; Kumho's European and US replacement revenue grew by double digits and Doublestar truck-bus OE revenue rose 13%. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. The filing supplies audited-scale sales and customer-channel evidence after Kumho consolidation, while year-on-year comparisons are distorted by the same-control combination and raw-material costs remained a stated risk. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: 双星-锦湖平台合并后报告 RMB13.83 billion 营业收入
what_happened_zh: 青岛双星重组后的首份半年报显示，营业收入为 RMB13.829 billion、利润总额为 RMB1.141 billion、归属母公司净利润为 RMB142.95 million。乘用车轮胎收入为 RMB11.4 billion；锦湖在欧洲和美国的替换市场收入实现两位数增长，双星卡客车原配收入增长 13%。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场接受度最清晰的公开证据。该公告在锦湖并表后提供了经审计规模的销售与客户渠道证据，但同一控制下的合并使同比比较失真，原材料成本仍是公司列明的风险。后续应关注推广量、更多整车项目、续约证据以及实际使用表现。

title: Yokohama posts record first-half sales and profit and raises full-year forecast
what_happened: Yokohama Rubber reported first-half sales revenue of JPY639.4 billion, up 10.4%, business profit of JPY95.8 billion, up 54.3%, and operating profit of JPY109.7 billion, up 100%. It raised its full-year sales forecast to JPY1.32 trillion and business-profit forecast to JPY192.5 billion. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. The results indicate stronger earnings conversion during portfolio expansion, but consolidated figures include non-tire businesses and do not alone explain volume, price, mix or acquisition contributions. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶上半年销售与利润创纪录并上调全年预期
what_happened_zh: 横滨橡胶公布上半年销售收入为 JPY639.4 billion，增长 10.4%；事业利润为 JPY95.8 billion，增长 54.3%；营业利润为 JPY109.7 billion，增长 100%。公司将全年销售预期上调至 JPY1.32 trillion，事业利润预期上调至 JPY192.5 billion。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场接受度最清晰的公开证据。这一业绩显示公司在业务组合扩张过程中的盈利转化能力增强，但合并数据包含非轮胎业务，单凭这些数字无法解释销量、价格、产品结构或并购带来的贡献。后续应关注推广量、更多整车项目、续约证据以及实际使用表现。

title: OEC agrees to buy epyx and adjacent fleet-workshop software businesses
what_happened: OEConnection agreed to acquire epyx, r2c Online and Business Gateway from Corpay, combining fleet management, service-maintenance-repair, workshop management and compliance technology across the UK and continental Europe. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. The transaction consolidates digital infrastructure used around fleet tire and maintenance decisions, but the public announcement does not separate tire-specific revenue, users or customer outcomes. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: OEC 同意收购 epyx 及相邻的车队与车间软件业务
what_happened_zh: OEConnection 同意从 Corpay 收购 epyx、r2c Online 和 Business Gateway，把车队管理、服务-维护-维修、车间管理和合规技术整合到英国与欧洲大陆市场。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场接受度最清晰的公开证据。该交易整合了围绕车队轮胎与维修决策所使用的数字化基础设施，但公开公告没有单独披露轮胎相关的收入、用户或客户成效。后续应关注推广量、更多整车项目、续约证据以及实际使用表现。

title: USTMA shipment forecast receives in-window trade recap
what_happened: An August 10 recap revisited the US Tire Manufacturers Association forecast released August 6. Named fitments and customer agreements remain the clearest public evidence of market adoption. The forecast is relevant market context but its original public date falls before the target window, so it is not counted as a new core signal. The in-window page is a recap of an August 6 forecast, outside this week's first-public boundary. Watch for rollout volumes, additional vehicle programs, renewal evidence and in-service performance.
title_zh: USTMA 出货量预测在报告期内获得行业媒体回顾
what_happened_zh: 一篇 8 月 10 日的回顾文章重新梳理了美国轮胎制造商协会 8 月 6 日发布的预测。具名配套和客户协议仍是市场接受度最清晰的公开证据。该预测是相关的市场背景，但其最初公开日期早于目标报告期，因此不计为新的核心信号。报告期内的这个页面是对 8 月 6 日预测的回顾，落在本周首次公开的边界之外。后续应关注推广量、更多整车项目、续约证据以及实际使用表现。

title: RUBBIO develops three synthetic-rubber routes from bread and potato waste
companies: RUBBIO consortium; Circular Bio-based Europe Joint Undertaking
what_happened: An in-window trade feature described the four-year RUBBIO research program, which is using starch-rich food waste to produce intermediates and monomers for polybutadiene, SBR and NBR and plans commercial-significance validation in products. The funded project links fermentation, chemical conversion and polymer synthesis across three rubber families, but it began in May and remains research-stage rather than a commercial supply source. Watch for Pilot yields, polymer properties, life-cycle results and validation in footwear or technical-flooring products.
title_zh: RUBBIO 开发三条以面包和马铃薯废料制取合成橡胶的路线
what_happened_zh: 报告期内的一篇行业特稿介绍了为期四年的 RUBBIO 研究计划，该计划正利用富含淀粉的食品废料生产用于聚丁二烯、SBR 和 NBR 的中间体与单体，并计划在产品中开展具有商业意义的验证。这一获得资助的项目把发酵、化学转化和聚合物合成贯穿三大橡胶品类，但它于 5 月启动，仍处于研究阶段，而不是商业供应来源。后续应关注中试收率、聚合物性能、生命周期结果，以及在鞋材或技术地板产品中的验证。

title: Prinx Xelera EcoLine truck-tire range gains TÜV SÜD certification
what_happened: Steer, drive and trailer versions of the Xelera EcoLine range gained the TÜV SÜD certification mark after testing covering rolling resistance, wet grip, noise and robustness. The certification is independent market-access and product-validation evidence across the complete axle-position range, although the detailed test data and comparator results were not published. Watch for Publication of the TÜV test protocol, certificate scope and fleet adoption for the certified range.
title_zh: 浦林成山 Xelera EcoLine 卡客车轮胎系列获得 TÜV SÜD 认证
what_happened_zh: Xelera EcoLine 系列的转向轮、驱动轮和挂车轮版本在经过滚动阻力、湿地抓地力、噪声和耐用性测试后，获得了 TÜV SÜD 认证标志。该认证是覆盖完整轴位系列的独立市场准入与产品验证证据，不过详细测试数据和对比产品结果并未公布。后续应关注 TÜV 测试方案和证书范围的公布情况，以及该认证系列的车队应用。

title: Apollo launches mixed-service truck tire with quantified bead, belt, and cut-resistance gains
what_happened: Apollo launched the Endutrax MD HD for Indian rigid tippers operating roughly 70% on-road and 30% off-road. It claims 45% higher bead durability, 25% higher belt durability, and 10% better cut-and-chip resistance from an optimized casing and tread compound after R&D-center and field testing. The launch supplies comparative durability metrics and says field validation followed laboratory work, making it more decision-useful than an unquantified pattern refresh. Test protocols, sample size, and exact baseline product were not disclosed. Watch for Fleet mileage, retreadability, casing rejection rates, and third-party or customer results against the undisclosed comparison tire.
title_zh: Apollo 推出混合路况卡车轮胎，量化胎圈、带束层与抗切割性能提升
what_happened_zh: Apollo 为印度刚性自卸车推出 Endutrax MD HD，该类车辆约 70% 在公路行驶、30% 在非公路行驶。公司称，经研发中心和实地测试，优化的胎体与胎面胶料使胎圈耐久性提高 45%、带束层耐久性提高 25%、抗切割与抗崩花性能提升 10%。此次发布提供了可比的耐久性指标，并表示实验室工作之后进行了实地验证，因此比缺乏量化数据的花纹更新更具决策参考价值。测试方案、样本量和确切的基准产品均未披露。后续应关注车队里程、可翻新性、胎体报废率，以及针对未披露对比轮胎的第三方或客户结果。

title: AFM and NMR separate crosslink and entanglement changes in stretched vulcanized butadiene rubber
companies: Industrial Technology Center of Okayama Prefecture; Institute of Science Tokyo
what_happened: Researchers combined atomic-force-microscopy nanomechanics, time-domain NMR, tensile tests, and a tube model to study vulcanized butadiene rubber under elongation. The fitted BR modulus split into crosslink and entanglement contributions of 0.21 and 0.54 MPa, and NMR indicated fewer constrained components up to an elongation ratio of 3.5. The method provides local structure-property information that bulk tensile testing alone cannot show and could improve formulation models. Evidence is from a simple unfilled BR compound and does not yet cover production tire compounds. Watch for Application to silica- and carbon-black-filled tread compounds, cyclic fatigue, temperature sweeps, and links to tire-level durability or hysteresis.
title_zh: AFM 与 NMR 区分拉伸状态下硫化丁二烯橡胶的交联与缠结变化
what_happened_zh: 研究人员结合原子力显微镜纳米力学、时域 NMR、拉伸测试和管模型，研究了拉伸状态下的硫化丁二烯橡胶。拟合得到的 BR 模量可拆分为交联贡献 0.21 MPa 与缠结贡献 0.54 MPa，而 NMR 显示在拉伸比达到 3.5 之前受约束组分减少。该方法提供了单纯本体拉伸测试无法呈现的局部结构—性能信息，有望改进配方模型。证据来自一种简单的无填充 BR 胶料，尚未覆盖量产轮胎胶料。后续应关注该方法在白炭黑和炭黑填充胎面胶料上的应用、循环疲劳、温度扫描，以及与轮胎层面耐久性或滞后损失的关联。

title: Continental adds a 32 mm Aero 111 bicycle tire using 48 tread cavities as vortex generators
what_happened: Continental launched a 32-622 Aero 111 road-bicycle tire co-developed with Swiss Side. Its patented tread uses 48 cavities as vortex generators and combines BlackChili compound, a Vectran breaker, tubeless-ready construction, and hookless-rim compatibility. The size extension applies aerodynamic tread features to the wider road-tire segment, where comfort and rough-surface capability matter. Drag, rolling-resistance, and durability claims were not accompanied by test data in the weekly source. Watch for Independent wheel-tunnel drag curves across yaw angles and on-road rolling-resistance, grip, puncture, and wear comparisons.
title_zh: 大陆集团新增 32 mm Aero 111 自行车轮胎，以 48 个胎面凹坑充当涡流发生器
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团推出与 Swiss Side 联合开发的 32-622 Aero 111 公路自行车轮胎。其专利胎面以 48 个凹坑作为涡流发生器，并结合 BlackChili 胶料、Vectran 缓冲层、可无内胎安装结构以及无钩圈兼容性。该规格扩展把空气动力学胎面特征引入更宽的公路轮胎细分市场，而舒适性与粗糙路面通过性在该细分市场中十分重要。周报来源中的风阻、滚动阻力和耐久性主张没有附带测试数据。后续应关注覆盖不同偏航角的独立轮组风洞风阻曲线，以及道路上的滚动阻力、抓地力、抗穿刺和磨耗对比。

title: Giti adds two 19.5-inch GTR955 trailer sizes rated for five tonnes per tire
what_happened: Giti added 445/45R19.5 and 435/50R19.5 sizes to the GTR955 Combi Road trailer range. The in-window report gives load index 164 and up to five tonnes per tire; Giti's product page lists the new sizes and technical dimensions. The launch targets high-volume trailer operators with a concrete capacity and size expansion, although comparative mileage and operating-cost evidence for these exact sizes was not disclosed. This is a size and load-rating extension supported by a company product page and trade-media report. Comparative mileage, retreadability, operating-cost, and fleet-trial evidence for the two sizes was not disclosed. Watch for Named fleet trials, casing durability, mileage and retreadability for the new 19.5-inch sizes.
title_zh: 佳通为 GTR955 挂车轮胎新增两个 19.5-inch 规格，单胎承载达五吨
what_happened_zh: 佳通在 GTR955 Combi Road 挂车轮胎系列中新增 445/45R19.5 和 435/50R19.5 规格。报告期内的报道给出负荷指数 164、单胎最高承载五吨；佳通产品页面列出了新规格及技术尺寸。该发布以明确的承载与规格扩展面向大批量挂车运营商，不过这两个具体规格的对比里程和运营成本证据并未披露。本条属于由公司产品页面和行业媒体报道支持的规格与负荷等级扩展。这两个规格的对比里程、可翻新性、运营成本和车队试用证据均未披露。后续应关注具名车队试用、胎体耐久性，以及新 19.5-inch 规格的里程与可翻新性。

title: Clariant China launches two local additive R&D laboratories
what_happened: Clariant announced laboratories in Huizhou and Shanghai that extend local capability from application work to synthesis, analytics and pilot-scale development for flame retardants and performance additives including antioxidants, light stabilizers and waxes. The facilities strengthen China's local specialty-additive development base, but the release does not identify a tire-compound program, rubber qualification, customer, investment amount specific to the labs or measured development-cycle improvement. Clariant's official Chinese page identifies the item as originating from the Clariant China official WeChat account, but no exact mp.weixin.qq.com post URL was recoverable. The disclosed end markets are broad and do not establish a tire-specific program, so this is adjacent-material R&D context. Watch for a named rubber or tire application, compound qualification, customer co-development program, pilot throughput or measurable time-to-market result from the laboratories.

sources.publisher: Clariant China official WeChat / Clariant newsroom
sources.link_label: Clariant China official WeChat / Clariant newsroom

title_zh: Clariant 中国启用两家本地添加剂研发实验室
what_happened_zh: Clariant 宣布在惠州和上海设立实验室，把本地能力从应用研究扩展到合成、分析和中试规模开发，覆盖阻燃剂以及包括抗氧剂、光稳定剂和蜡在内的性能添加剂。这些设施强化了中国本地特种添加剂的开发基础，但该发布没有指明轮胎胶料项目、橡胶认证、客户、专门针对这些实验室的投资金额，也没有给出可量化的开发周期改善。Clariant 的官方中文页面标明该信息源自 Clariant 中国官方微信公众号，但未能找到确切的 mp.weixin.qq.com 文章链接。所披露的终端市场范围宽泛，不足以确立轮胎专属项目，因此本条属于相邻材料领域的研发背景信息。后续应关注来自这些实验室的具名橡胶或轮胎应用、胶料认证、客户联合开发项目、中试产能或可衡量的上市周期结果。

title: Maxam's RowXtra implement tire applies VF load and pressure flexibility to soil protection
what_happened: Maxam launched the steel-belted MS963R RowXtra VF implement tire for balers, seeders, hay mergers, and similar equipment. The company says operators can carry up to 40% more load at standard pressure or use up to 40% lower pressure at the same load. The product translates the standard VF operating envelope into an implement-tire line aimed at heavier machinery and reduced compaction. The source provides no comparative field yield, footprint, cut-resistance, or wear data. This is a company-attributed product launch carried by trade media. The 40% load/pressure figures describe the standard VF operating envelope; no comparative footprint, soil-compaction, wear, or yield protocol was supplied. Watch for Independent footprint and soil-compaction trials plus cut, stubble, wear, and heat performance across planned sizes.
title_zh: MAXAM 的 RowXtra 农机具轮胎把 VF 负荷与气压弹性用于土壤保护
what_happened_zh: MAXAM 推出钢丝带束的 MS963R RowXtra VF 农机具轮胎，适用于打捆机、播种机、草料归行机等设备。公司称，操作者在标准气压下可多承载最高 40% 的负荷，或在相同负荷下将气压最多降低 40%。该产品把标准 VF 工作范围移植到面向更重机械、减少土壤压实的农机具轮胎产品线。来源未提供田间产量、接地印迹、抗切割或磨耗的对比数据。本条属于由行业媒体报道的公司自述产品发布。40% 的负荷/气压数据描述的是标准 VF 工作范围，未提供对比的接地印迹、土壤压实、磨耗或产量测试方案。后续应关注独立的接地印迹与土壤压实试验，以及规划规格上的抗切割、抗茬口、磨耗和生热表现。

title: Toyo records two Bark River wins on off-the-shelf Open Country tires
what_happened: Toyo reported that Johnny Greaves won Pro-4 on a 35x12.50R17 Open Country R/T Trail and Ryan Beat won Pro-2 on a 35x12.50R17 Open Country C/T at Bark River. The result is a real-use exposure for named retail tire specifications under high-speed short-course conditions, but a race win does not isolate tire contribution or replace comparative testing. This is a maker-issued motorsport result using named off-the-shelf tires. It supplies no controlled comparison, setup normalization, wear result, or evidence that the tires caused the victories. Watch for Lap, wear, temperature and failure data or a controlled comparison against competing tires under the same course conditions.
title_zh: 东洋以市售 Open Country 轮胎在 Bark River 取得两场胜利
what_happened_zh: 东洋表示，Johnny Greaves 使用 35x12.50R17 Open Country R/T Trail 赢得 Pro-4 组别，Ryan Beat 使用 35x12.50R17 Open Country C/T 在 Bark River 赢得 Pro-2 组别。该结果是具名零售轮胎规格在高速短道条件下的真实使用展示，但一场比赛胜利无法分离轮胎的贡献，也不能替代对比测试。本条属于制造商发布的赛车运动成绩，使用的是具名的市售轮胎。它没有提供受控对比、调校标准化、磨耗结果，也没有证据表明轮胎导致了这两场胜利。后续应关注圈速、磨耗、温度和失效数据，或在相同赛道条件下与竞品轮胎的受控对比。

title: Giti schedules Ecoroad range display at IAA Transportation
what_happened: Giti said it would make its IAA Transportation debut with the Ecoroad steer, drive and trailer range, each carrying an EU label A rolling-resistance rating; the drive tire was already orderable. The exhibition plan is relevant to commercial-vehicle positioning, but the products and label claims predate the weekly mention and no new test or launch stage is demonstrated. This is an exhibition preview for products already launched or orderable. The A ratings are regulatory label classifications, not fresh independent fleet-performance evidence. Watch for Independent fleet results, new OE nominations, additional orderable sizes, or a post-show commercial milestone.
title_zh: 佳通计划在 IAA Transportation 展出 Ecoroad 系列
what_happened_zh: 佳通表示将以 Ecoroad 转向轮、驱动轮和挂车轮系列首次参展 IAA Transportation，各款产品均具备 EU 标签滚动阻力 A 级评级；其中驱动轮轮胎已可订购。该展会计划与商用车定位相关，但相关产品及标签主张早于本周的提及时间，也未体现新的测试或上市阶段。本条属于已上市或已可订购产品的展会预告。A 级评级属于法规标签分类，而不是新的独立车队性能证据。后续应关注独立车队结果、新的原配提名、更多可订购规格，或展后的商业里程碑。

title: POLYN claims VibroSense data can improve ABS braking by up to 12%
what_happened: POLYN said its VibroSense tire-road-friction input could improve ABS braking performance by up to 12% and described neuromorphic local signal processing for reducing transmitted vibration data. If replicated, tire-derived friction estimates could become inputs to vehicle safety controls rather than only maintenance data; the accessible claim is still vendor-led and safety-critical validation is incomplete. The 12% figure is a vendor maximum repeated by trade media. No recoverable protocol, sample, baseline calibration, uncertainty range, or independent validation was available, so the claim is not treated as established performance. Watch for a recoverable test protocol, vehicles and tires tested, surface and speed conditions, baseline ABS calibration, repeated stopping-distance distributions, and independent validation.
title_zh: POLYN 称 VibroSense 数据可将 ABS 制动性能提升最高 12%
what_happened_zh: POLYN 表示，其 VibroSense 轮胎—路面摩擦输入可将 ABS 制动性能提升最高 12%，并介绍了用于减少振动数据传输量的神经形态本地信号处理。如果能够复现，源自轮胎的摩擦估计可以成为整车安全控制的输入，而不只是维护数据；但这一易于传播的主张仍由供应商主导，安全关键的验证尚不完整。12% 这一数字是供应商给出的上限值，并由行业媒体转述。没有可获取的测试方案、样本、基线标定、不确定度范围或独立验证，因此该主张不被视为已确立的性能。后续应关注可获取的测试方案、受测车辆与轮胎、路面与速度条件、基线 ABS 标定、重复制动距离分布，以及独立验证。

title: Olam Agri closes ASAF acquisition, adding 176,000 tonnes of rubber processing capacity
companies: Olam Agri; Asia Africa Rubber Industry
what_happened: Olam Agri completed the acquisition of ASAF, adding 176,000 tonnes per year of natural-rubber processing capacity in Côte d'Ivoire and increasing geographic density, logistics reach and access to international customers. The closed transaction materially expands an upstream processor and can affect supply reliability and traceability at export scale; the capacity figure is company-reported. Watch for Integration milestones, utilization, farmer sourcing, due-diligence metrics and delivered customer volumes.
title_zh: Olam Agri 完成 ASAF 收购，新增 176,000 tonnes 橡胶加工能力
what_happened_zh: Olam Agri 完成对 ASAF 的收购，在科特迪瓦新增每年 176,000 tonnes 天然橡胶加工能力，并提升了地理密度、物流覆盖以及对国际客户的触达。这笔已完成的交易实质性扩大了一家上游加工企业的规模，可能影响出口规模下的供应可靠性与可追溯性；该产能数字由公司提供。后续应关注整合里程碑、产能利用率、胶农采购、尽职调查指标和实际交付的客户量。

title: Sumitomo Rubber joins Thai study of lower-frequency rubber tapping
companies: Sumitomo Rubber Industries; Rubber Authority of Thailand; CIRAD
what_happened: Sumitomo Rubber joined Thai and French partners to study whether less frequent tapping can preserve natural-rubber quality and tree productivity while reducing farmer labor, with university partners assessing internal rubber structure and economics. A workable lower-frequency regime could ease labor pressure and improve supply resilience, but the project is at research/pilot stage and has not yet established commercial yield or farmer economics. Watch for Field-trial yield, rubber-quality, tree-health and farmer-income results and any recommended tapping protocol.
title_zh: 住友橡胶参与泰国低频率割胶研究
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶与泰国和法国伙伴合作，研究降低割胶频率能否在减轻胶农劳动强度的同时保持天然橡胶质量和橡胶树产能，合作高校将评估橡胶的内部结构与经济性。可行的低频率割胶方案有望缓解劳动力压力并提升供应韧性，但该项目仍处于研究/试点阶段，尚未确立商业产量或胶农经济性。后续应关注田间试验的产量、橡胶质量、树体健康和胶农收入结果，以及任何推荐的割胶方案。

title: China industry guidance maps California 6PPD alternatives-analysis duties and SA6000 option
companies: China tire exporters; Sennics; California DTSC
what_happened: CRIA published a compliance analysis for tire and rubber exporters explaining California's alternatives-analysis process and identifying Sennics' non-PPD SA6000 among emerging alternatives. DTSC's official page says manufacturers are evaluating 21 selected antidegradants and lists SA6000 as an emerging option without endorsing its safety or performance. The update connects a Chinese material candidate with a concrete market-access process while preserving the regulator's caution that listing is not validation. Watch for Final alternatives analyses, independent tire-performance and aquatic-toxicity results, and any DTSC regulatory response.
title_zh: 中国行业指引梳理加州 6PPD 替代方案分析义务与 SA6000 选项
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会发布面向轮胎和橡胶出口企业的合规分析，解释了加州的替代方案分析流程，并把 Sennics 的非 PPD 类产品 SA6000 列为新兴替代品之一。DTSC 官方页面表示，制造商正在评估 21 种入选防老剂，并把 SA6000 列为新兴选项，但未对其安全性或性能作出认可。该更新把一种中国材料候选方案与具体的市场准入流程联系起来，同时保留了监管机构的谨慎立场，即列入名单并不等于验证通过。后续应关注最终的替代方案分析、独立的轮胎性能与水生毒性结果，以及 DTSC 的任何监管回应。

title: UV-aged tire-wear particles cut tomato shoot biomass 77.1% in a high-dose soil test
what_happened: A 30-day tomato experiment applied UV-aged tire-wear particles of 100 or 200 micrometers at 0.1% or 1% soil concentration. The 1% 100-micrometer condition reduced shoot biomass 77.1% and net assimilation 62.1%, increased malondialdehyde 72%, and altered soil enzymes and rhizosphere communities. The paper isolates particle size and photoaging as factors that can change tire-wear environmental effects. The high-dose pot experiment is hazard evidence, not a field exposure or human-risk estimate. Watch for Field-realistic concentrations, multiple soils and crops, chemical-source apportionment, and measured environmental exposure distributions.
title_zh: 紫外老化轮胎磨耗颗粒在高剂量土壤试验中使番茄地上部生物量减少 77.1%
what_happened_zh: 一项为期 30 天的番茄试验施用了粒径 100 或 200 微米的紫外老化轮胎磨耗颗粒，土壤浓度分别为 0.1% 或 1%。在 1% 浓度、100 微米的条件下，地上部生物量减少 77.1%，净同化率下降 62.1%，丙二醛升高 72%，土壤酶活性和根际群落也发生改变。该论文把颗粒粒径和光老化分离为可改变轮胎磨耗环境影响的因素。这项高剂量盆栽试验属于危害证据，而不是田间暴露或人体风险估计。后续应关注符合田间实际的浓度、多种土壤与作物、化学物质来源解析，以及实测的环境暴露分布。

title: Shougang Century and Cordenka owner outline tire-reinforcement joint venture
what_happened: Shougang Century signed a cooperation framework with Cordenka owner HK BMC to explore a joint venture combining Shougang steel cord with Cordenka industrial rayon and overlapping tire-industry customers. The proposed vehicle could join two complementary reinforcement portfolios and customer networks, but the framework is preliminary and most commercial terms remain non-binding. Watch for Definitive agreements, ownership and funding terms, production scope and named customer programs.
title_zh: Shougang Century 与 Cordenka 母公司规划轮胎增强材料合资公司
what_happened_zh: Shougang Century 与 Cordenka 的持有方 HK BMC 签署合作框架，拟探讨成立合资公司，把 Shougang 的钢丝帘线与 Cordenka 的工业粘胶纤维以及双方重叠的轮胎行业客户结合起来。该拟设主体有望整合两套互补的增强材料产品组合与客户网络，但该框架尚属初步，大部分商业条款仍不具约束力。后续应关注最终协议、股权与出资条款、生产范围和具名客户项目。

title: China tire carbon-footprint method keeps use-phase emissions optional, not mandatory
companies: China Rubber Industry Association and tire standards committee
what_happened: An in-window CRIA technical explanation states that its March 2026 tire product carbon-footprint guide and the reviewed draft national recommended standard exclude use-phase emissions from the mandatory calculation boundary while providing an optional calculation method. Boundary choice materially changes product-level carbon comparisons because the article says use can exceed 80% of tire life-cycle emissions. The item clarifies the Chinese method; it does not represent a newly issued standard this week. Watch for Formal publication of the national recommended standard and whether customers request optional use-phase reporting alongside cradle-to-gate values.
title_zh: 中国轮胎碳足迹方法将使用阶段排放设为可选而非强制
what_happened_zh: 报告期内中国橡胶工业协会的一份技术说明指出，其 2026 年 3 月发布的轮胎产品碳足迹指南以及已通过审查的国家推荐性标准草案，把使用阶段排放排除在强制核算边界之外，同时提供了可选的计算方法。边界选择会实质性改变产品层面的碳排放比较，因为该文章称使用阶段可能超过轮胎全生命周期排放的 80%。本条澄清的是中国的方法，并不代表本周新发布了标准。后续应关注该国家推荐性标准的正式发布，以及客户是否会在摇篮到大门数据之外要求可选的使用阶段报告。

title: CRIA flags dual EUDR traceability and China data-law constraints for tire exporters
what_happened: CRIA's rubber-materials committee explained that EUDR requests for farm geolocation, suppliers and multi-tier traceability can also engage Chinese supply-chain, data-security and national-security rules, creating a dual-compliance design problem for exporters. The analysis identifies a practical governance constraint on natural-rubber traceability: exporters must produce defensible due diligence without transferring protected data unlawfully. Watch for Company protocols for consent, localization, controlled disclosure and regulator-accepted EUDR submissions after the rule becomes applicable.
title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会提示轮胎出口企业面临 EUDR 可追溯性与中国数据法规双重约束
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会橡胶材料专业委员会说明，EUDR 对种植园地理坐标、供应商和多层级可追溯性的要求，也可能触及中国的供应链、数据安全和国家安全规定，从而给出口企业带来双重合规的设计难题。该分析指出了天然橡胶可追溯性方面的一项实际治理约束：出口企业必须在不违法转移受保护数据的前提下，提供经得起检验的尽职调查材料。后续应关注企业在授权同意、数据本地化、受控披露方面的操作规程，以及规则适用之后获监管机构认可的 EUDR 提交文件。

title: Multi-material 3D printing doubles flexural strength in graded concrete using waste-rubber aggregate
companies: Guangdong University of Technology and University of South Australia
what_happened: Researchers combined alkali-activated rubber concrete with strain-hardening alkali-activated concrete in printed functionally graded plates. Increasing the strain-hardening layers produced an approximately linear flexural-strength rise, with a maximum increase of 101.4%, while printing avoided rubber flotation seen in mold-cast specimens. The study shows a technically controlled outlet for waste-tire rubber in structural materials and links material placement to flexural behavior. It remains a laboratory plate study, and incompatible layer interfaces weakened some bonds. Watch for Larger structural elements, durability and freeze-thaw testing, process repeatability, and lifecycle/cost comparisons with conventional concrete.
title_zh: 多材料 3D 打印使采用废胶骨料的梯度混凝土抗折强度翻倍
what_happened_zh: 研究人员把碱激发橡胶混凝土与应变硬化碱激发混凝土组合，3D 打印成功能梯度板件。随着应变硬化层数增加，抗折强度呈近似线性上升，最大增幅为 101.4%，同时打印工艺避免了模具浇注试件中出现的橡胶上浮现象。该研究展示了废旧轮胎橡胶在结构材料中技术可控的消纳途径，并把材料布置与抗折行为联系起来。它仍属实验室板件研究，且不相容的层间界面削弱了部分粘结。后续应关注更大尺寸的结构构件、耐久性与冻融测试、工艺重复性，以及与常规混凝土的生命周期/成本比较。

title: Functionalized waste-tire powder halves chloride penetration in heavy-metal cement mortar
what_happened: A peer-reviewed study coated waste-tire rubber powder with a tannic-acid/iron metal-phenolic network and used it as partial aggregate in cement systems containing Cu, Co, Ni, and Pb. The functionalized mortar showed 16.02 mm chloride penetration versus 29.87 mm for control mortar and 31.68 mm for unmodified-rubber mortar. The work gives mechanistic evidence that surface treatment can turn waste-rubber powder from a weak interface into an adsorption and durability aid. Economic performance and long-term engineering service were not quantified. Watch for Independent leaching and durability tests under field exposure plus modification cost and scale-up data.
title_zh: 功能化废胎胶粉使重金属水泥砂浆的氯离子渗透深度减半
what_happened_zh: 一项同行评议研究用单宁酸/铁金属—多酚网络对废旧轮胎胶粉进行包覆，并将其作为部分骨料用于含 Cu、Co、Ni 和 Pb 的水泥体系。功能化砂浆的氯离子渗透深度为 16.02 mm，对照砂浆为 29.87 mm，未改性胶粉砂浆为 31.68 mm。该工作提供了机理性证据，表明表面处理可以把废胶粉从薄弱界面转变为吸附与耐久性的有利因素。经济性与长期工程服役表现未作量化。后续应关注田间暴露条件下的独立浸出与耐久性测试，以及改性成本和放大数据。

title: Shandong Daye steel cord enters provincial manufacturing-champion proposal list
what_happened: An in-window account of Shandong's tenth manufacturing-champion proposal list identified Shandong Daye's steel-cord business among the proposed specialist leaders; the public-comment period ran Aug. 20-26. Recognition is a bounded competitiveness signal for a tire-reinforcement supplier, not proof of product superiority or final designation. Watch for Final provincial list and any disclosed market-share or customer evidence supporting the designation.
title_zh: Shandong Daye 钢丝帘线进入省级制造业单项冠军公示名单
what_happened_zh: 报告期内一则关于山东第十批制造业单项冠军公示名单的报道显示，Shandong Daye 的钢丝帘线业务被列入拟认定的单项冠军企业之中；公示期为 8 月 20 日至 26 日。这一认可是轮胎增强材料供应商竞争力的有限信号，并不能证明产品优势或最终获得认定。后续应关注最终的省级名单，以及支撑该认定的任何已披露市场份额或客户证据。

title: Chinese vendor data points to firmer natural-rubber prices and constrained tire operating rates
what_happened: Business Society reported a domestic natural-rubber spot reference near RMB17,133 per tonne on Aug. 17, up 3.94% from the start of August, alongside Qingdao inventory of 642,100 tonnes and sampled semi-steel and all-steel tire operating loads of 64.32% and 63.01% as of Aug. 14. The combination suggests near-term input-cost support while tire production remained below full utilization, but the accessible article does not fully disclose transaction weighting, sample composition or revision policy. This is attributable commodity-vendor data republished by Chinese financial media. The accessible page does not expose complete price weighting, tire-maker sample composition, or revision policy, so the figures are directional context rather than audited market totals. Watch for Exchange and physical price convergence, Qingdao inventory, rainfall and tapping conditions, plus independently sourced semi-steel and all-steel operating rates.
title_zh: 中国供应商数据显示天然橡胶价格走强、轮胎开工率受限
what_happened_zh: 生意社报道，8 月 17 日国内天然橡胶现货参考价接近 RMB17,133 每吨，较 8 月初上涨 3.94%；同时青岛库存为 642,100 tonnes，截至 8 月 14 日抽样半钢胎和全钢胎开工负荷分别为 64.32% 和 63.01%。这一组合显示近期投入成本存在支撑，而轮胎生产仍低于满负荷运行；但可获取的文章没有完整披露成交权重、样本构成或修订规则。本条属于中国财经媒体转载的可归属商品数据服务商数据。可获取的页面没有完整展示价格权重、轮胎企业样本构成或修订规则，因此这些数字属于方向性背景信息，而不是经审计的市场总量。后续应关注期货与现货价格的收敛、青岛库存、降雨与割胶条件，以及独立来源的半钢胎和全钢胎开工率。

title: China's July tire output rises 8.1% while exports weaken
what_happened: China's National Bureau of Statistics reported 102.658 million rubber tire casings produced in July, up 8.1% year over year, and 708.594 million in January-July, up 2.8%. A Chinese tire-industry analysis contrasted the output rise with July export declines. The output/export divergence suggests production growth was not matched by external demand in July, increasing the importance of domestic replacement demand and inventory discipline. The aggregate does not identify maker-level utilization or inventory. Watch for August national output and customs data, sample-maker inventories, operating rates and price changes that show whether the divergence persists.

sources.publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China
sources.link_label: National Bureau of Statistics of China

title_zh: 中国 7 月轮胎产量增长 8.1%，出口走弱
what_happened_zh: 中国国家统计局数据显示，7 月橡胶轮胎外胎产量为 102.658 million 条，同比增长 8.1%；1 月至 7 月累计产量为 708.594 million 条，同比增长 2.8%。一篇中国轮胎行业分析把产量上升与 7 月出口下降进行了对比。产量与出口的背离表明，7 月的生产增长没有得到外部需求的匹配，国内替换需求和库存管理的重要性因此上升。该总量数据无法反映企业层面的产能利用率或库存。后续应关注 8 月全国产量和海关数据、样本企业库存、开工率和价格变化，以判断这种背离是否持续。

title: Dunlop completes R1.7 billion South Africa plant upgrade for OE, export, and low-resistance tires
companies: Dunlop Tyres South Africa; Sumitomo Rubber Industries
what_happened: An Aug. 17 industry publication recapped Dunlop's Aug. 13 completion of a three-year R1.7 billion uMnambithi investment. The upgrade adds a mixer, tread and sidewall lines, advanced curing control, and capacity for passenger, SUV, light-truck, and very-low-rolling-resistance tires. The project has moved from investment to completed equipment and expanded production capability at an African OE/export hub. The release does not disclose incremental annual capacity, utilization, energy savings, or yield. Watch for Qualified OE programs, export volume, utilization, energy intensity, scrap, and the first product-specific low-rolling-resistance results.
title_zh: Dunlop 完成 R1.7 billion 南非工厂升级，面向原配、出口与低阻轮胎
what_happened_zh: 8 月 17 日的一家行业媒体回顾了 Dunlop 于 8 月 13 日完成的为期三年、金额 R1.7 billion 的 uMnambithi 投资项目。此次升级新增一台密炼机、胎面和胎侧生产线、先进硫化控制，以及乘用车、SUV、轻卡和超低滚动阻力轮胎的生产能力。该项目已从投资阶段推进到设备建成阶段，扩大了这家非洲原配/出口基地的生产能力。相关发布没有披露新增年产能、产能利用率、节能效果或成品率。后续应关注已通过认证的原配项目、出口量、产能利用率、能耗强度、废品率，以及首批具体产品的低滚动阻力结果。

title: Kumho structures up to €300 million of borrowing for planned Poland tire plant
what_happened: An in-window report traced a Korean disclosure approving collateral for Kumho Tire Poland to borrow up to €300 million, with the parent pledging its Polish shares and a collateral ceiling of €450 million through 2036. The financing structure is a material execution step for Kumho's planned first European plant, but the disclosure does not establish that the loan has been drawn or construction has begun. Watch for Loan closing and drawdown, construction permits, equipment orders and groundbreaking at Opole.
title_zh: 锦湖为规划中的波兰轮胎工厂安排最高 €300 million 借款
what_happened_zh: 报告期内的一则报道梳理了一份韩国披露文件，其中批准为 Kumho Tire Poland 提供担保，使其可借款最高 €300 million；母公司质押其持有的波兰公司股权，担保上限为 €450 million，期限至 2036 年。该融资结构是锦湖规划中的首座欧洲工厂的实质性执行步骤，但该披露并不表明贷款已经提取或建设已经开工。后续应关注贷款签署与提款、施工许可、设备订单，以及 Opole 的动工情况。

title: Pyrum signs equipment agreement for three-reactor Czech tire-pyrolysis plant
what_happened: Pyrum and its Czech joint venture signed the equipment purchase agreement for a fully financed three-reactor plant designed to process more than 22,000 tonnes of end-of-life tires annually, with commissioning targeted for spring 2028. The binding equipment order moves the project beyond planning and is Pyrum's first external plant agreement, though construction and commissioning risk remain. Watch for Site construction, reactor delivery, permitting, feedstock contracts and commissioning against the spring-2028 target.
title_zh: Pyrum 为捷克三反应器轮胎热解工厂签署设备协议
what_happened_zh: Pyrum 与其捷克合资公司签署了设备采购协议，该工厂已完成全额融资，设计配置三台反应器，年处理报废轮胎能力超过 22,000 tonnes，计划于 2028 年春季投料试车。这一具有约束力的设备订单使项目超越规划阶段，也是 Pyrum 首个对外工厂协议，不过建设和试车风险仍然存在。后续应关注现场施工、反应器交付、许可审批、原料合同，以及相对 2028 年春季目标的试车进度。

title: Guizhou Tyre clears China-side approvals for 6-million-tire Morocco plant
what_happened: An in-window trade report said Guizhou Tyre had completed the required Chinese approvals and outbound-investment filing for a planned Tangier Tech City plant with annual capacity of six million passenger-car radial tires and investment of about US$299 million. The filing closes the China-side approval stage for Guizhou's second overseas production base, but Moroccan permits, entity formation and construction still remain. Watch for Moroccan investment and land approvals, subsidiary registration, groundbreaking and equipment tenders.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎完成 6-million-tire 摩洛哥工厂的中国境内审批
what_happened_zh: 报告期内一则行业报道称，贵州轮胎已完成规划中的丹吉尔科技城工厂所需的中国境内审批和境外投资备案，该项目年产能为六百万条乘用车子午线轮胎，投资额约 US$299 million。该备案结束了贵州轮胎第二个海外生产基地的中国境内审批阶段，但摩洛哥的许可、主体设立和工程建设仍待推进。后续应关注摩洛哥的投资与土地审批、子公司注册、动工和设备招标。

title: China researchers report 95.4%-97.8% precision for attention-based tire surface-defect classification
companies: Xi'an Jiaotong University; Shandong Management University
what_happened: A peer-reviewed paper introduced AE-Swin, adding multi-scale attention and cross-scale feature fusion to a Swin Transformer. Across three public tire-defect datasets it reported average precision of 97.8%, 96.5%, and 95.4%, with 2.3-4.5-point gains over selected backbones. The paper provides statistically tested tire-specific AI evidence and a measured inference rate, but the approximately 4,580 images were captured in relatively ideal conditions and no factory deployment or customer result was reported. Watch for Validation on contaminated, low-light, high-speed production images and a compressed edge-device model tested on a live line.
title_zh: 中国研究人员报告基于注意力机制的轮胎表面缺陷分类精度为 95.4%-97.8%
what_happened_zh: 一篇同行评议论文提出 AE-Swin，在 Swin Transformer 基础上加入多尺度注意力和跨尺度特征融合。在三个公开轮胎缺陷数据集上，其平均精度分别为 97.8%、96.5% 和 95.4%，相对所选骨干网络提升 2.3-4.5 个百分点。该论文提供了经统计检验的轮胎专用 AI 证据和实测推理速率，但约 4,580 张图像是在相对理想的条件下采集的，也没有报告工厂部署或客户结果。后续应关注在受污染、低照度、高速生产图像上的验证，以及在实际生产线上测试的压缩版边缘设备模型。

title: Haian-linked Omsk giant-tire plant receives construction approval
what_happened: An in-window trade report said planning permission had been granted for Russia's first ultra-large-tire plant in the Avangard SEZ. The host-zone record gives planned capacity of 10,500 tires per year, roughly RUB60 billion of investment and a late-2028 to early-2029 start target. This is an approval-stage advance for a China-linked cross-border mining-tire project, not a completed factory; it could localize a strategically constrained product category in Russia. Watch for Building start, definitive ownership/JV documents, equipment orders and evidence that the 2028-29 schedule is maintained.
title_zh: Haian 关联的鄂木斯克巨型轮胎工厂获得建设批准
what_happened_zh: 报告期内的一则行业报道称，俄罗斯首个超大规格轮胎工厂已在 Avangard 经济特区获得规划许可。园区方面的记录给出的规划产能为每年 10,500 条轮胎，投资额约 RUB60 billion，投产目标为 2028 年底至 2029 年初。这是一个中国关联的跨境矿用轮胎项目的审批阶段进展，而不是已建成的工厂；它可能使一类战略性受限的产品在俄罗斯实现本地化生产。后续应关注开工建设、最终的股权/合资文件、设备订单，以及 2028-29 进度是否得以维持。

title: Birla Tyres owner targets Rs30 billion scale with plant modernization and PCR entry
what_happened: Himadri outlined a four-to-five-year target of Rs30 billion in annual Birla Tyres revenue, supported by plant modernization, added off-highway capacity and planned entry into passenger-car radial tires after commercial operations resumed. The update connects a turnaround target with concrete product and plant directions, but the revenue goal is management ambition and the capacity ramp remains unproven. Watch for Commissioned PCR equipment, production volumes, dealer expansion, utilization and progress toward the revenue target.
title_zh: Birla Tyres 母公司以工厂现代化和半钢胎业务切入瞄准 Rs30 billion 规模
what_happened_zh: Himadri 提出了在四到五年内实现 Birla Tyres 年收入 Rs30 billion 的目标，支撑手段包括工厂现代化改造、新增非公路轮胎产能，以及在商业运营恢复后计划进入乘用车子午线轮胎领域。该更新把扭亏目标与具体的产品和工厂方向联系起来，但该收入目标属于管理层雄心，产能爬坡仍未得到验证。后续应关注已投产的乘用车子午线轮胎设备、产量、经销网络扩张、产能利用率，以及实现收入目标的进展。

title: Haiyang Technology starts key lines in an 80,000-tonne high-performance cord-fabric project
what_happened: CRIA's summary of Haiyang Technology's half-year report says the twisting/weaving shop for phase one of an 80,000-tonne-per-year high-performance cord-fabric project is operating, dipping lines are entering production, and an automated high-bay warehouse is in use. Supporting high-modulus low-shrinkage polyester and a new nylon-6 polymerization project are also ramping in stages. This is a commissioning-stage reinforcement-material capacity signal rather than another project announcement. The company also said some international tier-one tire customers had reached batch-supply or specification-confirmation stages. Watch for Completion of remaining dipping and spinning lines, utilization, and conversion of specification-confirmation programs into repeat batch supply.
title_zh: Haiyang Technology 在 80,000-tonne 高性能帘子布项目中启动关键生产线
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会对 Haiyang Technology 半年报的摘要称，年产 80,000-tonne 高性能帘子布项目一期的捻织车间已投入运行，浸胶生产线正在进入生产，自动化高架库已投入使用。配套的高模低收缩聚酯以及新的 nylon-6 聚合项目也在分阶段爬坡。这是增强材料产能进入试车阶段的信号，而不是又一个项目公告。公司还表示，部分国际一线轮胎客户已进入批量供货或规格确认阶段。后续应关注剩余浸胶和纺丝生产线的建成、产能利用率，以及规格确认项目转化为持续批量供货的情况。

title: MCRI takes over established tire-spray technologies and lifecycle support
what_happened: MCRI said selected patents, technologies, and personnel tied to RTS, DTS, and HTS tire-spray systems are transitioning to it. The company will build new systems and support installed equipment with parts, programming, upgrades, maintenance, and integration with robotics, machine vision, AMRs, and AGVs. The transition affects continuity for installed tire automation and consolidates specialized spray processes with broader material handling and controls capability. No transaction value, installed-base count, or performance improvement was disclosed. Watch for Named plant projects, installed-base retention, service-response metrics, and quantified improvements from integrated inspection and transport.
title_zh: MCRI 承接成熟的轮胎喷涂技术与全生命周期支持
what_happened_zh: MCRI 表示，与 RTS、DTS 和 HTS 轮胎喷涂系统相关的部分专利、技术和人员正在转入该公司。公司将制造新系统，并以备件、程序编制、升级、维护以及与机器人、机器视觉、AMR 和 AGV 的集成来支持已安装设备。此次转移影响已安装轮胎自动化设备的服务延续性，也把专用喷涂工艺与更广泛的物料搬运和控制能力整合在一起。交易金额、已安装设备数量或性能改善均未披露。后续应关注具名工厂项目、已安装设备的留存率、服务响应指标，以及检测与搬运集成带来的量化改善。

title: California approves first U.S. replacement-tire efficiency standard with a 2029 start
what_happened: The California Energy Commission unanimously approved its Replacement Tire Efficiency Program for passenger and light-duty replacement tires. Phase 1 begins in 2029, full effect is planned for 2033, and specialty exceptions include competition, large off-road, and certain all-weather winter-performance tires. The approval creates a dated compliance path in a major replacement market and will require portfolio, testing, and channel planning. State savings and emissions figures are forecasts, not observed results. Watch for Final implementation guidance, enforcement details, compliant-product disclosures, and manufacturer portfolio changes before 2029.
title_zh: 加州批准美国首个替换轮胎能效标准，2029 年起实施
what_happened_zh: 加州能源委员会一致批准了面向乘用车和轻型车替换轮胎的替换轮胎能效计划。第 1 阶段自 2029 年开始，计划到 2033 年全面生效，专门豁免包括竞赛轮胎、大型非公路轮胎和某些全天候冬季性能轮胎。该批准在一个重要的替换市场中确立了带有明确时间表的合规路径，并将要求企业进行产品组合、测试和渠道规划。州层面的节能和减排数字属于预测，而非已观测结果。后续应关注最终的实施指南、执法细则、合规产品披露，以及制造商在 2029 年之前的产品组合调整。

title: China's July tire exports fall by double digits even as year-to-date tonnage stays positive
what_happened: CRIA's account of customs data says China exported 820,000 tonnes of rubber tires in July, down 10.1% year over year and 90,000 tonnes from June; export value fell 13.1%. January-July tonnage rose 2.4%, while export value fell 3.0%. The month-versus-year-to-date divergence is a useful distribution and pricing signal: physical exports remain slightly ahead for the year, but July weakened sharply and value is underperforming volume. Watch for August customs tonnage, unit value, and whether the July decline extends into a second month.
title_zh: 中国 7 月轮胎出口两位数下滑，年初至今出口量仍为正增长
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会对海关数据的说明称，7 月中国出口橡胶轮胎 820,000 tonnes，同比下降 10.1%，比 6 月减少 90,000 tonnes；出口金额下降 13.1%。1 月至 7 月出口量增长 2.4%，而出口金额下降 3.0%。单月与年初至今的背离是有价值的渠道与价格信号：全年实物出口仍略有领先，但 7 月明显走弱，且金额表现落后于数量。后续应关注 8 月海关出口量、单位价值，以及 7 月的下滑是否延续到第二个月。

title: EAEU review recommends five more years of duties on China-made truck and bus tires
companies: Chinese truck and bus tire exporters
what_happened: CRIA reported that the Eurasian Economic Commission's internal-market defense unit issued its final disclosure in the second sunset review and recommended maintaining duties of 14.79%-35.35% for five years on specified China-origin truck, bus, and semitrailer tires with 17.5-24.5-inch rims. Comments were due September 2. The recommendation preserves a material market-access constraint if adopted, but it is a final disclosure and recommendation rather than the final extension decision itself. Watch for the Eurasian Economic Commission's adoption decision after the comment period and any exporter-specific changes.
title_zh: 欧亚经济联盟复审建议对中国产卡客车轮胎再延长五年关税
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会报道，欧亚经济委员会内部市场保护部门在第二次日落复审中发布了最终披露文件，建议对特定中国原产、轮辋为 17.5-24.5-inch 的卡车、客车和半挂车轮胎，在五年内继续维持 14.79%-35.35% 的关税。意见提交截止日期为 9 月 2 日。该建议如获采纳，将延续一项实质性的市场准入限制，但它属于最终披露和建议，而不是最终的延期决定本身。后续应关注意见征求期结束后欧亚经济委员会的采纳决定，以及任何针对具体出口企业的调整。

title: Delticom lifts margin and earnings while H1 revenue falls under value-led strategy
what_happened: Delticom reported H1 revenue of €214 million versus €237 million, gross margin of 24.9% versus 24.3%, operating EBITDA of €5.8 million versus €5.5 million and EBIT of €0.9 million versus a €0.6 million loss. The results provide measured evidence that Europe's large online tire retailer is prioritizing margin and earnings over volume, though one half-year does not prove the transformation is durable. Watch for Winter-season sales, repeat-customer metrics and whether margin improvement persists through full-year 2026.
title_zh: Delticom 在价值导向战略下提升毛利率与盈利，H1 收入下降
what_happened_zh: Delticom 报告 H1 营业收入为 €214 million，上年同期为 €237 million；毛利率为 24.9%，上年同期为 24.3%；经营性 EBITDA 为 €5.8 million，上年同期为 €5.5 million；EBIT 为 €0.9 million，上年同期为亏损 €0.6 million。这些结果提供了可量化的证据，表明这家欧洲大型线上轮胎零售商正把利润率和盈利置于销量之上，不过一个半年期还不能证明该转型具有持续性。后续应关注冬季销售、复购客户指标，以及利润率改善能否贯穿 2026 年全年。

title: Triangle and Vaculug describe value-led UK OTR distribution model
what_happened: An in-window trade feature described how Triangle's UK OTR distributor Vaculug is positioning supply availability, technical support and value rather than price alone, alongside comments that European OTR demand slowed after a strong start while UK activity improved in Q2. The interview supplies current channel-side evidence on how a Chinese OTR brand is being positioned and serviced in the UK, but it is a continuing signal from an agreement effective in 2025 rather than a new appointment. Watch for Inventory turns, end-user trials, repeat orders and service-level evidence under the Vaculug distribution model.
title_zh: 三角轮胎与 Vaculug 介绍英国 OTR 价值导向分销模式
what_happened_zh: 报告期内的一篇行业特稿介绍了三角轮胎的英国 OTR 分销商 Vaculug 如何以供货保障、技术支持和价值而非单纯价格进行定位，同时提到欧洲 OTR 需求在开年强劲之后放缓，而英国市场活动在 Q2 有所改善。该访谈提供了关于一个中国 OTR 品牌在英国如何定位和服务的最新渠道侧证据，但它属于一项 2025 年生效协议的延续信号，而不是新的经销商任命。后续应关注 Vaculug 分销模式下的库存周转、终端用户试用、复购订单和服务水平证据。

title: Yokohama signs multi-year Juventus partnership to support European expansion
what_happened: Yokohama Europe became a Juventus Official Partner under a multi-year agreement covering stadium advertising, digital media, fan engagement and hospitality. The maker said its European turnover had tripled before this next growth push. The agreement is explicitly tied to increasing European market share, awareness and premium positioning, giving the sponsorship a stated regional commercial objective. This is a new official football sponsorship tied by the maker to European growth. The stated commercial objective is directional; the sources do not provide a budget, baseline market share, or attributable sales result. Watch for Country-level activation, dealer programs and whether European market share rises during the agreement.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶签署多年期尤文图斯合作，支持欧洲扩张
what_happened_zh: 横滨橡胶欧洲公司依据一项多年期协议成为尤文图斯官方合作伙伴，内容涵盖球场广告、数字媒体、球迷互动和接待权益。该制造商表示，在这一轮增长推进之前，其欧洲营业额已增长至三倍。该协议被明确与提升欧洲市场份额、知名度和高端定位挂钩，从而赋予这项赞助明确的区域商业目标。本条属于被制造商与欧洲增长挂钩的新官方足球赞助。所述商业目标具有方向性，来源未提供预算、基线市场份额或可归因的销售结果。后续应关注国别层面的活动落地、经销商项目，以及欧洲市场份额在协议期内是否上升。

title: Triangle becomes Brentford FC's inaugural official tyre partner
what_happened: Triangle signed a two-year exclusive tyre-category partnership with Brentford FC, with Stapleton's Tyre Services supporting local activation and delivery in the UK. The named duration, exclusivity and local delivery partner turn the deal into a concrete European go-to-market and brand-activation signal rather than a generic sponsorship announcement. This is an official two-year football sponsorship and UK activation arrangement. It is included as market context because no budget, campaign reach, dealer conversion, or tire-sales result is yet available. Watch for Dealer, customer and campaign activation metrics in the UK during the two-season term.
title_zh: 三角轮胎成为 Brentford FC 首个官方轮胎合作伙伴
what_happened_zh: 三角轮胎与 Brentford FC 签署了为期两年的轮胎品类独家合作协议，由 Stapleton's Tyre Services 在英国支持本地活动落地与交付。明确的期限、独家性和本地交付合作方，使这项协议成为具体的欧洲市场进入与品牌活动信号，而不是一则笼统的赞助公告。本条属于官方的两年期足球赞助及英国活动落地安排。由于目前尚无预算、传播覆盖、经销商转化或轮胎销售结果，本条作为市场背景信息收录。后续应关注两个赛季期间在英国的经销商、客户和活动落地指标。

title: Hankook extends Borussia Dortmund Champion Partner deal through 2027/28
what_happened: Hankook extended its 17-year BVB relationship for two more seasons through 2027/28, retaining Champion Partner status and activation across LED signage and team buses. The renewal is a defined-duration European brand and channel commitment, not merely a continuation inferred from old signage. This is a defined-duration renewal of a long-running football sponsorship. It documents continued European brand activation, but no spending, audience, dealer, or sales-return metric is disclosed. Watch for Activation reach, dealer tie-ins and any change in regional sales or brand metrics through 2027/28.
title_zh: 韩泰将多特蒙德 Champion Partner 合作延续至 2027/28 赛季
what_happened_zh: 韩泰把与多特蒙德长达 17 年的合作再延长两个赛季至 2027/28 赛季，继续保留 Champion Partner 身份，并在 LED 广告牌和球队大巴上开展活动。此次续约是期限明确的欧洲品牌与渠道投入，而不仅是从旧有广告牌推断出的延续。本条属于一项长期足球赞助的期限明确续约。它记录了欧洲品牌活动的延续，但未披露投入金额、受众、经销商或销售回报指标。后续应关注活动覆盖面、经销商联动，以及到 2027/28 赛季区域销售或品牌指标的任何变化。

title: Linglong activates Real Madrid partnership with China dealer and customer program
what_happened: An Aug. 18 industry report covered Real Madrid ambassador Roberto Carlos's Aug. 14-16 visit to Linglong in Shandong, including a channel-partner conference, factory and R&D tours and the Sino-Asia proving ground. The event shows the older global sponsorship being used for dealer, customer and product-technology activation in China rather than only stadium visibility. This is an in-window recap of an Aug. 14-16 dealer and customer activation tied to an older Real Madrid sponsorship. It shows use of the relationship but does not establish incremental sales or independent campaign performance. Watch for Dealer campaigns, lead conversion and measurable customer engagement from the 2026/27 partnership season.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎以中国经销商与客户活动激活皇家马德里合作
what_happened_zh: 8 月 18 日的一则行业报道介绍了皇家马德里形象大使 Roberto Carlos 于 8 月 14 日至 16 日对山东玲珑轮胎的访问，内容包括渠道伙伴会议、工厂与研发参观以及 Sino-Asia 试验场。该活动显示这项较早的全球赞助正被用于中国市场的经销商、客户和产品技术活动，而不只是球场曝光。本条是对一项与较早皇家马德里赞助相关、于 8 月 14 日至 16 日举行的经销商与客户活动的报告期内回顾。它表明该合作关系得到了运用，但并未确立增量销售或独立的活动效果。后续应关注 2026/27 合作赛季的经销商活动、线索转化和可衡量的客户互动。

title: Pirelli signs U.S. Ski & Snowboard partnership through the 2028-29 season
what_happened: Pirelli became an official partner of U.S. Ski & Snowboard through the 2028-29 season. Planned activation includes athlete-led content, digital and broadcast media, branding on the U.S. Alpine Ski Team uniforms, and presence at domestic alpine World Cup events. The multi-year contract expands Pirelli's sports-marketing portfolio in a market the company calls strategic and provides concrete activation channels. The release does not disclose spending, audience targets, or sales attribution. This is a new but promotional sports partnership. The term and activation channels are disclosed, but spending, audience targets, dealer conversion, and tire-sales attribution are not. Watch for Campaign reach, dealer activation, winter-tire sell-through, and any disclosed North American brand or sales lift.
title_zh: 倍耐力签署 U.S. Ski & Snowboard 合作，延续至 2028-29 赛季
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力成为 U.S. Ski & Snowboard 的官方合作伙伴，合作期至 2028-29 赛季。计划中的活动包括运动员主导的内容、数字与广播媒体、U.S. Alpine Ski Team 队服上的品牌标识，以及出现在美国国内高山滑雪世界杯赛事现场。这份多年期合同扩大了倍耐力在一个被公司称为战略市场的体育营销版图，并提供了具体的活动渠道。该发布未披露投入金额、受众目标或销售归因。本条属于新的但带有宣传性质的体育合作。期限和活动渠道已披露，但投入金额、受众目标、经销商转化和轮胎销售归因均未披露。后续应关注传播覆盖、经销商活动、冬季轮胎的终端销售，以及任何已披露的北美品牌或销售提升。

title: Delticom value-transformation analysis repeats H1 result family
what_happened: Tyrepress revisited Delticom's first-half results and its shift from volume-led online tire retail toward profitability and value creation. The analysis provides useful interpretation of the retailer's strategic direction, but it shares the same H1 result family already covered in the core report. This is a second in-window interpretation of the same Delticom H1 result family reported in core story GL-MD-05. It is retained only as explicitly marked repeat context. Watch for Second-half revenue, gross margin, repeat-customer and marketing-efficiency indicators that test whether the value strategy holds.
title_zh: Delticom 价值转型分析重复了同一组 H1 业绩
what_happened_zh: Tyrepress 再次回顾了 Delticom 的上半年业绩，以及它从以销量为导向的线上轮胎零售转向盈利能力与价值创造。该分析对这家零售商的战略方向提供了有价值的解读，但它与核心报告中已经覆盖的 H1 业绩属于同一来源。本条是对核心内容 GL-MD-05 中已报道的同一组 Delticom H1 业绩的第二次报告期内解读。它仅作为明确标注的重复内容保留。后续应关注下半年收入、毛利率、复购客户和营销效率指标，以检验这一价值战略是否成立。

title: Double Coin names Southeast regional sales manager
what_happened: CMA/Double Coin appointed Andrew Martin regional sales manager for the U.S. Southeast, with responsibility for dealers, fleets and strategic partners. The hire indicates attention to regional commercial-tire coverage, but it does not itself establish a new channel, customer win, distribution footprint, or sales increase. The in-window trade-media mention recaps an Aug. 12 company appointment. It indicates channel-management intent but no new dealer, fleet, distribution, or revenue outcome. Watch for New dealer locations, fleet accounts, distribution agreements, regional revenue or service-capacity changes.
title_zh: Double Coin 任命美国东南区域销售经理
what_happened_zh: CMA/Double Coin 任命 Andrew Martin 为美国东南地区区域销售经理，负责经销商、车队和战略合作伙伴。这一招聘显示公司重视区域商用车轮胎覆盖，但其本身并未确立新的渠道、客户获取、分销布局或销售增长。报告期内的行业媒体提及回顾的是 8 月 12 日的公司任命。它表明了渠道管理意图，但没有新的经销商、车队、分销或收入成果。后续应关注新的经销商门店、车队客户、分销协议、区域收入或服务能力变化。

title: Investigation reports competitor allegations about Euromaster pricing
