what_happened: Follow the Money analyzed Euromaster accounts in ten European markets and reported combined 2024 losses of EUR65 million while competitors alleged that some bids were unsustainably low. Euromaster denied predatory or loss-making pricing. The reporting raises a channel-competition and independent-dealer margin question, but allegations and accounting losses do not by themselves prove below-cost pricing or a competition-law violation. This investigative report combines filed accounts and competitor interviews, and it includes Euromaster's denial. It has not established below-cost pricing, dominance, or a legal violation; those remain allegations requiring regulatory or court evidence. Watch for a regulator decision, filed case, disclosed cost evidence, or independently verified contract-level pricing comparison.
title_zh: 调查报道称竞争对手指控 Euromaster 定价问题
what_happened_zh: Follow the Money 分析了 Euromaster 在十个欧洲市场的财务报表，报道其 2024 年合计亏损 EUR65 million，同时竞争对手称其部分投标价格低到难以为继。Euromaster 否认存在掠夺性或亏损性定价。该报道提出了渠道竞争和独立经销商利润率的问题，但指控和会计亏损本身并不能证明低于成本定价或违反竞争法。这篇调查报道结合了已备案的财务报表与竞争对手访谈，并包含了 Euromaster 的否认。它尚未确立低于成本定价、市场支配地位或法律违规；这些仍属需要监管或司法证据支持的指控。后续应关注监管机构的决定、已提起的案件、已披露的成本证据，或经独立核实的合同层面价格比较。

title: Goodyear previews ELMS tire supply at Spa
what_happened: Goodyear previewed the Aug. 23 ELMS round at Spa and listed the existing Racing Eagle Medium specifications, prior usage, tire dimensions and expected single- versus double-stint strategies. The note provides concrete operating context for an existing series-supply role, but it is a race preview rather than a new contract, product, or measured result. This is a company race preview for an existing supply role. Specifications and expected strategies are useful context, but no new contract, tire specification, or completed performance result was announced. Watch for Post-race stint length, degradation, wet-weather use and any subsequent specification or supply-contract change.
title_zh: 固特异预告 Spa 站 ELMS 供胎安排
what_happened_zh: 固特异预告了 8 月 23 日在 Spa 举行的 ELMS 分站赛，并列出了现有 Racing Eagle Medium 规格、此前使用情况、轮胎尺寸以及预期的单段与双段使用策略。该说明为一项既有的系列赛供胎角色提供了具体的运行背景，但它属于赛前预告，而不是新的合同、产品或实测结果。本条属于公司针对既有供胎角色发布的赛事预告。规格和预期策略是有用的背景信息，但没有宣布新的合同、轮胎规格或已完成的性能结果。后续应关注赛后的单段里程、性能衰减、湿地使用情况，以及后续任何规格或供应合同变化。

title: Magna Tyres appoints a new chief financial officer
what_happened: Magna Tyres Group appointed Arnold van Woerkum chief financial officer and said the role would support international growth and possible acquisitions. The appointment can matter if it precedes funded expansion or transactions, but current evidence is a personnel change plus management intent. The accessible trade-media item is partly paywalled and describes a personnel appointment and general growth intent, not a funded project, transaction, or customer result. Watch for a financed acquisition, capital program, distribution expansion, or measurable operating change attributed to the new finance leadership.
title_zh: Magna Tyres 任命新任首席财务官
what_happened_zh: Magna Tyres Group 任命 Arnold van Woerkum 为首席财务官，并表示该职位将支持国际扩张和可能的收购。如果这一任命先于有资金支持的扩张或交易，它可能具有意义，但目前的证据只是人事变动加上管理层意图。可获取的行业媒体报道部分需要付费订阅，所描述的是一项人事任命和笼统的增长意图，而不是有资金支持的项目、交易或客户成果。后续应关注获得融资的收购、资本计划、分销扩张，或可归因于新任财务负责人的可衡量运营变化。

title: Prometeon fitment on MMT EVO5 resurfaced in an agency post
what_happened: An Aug. 20 agency page repeated the previously announced fitment of Prometeon tires on the MMT EVO5 construction vehicle. The renewed mention keeps the specialized OE relationship visible, but it does not establish a new nomination, order, delivery, or field-performance stage. This Aug. 20 agency post repeats MMT's July 21 announcement and adds no new fitment, order, delivery, or operating milestone. Watch for a dated order, serial-production start, delivery volume, or operating result from MMT or Prometeon.
title_zh: Prometeon 为 MMT EVO5 配套的信息在一则代理机构帖文中重现
what_happened_zh: 8 月 20 日的一则代理机构页面重复了此前已宣布的 Prometeon 轮胎为 MMT EVO5 工程车辆配套的信息。这一重新提及让该专用原配关系保持可见度，但并未确立新的提名、订单、交付或实地性能阶段。这则 8 月 20 日的代理机构帖文重复的是 MMT 于 7 月 21 日的公告，没有增加新的配套、订单、交付或运营里程碑。后续应关注 MMT 或 Prometeon 给出的具体日期订单、量产开始、交付量或运营结果。

title: ZC Rubber pairs double-digit tire revenue growth with a new AITO M6 OE fitment
what_happened: ZC Rubber reported first-half revenue of RMB23.474 billion, up 7.41%, and adjusted attributable profit of RMB2.398 billion, up 5.79%. Second-quarter tire revenue rose 15.98% on 7.02% higher volume, while the company identified the AITO M6 as a new mid-to-high-end passenger-vehicle OE fitment. The disclosure links financial growth to actual product volume and a named OE platform while overseas plants continue to ramp. It is stronger customer evidence than an undated nomination, although model-level supply volumes were not disclosed. Watch for AITO M6 fitment volumes and the next production update for Indonesia half-steel tires and the Vietnam project.
title_zh: 中策橡胶轮胎收入实现两位数增长，并新增 AITO M6 原配配套
what_happened_zh: 中策橡胶报告上半年营业收入为 RMB23.474 billion，增长 7.41%；调整后归母净利润为 RMB2.398 billion，增长 5.79%。第二季度轮胎收入增长 15.98%，销量增长 7.02%，同时公司指出 AITO M6 为新增的中高端乘用车原配配套车型。该披露把财务增长与实际产品销量以及具名原配平台联系起来，而海外工厂仍在爬坡。相比没有时间节点的提名，这是更有力的客户证据，不过车型层面的供货量并未披露。后续应关注 AITO M6 的配套供货量，以及印尼半钢胎和越南项目的下一次生产进展更新。

title: Prinx Chengshan grows OE revenue 25.8% as OTR and truck-tire sales offset passenger-tire pressure
what_happened: Prinx Chengshan reported first-half revenue of RMB5.786 billion, up 1.4%, and attributable profit of RMB414 million, down 18.5%. Domestic dealer revenue rose 18.1%, direct sales to automakers rose 25.8%, all-steel tire revenue rose 5.1% on 9.0% volume growth, and bias/OTR revenue rose 30.8%. The mix shows named commercial channels moving in different directions: stronger domestic dealer and OE sales partly offset weaker international distribution and passenger-tire pricing. The results also provide a Shandong-maker benchmark for segment demand. Watch whether OE and OTR growth sustains margin as raw-material and foreign-exchange pressure continues.
title_zh: 浦林成山原配收入增长 25.8%，非公路与卡车轮胎销售抵消乘用车轮胎压力
what_happened_zh: 浦林成山报告上半年营业收入为 RMB5.786 billion，增长 1.4%；归母净利润为 RMB414 million，下降 18.5%。国内经销商收入增长 18.1%，对整车厂的直销增长 25.8%，全钢子午线轮胎收入增长 5.1%、销量增长 9.0%，斜交/非公路轮胎收入增长 30.8%。这一结构显示具名商用渠道走向分化：国内经销商和原配销售走强，部分抵消了国际分销走弱和乘用车轮胎价格压力。该业绩也为细分需求提供了一个山东制造商的基准。后续应关注在原料和汇率压力延续的情况下，原配与非公路业务增长能否支撑利润率。

title: Lamborghini selects Bridgestone as sole tire partner for the Revuelto SV across track, road, and winter use
what_happened: Bridgestone unveiled the road-homologated Potenza Race R with a bespoke variant for the 2026 Lamborghini Revuelto SV and said it is the model's exclusive tire partner. The fitment package also includes Potenza Sport and Blizzak LM005 variants made in Italy. A named exclusive OE application is concrete customer adoption. Bridgestone says virtual tire development can reduce raw-material use and development-phase CO2 by 60%, but the weekly release gives no project-specific baseline or audit. Watch for Homologation labels, fitment volumes, lap and wet-performance data, and project-specific development-material savings.
title_zh: Lamborghini 选定普利司通为 Revuelto SV 赛道、公路与冬季用胎的独家合作伙伴
what_happened_zh: 普利司通发布了获得公路认证的 Potenza Race R，并推出面向 2026 款 Lamborghini Revuelto SV 的定制版本，同时表示自己是该车型的独家轮胎合作伙伴。该配套组合还包括在意大利生产的 Potenza Sport 和 Blizzak LM005 版本。一项具名的独家原配应用属于实际的客户采用。普利司通称虚拟轮胎开发可把原料使用和开发阶段的 CO2 减少 60%，但本周的发布没有提供项目层面的基线或审计。后续应关注认证标签、配套供货量、圈速与湿地性能数据，以及项目层面的开发材料节约情况。

title: NASCAR qualifies a revised American Racer tire combination after two track tests
what_happened: After tests at New Hampshire and Stafford, NASCAR selected softer control left-side tires with harder New Hampshire right-side tires for the final four 2026 Modified Tour races. The work addressed size consistency, heat, blistering, grip, and fall-off concerns from teams and drivers. The item documents an iterative customer-validation loop leading to an operating specification, including negative findings that eliminated one option. It is motorsport evidence and should not be generalized to road-tire performance. Watch for Blistering, grip fall-off, passing behavior, and team feedback across the four specified races and subsequent 2027 development.
title_zh: NASCAR 在两次赛道测试后确认改进版 American Racer 轮胎组合
what_happened_zh: 在 New Hampshire 和 Stafford 完成测试后，NASCAR 为 2026 赛季 Modified Tour 最后四场比赛选定了更软的控制型左侧轮胎与更硬的 New Hampshire 右侧轮胎。相关工作回应了车队和车手提出的尺寸一致性、生热、起泡、抓地力和性能衰减等问题。本条记录了一个迭代式客户验证循环如何形成运行规格，其中包括排除了一个方案的负面发现。这属于赛车运动证据，不应推广到公路轮胎性能。后续应关注这四场指定比赛中的起泡、抓地力衰减、超车表现和车队反馈，以及随后的 2027 年开发工作。

title: Guizhou Changjiang uses locally supplied Guizhou Tyre products on new-energy commercial vehicles
what_happened: A Chinese media report based on an Aug. 17 factory visit said Guizhou Changjiang was installing locally supplied Guizhou Tyre products across its new-energy vehicle line. A plant representative attributed wear, puncture, low-heat and low-rolling-resistance suitability to the tires. The observation provides customer-side evidence of local OE use, but it does not disclose the tire models, contract, annual volume, duration or independent performance measurements. The article was published on Aug. 24 after the weekly cutoff but reports an Aug. 17 factory observation. It is human-approved post-cutoff context, does not count as weekly core evidence, and includes customer claims without a contract, volume or independent tire test. Watch for a named tire specification, supply contract, fitment volume, export-model use or independently measured rolling-resistance, heat and durability result.
title_zh: 贵州长江在新能源商用车上使用本地供应的贵州轮胎产品
what_happened_zh: 一则基于 8 月 17 日工厂走访的中国媒体报道称，贵州长江正在其新能源车生产线上全面使用本地供应的贵州轮胎产品。一位工厂代表把耐磨、抗刺穿、低生热和低滚动阻力的适用性归功于这些轮胎。该观察提供了本地原配使用的客户侧证据，但没有披露轮胎型号、合同、年度供货量、期限或独立性能测量。该文章发布于 8 月 24 日，晚于本周证据截止时间，但报道的是 8 月 17 日的工厂观察。它属于经人工批准的截止后背景信息，不计入本周核心证据，并且包含客户主张，而没有合同、供货量或独立轮胎测试。后续应关注具名轮胎规格、供应合同、配套供货量、出口车型应用，或独立测量的滚动阻力、生热和耐久性结果。

title: Radical and Hankook qualify the lighter Ventus R54 for a January 2027 rollout
what_happened: Radical Motorsport said the Hankook Ventus Race R54 will replace the current tire across its racing ecosystem from January 2027 after joint development and track testing. The partners report a reduction of roughly 4 kg per set. The item has a customer, a completed development programme, quantified weight change, and a dated fleet-wide rollout. Performance claims remain partner-reported until comparative test data are published. Watch for Series adoption in January, lap-time and durability data against the outgoing specification, and feedback across different Radical models.
title_zh: Radical 与韩泰完成更轻 Ventus R54 的验证，定于 2027 年 1 月全面推广
what_happened_zh: Radical Motorsport 表示，经联合开发与赛道测试后，Hankook Ventus Race R54 将自 2027 年 1 月起在其赛事体系内替代现有轮胎。双方报告每套轮胎减重约 4 kg。该条目具备客户、已完成的开发项目、量化的重量变化以及明确日期的全体系推广。在对比测试数据公布之前，性能主张仍属合作方自述。后续应关注 1 月的赛事系列采用情况、相对旧规格的圈速与耐久性数据，以及不同 Radical 车型的反馈。

title: Hoosier launches the ECE R117-approved TrackAttack Pro across 45 sizes
what_happened: Hoosier launched the road-legal TrackAttack Pro extreme-performance summer tire, stating ECE R117 approval and a 45-size range for 15- to 21-inch wheels. It positions one tire for road travel and circuit use. The breadth of the homologated range turns motorsport positioning into a replacement-market offer rather than a limited demonstration. No comparative wet, wear, or lap-time test is published with the launch. Watch for Independent road-and-track tests, final size availability, wet performance, and channel adoption outside specialist motorsport dealers.
title_zh: Hoosier 推出获 ECE R117 认证的 TrackAttack Pro，覆盖 45 个规格
what_happened_zh: Hoosier 推出可合法上路的 TrackAttack Pro 极限性能夏季轮胎，称其已取得 ECE R117 认证，并提供覆盖 15 至 21-inch 轮辋的 45 个规格。该产品把公路行驶与赛道使用集中在同一条轮胎上。认证规格覆盖面之广，使其赛车运动定位转化为替换市场产品，而不只是有限的示范。此次发布未同时公布湿地、磨耗或圈速的对比测试。后续应关注独立的道路与赛道测试、最终规格供货情况、湿地性能，以及在专业赛车运动经销商之外的渠道采用。

title: Yokohama puts a retrieval-augmented AI system into full-scale tire-development operation
what_happened: Yokohama Rubber developed and began full-scale operation of a proprietary generative-AI system that retrieves internal technical documents and answers developer questions. An agent iterates planning, retrieval, and evaluation, while links to original documents let engineers inspect the basis for responses. The industrial value is not generic chat: the system constrains answers to internal domain evidence and exposes source links for engineering review. This is deployment evidence inside a tire-development workflow and addresses a practical bottleneck in reusing regulatory, procedure, test, and case-study knowledge. The company provides no time saving, error rate, adoption count, or baseline. Watch for Measured search-time reduction, answer-quality evaluation, user adoption, access-control performance, and a disclosed example where the system changes a development decision.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶将检索增强 AI 系统投入轮胎开发全面运行
what_happened_zh: 横滨橡胶自主开发并已全面投入运行一套生成式 AI 系统，可检索内部技术文档并回答开发人员的提问。系统中的 agent 反复进行规划、检索与评估，同时通过指向原始文档的链接，使工程师能够核查答案依据。其工业价值并不在于通用对话：该系统把答案限定在内部领域证据之内，并提供可供工程评审的来源链接。这是轮胎开发工作流内部的部署证据，针对的是法规、作业规程、测试与案例知识复用中的实际瓶颈。公司未提供任何时间节省、错误率、使用人数或基线数据。后续应关注可计量的检索时间缩短、答案质量评估、用户采用情况、权限控制表现，以及系统改变某项开发决策的公开案例。

title: Tolins subsidiary Terra Rubber starts construction of a reclaim-rubber facility in Kerala
what_happened: An issuer press release says Tolins Tyres subsidiary Terra Rubber broke ground on a reclaim-rubber manufacturing facility in Palakkad, Kerala, intended to convert scrap tires and rubber waste into reclaimed rubber for circular use and extended-producer-responsibility needs. The project is a physical construction-stage signal from an Indian tire maker outside the active registry and could add regional reclaim capacity. Capacity, commissioning schedule, process yield, customers, and economics were not disclosed in the accessible release. Watch for Permits, equipment installation, designed capacity, commissioning, product specifications, and named tire-industry customers.

sources.publisher: Tolins Tyres issuer press release via Bazaarwatch
sources.link_label: Tolins Tyres issuer press release via Bazaarwatch

title_zh: Tolins 子公司 Terra Rubber 在喀拉拉邦启动再生橡胶工厂建设
what_happened_zh: 一则发行人新闻稿称，Tolins Tyres 子公司 Terra Rubber 已在喀拉拉邦 Palakkad 为一座再生橡胶生产工厂破土动工，计划把废旧轮胎和橡胶废料转化为再生橡胶，用于循环利用和生产者责任延伸需求。该项目来自活跃注册名单之外的一家印度轮胎制造商，是实体建设阶段的信号，并有可能增加区域再生橡胶产能。可获取的新闻稿未披露产能、投产时间、工艺收率、客户和经济性。后续应关注许可审批、设备安装、设计产能、投产、产品规格，以及具名的轮胎行业客户。

title: Continental's ZEvRA concept reaches 43% recycled and renewable content
what_happened: Continental presented a ZEvRA research tire containing 43% recycled and renewable materials, developed within the EU-backed zero-emission vehicle project. The company frames it as a demonstrator and identifies further validation before series application. The demonstrator is a materially higher-content formulation signal, but the concept stage keeps durability, consistency, cost, and scaled supply open. It is progress in integration, not evidence of commercial-volume adoption. Watch for Validated performance against a production reference, named material shares, series nomination, and supplier-scale availability.
title_zh: 大陆集团 ZEvRA 概念轮胎的再生与可再生材料占比达到 43%
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团展示了一条含 43% 再生与可再生材料的 ZEvRA 研究轮胎，该产品在欧盟支持的零排放车辆项目中开发。公司将其定位为示范产品，并指出在量产应用之前仍需进一步验证。该示范产品代表材料占比明显提高的配方信号，但概念阶段使耐久性、一致性、成本和规模化供应仍然悬而未决。这是材料集成方面的进展，而不是商业化量产采用的证据。后续应关注与量产参照产品对比的验证性能、具名的材料占比、量产提名，以及供应商规模的可获得性。

title: Triangle reports a 10.3% year-on-year rise in second-quarter raw-material purchase prices as tire selling prices fall
what_happened: Triangle's half-year filing says average tire selling prices in the second quarter fell 4.09% year over year and 0.42% quarter over quarter, while average raw-material purchase prices rose 10.31% year over year and 13.36% quarter over quarter. The same-company comparison is direct evidence of the cost-price squeeze facing a major Shandong producer. It is more diagnostic than general claims about higher rubber costs because it places input and output prices on the same reporting basis. Watch for Third-quarter price realization, raw-material purchase prices, gross margin, and whether announced channel price increases close the gap.
title_zh: 三角轮胎报告第二季度原材料采购价格同比上涨 10.3%，而轮胎售价下滑
what_happened_zh: 三角轮胎半年度报告称，第二季度轮胎平均售价同比下降 4.09%、环比下降 0.42%，同期原材料平均采购价格同比上涨 10.31%、环比上涨 13.36%。同一公司口径的对比，是这家山东主要生产商面临成本与价格挤压的直接证据。由于把投入与产出价格置于同一报告基础之上，它比关于橡胶成本上涨的笼统说法更具诊断价值。后续应关注第三季度的价格实现、原材料采购价格、毛利率，以及已宣布的渠道涨价能否弥合价差。

title: Linglong's first-half revenue rises 7.8% while attributable profit falls 88.1%
what_happened: Linglong reported first-half revenue of RMB12.733 billion, up 7.80%, attributable profit of RMB101.44 million, down 88.13%, and operating cash flow of RMB1.316 billion, up 3,088.64%. The filing also identifies EUR227.7 million of borrowings as foreign-exchange exposure and says the group uses forwards and swaps to manage currency risk. Rising sales did not translate into profit, making foreign exchange and input-cost exposure a more important competitive variable than volume alone. The cash-flow recovery helps liquidity but does not explain away the margin compression. Watch for Second-half gross margin, foreign-exchange gains or losses, and whether hedging reduces earnings volatility without constraining overseas operations.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎上半年营业收入增长 7.8%，归母净利润下降 88.1%
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎报告上半年营业收入 RMB12.733 billion，增长 7.80%；归母净利润 RMB101.44 million，下降 88.13%；经营活动现金流 RMB1.316 billion，增长 3,088.64%。该文件还指出 EUR227.7 million 的借款构成外汇敞口，并称集团使用远期和掉期工具管理汇率风险。销售增长并未转化为利润，使外汇与投入成本敞口成为比销量本身更重要的竞争变量。现金流回升有助于流动性，但并不能解释毛利率压缩。后续应关注下半年毛利率、外汇损益，以及对冲是否能在不制约海外经营的前提下降低业绩波动。

title: Probabilistic LCA finds rubber-binder climate results can reverse with the allocation method
companies: Nanjing Institute of Technology research team
what_happened: A peer-reviewed study modelled cradle-to-gate greenhouse-gas impact for one metric ton of binder across eight alternatives and three end-of-life allocation approaches using 10,000-iteration Monte Carlo simulation. Under cut-off allocation, mean impact fell from 496 kg CO2e/t for the control to 446-471 kg CO2e/t, and the 30% crumb-rubber/15% bio-oil option had a 98.8% probability of outperforming the control; clinker-fuel system expansion reversed the result. Allocation choice, not only formulation, can determine whether a tire-derived material appears climate-positive, so procurement claims need sensitivity analysis rather than one carbon number. The paper provides quantified uncertainty instead of a single deterministic footprint and exposes a decision risk for tire-rubber circularity claims: the conclusion changes when displaced end-of-life uses are credited differently. Watch for Plant-specific inventory data, measured binder and pavement performance, and whether purchasers require multiple allocation scenarios in product-carbon declarations.
title_zh: 概率化 LCA 研究发现：橡胶改性胶结料的气候结果会随分配方法而反转
what_happened_zh: 一项同行评议研究采用 10,000 次蒙特卡洛模拟，对八种替代方案在三种报废阶段分配方法下、一公吨胶结料从摇篮到大门的温室气体影响进行了建模。在截断分配法下，平均影响从对照组的 496 kg CO2e/t 降至 446-471 kg CO2e/t，其中 30% 胶粉与 15% 生物油方案优于对照组的概率为 98.8%；而熟料燃料系统扩展法使结果反转。分配方法的选择，而不仅是配方，都可能决定一种轮胎衍生材料是否呈现气候正效应，因此采购层面的主张需要敏感性分析，而不是单一的碳数字。该论文给出的是量化的不确定性，而非单一确定性碳足迹，并揭示了轮胎橡胶循环利用主张中的一项决策风险：当被替代的报废用途以不同方式计入信用时，结论会发生改变。后续应关注工厂层面的清单数据、实测的胶结料与路面性能，以及采购方是否会要求在产品碳声明中提供多种分配情景。

title: Sentury closes its 12-million-tire Morocco project while its aviation-tire programme remains below plan
what_happened: Sentury's half-year disclosure says the Morocco project designed for 12 million tires a year completed implementation and closed its fundraising account in May-June 2026. The separate 80,000-unit aviation-tire project, including 50,000 retreads, has been implemented but remains below expected benefits while supplier-list qualification and joint development continue. The filing distinguishes physical project completion from commercial performance. Morocco has crossed a construction milestone, while aviation tires still need customer qualification and volume evidence before the investment can be treated as commercially mature. Watch for Morocco utilization and profitability, plus named aviation qualifications, repeat orders, and retread volumes.

sources.publisher: Qingdao Sentury Tire half-year fundraising report
sources.link_label: Qingdao Sentury Tire half-year fundraising report

title_zh: 森麒麟 12-million-tire 摩洛哥项目收官，航空轮胎项目仍低于计划
what_happened_zh: 森麒麟半年度披露称，设计年产能 12 million 条轮胎的摩洛哥项目已完成实施，并于 2026 年 5 月至 6 月注销募集资金专户。另一个 80,000 条航空轮胎项目（含 50,000 条翻新胎）虽已实施，但在供应商名录资质认证与联合开发仍在进行的情况下，效益仍低于预期。该文件把项目的实体完工与商业表现区分开来。摩洛哥项目已跨过建设里程碑，而航空轮胎在这笔投资被视为商业成熟之前，仍需客户资质认证与产量证据。后续应关注摩洛哥项目的产能利用率与盈利能力，以及具名的航空资质、复购订单和翻新产量。

title: FATE workers escalate a dismissal and pay dispute into a Buenos Aires march
what_happened: Página/12 reported that FATE workers and supporters marched to Plaza de Mayo and held a public event over dismissals, wages, and concern about the tire factory's continuity. The plant had not been reported closed in the article. The dispute is an operating-continuity and labor-cost signal at an active Argentine manufacturer. Claims from workers and the union need to remain attributed until the company or an official proceeding supplies a competing record. Watch for Company response, reinstatement or bargaining outcomes, production changes, court or labor-authority records, and any verified closure decision.
title_zh: FATE 工人把解雇与薪酬纠纷升级为布宜诺斯艾利斯游行
what_happened_zh: Página/12 报道称，FATE 工人及支持者游行至五月广场并举行公开活动，抗议解雇与薪酬问题，并表达对这家轮胎工厂存续的担忧。文章并未报道该工厂已经关闭。该纠纷是这家仍在运营的阿根廷制造商的经营连续性与劳动力成本信号。在公司或官方程序提供相反记录之前，工人和工会方面的主张仍需保持注明来源。后续应关注公司回应、复职或谈判结果、生产变化、法院或劳动主管部门记录，以及任何经核实的关停决定。

title: Nexen signs a roughly 4 MW direct renewable-power agreement for its Yangsan plant
what_happened: Nexen said it signed a direct power-purchase agreement covering roughly 4 MW of onshore wind and solar generation for its Yangsan plant and is expanding self-generation at Yangsan and Changnyeong. A direct PPA is a contracted change in factory electricity sourcing, stronger than a general renewable-energy target. The release does not state annual generation, renewable share, price, or avoided emissions. Watch for Commissioning dates, delivered megawatt-hours, renewable share of plant demand, contract term, and verified emissions impact.
title_zh: Nexen 为 Yangsan 工厂签署约 4 MW 可再生电力直购协议
what_happened_zh: Nexen 表示，已就为 Yangsan 工厂供应约 4 MW 陆上风电与光伏发电签署直购电协议，并正在 Yangsan 和 Changnyeong 扩大自发电。直购电协议是工厂电力来源的合同化改变，强于笼统的可再生能源目标。该新闻稿未说明年发电量、可再生能源占比、价格或减排量。后续应关注投运时间、实际供电量、可再生能源在工厂用电中的占比、合同期限，以及经核实的排放影响。

title: General Science reports an external line-side pilot for AI visual inspection
what_happened: General Science's half-year report says it completed full-chain AI integration and moved an AI visual-inspection application into an external line-side pilot. It also reported revenue of RMB4.448 billion, up 11.20%, attributable profit of RMB138.1 million, up 114.84%, and operating cash flow of RMB840.9 million. Industrial AI evidence is moving from internal demonstrations toward external line-side trials, but quantified defect-detection performance remains the missing proof layer. A line-side pilot is stronger evidence than an award or lab demo because it puts the system beside a production process. The disclosure still omits the customer, defect classes, false-reject rate, throughput, and baseline, so it does not establish production-scale value. Watch for Customer identity, measured detection accuracy and false-reject rate, production throughput, and conversion from pilot to a paid repeat deployment.
title_zh: 通用股份披露 AI 视觉检测的外部线边试点
what_happened_zh: 通用股份半年度报告称，公司已完成全链条 AI 融合，并把一项 AI 视觉检测应用推进到外部线边试点。报告还显示营业收入 RMB4.448 billion，增长 11.20%；归母净利润 RMB138.1 million，增长 114.84%；经营活动现金流 RMB840.9 million。工业 AI 的证据正从内部演示走向外部线边试验，但量化的缺陷检出表现仍是缺失的证明环节。线边试点比获奖或实验室演示更有力，因为它把系统放在了生产工序旁边。该披露仍未给出客户、缺陷类别、误判率、生产节拍和基线，因此并不能确立规模化生产价值。后续应关注客户身份、实测检出准确率与误判率、生产节拍，以及从试点转为付费复购部署的情况。

title: Guizhou Tyre's Vietnam output rises 39.8% while Phase III debugging weighs on subsidiary profit
what_happened: Guizhou Tyre reported first-half production of 5.420 million tires, up 17.87%, sales of 5.070 million, up 9.59%, revenue of RMB5.739 billion, up 10.51%, and attributable profit of RMB358.5 million, up 44.23%. Vietnam production rose 39.76% and sales 20.76%, but the subsidiary's profit fell 32.25% as Phase III equipment and products were debugged, assets transferred, passenger-tire R&D continued, and foreign exchange moved against it. The Vietnam plant is clearly ramping, but the disclosure shows why output growth is not the same as a mature overseas operation: commissioning, product development, depreciation, and currency effects can depress profit during the transition. Watch for Phase III utilization, passenger-tire qualification, Vietnam unit margin, and whether sales growth catches production growth.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎越南产量增长 39.8%，三期调试拖累子公司利润
what_happened_zh: 贵州轮胎报告上半年产量 5.420 million 条轮胎，增长 17.87%；销量 5.070 million 条，增长 9.59%；营业收入 RMB5.739 billion，增长 10.51%；归母净利润 RMB358.5 million，增长 44.23%。越南产量增长 39.76%、销量增长 20.76%，但由于三期设备与产品处于调试、资产划转、乘用车轮胎研发持续推进以及汇率不利变动，该子公司利润下降 32.25%。越南工厂显然处于产能爬坡阶段，但披露内容说明了为何产量增长并不等于成熟的海外运营：调试、产品开发、折旧和汇率影响都可能在过渡期压低利润。后续应关注三期产能利用率、乘用车轮胎认证、越南单位盈利能力，以及销量增长能否追上产量增长。

title: Sailun and Bosch Car Service open a joint retail-service outlet in Indonesia's PIK 2
companies: Sailun Tire; Bosch Car Service; XMotors
what_happened: The Tyreman reported that Sailun Tire, XMotors as Bosch Car Service's Indonesian master-licence partner, and local partners opened a co-branded store in the PIK 2 development. The outlet combines tire retail with vehicle-service capability in one customer-facing channel. The store puts a Chinese tire brand inside a recognized automotive-service format rather than relying only on a tire distributor. It is a concrete route-to-market experiment, although one outlet does not yet establish scale or sales productivity. Watch for Store throughput, additional openings, product mix, and whether the model expands beyond the Jakarta market.
title_zh: 赛轮与 Bosch Car Service 在印度尼西亚 PIK 2 开设联合零售服务门店
what_happened_zh: The Tyreman 报道称，赛轮轮胎、作为 Bosch Car Service 印度尼西亚总代理伙伴的 XMotors 以及本地合作方，在 PIK 2 开发区开设了一家联合品牌门店。该门店把轮胎零售与车辆服务能力整合在同一个面向客户的渠道之中。这家门店把一个中国轮胎品牌放进了获得认可的汽车服务业态，而不是仅依靠轮胎经销商。这是一次具体的市场路径试验，不过单一门店尚不足以确立规模或销售产出水平。后续应关注门店业务量、新增门店、产品结构，以及该模式能否扩展到雅加达市场之外。

title: Context: California closes the docket after approving replacement-tire efficiency rules
what_happened: The California Energy Commission docket posted a closure memorandum during the reporting week after the Commission approved the replacement-tire efficiency programme on August 17. The rule will shape market-access and product-data requirements, but the substantive approval predates the week; the closure memo is administrative chronology rather than a new rule stage. The Aug. 26 docket-close memo follows an Aug. 17 approval outside the window; retained for regulatory continuity and excluded from the core count. Watch for Effective dates, compliance guidance, test-data submissions, and manufacturer or dealer implementation.
title_zh: 背景信息：加州在批准替换轮胎能效规则后关闭案卷
what_happened_zh: 加州能源委员会的案卷在本报告期内发布了一份结案备忘录，此前该委员会已于 8 月 17 日批准替换轮胎能效计划。该规则将影响市场准入与产品数据要求，但实质性批准发生在本周之前；结案备忘录属于行政程序记录，而不是新的规则阶段。8 月 26 日的结案备忘录对应的是窗口期之外 8 月 17 日的批准；本条为保持监管连续性而保留，并不计入核心内容。后续应关注生效日期、合规指引、测试数据提交，以及制造商或经销商的执行情况。

title: Context: Linglong is the first Chinese full member of the Global Data Service Organization
what_happened: A weekly trade-media item restated Linglong's entry as GDSO's fourteenth member and first Chinese tire-maker full member. Earlier dated coverage places the underlying announcement on August 13, outside this reporting window. Membership could connect a Chinese manufacturer's tire data to shared digital-identification infrastructure, but the week produced no implementation detail or new stage beyond the earlier membership announcement. The Aug. 24 item repeats an Aug. 13 membership event, so it is retained as visible context and excluded from the core floor and China-share calculation. Watch for a dated implementation, API participation, digital product passport, or customer use of Linglong data through the GDSO framework.
title_zh: 背景信息：玲珑轮胎成为全球数据服务组织首家中国全权会员
what_happened_zh: 一则周度行业媒体信息重述了玲珑轮胎成为 GDSO 第十四家会员、也是首家中国轮胎制造商全权会员的消息。更早的带日期报道把相关公告时间定在 8 月 13 日，位于本报告窗口之外。会员资格有可能把一家中国制造商的轮胎数据接入共享的数字识别基础设施，但本周并未产生任何实施细节，也没有超出此前会员公告的新阶段。8 月 24 日的这条信息重复了 8 月 13 日的入会事件，因此作为可见背景信息保留，并排除在核心内容下限和中国占比计算之外。后续应关注带日期的实施进展、API 参与情况、数字产品护照，或客户通过 GDSO 框架使用玲珑数据的情况。

title: Context: Triangle begins a two-year Brentford FC partnership with STS as delivery partner
companies: Triangle Tyre; Brentford FC; Stapleton's Tyre Services
what_happened: A trade-media recap described Triangle as Brentford FC's inaugural official tire partner under a two-year agreement, with UK distributor STS supporting local activation. Brentford and Triangle's own pages date the underlying agreement to August 19. The distributor-linked partnership is relevant to European positioning, but the weekly mention does not create a new contract stage or provide tire-sales evidence. The accessible Aug. 26 recap concerns an Aug. 19 agreement outside the window; it is context, not a new weekly core signal. Watch for Dealer campaigns, measurable UK sell-through, customer acquisition, and any extension from brand exposure into fleet or OE business.
title_zh: 背景信息：三角轮胎启动为期两年的 Brentford FC 合作，由 STS 作为落地伙伴
what_happened_zh: 一则行业媒体回顾报道把三角轮胎描述为 Brentford FC 首家官方轮胎合作伙伴，双方签署为期两年的协议，并由英国分销商 STS 支持本地落地活动。Brentford 与三角轮胎自己的页面把相关协议时间定在 8 月 19 日。这一与分销商挂钩的合作对欧洲市场定位具有相关性，但本周的提及并未形成新的合同阶段，也未提供轮胎销售证据。可获取的 8 月 26 日回顾报道涉及的是窗口期之外 8 月 19 日的协议；因此属于背景信息，而不是本周新的核心信号。后续应关注经销商推广活动、可衡量的英国终端销售、客户获取，以及品牌曝光是否会延伸为车队或原配业务。

title: Michelin remains the exclusive FIA WEC Hypercar tire supplier through 2032
what_happened: Michelin said its exclusive tire-supply role for the FIA World Endurance Championship Hypercar category has been extended through the 2032 season. A six-season horizon gives Michelin a durable customer and test platform across multiple manufacturers. The commercial terms and development obligations remain undisclosed. Watch for the next tire specification, manufacturer participation, allocation rules, and evidence of technology transfer to road products.
title_zh: 米其林继续担任 FIA WEC Hypercar 组别独家轮胎供应商至 2032 年
what_happened_zh: 米其林表示，其在 FIA 世界耐力锦标赛 Hypercar 组别的独家轮胎供应角色已延长至 2032 赛季。六个赛季的时间跨度，为米其林提供了稳定的客户以及跨多家整车制造商的测试平台。商业条款与开发义务仍未披露。后续应关注下一代轮胎规格、整车制造商参赛情况、配胎分配规则，以及向公路产品技术转移的证据。

title: Volkswagen selects Continental's EcoContact 7 for the electric ID. Polo
what_happened: Continental said Volkswagen approved 17- and 18-inch EcoContact 7 sizes as original equipment for the ID. Polo and recommends AllSeasonContact 2 and WinterContact TS 870 P products for seasonal replacement. The fitment links a high-volume electric platform to a defined summer and replacement portfolio, giving stronger customer evidence than a product launch without an automaker selection. Watch for ID. Polo production volumes, regional fitment mix, and whether the seasonal recommendations translate into dealer replacement programmes.
title_zh: 大众为纯电 ID. Polo 选择大陆集团 EcoContact 7
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团表示，大众已批准 17 与 18-inch 的 EcoContact 7 规格作为 ID. Polo 的原厂配套，并推荐 AllSeasonContact 2 与 WinterContact TS 870 P 产品用于季节性替换。该配套把一个大批量电动平台与明确的夏季及替换市场产品线连接起来，相比没有整车制造商选择的产品发布，提供了更有力的客户证据。后续应关注 ID. Polo 的产量、各地区配套结构，以及季节性推荐能否转化为经销商替换市场项目。

title: Haian's mining-tire management service grows 26.2% and reaches nearly one-third of revenue
what_happened: Haian reported RMB343 million of mining-tire management-service revenue in the first half, up 26.23% and equal to 30.75% of total revenue. The company added 24 customers and said exports represented more than 60% of revenue. A service line approaching one-third of revenue is evidence that lifecycle management is becoming a material business model rather than an add-on to tire sales. New customers and export concentration also make the model testable in operating results. Watch for Contract renewals, service margin, tire life or cost-per-hour outcomes, and the number of mines converted from product sales to managed service.
title_zh: Haian 矿用轮胎管理服务增长 26.2%，接近总收入的三分之一
what_happened_zh: Haian 报告上半年矿用轮胎管理服务收入 RMB343 million，增长 26.23%，相当于总收入的 30.75%。公司新增 24 家客户，并称出口占收入的 60% 以上。一条接近总收入三分之一的服务业务，说明全生命周期管理正在成为实质性的商业模式，而不只是轮胎销售的附加项。新增客户与出口集中度也使该模式可以在经营业绩中得到检验。后续应关注合同续签、服务毛利率、轮胎寿命或单小时成本结果，以及由产品销售转为托管服务的矿山数量。

title: Techking's mining-tire revenue rises 30.5% as it establishes a Japanese technology subsidiary
what_happened: Techking reported first-half revenue of RMB1.577 billion, up 27.04%, and attributable profit of RMB101 million, up 15.94%. Mining-tire revenue reached RMB1.068 billion, up 30.50%, with an 18.17% gross margin, and the company established a Japanese technology subsidiary. Mining tires are the company's dominant growth engine, while the Japanese subsidiary signals an attempt to place technical capability closer to global customers and talent. Profit growing slower than revenue keeps execution and margin under scrutiny. Watch for Named mining customers, overseas service contracts, the Japanese unit's technical outputs, and whether mining-tire margin holds as volume expands.
title_zh: Techking 矿用轮胎收入增长 30.5%，并设立日本技术子公司
what_happened_zh: Techking 报告上半年营业收入 RMB1.577 billion，增长 27.04%；归母净利润 RMB101 million，增长 15.94%。矿用轮胎收入达到 RMB1.068 billion，增长 30.50%，毛利率为 18.17%，公司还设立了一家日本技术子公司。矿用轮胎是该公司最主要的增长引擎，而日本子公司显示其试图把技术能力布置在更靠近全球客户与人才的位置。利润增速慢于收入，使执行与毛利率仍处于关注之中。后续应关注具名的矿业客户、海外服务合同、日本子公司的技术产出，以及矿用轮胎毛利率能否在销量扩张中保持。

title: Prometeon's Kocaeli-developed rally tires become OE on MM Technology's EVO5 truck
what_happened: Anadolu Agency reported that Prometeon's next-generation rally tires, developed at its Kocaeli R&D centre, were selected as original equipment for MM Technology's new EVO5 rally truck associated with Dakar champion Martin Macik. A named vehicle fitment provides customer validation for a Turkish-developed specialist tire. The public account does not provide compound, durability, or comparative performance data. Watch for Competition results, tire allocation and failure data, and whether the construction transfers into commercial off-road products.
title_zh: Prometeon 在 Kocaeli 开发的拉力轮胎成为 MM Technology EVO5 卡车原配
what_happened_zh: Anadolu Agency 报道称，Prometeon 在其 Kocaeli 研发中心开发的新一代拉力轮胎，被选为 MM Technology 新款 EVO5 拉力卡车的原厂配套，该车与达喀尔冠军 Martin Macik 相关联。具名的车型配套为一款土耳其本土开发的专业轮胎提供了客户验证。公开报道未提供胶料、耐久性或对比性能数据。后续应关注比赛成绩、轮胎配给与失效数据，以及该结构能否转化为商用非公路产品。

title: Aeolus grows domestic OE and overseas revenue in the first half
what_happened: Aeolus reported first-half revenue growth of 8.02% and attributable profit growth of 3.3%. The company said domestic original-equipment revenue rose 5.44%, overseas revenue rose 12.58%, and it expanded non-road tire business. The channel split supplies customer-side evidence that growth was not confined to one market. Overseas sales outpaced domestic OE, while profit grew much more slowly than revenue, leaving mix and margin as the next questions. Watch for Named OE programmes, non-road customer wins, export-market mix, and second-half margin by channel.
title_zh: Aeolus 上半年国内原配与海外收入双双增长
what_happened_zh: Aeolus 报告上半年营业收入增长 8.02%，归母净利润增长 3.3%。公司称国内原厂配套收入增长 5.44%，海外收入增长 12.58%，并扩大了非公路轮胎业务。渠道结构的拆分提供了客户侧证据，说明增长并不局限于单一市场。海外销售增速快于国内原配，而利润增速远低于收入增速，使产品结构与毛利率成为下一步的问题。后续应关注具名的原配项目、非公路客户获取、出口市场结构，以及下半年各渠道的毛利率。

title: Sailun reports first-half revenue of RMB20.0 billion and profit of RMB2.16 billion
what_happened: A same-day account of Sailun's half-year results reports revenue of RMB20.03 billion, up 13.9%, attributable profit of RMB2.16 billion, up 18.0%, and operating cash flow of RMB1.033 billion, up 16.9%. Second-quarter revenue reached RMB10.57 billion and attributable profit RMB1.103 billion. Sailun's growth provides a counterpoint to the profit compression reported by several peers, suggesting that global capacity and product mix are producing materially different outcomes across Chinese manufacturers. Watch for the exchange-filed full report, plant-level utilization in Mexico, Indonesia and Egypt, and the share of growth coming from named OE or replacement customers.
title_zh: 赛轮报告上半年营业收入 RMB20.0 billion、净利润 RMB2.16 billion
what_happened_zh: 一篇同日报道称，赛轮半年度业绩实现营业收入 RMB20.03 billion，增长 13.9%；归母净利润 RMB2.16 billion，增长 18.0%；经营活动现金流 RMB1.033 billion，增长 16.9%。第二季度营业收入达到 RMB10.57 billion，归母净利润为 RMB1.103 billion。赛轮的增长与多家同业披露的利润压缩形成对照，似乎表明全球产能与产品结构正在中国制造商之间带来显著不同的结果。后续应关注交易所披露的完整报告，墨西哥、印度尼西亚和埃及的工厂级产能利用率，以及增长中来自具名原配或替换市场客户的比例。

title: Linglong moves DVA innerliner material into stable small-batch tire production
what_happened: Linglong said its DVA program had reached about 5,000 trial tires per month after it and Dawn developed a co-continuous crosslinked structure and an online film-application process. A high-barrier thermoplastic-elastomer innerliner is moving from material promise toward process-compatible tire production. The stated batch rate is concrete industrial evidence, but the 7-10 times barrier, 80% weight and 50% durability claims are company figures without a disclosed test protocol. Watch for homologation, named vehicle trials, scrap rates and independently tested gas retention and durability.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎将 DVA 气密层材料推进到稳定的小批量轮胎生产
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎表示，在与 Dawn 共同开发出共连续交联结构和在线贴膜工艺之后，其 DVA 项目的试制量已达到约每月 5,000 条轮胎。一种高阻隔热塑性弹性体气密层正从材料前景走向与工艺相匹配的轮胎生产。所述批量产出是具体的工业证据，但 7-10 倍阻隔性、80% 减重和 50% 耐久性等主张均为公司数据，未公开测试方案。后续应关注型号认证、具名车辆试验、废品率，以及经独立测试的气密性与耐久性。

title: Guizhou Tyre positions Jieyun range for battery-electric delivery trucks
what_happened: Guizhou Tyre introduced metric and light-truck products for urban delivery, citing reinforced carcasses, low-heat compounds and wet-grip features for heavier, frequently stopping electric vehicles. Commercial-vehicle electrification is producing application-specific tire designs that combine load capacity, heat control and rolling resistance. The products translate electric-truck duty cycles into explicit construction and compound choices, although the source gives no controlled comparative test values. Look for fleet mileage, rolling-resistance and wet-braking results against named conventional products.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎将 Jieyun 系列定位于纯电动配送卡车
what_happened_zh: 贵州轮胎推出面向城市配送的米制规格和轻卡产品，并提到针对更重、频繁启停的电动车辆采用了加强胎体、低生热配方和湿地抓地设计。商用车电动化正在催生把承载能力、生热控制和滚动阻力结合在一起的应用专用轮胎设计。这些产品把电动卡车的工作循环转化为明确的结构与配方选择，不过该来源没有给出受控的对比测试数值。后续应关注车队里程、滚动阻力，以及与具名常规产品对比的湿地制动结果。

title: Toyo launches Proxes G-Tour for gas, hybrid and electric vehicles
what_happened: Toyo introduced the Proxes G-Tour grand-touring all-season replacement tire, using an asymmetric tread and five-variable pitch design and beginning initial US sales in September. Replacement products are being designed and marketed across combustion, hybrid and electric powertrains instead of as narrowly separated EV lines. The launch broadens a major maker's efficient touring offer, but the release provides no third-party comparison or quantified rolling-resistance result. Watch independent wet, snow, noise and efficiency testing as more sizes reach dealers.
title_zh: 东洋推出面向燃油、混动与纯电车型的 Proxes G-Tour
what_happened_zh: 东洋推出 Proxes G-Tour 豪华旅行型全季节替换轮胎，采用非对称胎面和五节距变化设计，并自 9 月起在美国开始初步销售。替换市场产品正被设计和推广为同时覆盖燃油、混动和纯电动力，而不再作为界限分明的电动车专用产品线。此次上市拓宽了一家主要制造商的高效旅行产品供应，但该发布没有提供第三方对比或量化的滚动阻力结果。后续应关注随着更多规格到店，独立的湿地、雪地、噪声和能效测试结果。

title: Double Coin presents three electric-vehicle commercial tire products in Shanghai
what_happened: Double Coin presented three commercial-vehicle tire products aimed at electric applications during CITEXPO, with positioning around load, rolling resistance and operating noise. Chinese commercial-tire portfolios are being segmented around the higher axle loads and energy-efficiency needs of electrified fleets. The named products and use cases are concrete, but the report did not publish comparative fleet or laboratory measurements. Watch for named OE or fleet adoption and standardized rolling-resistance and mileage data.
title_zh: Double Coin 在上海展示三款面向电动车的商用轮胎产品
what_happened_zh: Double Coin 在 CITEXPO 期间展示了三款面向电动化应用的商用车轮胎产品，定位围绕承载、滚动阻力和使用噪声展开。中国商用轮胎产品组合正围绕电动化车队更高的轴荷和能效需求进行细分。具名产品和应用场景是具体的，但该报道没有公布对比性的车队或实验室测量数据。后续应关注具名的原配或车队采用情况，以及标准化的滚动阻力与里程数据。

title: Prinx Chengshan shows giant-tire, smart-tire and electric-truck technologies
what_happened: Prinx Chengshan's CITEXPO display combined 57-inch giant-tire manufacturing progress with GPT low-rolling-resistance, X-CHIP smart-tire and ETT electric-truck wear technologies. Product portfolios are combining special-purpose scale, embedded sensing and duty-cycle-specific designs in one development pipeline. The source confirms products and technologies shown, not independently measured superiority. Look for customer deployments of X-CHIP and field results for the electric-truck and mining products.
title_zh: 浦林成山展示巨型轮胎、智能轮胎与电动卡车技术
what_happened_zh: 浦林成山在 CITEXPO 的展台把 57-inch 巨型轮胎的制造进展，与 GPT 低滚动阻力、X-CHIP 智能轮胎和 ETT 电动卡车耐磨技术结合在一起。产品组合正把特种规格、嵌入式传感和针对具体工作循环的设计纳入同一条开发链。该来源确认的是所展示的产品与技术，而不是经独立测量的性能优势。后续应关注 X-CHIP 的客户部署情况，以及电动卡车和矿用产品的现场结果。

title: CRIA releases January-July operating indicators for China's rubber industry
what_happened: CRIA posted its January-July partial indicators and operating review, extending the monitored series on output, revenue, profit, inventory and exports. Association member-company data continue to show why volume, revenue and profitability must be separated when judging rubber-sector health. The release is a structured industry dataset, but its member sample and aggregation differ from national statistical series. Compare the association series with customs and National Bureau of Statistics data when full tables are available.
title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会发布 1月至7月 中国橡胶行业运行指标
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会公布了 1月至7月 的部分指标和运行综述，延续其对产量、收入、利润、库存和出口的监测序列。协会会员企业数据持续说明，在判断橡胶行业健康状况时必须把产量、收入和盈利能力区分开来。该发布是结构化的行业数据集，但其会员样本和汇总方式与国家统计序列并不相同。后续应在完整表格可获取时，把协会序列与海关及国家统计局数据进行比较。

title: China natural-rubber spot assessment reaches RMB17,900 per tonne
what_happened: A Chinese market report placed a natural-rubber spot assessment at RMB17,900 per tonne on 4 September, about 14% higher year to date, alongside a new round of tire price letters. Natural-rubber strength is arriving together with carbon-black and synthetic-rubber pressure, narrowing manufacturers' ability to offset one input with another. A single assessed price is not a transaction-weighted industry average and grades, locations and contract timing vary. Compare exchange settlements, physical premiums and tire-company procurement disclosures.
title_zh: 中国天然橡胶现货评估价达到 RMB17,900 每吨
what_happened_zh: 一份中国市场报告称，9 月 4 日天然橡胶现货评估价为 RMB17,900 每吨，年初至今上涨约 14%，同期还出现新一轮轮胎涨价函。天然橡胶走强与炭黑、合成橡胶的压力同时出现，削弱了制造商以一种原料涨价抵消另一种原料涨价的能力。单一评估价并不是以成交量加权的行业均价，牌号、地点和合同时点也存在差异。后续应比较交易所结算价、现货升水，以及轮胎企业的采购披露。

title: ZC Rubber signs letter of intent for proposed $500 million Egypt complex
what_happened: Egyptian authorities witnessed a letter of intent between the Suez Canal Economic Zone and ZC Rubber for a possible $500 million integrated tire complex on about 600,000 square metres. Egypt is becoming a manufacturing and export-route option for Chinese tire groups seeking access to African, Middle Eastern and European markets. The document is a letter of intent, not a final investment approval, funded construction plan or operating asset. Watch for land allocation, board approval, environmental permits, construction contracts and a phased capacity schedule.
title_zh: 中策橡胶就规划中的 $500 million 埃及综合基地签署意向书
what_happened_zh: 埃及有关部门见证苏伊士运河经济区与中策橡胶签署意向书，拟建设一座 $500 million 的一体化轮胎基地，占地约 600,000 平方米。对于寻求进入非洲、中东和欧洲市场的中国轮胎集团，埃及正在成为制造和出口路径的一个选项。该文件只是意向书，并不是最终投资批准、已落实资金的建设计划或已投运资产。后续应关注土地划拨、董事会批准、环保许可、施工合同以及分期产能计划。

title: Anhui Koteli files environmental assessment for 12-million-tire project
what_happened: A publicized environmental-assessment filing described a proposed Anhui project with annual capacity for 12 million tires, moving the project into a formal permitting stage. Permit and environmental-review records provide earlier and more accountable capacity signals than promotional launch announcements. The filing identifies scope and stage but does not establish financing, construction progress or a commissioning date. Check approval documents, construction tenders and equipment procurement before treating the capacity as committed.
title_zh: Anhui Koteli 为 12-million-tire 项目提交环境影响评价
what_happened_zh: 一份公示的环境影响评价文件描述了安徽一个规划项目，年产能为 12 million 条轮胎，使该项目进入正式审批阶段。许可与环保审查记录比宣传性的发布公告更早、更可追溯地提供产能信号。该文件明确了范围和阶段，但并没有确立融资、建设进度或投产时间。后续应在把该产能视为已落实之前，核查批复文件、工程招标和设备采购。

title: Continental plans job reductions as Korbach solid-tire production changes
what_happened: Trade reporting said Continental would reduce positions at its Korbach site as the company changed the plant's solid industrial tire role. European industrial-tire capacity is being rebalanced toward other production locations rather than protected by historic site importance. The report establishes a restructuring signal but detailed timing, product flows and final headcount require direct company or works-council confirmation. Watch consultation outcomes and the destination, schedule and customer effects of transferred production.
title_zh: 大陆集团因 Korbach 实心轮胎生产调整而计划裁减岗位
what_happened_zh: 行业报道称，随着公司调整该厂的实心工业轮胎定位，大陆集团将在 Korbach 基地减少岗位。欧洲工业轮胎产能正在向其他生产基地重新平衡，而不是依靠基地的历史地位得到保护。该报道确立了重组信号，但具体时间安排、产品流向和最终裁员人数仍需公司或职工委员会直接确认。后续应关注协商结果，以及转移产能的目的地、时间表和对客户的影响。

title: Linglong details premium OE, channel and sustainable-material priorities
what_happened: Linglong's president said high-end products represented about 70% of its 2025-2026 automaker nominations and described nearly 30,000 Chinese partner stores, a four-tier delivery model and an 85% sustainable-material tire prototype. Large Chinese makers are coupling premium OE nominations with denser service channels and material-development claims rather than relying on export price alone. The interview supplies quantified strategic markers, but most figures are company statements and the sustainable-material tire is not presented as mass-market volume. Track named nominations entering production, same-day delivery coverage and independent validation of material content.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎详述高端原配、渠道与可持续材料重点方向
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎总裁表示，高端产品约占公司 2025-2026 年整车厂定点项目的 70%，并介绍了近 30,000 家中国合作门店、四级交付模式以及一款可持续材料占比 85% 的轮胎样品。中国大型轮胎企业正把高端原配定点与更密集的服务渠道和材料开发主张结合起来，而不再仅依靠出口价格。该访谈提供了量化的战略标志，但多数数据属于公司表述，而这款可持续材料轮胎也没有被描述为量产规模。后续应跟踪具名定点项目进入量产的情况、当日交付覆盖范围，以及材料含量的独立验证。

title: More than 20 Chinese tire companies issue a third round of price notices
what_happened: A trade-media tally found more than 20 manufacturers had issued price notices, mostly for 2-3% increases and 3-5% for inner tubes, with many changes centered on 1 September. Repeated price letters show manufacturers attempting to transmit rubber, carbon-black and synthetic-rubber costs into distribution channels. Notices signal intent, not realized transaction prices; promotions, rebates and weak demand can dilute implementation. Track dealer invoice data, channel inventory and whether another catch-up round follows later in September.
title_zh: 超过 20 家中国轮胎企业发布第三轮涨价函
what_happened_zh: 一项行业媒体统计发现，超过 20 家制造商已发出涨价函，多数涨幅为 2-3%，内胎为 3-5%，其中许多调整集中在 9 月 1 日。反复出现的价格函显示，制造商正试图把橡胶、炭黑和合成橡胶成本传导到分销渠道。涨价函表达的是意向，而不是已实现的成交价格；促销、返利和需求疲弱都可能削弱执行效果。后续应跟踪经销商发票数据、渠道库存，以及 9 月稍后是否出现新一轮补涨。

title: Myers Industries agrees $30 million sale of Myers Tire Supply
what_happened: Myers Industries agreed to sell its North American Myers Tire Supply business to Lion Equity Partners for $30 million, subject to customary adjustments. Ownership of tire-service distribution assets continues to shift as diversified groups narrow portfolios and investment firms consolidate channels. The signed transaction value is concrete; the buyer's post-close operating plan was not described. Watch closing conditions, supplier continuity and changes to branches, inventory and customer terms.
title_zh: Myers Industries 同意以 $30 million 出售 Myers Tire Supply
what_happened_zh: Myers Industries 同意把其北美 Myers Tire Supply 业务以 $30 million 出售给 Lion Equity Partners，并以惯常调整为条件。随着多元化集团收窄业务组合、投资机构整合渠道，轮胎服务分销资产的所有权仍在持续转移。已签署的交易金额是具体的，但买方交割后的运营计划没有说明。后续应关注交割条件、供应商延续性，以及网点、库存和客户条款的变化。

title: Yokohama Rubber expands Borgo's global tire-manufacturing responsibilities
what_happened: Yokohama Rubber assigned Gregorio Borgo additional responsibilities in its global tire-manufacturing organization effective 1 September. Manufacturers are tightening cross-region operating accountability as portfolios and plants become more globally integrated. The appointment is factual but does not by itself prove a change in capacity, spending or market share. Watch the remit, reporting lines and subsequent plant or supply-chain decisions.
title_zh: 横滨橡胶扩大 Borgo 在全球轮胎制造方面的职责
what_happened_zh: 横滨橡胶自 9 月 1 日起赋予 Gregorio Borgo 在其全球轮胎制造组织中更多职责。随着产品组合和工厂在全球范围内更加一体化，制造商正在强化跨区域的运营责任。该任命是事实，但其本身并不能证明产能、支出或市场份额发生变化。后续应关注其职责范围、汇报关系，以及后续的工厂或供应链决策。

title: BKT uses first Steinexpo appearance to target quarry and aggregate users
what_happened: BKT made its Steinexpo debut with off-highway products for quarrying, aggregates and earthmoving, creating a direct channel to German extraction-industry customers. Off-highway makers are using application-specific field events as market-entry and distributor-support platforms. Participation is a commercial signal, not proof of orders or field performance. Watch German distributor appointments, trials and customer orders after the event.
title_zh: BKT 首次参展 Steinexpo，瞄准采石与骨料客户
what_happened_zh: BKT 首次参加 Steinexpo，带来面向采石、骨料和土方作业的非公路产品，由此建立起与德国采掘行业客户的直接渠道。非公路轮胎制造商正把针对具体应用的现场展会作为市场进入和经销商支持平台。参展是一个商业信号，并不能证明订单或实际使用表现。后续应关注展会之后德国经销商的任命、试用和客户订单。

title: Sumitomo Rubber to end karting tire supply after 2027
what_happened: Sumitomo Rubber Industries decided to stop supplying karting tires at the end of 2027, giving the market a defined portfolio-exit timetable. Specialist racing-tire portfolios are being tested for strategic fit even where products carry heritage and technical signaling value. The announced end date is firm public evidence; implications for individual series and distributors were not detailed. Watch replacement suppliers, final-order timing and whether compounds or tooling move to other categories.
title_zh: 住友橡胶将在 2027 年之后停止卡丁车轮胎供应
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶工业决定在 2027 年底停止供应卡丁车轮胎，为市场给出了明确的产品线退出时间表。即使产品带有历史传承和技术象征价值，专业赛车轮胎产品线仍在接受战略适配性的检验。公布的终止日期是确凿的公开证据，但对各赛事系列和经销商的影响没有详细说明。后续应关注替代供应商、最后订单时点，以及配方或模具是否转用于其他产品类别。

title: CITEXPO organizer reports more than 15,000 professional visitors
what_happened: The event recap reported more than 400 exhibitors and 15,000 professional visitors from over 140 countries and regions across the three-day Shanghai show. Large in-person trade events remain a channel for Chinese tire and equipment suppliers to meet cross-border buyers. Attendance is useful market context but is not evidence of orders, technical performance or investment decisions. Organizer-aligned attendance recap; retained as market context and excluded from the core-story count. Look for attributable contracts, distributor appointments and product evidence resulting from the show.
title_zh: CITEXPO 主办方称专业观众超过 15,000 人
what_happened_zh: 该展会回顾称，为期三天的上海展会汇集了超过 400 家展商，以及来自 140 多个国家和地区的 15,000 名专业观众。大型线下贸易展会仍是中国轮胎和设备供应商接触跨境买家的渠道。观众人数是有用的市场背景，但不构成订单、技术表现或投资决策的证据。属于与主办方口径一致的观众人数回顾；本条作为市场背景保留，不计入核心内容。后续应关注展会带来的可归因合同、经销商任命和产品证据。

title: Zodo recaps its CITEXPO product display
what_happened: Zodo published a company recap of its CITEXPO participation and displayed portfolio. Smaller Chinese manufacturers continue to use Shanghai's tire show for international visibility. The page is promotional and supplies no independently verifiable order, test or investment result. Direct promotional event recap without measurable commercial or technical outcome; excluded from the core-story count. Watch for named distributors, certifications or customer programs.
title_zh: Zodo 回顾其 CITEXPO 产品展示
what_happened_zh: Zodo 发布了一份关于自身参加 CITEXPO 及展出产品组合的公司回顾。中国规模较小的制造商仍在利用上海轮胎展获取国际曝光。该页面属于宣传性内容，没有提供可独立核实的订单、测试或投资结果。属于直接的宣传性展会回顾，没有可衡量的商业或技术成果；不计入核心内容。后续应关注具名经销商、认证或客户项目。

title: Sailun reports first-half volume and profit growth despite input-cost pressure
what_happened: A review of Sailun's half-year report put revenue at RMB20.027 billion, net profit at RMB2.160 billion and tire sales at 45.0135 million units, with reported year-on-year growth in each measure. Chinese tire globalization is moving from export volume toward multi-region production, mix management and standardized operations. The combination of sales growth and margin improvement under higher reported raw-material costs is a stronger customer-demand signal than capacity announcements alone. Track utilization at the Indonesia, Mexico and planned Egypt assets and the share of higher-value products.
title_zh: 赛轮报告上半年销量与利润增长，尽管投入成本承压
what_happened_zh: 一份对赛轮半年报的回顾显示，营业收入为 RMB20.027 billion，净利润为 RMB2.160 billion，轮胎销量为 45.0135 million 条，各项指标均报告同比增长。中国轮胎企业的全球化正从出口量转向多区域生产、产品结构管理和标准化运营。在原材料成本上升的情况下，销量增长与利润率改善并存，是比单纯的产能公告更强的客户需求信号。后续应跟踪印度尼西亚、墨西哥以及规划中的埃及资产的产能利用率，以及高附加值产品的占比。

title: Bridgestone RS12 selected as OE for Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R
what_happened: Bridgestone will supply 120/70ZR17 front and 190/55ZR17 rear BATTLAX Racing Street RS12 tires for Kawasaki's new Ninja ZX-10R. Track-derived motorcycle compounds and tread designs continue to move into homologated road-going fitments. An OE selection is concrete customer evidence, though the release does not publish Kawasaki's evaluation data. Watch production volumes and independent grip consistency testing over repeated laps.
title_zh: 普利司通 RS12 获选为 Kawasaki Ninja ZX-10R 原配轮胎
what_happened_zh: 普利司通将为 Kawasaki 新款 Ninja ZX-10R 提供前轮 120/70ZR17 和后轮 190/55ZR17 规格的 BATTLAX Racing Street RS12 轮胎。源自赛道的摩托车配方和胎面设计正持续进入经认证的公路配套产品。原配选型是具体的客户证据，不过该发布没有公布 Kawasaki 的评估数据。后续应关注量产规模，以及在连续多圈条件下抓地力一致性的独立测试。

title: Pirelli develops two dedicated fitments for Bentley Supersports
what_happened: Pirelli developed a P Zero Trofeo RS for track-oriented use and a P Zero for everyday driving for the rear-wheel-drive Bentley Supersports coupe. Premium OE programs increasingly use paired fitments to separate track performance from everyday usability on one vehicle platform. The named dual fitment is concrete, while the 1.3-g vehicle performance is not isolated as a tire-only result. Watch final sizes, homologation markings and independent track and wet-road comparisons.
title_zh: 倍耐力为 Bentley Supersports 开发两款专属配套轮胎
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力为后轮驱动的 Bentley Supersports 双门轿跑开发了面向赛道使用的 P Zero Trofeo RS，以及用于日常驾驶的 P Zero。高端原配项目正越来越多地采用成对配套，在同一车型平台上区分赛道性能与日常可用性。具名的双配套是具体的，而 1.3-g 的整车表现并没有被单独归结为轮胎本身的结果。后续应关注最终规格、认证标记，以及独立的赛道和湿滑路面对比测试。

title: eBay launches MOT hub linking inspection failures to parts demand
what_happened: eBay launched a UK MOT information hub that directs motorists toward common maintenance categories including tires, brakes and suspension. Digital marketplaces are using inspection and compliance moments to acquire aftermarket customers earlier in the repair journey. The service launch is observable, but traffic, conversion and tire-category sales effects were not published. Watch usage, conversion rates and whether fitting or local-service partners are added.
title_zh: eBay 推出 MOT 专题页面，把年检不合格项与配件需求连接起来
what_happened_zh: eBay 推出英国 MOT 信息专题页面，引导车主关注包括轮胎、制动和悬架在内的常见维修品类。数字市场平台正利用年检与合规节点，在维修流程更早的阶段获取售后客户。该服务上线是可观察的，但流量、转化以及轮胎品类销售的影响均未公布。后续应关注使用量、转化率，以及是否新增安装或本地服务合作伙伴。

title: Nokian launches Hakkapeliitta 01 with temperature-responsive studs
what_happened: Nokian introduced an adaptive base layer that firms in ice and snow to push studs outward and softens on warmer pavement so they retract deeper into the tread. Mechanical winter grip is becoming condition-responsive at the material-structure interface rather than fixed for all surfaces. Nokian claims up to 30% less road wear, 1 dB less cabin noise, 10% better ice grip and 5% better wet grip versus Hakkapeliitta 10; protocols were not supplied. Look for independent winter tests and durability of the adaptive layer over the tire's wear life.
title_zh: Nokian 推出采用温度响应式防滑钉的 Hakkapeliitta 01
what_happened_zh: Nokian 推出一种自适应基部胶层，在冰雪条件下变硬，把防滑钉向外顶出，在温度较高的路面上变软，使防滑钉更深地收回胎面之中。冬季机械抓地力正从对所有路面固定不变，转为在材料与结构界面上随工况响应。Nokian 称，相对 Hakkapeliitta 10，道路磨损最多减少 30%、车内噪声降低 1 dB、冰面抓地力提升 10%、湿地抓地力提升 5%；但未提供测试方案。后续应关注独立冬季测试，以及该自适应胶层在轮胎整个磨耗寿命期内的耐久性。

title: Giti segments Shenju commercial tires around three Chinese freight scenarios
what_happened: Giti described Shenju products for long-haul highway, mixed highway-national-road and winding mountain routes, linked to its T5 digital development platform. Commercial-tire design is shifting from broad axle categories toward route and duty-cycle definitions. The source identifies product-to-route logic but provides no named fleet comparison or controlled mileage result. Watch for fleet trials, casing durability and cost-per-kilometre evidence in each route class.
title_zh: 佳通围绕中国三类货运场景细分 Shenju 商用车轮胎
what_happened_zh: 佳通介绍了面向长途高速公路、高速与国道混合以及盘山路线的 Shenju 产品，并将其与自身 T5 数字化开发平台相关联。商用车轮胎设计正从宽泛的轴位分类转向按路线和工作循环来定义。该来源说明了产品与路线的对应逻辑，但没有提供具名车队对比或受控里程结果。后续应关注各路线类别中的车队试用、胎体耐久性以及单公里成本证据。

title: MRF completes new tarmac-rally tire development session in Italy
what_happened: MRF and Paolo Andreucci completed an intensive asphalt session evaluating multiple development specifications for the company's tarmac rally range. Instrumented motorsport programs continue to use experienced drivers and comparative specifications as rapid development loops. The test stage and purpose are clear, but MRF released no lap, wear, temperature or specification-level results. Watch the selected specification, competition debut and comparative stage performance.
title_zh: MRF 在意大利完成新一轮柏油路面拉力轮胎开发测试
what_happened_zh: MRF 与 Paolo Andreucci 完成了一次高强度沥青路面测试，评估了面向公司柏油拉力轮胎系列的多种开发规格。配备测量设备的赛车运动项目仍在以经验丰富的车手和对比规格作为快速开发循环。测试环节与目的是明确的，但 MRF 没有公布圈速、磨耗、温度或规格层面的结果。后续应关注最终选定的规格、比赛首次亮相以及赛段对比表现。

title: Apollo previews three EnduMile products ahead of IAA launch
what_happened: Apollo said it would launch EnduMile LHA, LH Front and LHD products at the following week's IAA Transportation show, completing a long-haul line around the existing LHT trailer tire. Truck-tire makers continue building axle-complete long-haul families. The products were pre-announced but had not yet reached the stated launch event during the reporting window. Pre-event announcement with no in-window launch or customer evidence; shown as context and excluded from the core count. Confirm specifications, labels, availability and customer trials after IAA.
title_zh: Apollo 在 IAA 发布前预告三款 EnduMile 产品
what_happened_zh: Apollo 表示将在下一周的 IAA Transportation 展会上发布 EnduMile LHA、LH Front 和 LHD 产品，从而围绕现有的 LHT 挂车轮胎补齐长途产品线。卡车轮胎制造商仍在继续构建覆盖全部轴位的长途产品家族。这些产品已提前宣布，但在报告期内尚未进入其宣称的发布活动。属于展会前预告，报告期内没有实际发布或客户证据；本条作为背景信息呈现，不计入核心内容。后续应在 IAA 之后确认规格、标签、供货情况和客户试用。

title: Chinese N220 carbon-black assessment approaches RMB9,628 per tonne
what_happened: A market report placed N220 carbon black near RMB9,628 per tonne as coal-tar costs and supply-side constraints pushed tire input costs higher. Carbon-black inflation is reinforcing natural-rubber pressure and narrowing the benefit of input diversification. Quoted assessments vary by grade, plant, region and contract; the article is not a transaction-weighted official index. Watch coal-tar supply, plant operating rates and realized procurement costs in tire-company disclosures.
title_zh: 中国 N220 炭黑评估价接近 RMB9,628 每吨
what_happened_zh: 一份市场报告称，随着煤焦油成本和供给端约束推高轮胎投入成本，N220 炭黑价格接近 RMB9,628 每吨。炭黑涨价正在强化天然橡胶带来的压力，并削弱原料多元化的收益。报价评估因牌号、工厂、地区和合同而异，该文章并非以成交量加权的官方指数。后续应关注煤焦油供应、炭黑装置开工率，以及轮胎企业披露中的实际采购成本。

title: Vulkanox 4060 returns to attention as a proposed 6PPD alternative
what_happened: Trade coverage again described Lanxess's CCPD antidegradant Vulkanox 4060 as an alternative to 6PPD. Regulatory concern about 6PPD-quinone is sustaining supplier work on substitute antidegradants. The underlying product and laboratory comparison were announced in March, so the September item is a repeated signal rather than a new technical stage. September coverage repeats a product first detailed by Lanxess in March; shown as context and excluded from the core count. Watch regulatory registration, production availability and tire-level durability and toxicology evidence.
title_zh: Vulkanox 4060 作为 6PPD 替代方案再度受到关注
what_happened_zh: 行业媒体再次将 Lanxess 的 CCPD 类防老剂 Vulkanox 4060 描述为 6PPD 的替代品。围绕 6PPD-醌 的监管担忧正在推动供应商持续开展替代防老剂工作。相关产品及实验室对比在 3 月已经公布，因此 9 月的这条信息属于重复信号，而不是新的技术阶段。9 月的报道重复了 Lanxess 在 3 月首次详细介绍的产品；本条作为背景信息呈现，不计入核心内容。后续应关注法规注册、量产供应情况，以及轮胎层面的耐久性与毒理学证据。

title: Shandong launches tire-manufacturing large-model ecosystem with Guangrao pilot
what_happened: A provincial-guided consortium launched the Jiaolun Yuzhi initiative for intelligent inspection and curing-process improvement, with the first implementation scenario in Guangrao. Shared models, edge infrastructure and factory testbeds could make advanced inspection and process tools accessible beyond the largest tire groups. The initiative has reached a pilot ecosystem stage, not demonstrated scaled results; the cited energy figure belongs to electromagnetic curing rather than the model itself. Watch false-reject rates, root-cause accuracy, line deployment, production yield and independently metered energy baselines.
title_zh: 山东启动轮胎制造大模型生态，首个试点落地广饶
what_happened_zh: 一个由省级层面引导的联合体启动了 Jiaolun Yuzhi 计划，聚焦智能检测与硫化工艺改进，首个落地场景位于广饶。共享模型、边缘基础设施和工厂测试平台，有可能让先进的检测与工艺工具不再局限于最大的轮胎集团。该计划目前处于试点生态阶段，并未展示规模化成果；所引用的能耗数据属于电磁硫化，而不是该模型本身。后续应关注误判率、根因定位准确度、生产线部署、生产合格率，以及经独立计量的能耗基线。

title: Shandong Dongsheng files 18-million motorcycle-tire and recycled-rubber project
what_happened: An association notice reported completion of project filing for annual capacity of 18 million motorcycle tires and 80,000 tonnes of recycled rubber. Combining downstream tire capacity with recycled-rubber supply suggests a more integrated two-wheel production model. Filing does not prove financing, construction or market absorption of the planned output. Track environmental approval, equipment tenders, construction and product qualification.
title_zh: Shandong Dongsheng 完成 18-million 摩托车轮胎与再生橡胶项目备案
what_happened_zh: 一则协会通知称，年产 18 million 条摩托车轮胎和 80,000 tonnes 再生橡胶的项目已完成备案。把下游轮胎产能与再生橡胶供应结合起来，显示出更为一体化的两轮车生产模式。备案并不能证明融资、建设或规划产量的市场消化能力。后续应跟踪环保审批、设备招标、工程建设和产品认证。

title: ZC Rubber starts trial production in phase-two mixing block
what_happened: Reporting on ZC Rubber's 5G factory said the phase-two mixing building had entered trial production within a base budgeted at RMB3.187 billion. The project is moving from construction into process commissioning, a more meaningful capacity stage than announcement alone. The report establishes trial operation but not stable yield, utilization or final output. Watch acceptance tests, qualified compound volume and the ramp into downstream tire lines.
title_zh: 中策橡胶二期密炼车间进入试生产
what_happened_zh: 关于中策橡胶 5G 工厂的报道称，在总预算为 RMB3.187 billion 的基地内，二期密炼楼已进入试生产。项目正从建设转入工艺调试，这是比单纯宣布更有意义的产能阶段。该报道确认了试运行，但未证实稳定的成品率、产能利用率或最终产量。后续应关注验收测试、合格胶料产量，以及向下游轮胎生产线的产能爬坡。

title: Guizhou Tyre advances tender for 30,000-tonne carbon-black unit
what_happened: A construction-bid report covered a 30,000-tonne carbon-black unit within a larger integrated plan described as 130,000 tonnes of annual capacity. Tire makers are revisiting upstream integration as carbon-black prices and supply variability rise. A tender is a project-stage signal, not proof of completed capacity or economic self-sufficiency. Watch award, construction, environmental approval and the share of internal tire demand supplied.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎推进 30,000-tonne 炭黑装置招标
what_happened_zh: 一则工程招标报道涉及一套 30,000-tonne 炭黑装置，隶属于一个被描述为年产能 130,000 tonnes 的更大一体化规划。随着炭黑价格上涨、供应波动加大，轮胎制造商正重新审视上游一体化。招标属于项目阶段信号，并不能证明产能已经建成或实现经济上的自给。后续应关注中标、工程建设、环保审批，以及内部轮胎需求的自供比例。

title: Hankook files $5.45 million zero-land smart upgrade at Jiaxing plant
what_happened: A Jiaxing filing covered a $5.45 million upgrade of aging third-workshop equipment without new land, scheduled from September 2026 through December 2027. Brownfield equipment replacement is becoming a route to qualify existing Chinese capacity for newer vehicle tire requirements. The filing fixes scope and budget but does not yet demonstrate productivity, quality or customer-share gains. Track equipment installation, acceptance and named new-energy OE programs.
title_zh: 韩泰嘉兴工厂备案 $5.45 million 零用地智能化改造
what_happened_zh: 嘉兴的一份备案涉及一项 $5.45 million 的改造，针对老旧的三车间设备、不新增用地，计划工期为 2026 年 9 月至 2027 年 12 月。棕地设备更新正成为让中国现有产能满足更新车辆轮胎要求的一条路径。该备案确定了范围和预算，但尚未体现生产率、质量或客户份额方面的提升。后续应跟踪设备安装、验收，以及具名的新能源原配项目。

title: Yunnan breaks ground on TBR, non-pneumatic tire and tube project
what_happened: A RMB350 million project broke ground on 8 September with plans for 1.2 million TBR tires, 600,000 non-pneumatic tire sets and 3 million tubes annually, targeting operation by August 2028. The project combines conventional truck capacity with non-pneumatic products in a less established Chinese tire-manufacturing region. Groundbreaking is stronger than an announcement, but planned capacities and the 2028 date remain forward-looking. Watch construction milestones, equipment orders, product qualification and funding continuity.
title_zh: 云南全钢子午线轮胎、非充气轮胎及内胎项目破土动工
what_happened_zh: 一个 RMB350 million 的项目于 9 月 8 日破土动工，计划年产 1.2 million 条全钢子午线（TBR）轮胎、600,000 套非充气轮胎和 3 million 条内胎，目标在 2028 年 8 月投产。该项目把常规卡车轮胎产能与非充气产品结合在一起，落地于中国轮胎制造基础相对薄弱的地区。破土动工比单纯宣布更有力，但规划产能和 2028 年的时间表仍属前瞻性内容。后续应关注工程节点、设备订单、产品认证和资金连续性。

title: China's August passenger-car top ten shifts entirely to new-energy models
what_happened: A market-data report said all ten leading August passenger-car models were new-energy vehicles and placed new-energy retail sales at 1.005 million units with 65.2% penetration. The OE vehicle mix is accelerating the installed base of heavier, high-torque vehicles that shapes future replacement-tire demand. Model rankings and monthly penetration do not directly measure tire fitment share or replacement timing. Track tire-size mix, named OE suppliers and replacement intervals by powertrain.
title_zh: 中国 8 月乘用车销量前十全部转向新能源车型
what_happened_zh: 一份市场数据报告称，8 月销量领先的十款乘用车全部为新能源汽车，并给出新能源零售销量 1.005 million 辆、渗透率 65.2%。原配车型结构正在加快形成更重、高扭矩车辆的保有量基础，并由此影响未来的替换轮胎需求。车型排名和月度渗透率并不能直接衡量轮胎配套份额或替换时点。后续应跟踪轮胎规格结构、具名原配供应商，以及不同动力形式的替换周期。

title: China's tire exports to the United States fall 28% through July
what_happened: A weekly data recap reported that China's tire exports to the United States fell 28% in the first seven months, even as suppliers continued developing other overseas markets. Trade barriers are changing destination mix and reinforcing overseas-production strategies rather than simply reducing aggregate capacity ambitions. The recap does not publish a full customs table, product-code split or volume-value decomposition. Verify by HS code and compare diversion into Europe, Africa, Latin America and Southeast Asia.
title_zh: 截至 7 月，中国对美国轮胎出口下降 28%
what_happened_zh: 一份周度数据回顾称，前七个月中国对美国的轮胎出口下降 28%，同时供应商仍在继续开发其他海外市场。贸易壁垒正在改变出口目的地结构、强化海外生产策略，而不只是单纯压减总体产能雄心。该回顾未公布完整的海关数据表、产品编码拆分或量价分解。后续应按 HS 编码核实，并比较向欧洲、非洲、拉丁美洲和东南亚的转移情况。

title: Ascenso enters South African mining market with Royal Tyres
what_happened: Ascenso entered South Africa's mining segment through Royal Tyres, launching all-steel radial OTR products for surface and underground applications. Newer off-highway brands are moving from agriculture and construction into larger mining products through local distribution partners. The launch establishes market entry and portfolio scope, not mine-site adoption or field performance. Watch named mine trials, available sizes, service capability and repeat orders.
title_zh: Ascenso 携手 Royal Tyres 进入南非矿用轮胎市场
what_happened_zh: Ascenso 通过 Royal Tyres 进入南非矿业板块，推出面向露天和井下作业的全钢子午线 OTR 轮胎。较新的非公路品牌正借助本地分销合作伙伴，从农业和工程机械领域转向更大规格的矿用产品。此次发布确立了市场进入和产品线范围，而非矿区采用情况或实际使用表现。后续应关注具名矿区试用、可供规格、服务能力和复购订单。

title: Greentyre and Greencare return to local ownership after management buyout
what_happened: A management buyout led by Katie Fryer and Rob Ferguson returned the Middlesbrough producer of microcellular polyurethane puncture-proof tires to local ownership. Specialty tire manufacturing remains an acquisition niche where management teams can preserve focused production capabilities. Ownership transfer is confirmed, but valuation, financing and growth commitments were not disclosed. Watch capital spending, employment and expansion into bicycle and industrial applications.
title_zh: Greentyre 与 Greencare 经管理层收购回归本地持股
what_happened_zh: 由 Katie Fryer 和 Rob Ferguson 主导的管理层收购，使这家位于 Middlesbrough、生产微孔聚氨酯防刺穿轮胎的企业回归本地持股。特种轮胎制造仍是一个并购利基领域，管理团队可以在其中保留专注的生产能力。股权转让已经确认，但估值、融资和增长承诺均未披露。后续应关注资本支出、就业，以及向自行车和工业应用领域的扩展。

title: Leonard retreading restart at Bethune gains per-tire state support
what_happened: Executives detailed the August restart of passenger-tire retreading at the former Bridgestone Bethune site under the Leonard name, supported in part by a French per-retread subsidy introduced in March. Public support is being used to bridge the economics of domestic passenger-car retreading and circular manufacturing. The operation has restarted, but sustainable volume, yield, subsidy dependence and customer take-up remain unproven. Watch monthly output, casing supply, sales, warranty performance and economics after subsidy.
title_zh: Leonard 在 Bethune 重启翻新业务并获得按条计算的国家补贴
what_happened_zh: 公司管理层详细介绍了 8 月在原普利司通 Bethune 工厂以 Leonard 品牌重启乘用车轮胎翻新的情况，该业务部分得益于法国 3 月推出的按条翻新计算的补贴。公共支持正被用来弥补本土乘用车翻新与循环制造的经济性缺口。该业务已经重启，但可持续产量、成品率、对补贴的依赖程度和客户接受度仍未得到验证。后续应关注月度产量、胎体供应、销售、质保表现，以及补贴退出后的经济性。

title: Continental secures Audi Q3 OE and replacement approvals
what_happened: Audi approved Continental's EcoContact 6 Q as factory fitment in 18-20 inch sizes and recommended ProContact TX10 and WinterContact TS 870 P cold-weather alternatives in specified markets. One vehicle program is being supported by region- and season-specific OE and replacement fitments. The approvals are concrete customer evidence; comparative fuel, noise and braking measurements were not included. Watch production mix and replacement take-up across Europe and North America.
title_zh: 大陆集团获得 Audi Q3 原配与替换市场认证
what_happened_zh: Audi 批准大陆集团 EcoContact 6 Q 作为 18-20 inch 规格的原厂配套，并在特定市场推荐 ProContact TX10 和 WinterContact TS 870 P 作为低温替代选择。单一车型项目正通过按地区和季节区分的原配与替换配套得到支持。这些认证是具体的客户证据，但未包含油耗、噪声和制动的对比测量结果。后续应关注欧洲和北美的生产配套结构与替换市场接受度。

title: Michelin X Works Z2 and D2 become OE options on MAN construction trucks
what_happened: MAN made Michelin X Works Z2 and D2 products available as original equipment on selected construction trucks; Michelin describes the 315/80 R22.5 steer fitment as the segment's first B-rated rolling-resistance option. Construction-truck OE is placing greater value on on-road efficiency without abandoning mixed-surface capability. The OE availability is concrete; the first-in-segment label claim and operational savings need comparison at matched duty cycles. Watch fleet fuel data, wear and casing outcomes in mixed road-site work.
title_zh: 米其林 X Works Z2 与 D2 成为 MAN 工程卡车原配选项
what_happened_zh: MAN 将米其林 X Works Z2 和 D2 产品列为部分工程卡车的原厂配套；米其林称其 315/80 R22.5 转向轮配套是该细分市场首个滚动阻力达到 B 级的选项。工程卡车原配正更加重视公路行驶效率，同时并未放弃混合路面能力。原配供货是具体的，但细分市场首创的标签主张和运营节省需要在相同工作循环下进行对比。后续应关注混合公路与工地作业中的车队油耗数据、磨耗和胎体表现。

title: ZC Rubber confirms tire fitment on Xiaomi SkyNomad N70
what_happened: A listed-company disclosure confirmed ZC Rubber tires as original equipment on Xiaomi's SkyNomad N70 and quantified initial shipments at about RMB3.8 million. Named new-energy OE wins give Chinese tire makers qualification evidence even when early shipment values are financially small. The customer and shipment value are concrete, but the amount is immaterial relative to group revenue and does not establish program lifetime volume. Watch additional trims, annualized volume and repeat nominations from Xiaomi.
title_zh: 中策橡胶确认为小米 SkyNomad N70 配套轮胎
what_happened_zh: 一份上市公司披露确认，中策橡胶轮胎已作为小米 SkyNomad N70 的原厂配套，并将初期出货量化为约 RMB3.8 million。具名的新能源原配项目能为中国轮胎企业提供资质证据，即使早期出货金额在财务上并不大。客户和出货金额是具体的，但该金额相对集团收入并不重大，也不能确定项目全生命周期的量。后续应关注更多配置版本、年化出货量，以及小米的再次提名。

title: Goodyear to supply 37 cars across three ELMS classes at Silverstone
what_happened: Goodyear said it would supply Racing Eagle tires to 37 cars across LMGT3, LMP2 and LMP2 Pro/Am while title-sponsoring the four-hour Silverstone event. Multi-class single-event supply creates a concentrated validation and customer-support workload across different car and team requirements. The car count and classes are concrete; event supply does not alone establish product superiority. Watch allocation consistency, stint data and team feedback after the race.
title_zh: 固特异将在 Silverstone 为 ELMS 三个级别的 37 辆赛车供胎
what_happened_zh: 固特异表示，将为 LMGT3、LMP2 和 LMP2 Pro/Am 级别的 37 辆赛车提供 Racing Eagle 轮胎，同时冠名赞助这场四小时的 Silverstone 赛事。多级别单场赛事供胎，会在不同车型和车队需求之间形成集中的验证与客户支持工作量。参赛车辆数量和级别是具体的，但赛事供胎本身并不足以证明产品优势。后续应关注赛后的配胎一致性、分段数据和车队反馈。

title: Prometeon upgrades Pro Management fleet tire portal
what_happened: Prometeon released an upgraded in-house Pro Management platform intended to speed workflows and improve job, approval and cost visibility across its dealer network. Commercial-tire suppliers are competing through operating workflow and data visibility as well as physical products. The product update is observable, but customer adoption, time savings and cost outcomes were not quantified. Watch enrolled fleets, transaction volumes, integrations and measured administration savings.
title_zh: Prometeon 升级 Pro Management 车队轮胎门户
what_happened_zh: Prometeon 发布了升级版的自研 Pro Management 平台，旨在加快流程处理，并提升其经销商网络中工单、审批和成本的可见性。商用车轮胎供应商正通过运营流程和数据可见性，而不仅是实物产品展开竞争。产品更新是可观察的，但客户采用情况、节省的时间和成本结果均未量化。后续应关注接入车队数量、交易量、系统集成，以及经量化的管理成本节省。

title: Goodyear updates UltraGrip Arctic 2 ahead of stricter studded-tire rules
what_happened: Goodyear introduced an updated UltraGrip Arctic 2 with revised stud-pin geometry and the same stud count, positioning it for Finland's A+ road-wear requirement for new studded tires from 2027 and UNECE R164. Nordic winter-tire development is shifting toward lower road wear without simply reducing stud count. The design responds to a specific regulatory test regime, although the public performance evidence is based on the company's internal testing. Watch independent ice, wear and road-surface tests plus certified performance under the 2027 rule.
title_zh: 固特异在更严格的钉胎法规前更新 UltraGrip Arctic 2
what_happened_zh: 固特异推出更新版 UltraGrip Arctic 2，调整了钉脚几何结构并保持原有钉数，使其面向芬兰自 2027 年起对新钉胎实施的 A+ 路面磨损要求以及 UNECE R164。北欧冬季轮胎开发正朝着降低路面磨损、而非单纯减少钉数的方向发展。该设计针对的是特定的法规测试体系，但公开的性能证据来自公司内部测试。后续应关注独立的冰面、磨耗与路面测试，以及 2027 年法规下的认证性能。

title: Continental targets more than 650 UHP sizes by end-2027
what_happened: Continental said it plans to offer more than 650 ultra-high-performance tire sizes by the end of 2027 and reported that UHP products represented 62% of its passenger-tire sales in 2025, up from 49% in 2020. Premium tire portfolios are expanding in size coverage as UHP products take a larger share of manufacturer sales. The sales-mix history supports the direction of demand, while the 650-size figure remains a future portfolio target. Watch actual size releases, regional availability, OE nominations and mix-adjusted profitability.
title_zh: 大陆集团目标到 2027 年底提供逾 650 个 UHP 规格
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团表示，计划到 2027 年底提供逾 650 个超高性能轮胎规格，并报告超高性能产品在 2025 年占其乘用车轮胎销量的 62%，高于 2020 年的 49%。随着超高性能产品在制造商销量中的占比提升，高端轮胎产品组合正在扩大规格覆盖。销量结构的历史数据支持需求方向，而 650 这一规格数量仍是未来的产品组合目标。后续应关注实际规格发布、区域可获得性、原配提名以及经组合调整后的盈利能力。

title: Guizhou Tyre's AR600 receives agricultural-market application award
what_happened: The AR600 VF ultra-low-pressure paddy-field radial tire received a market-application award at an agricultural-machinery event. Agricultural tire makers are using application-specific awards to position low-pressure radial products. The award is attributable recognition but the source does not disclose independent field-test methods or customer outcomes. Promotional award coverage without a disclosed judging method or independent performance dataset. Watch named farm trials, soil-compaction measurements and commercial fitments.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎 AR600 获农机市场应用奖项
what_happened_zh: AR600 VF 超低压水田子午线轮胎在一场农业机械活动上获得市场应用类奖项。农业轮胎制造商正借助面向具体应用的奖项来定位低压子午线产品。该奖项属于可归因的认可，但来源未披露独立的田间测试方法或客户使用结果。属于推广性奖项报道，未披露评审方法，也没有独立的性能数据集。后续应关注具名的农田试验、土壤压实测量和商业配套。

title: Lianke approves Egypt base for silica and carbon-black supply
what_happened: A board disclosure reported approval for an Egypt project of about RMB1 billion in the Suez Canal Economic Zone, planned for 100,000 tonnes each of silica and carbon black with an 18-month construction schedule. Chinese upstream suppliers are pairing overseas tire investment with localized reinforcing-material capacity. The project could shorten regional material supply chains, but the evidence currently establishes board approval rather than permits, construction or output. Watch Egyptian approvals, financing, groundbreaking, equipment awards and customer qualification milestones.
title_zh: Lianke 批准埃及基地，用于白炭黑与炭黑供应
what_happened_zh: 一份董事会公告称，公司批准在苏伊士运河经济区投资约 RMB1 billion 的埃及项目，规划白炭黑与炭黑产能各 100,000 tonnes，建设周期 18 个月。中国上游供应商正把海外轮胎投资与本地化补强材料产能结合起来。该项目有望缩短区域材料供应链，但目前的证据只能确认董事会批准，而非许可、建设或产出。后续应关注埃及方面的审批、融资、开工、设备采购以及客户认证里程碑。

title: China carbon-black prices pull back after a feedstock-driven spike
what_happened: Trade reports described tire-grade carbon-black prices near or above RMB10,000 per tonne before a Shandong N330 quotation of RMB11,300-11,500 per tonne fell by RMB350 on September 18-19; tire makers had issued price-increase letters as costs rose. A fast raw-material spike is passing through to tire pricing while showing early signs of reversal, increasing procurement and quotation risk. Carbon black is a major tire input, but the reported spot quotations and operating-rate estimates are market snapshots rather than audited transaction data. Watch coal-tar prices, carbon-black operating rates, contract settlements and whether tire price increases hold after the pullback.
title_zh: 中国炭黑价格在原料推动的上涨后回落
what_happened_zh: 贸易报道称，轮胎级炭黑价格接近或超过 RMB10,000 每吨；此后山东 N330 报价 RMB11,300-11,500 每吨，并于 9 月 18-19 日下调 RMB350；在成本上行期间，轮胎企业已发出涨价函。原料价格的快速上涨正在向轮胎价格传导，同时已显现初步回落迹象，加大了采购与报价风险。炭黑是轮胎的主要投入品，但报道中的现货报价和开工率估算属于市场快照，而非经审计的成交数据。后续应关注煤焦油价格、炭黑开工率、合同结算，以及轮胎涨价在回落之后能否维持。

title: Cheeshine launches EP365 plasticizer for high-silica tire compounds
what_happened: At RubberTech China, Cheeshine introduced EP365 for high-silica compounds and reported lower Mooney viscosity, faster mixing and a 14-18% wear improvement in company testing. Material suppliers are packaging processing efficiency and wear claims into additives aimed at high-silica formulations. The product targets a real mixing-performance trade-off, but the public account omits formulation, test method, baseline and statistical detail. Watch independent compound trials, disclosed test conditions, tire-level validation and commercial qualification.
title_zh: Cheeshine 推出面向高白炭黑轮胎胶料的 EP365 增塑剂
what_happened_zh: 在 RubberTech China 展会上，Cheeshine 推出面向高白炭黑胶料的 EP365，并报告在公司测试中门尼粘度降低、混炼更快、耐磨性能改善 14-18%。材料供应商正把加工效率与耐磨主张打包进面向高白炭黑配方的助剂产品。该产品针对的是真实存在的混炼性能取舍，但公开信息未披露配方、测试方法、对比基线和统计细节。后续应关注独立的胶料试验、公开的测试条件、轮胎层面的验证以及商业认证。

title: Birla Carbon's China and Asia growth message receives an in-window trade recap
what_happened: An in-window trade article recapped Birla Carbon's September 8 statement on expanding supply and innovation for rubber customers in China and Asia. Global carbon-black suppliers are emphasizing local technical support and regional capacity around Asian tire demand. The original company announcement predates this week's window and the recap adds no independently verified project stage. In-window recap of a 2026-09-08 company release; retained as context rather than counted as a new weekly event. Watch named capacity, commissioning dates, customer qualifications and regional shipment data.
title_zh: Birla Carbon 的中国与亚洲增长信息在报告期内获贸易媒体回顾
