what_happened_zh: 一篇报告期内的贸易媒体文章回顾了 Birla Carbon 于 9 月 8 日就扩大面向中国和亚洲橡胶客户的供应与创新所作的表述。全球炭黑供应商正围绕亚洲轮胎需求强调本地技术支持和区域产能。公司的原始公告早于本周报告期，该回顾也未增加任何经独立核实的项目阶段。本条是对 2026-09-08 公司发布内容的报告期内回顾，作为背景信息保留，不计为新的周度事件。后续应关注具名产能、投产日期、客户认证和区域出货数据。

title: Linglong presents tire described as using 85% sustainable materials
what_happened: Linglong presented a tire it described as containing 85% sustainable materials at a zero-carbon industry forum. High sustainable-material content remains a visible prototype target among Chinese tire makers. The percentage is a company claim without a disclosed mass-balance boundary, certification or tire-performance dataset. Retained as context because the material-content boundary and performance validation were not disclosed. Watch third-party chain-of-custody evidence, bill-of-material definitions and comparable tire-test results.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎展示其称含 85% 可持续材料的轮胎
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎在一场零碳产业论坛上展示了一条其称含 85% 可持续材料的轮胎。高可持续材料占比在中国轮胎制造商中仍是可见的原型目标。该比例为公司主张，未披露质量平衡边界、认证或轮胎性能数据集。本条作为背景信息保留，因为材料含量边界和性能验证均未披露。后续应关注第三方监管链证据、物料清单定义以及可比的轮胎测试结果。

title: Hankook produces first pre-series tire at EUR540 million Hungary truck-tire plant
what_happened: Hankook reported the first pre-series tire from its EUR540 million Hungary expansion, designed for more than 800,000 truck and bus tires a year, with automated logistics, guided vehicles, real-time tracking and automated testing; production is scheduled for October. Large tire projects are embedding material flow, traceability and quality automation at the commissioning stage. The first pre-series tire is a meaningful stage change, but it precedes stable commercial output, yield and utilization evidence. Watch the October start, qualified output, ramp yield, labor productivity and customer approvals.
title_zh: 韩泰在 EUR540 million 匈牙利卡客车轮胎工厂产出首条试产轮胎
what_happened_zh: 韩泰报告其 EUR540 million 匈牙利扩建项目已产出首条试产轮胎；该项目设计年产 800,000 条以上卡车和客车轮胎，配备自动化物流、自动导引车、实时追踪和自动化检测，计划于 10 月投产。大型轮胎项目正在投产阶段就嵌入物料流转、可追溯性和质量自动化。首条试产轮胎是有意义的阶段性变化，但它先于稳定的商业产出、成品率和产能利用率证据。后续应关注 10 月的投产、合格产出、爬坡成品率、劳动生产率和客户审批。

title: Ascenso commits US$100 million to giant mining-tire manufacturing in India
what_happened: Ascenso outlined a US$100 million Indian investment in all-steel radial mining tires and said it produced its first 27.00R49 tire in August while expanding coverage from 25- to 49-inch sizes. Indian off-highway suppliers are moving into larger all-steel radial mining formats through dedicated capital investment. A first tire indicates process commissioning, but it does not establish qualified serial output, capacity or field life. Watch customer validation, serial-production rate, product-size releases and mine-site performance.
title_zh: Ascenso 投入 US$100 million 在印度生产巨型矿山轮胎
what_happened_zh: Ascenso 公布在印度投资 US$100 million 发展全钢子午线矿山轮胎，并表示已于 8 月生产出首条 27.00R49 轮胎，同时将规格覆盖从 25 英寸扩大到 49 英寸。印度非公路轮胎供应商正通过专项资本投入进入更大尺寸的全钢子午线矿山轮胎领域。首条轮胎表明工艺已进入调试，但并不能证明合格的批量产出、产能或使用寿命。后续应关注客户验证、批量生产速率、产品规格发布和矿区现场表现。

title: Wanli's Malaysia plant advances with EUR2.1 million steel-cord calender award
what_happened: Trade reporting said Rodolfo Comerio won a EUR2.1 million steel-cord calender procurement for Wanli's planned Malaysia base, which targets 1.2 million truck and bus radial tires and 5 million passenger tires a year. Chinese tire makers' overseas projects are moving from investment announcements into identifiable process-equipment procurement. An equipment award is a stronger execution marker than a plan alone, while still preceding installation, acceptance and commercial output. Watch shipment, installation, site acceptance and the first qualified tire from the Malaysia line.
title_zh: Wanli 马来西亚工厂取得进展：EUR2.1 million 钢丝帘布压延机采购落定
what_happened_zh: 贸易媒体报道称，Rodolfo Comerio 获得 Wanli 规划中的马来西亚基地 EUR2.1 million 钢丝帘布压延机采购订单；该基地目标年产 1.2 million 条卡客车子午线轮胎和 5 million 条乘用车轮胎。中国轮胎企业的海外项目正从投资公告走向可识别的工艺设备采购。设备中标是比单纯规划更强的执行标志，但仍先于安装、验收和商业产出。后续应关注发货、安装、现场验收以及马来西亚生产线产出的首条合格轮胎。

title: German tire production falls 9.1% in first half of 2026
what_happened: Tyrepress reported Wdk data showing German tire production of about 200,000 tonnes in the first half, down 9.1% year on year, while sector revenue fell 7.9% to EUR1.76 billion. European manufacturing pressure is visible in both physical output and revenue rather than in isolated plant announcements alone. The aggregate provides a sector baseline for capacity decisions, although it does not separate product mix, exports or individual companies. Watch second-half volumes, utilization, plant actions and whether revenue declines converge with tonnage.
title_zh: 2026 年上半年德国轮胎产量下降 9.1%
what_happened_zh: Tyrepress 引用 wdk 数据报道，德国上半年轮胎产量约 200,000 tonnes，同比下降 9.1%，同期行业营业收入下降 7.9% 至 EUR1.76 billion。欧洲的制造压力在实物产量和营业收入上同时显现，而不只体现在个别工厂公告中。该总量数据为产能决策提供了行业基准，但未区分产品结构、出口或单个企业。后续应关注下半年产量、产能利用率、工厂动作，以及营业收入降幅是否与产量降幅趋同。

title: Wanda Boto files RMB97.1 million passenger-tire line retrofit
what_happened: A project filing described a RMB97.149 million retrofit with dual-station uniformity correction, an upstream material system, constant-tension strip handling and twin-screw temperature control, without adding nominal capacity. Chinese brownfield projects are targeting closed-loop process stability and inline quality correction instead of headline capacity alone. The named equipment provides a concrete intelligent-manufacturing pathway, but the filing does not yet demonstrate realized quality, labor or energy gains. Watch equipment commissioning, first-pass yield, uniformity dispersion, energy per tire and labor-hour baselines after ramp-up.
title_zh: Wanda Boto 申报 RMB97.1 million 乘用车轮胎生产线技改
what_happened_zh: 一份项目申报文件描述了一项 RMB97.149 million 的技术改造，内容包括双工位均匀性修正、上游供料系统、恒张力胶条输送和双螺杆温控，且不增加名义产能。中国的存量技改项目正把目标放在闭环工艺稳定性和在线质量修正上，而不只是产能规模。文件列明的设备提供了具体的智能制造路径，但该申报尚未证明已实现质量、人工或能耗方面的改善。后续应关注设备投运、一次合格率、均匀性离散度、单胎能耗以及爬坡后的工时基线。

title: Hebei Zhenggu files energy-saving retrofit for motorcycle and e-bike tire lines
what_happened: A pre-approval environmental filing described a Pingxiang retrofit planned around annual output of 30 million inner tubes and 15 million outer tires, with older high-energy equipment to be replaced. Small-format tire producers are using brownfield equipment renewal to combine capacity renewal with energy-efficiency compliance. The filing is a concrete manufacturing-stage signal, but it is not evidence that the upgraded line is operating or meeting its planned energy profile. Watch for final approval, equipment orders, commissioning dates and verified energy consumption per tire.
title_zh: Hebei Zhenggu 申报摩托车与电动自行车轮胎生产线节能技改
what_happened_zh: 一份环评批前公示文件描述了平乡的技改项目，规划年产 30 million 条内胎和 15 million 条外胎，并将替换原有高能耗设备。小规格轮胎生产企业正利用存量设备更新，把产能更新与能效合规结合起来。该文件是具体的制造阶段信号，但并不能证明升级后的生产线已在运行或达到规划能耗水平。后续应关注最终批复、设备订单、投运时间以及经核实的单胎能耗。

title: Shandong's 2026 green-manufacturing list includes 13 tire and rubber companies
what_happened: Shandong's published green-manufacturing list covered 802 factories, 18 parks and 94 supply-chain enterprises; a tire-industry review identified 13 tire and rubber companies, with Yongsheng appearing in both factory and supply-chain categories. Environmental-management recognition is spreading from individual plants to supply-chain designations in Shandong's tire cluster. The list is evidence of formal recognition, not a comparative measurement of energy, emissions or circular-material performance. Watch disclosed audit criteria, plant-level metrics and whether recognized suppliers convert the designation into customer requirements.
title_zh: 山东 2026 年绿色制造名单包含 13 家轮胎与橡胶企业
what_happened_zh: 山东公布的绿色制造名单覆盖 802 家工厂、18 个园区和 94 家供应链企业；一项轮胎行业梳理从中识别出 13 家轮胎与橡胶企业，其中 Yongsheng 同时出现在工厂和供应链两个类别中。环境管理方面的认定正从单个工厂扩展到山东轮胎产业集群的供应链认定。该名单是正式认定的证据，而非能源、排放或循环材料表现的横向比较。后续应关注公开的审核标准、工厂层面指标，以及获认定的供应商能否把该称号转化为客户要求。

title: Anhui Aoxin discloses RMB150 million phase-one radial scooter-tire project
what_happened: An environmental-information notice described a RMB150 million first phase in Huaiyuan, Bengbu, planned for annual output of 12 million radial scooter tires and listed core production equipment. Radialization investment is extending into China's scooter-tire segment through specialized greenfield capacity. The notice establishes project scope and intended equipment, but not completed construction, qualification or demand. Watch final environmental approval, equipment arrival, product certification and utilization after commissioning.
title_zh: Anhui Aoxin 披露 RMB150 million 一期子午线踏板车轮胎项目
what_happened_zh: 一份环境信息公示描述了位于蚌埠怀远的 RMB150 million 一期项目，规划年产 12 million 条子午线踏板车轮胎，并列出了核心生产设备。子午化投资正通过专门的新建产能延伸到中国的踏板车轮胎领域。该公示确立了项目范围和拟用设备，但并不代表建设完成、认证通过或需求落地。后续应关注最终环评批复、设备到场、产品认证以及投产后的产能利用率。

title: Qingxian Hongyuan seeks approval for two-phase small-tire equipment upgrade
what_happened: Cangzhou authorities accepted an application for a RMB15 million, two-phase upgrade planned over 18 months for 6 million outer tires and 6 million inner tubes, with older reclaimed-rubber equipment to be retired. Environmental approval is becoming a visible gate in equipment renewal among smaller Chinese tire producers. The acceptance establishes a regulated project step, not construction completion or incremental operating capacity. Watch approval conditions, retirement of the old equipment and proof that both phases enter qualified production.
title_zh: Qingxian Hongyuan 就小规格轮胎设备两期升级申请审批
what_happened_zh: 沧州主管部门受理了一项 RMB15 million、分两期、计划用 18 个月完成的升级申请，规划 6 million 条外胎和 6 million 条内胎，并将淘汰原有再生胶设备。在中国规模较小的轮胎生产企业中，环保审批正成为设备更新中一道显见的关口。受理确立的是一个受监管的项目步骤，而非建设完成或新增运行产能。后续应关注批复条件、旧设备淘汰情况，以及两期是否都进入合格生产的证据。

title: USW asks USTR to open a Section 201 tire investigation
what_happened: The United Steelworkers asked USTR to initiate a Section 201 safeguard investigation into tire imports and cited a 40% decline in domestic output since 2000, nine announced plant closures in two years and more than 7,000 jobs affected. US tire-market pressure is moving from plant-level complaints toward a possible broad safeguard route. A union request could reshape market access if accepted, but no USTR investigation or remedy had begun at publication. Watch USTR's response, product scope, import-source analysis and any formal investigation calendar.
title_zh: USW 要求 USTR 启动 Section 201 轮胎调查
what_happened_zh: 美国钢铁工人联合会（USW）要求 USTR 就轮胎进口启动 Section 201 保障措施调查，并称自 2000 年以来美国国内产量下降 40%、两年内有九家工厂宣布关闭、逾 7,000 个岗位受到影响。美国轮胎市场的压力正从工厂层面的申诉转向可能的全面保障措施路径。若获受理，工会请求可能重塑市场准入，但在发布时 USTR 尚未启动调查或采取救济措施。后续应关注 USTR 的回应、产品范围、进口来源分析以及任何正式的调查时间表。

title: China tire export volume rises through August while export value falls
what_happened: CRIA's summary of customs data put January-August tire exports at 6.63 million tonnes, up 2.0%, and value at RMB110.639 billion, down 3.1%; August volume fell 0.7% and value fell 4.1% year on year. Export tonnage and export value are diverging, indicating a weaker realized value mix despite modest volume growth. The divergence matters for margin and product-mix interpretation, but average value per tonne is an aggregate calculation rather than a like-for-like price series. Watch destination mix, product category, trade measures and fourth-quarter value per tonne.
title_zh: 中国轮胎出口量截至 8 月累计上升，出口金额下降
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会汇总的海关数据显示，1月至8月轮胎出口量为 6.63 million tonnes，增长 2.0%，出口金额为 RMB110.639 billion，下降 3.1%；8月出口量同比下降 0.7%，出口金额同比下降 4.1%。出口吨位与出口金额正在背离，表明在出口量小幅增长的同时，实现价值结构趋弱。这一背离对毛利和产品结构的解读很重要，但吨均价值是总量计算结果，而非可比口径的价格序列。后续应关注目的地结构、产品类别、贸易措施以及第四季度的吨均价值。

title: China's rising NEV mix contrasts with weaker passenger-tire OE demand
what_happened: A trade analysis using CAAM and Longzhong data put January-August new-energy vehicle sales at 10.65 million, up 10.7%, while estimating passenger-tire OE demand at 86.67 million, down 5.35%; estimated commercial-tire OE demand rose 7.45%. Vehicle electrification is increasing its share even as aggregate passenger-vehicle output provides a softer OE tire-volume base. Product-mix opportunity and market-volume growth are diverging, which changes how suppliers should read the EV opportunity. Watch whether EV-specific fitments offset passenger-volume weakness and whether commercial-vehicle strength persists into the fourth quarter.
title_zh: 中国新能源汽车占比上升，与走弱的乘用车轮胎原配需求形成对比
what_happened_zh: 一项引用中国汽车工业协会和隆众数据的行业分析显示，1月至8月新能源汽车销量为 10.65 million 辆，增长 10.7%；同期乘用车轮胎原配需求估计为 86.67 million 条，下降 5.35%；商用车轮胎原配需求估计增长 7.45%。在乘用车总产量为原配轮胎提供更弱的量基础的同时，汽车电动化的占比仍在提升。产品结构机会与市场总量增长正在背离，这改变了供应商解读电动车机会的方式。后续应关注针对电动车的专用配套能否抵消乘用车量的走弱，以及商用车的强势能否延续到第四季度。

title: Prinx enters Europe's OTR segment with ELD12 rollout
what_happened: Prinx introduced the ELD12 earthmover tire and described a broader European rollout through its dealer network. Chinese manufacturers are extending European channel strategies beyond passenger and truck tires into specialist off-road segments. The launch broadens the addressable market, but the public evidence does not provide dealer count, orders or field-performance data. Watch available sizes, dealer stocking, fleet trials and repeat orders from European earthmoving customers.
title_zh: 浦林成山以 ELD12 进入欧洲 OTR 市场
what_happened_zh: 浦林成山推出 ELD12 工程机械轮胎，并介绍了通过其经销商网络在欧洲更大范围铺开的计划。中国制造商正把欧洲渠道策略从乘用车和卡车轮胎延伸到专业的非公路细分市场。此次上市扩大了可触达市场，但公开证据未提供经销商数量、订单或现场使用表现数据。后续应关注可供规格、经销商备货、车队试用以及欧洲工程机械客户的复购订单。

title: Linglong showcases mining and support-vehicle tires in Indonesia
what_happened: Linglong displayed 27.00R49 mining tires and several support-vehicle sizes at Mining Indonesia. Chinese OTR suppliers continue to use Southeast Asian trade events to build mining-market visibility. The item identifies products and market intent but provides no order, trial or field-performance evidence. Event-only promotional signal; retained as context because it does not show customer adoption or a new technical stage. Watch distributor appointments, mine trials and repeat orders in Indonesia.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎在印尼展示矿山与辅助车辆轮胎
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎在 Mining Indonesia 展会上展示了 27.00R49 矿山轮胎和多种辅助车辆规格。中国 OTR 供应商继续借助东南亚展会提升矿业市场能见度。该信息明确了产品和市场意图，但未提供订单、试用或现场使用表现的证据。属于仅限展会的推广性信号，作为背景信息保留，因为它未显示客户采用或新的技术阶段。后续应关注经销商授权、矿区试用和印尼市场的复购订单。

title: Linglong holds Egypt dealer event amid Middle East and Africa expansion claims
what_happened: Linglong held a dealer event in Egypt and said its sales and share had grown in the Middle East and Africa. Chinese brands continue to deepen regional dealer engagement around overseas manufacturing and distribution ambitions. The event supports channel activity but provides no market-share definition, sales period or audited volume. Company growth claims are unquantified; retained as channel context rather than core commercial evidence. Watch named distributor expansion, sell-through data and Egyptian market share from an independent dataset.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎在埃及举办经销商活动，并提出中东与非洲扩张主张
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎在埃及举办经销商活动，并表示其在中东和非洲的销量与份额有所增长。中国品牌继续围绕海外制造与分销目标深化区域经销商合作。该活动支持渠道层面的动作，但未提供市场份额定义、销售期间或经审计的销量。公司的增长主张未经量化，本条作为渠道背景信息保留，而非核心商业证据。后续应关注具名的经销商拓展、终端销售数据，以及来自独立数据集的埃及市场份额。

title: Michelin pilots NAZCA automated truck-tire regrooving in European workshops
what_happened: Michelin described about 20 NAZCA machines in European pilot use for more than a year; the system uses high-density laser measurement and adaptive control to set regrooving depth, with commercial rollout planned for 2027. Automation is moving into tire-life-extension services, where workshop consistency and technician time constrain adoption. Multi-site pilot use provides industrial evidence, but the claimed 30-50% capacity gain and under-three-minute hands-on time are company-reported without an external baseline. Watch paid deployments, workshop throughput, casing safety outcomes and customer economics after 2027 rollout.
title_zh: 米其林在欧洲维修车间试点 NAZCA 自动化卡车轮胎再刻槽
what_happened_zh: 米其林介绍称，约 20 台 NAZCA 设备已在欧洲试点使用一年以上；该系统采用高密度激光测量和自适应控制来设定再刻槽深度，商业化推广计划于 2027 年进行。自动化正进入轮胎延寿服务领域，而车间作业一致性和技师工时是该领域采用的制约因素。多门店试点提供了工业层面的证据，但其主张的 30-50% 产能提升和不到三分钟的人工操作时间均为公司自述，没有外部基线。后续应关注付费部署、车间产出效率、胎体安全结果，以及 2027 年推广之后的客户经济性。

title: Xiaomi selects ZC Rubber ARISUN 1 Star for 19-inch N70 variants
what_happened: ZC Rubber said its 245/55R19 ARISUN 1 Star is original equipment on all 19-inch Xiaomi SkyNomad N70 Pro and Max configurations; an independent trade publication corroborated the fitment. Chinese tire makers are converting EV-focused product development into named domestic premium-vehicle fitments. A specified vehicle and size provide concrete customer evidence, while rolling-resistance, noise and grip claims remain supplier statements. Watch vehicle delivery volume, warranty experience, replacement availability and future Xiaomi platform nominations.
title_zh: 小米 N70 的 19 英寸版本选用中策橡胶 ARISUN 1 Star
what_happened_zh: 中策橡胶表示，其 245/55R19 规格 ARISUN 1 Star 已成为小米 SkyNomad N70 Pro 和 Max 全部 19 英寸配置的原配轮胎；一家独立贸易媒体对该配套予以印证。中国轮胎企业正把面向电动车的产品开发转化为具名的国内高端车型配套。明确的车型和规格提供了具体的客户证据，而滚动阻力、噪声和抓地力方面的主张仍属供应商自述。后续应关注整车交付量、质保表现、替换市场可获得性以及小米平台未来的提名。

title: Hankook and Schmitz Cargobull begin four-year trailer-tire OE agreement
what_happened: Hankook said an original-equipment agreement with trailer maker Schmitz Cargobull took effect on July 1 and runs through June 2030, covering Smart Line, Smart Flex and Smart Work trailer products. Commercial-tire suppliers are converting regional product portfolios into multi-year trailer OE contracts. The named customer, product families and contract term provide concrete demand evidence, but public volume and pricing are absent. Watch fitted-unit volumes, geographic rollout, renewal terms and replacement-channel pull-through.
title_zh: 韩泰与 Schmitz Cargobull 启动为期四年的挂车轮胎原配协议
what_happened_zh: 韩泰表示，与挂车制造商 Schmitz Cargobull 签订的原配协议已于 7 月 1 日生效，有效期至 2030 年 6 月，覆盖 Smart Line、Smart Flex 和 Smart Work 挂车产品。商用车轮胎供应商正把区域产品组合转化为多年期的挂车原配合同。具名客户、产品系列和合同期限提供了具体的需求证据，但公开信息中没有数量和价格。后续应关注装配数量、地域铺开、续约条件以及对替换渠道的带动。

title: Bridgestone unveils two-tire Potenza system for Formula E GEN4
what_happened: Bridgestone introduced an all-weather Potenza GEN4 and separate heavy-wet Typhoon tire as Formula E sole supplier for 2026/27; development included more than 6,500 km of testing. Electric racing is returning to condition-specific tires while using recovered carbon black and rice-husk silica. GEN4 creates a demanding laboratory, but race durability and lifecycle comparisons are not public. Watch homologation, race degradation and transfer to road tires.

sources.publisher: Bridgestone global newsroom and technical feature
sources.link_label: Bridgestone global newsroom and technical feature

title_zh: 普利司通发布面向 Formula E GEN4 的双款 Potenza 轮胎体系
what_happened_zh: 普利司通作为 2026/27 赛季 Formula E 独家供应商，推出了全天候 Potenza GEN4 以及单独的重雨胎 Typhoon，开发过程包含超过 6,500 km 的测试。电动赛车正在重新回到按条件区分的轮胎配置，同时使用回收炭黑和稻壳基白炭黑。GEN4 构成了一个要求严苛的试验平台，但比赛耐久性和全生命周期对比并未公开。后续应关注型号认证、比赛中的性能衰减以及向公路轮胎的技术转移。

title: POLYN ships engineering nodes for in-tire road-grip estimation
what_happened: POLYN began delivering VibroSense TMS engineering chips for sensor nodes that estimate peak friction coefficient from accelerometer signals at the edge. Tire sensing is moving from pressure and temperature toward local inference of road grip. Customer evaluation is tangible, but the braking claim lacks a published protocol and repeat statistics. Watch named evaluators, test protocol, qualification and production tape-out.
title_zh: POLYN 交付用于胎内路面抓地力估算的工程样品节点
what_happened_zh: POLYN 开始交付 VibroSense TMS 工程芯片，用于在边缘侧根据加速度计信号估算峰值摩擦系数的传感器节点。轮胎传感正从胎压和温度监测，转向对路面抓地力的本地推断。客户评估是实际可见的进展，但其制动主张缺少公开的测试方案和重复性统计。后续应关注具名评估方、测试方案、认证以及量产流片。

title: Italy places safeguards around Pirelli-ABET extreme-terrain vehicle R&D
companies: Pirelli and ABET High Tech Solutions
what_happened: Italy classified the companies' defence work and remote-controlled electric rescue-vehicle co-development as strategic, imposing safeguards on IP, know-how, products and data. Connected-tire data and vehicle-control know-how are becoming national-security assets. The measure changes program governance; it does not validate product performance or deployment. Watch implementation requirements, program milestones and data-access constraints.
title_zh: 意大利对倍耐力与 ABET 的极端地形车辆研发施加保护措施
what_happened_zh: 意大利将两家公司的国防业务以及遥控电动救援车辆的联合开发认定为战略事项，对知识产权、专有技术、产品和数据施加保护措施。互联轮胎数据和车辆控制专有技术正在成为国家安全资产。该措施改变的是项目治理方式，并不验证产品性能或部署情况。后续应关注具体执行要求、项目里程碑以及数据访问限制。

title: Continental launches regional truck tires with estimated 19-22% mileage gains
what_happened: Continental launched HSR 5 EP steer and HDR 5 EP drive tires, claiming estimated removal-mileage gains of 22% and 19% versus predecessors while maintaining low rolling resistance. Truck-tire development is optimizing tread life, fuel efficiency and casing retreadability as one cost system. The estimates could lower cost per mile, but test method and conditions are undisclosed. Watch fleet trials, rolling-resistance data and realized removal mileage.
title_zh: 大陆集团推出区域运输卡车轮胎，预计里程提升 19-22%
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团推出 HSR 5 EP 转向轮胎和 HDR 5 EP 驱动轮胎，称其相对上一代产品的预计下线里程分别提升 22% 和 19%，同时保持低滚动阻力。卡车轮胎开发正把胎面寿命、燃油效率和胎体可翻新性作为一个成本系统统一优化。这些预计值有望降低单位里程成本，但测试方法和条件未予披露。后续应关注车队路试、滚动阻力数据以及实际下线里程。

title: Pirelli virtualizes bespoke P Zero development for the 360 km/h Brabus Bodo
what_happened: Pirelli launched 22-inch BB-marked P Zero fitments after virtual development and joint high-speed testing at Papenburg; sizes are 285/30 ZR22 XL front and 335/25 ZR22 XL rear. Virtual optimization is being coupled with targeted proving-ground work for low-volume extreme fitments. The workflow is concrete, but no development-time reduction or comparative result was disclosed. Watch independent testing, homologation volume and transfer to broader OE programs.
title_zh: 倍耐力以虚拟开发完成面向 360 km/h Brabus Bodo 的定制 P Zero 轮胎
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力在完成虚拟开发并于 Papenburg 联合进行高速测试后，推出了带 BB 标识的 22-inch P Zero 配套轮胎；规格为前轮 285/30 ZR22 XL、后轮 335/25 ZR22 XL。虚拟优化正与有针对性的试车场工作相结合，用于小批量极限规格产品。该工作流程是具体可见的，但未披露开发周期缩短幅度或任何对比结果。后续应关注独立测试、型号认证数量以及向更广泛原配项目的转移。

title: Prinx Chengshan sidewall-compound patent receives national award
what_happened: China Rubber reported that a patent for a low-rolling-resistance, flex-resistant sidewall compound for new-energy vehicles received an Excellence Award in the 26th China Patent Awards. EV-tire work is moving deeper into component compounds that balance energy loss with repeated flexing. The award validates patent significance, not quantified tire performance. Watch the patent text, commercial applications and comparative fatigue and rolling-loss data.
title_zh: 浦林成山胎侧胶配方专利获得国家级奖项
what_happened_zh: 《中国橡胶》报道称，一项面向新能源汽车的低滚动阻力、耐屈挠胎侧胶配方专利在第二十六届中国专利奖中获得优秀奖。新能源汽车轮胎的研发正进一步深入到兼顾能量损失与反复屈挠的部件胶料层面。该奖项印证的是专利本身的重要性，而非经量化的轮胎性能。后续应关注专利文本、商业化应用以及疲劳与滚动损失的对比数据。

title: Michelin-backed platform starts industrial-scale fermentation projects
companies: Michelin and Biotech Open Platform partners
what_happened: The Clermont-Ferrand platform opened with more than EUR20 million invested, fermentation capacity up to 15 cubic metres and scale-up capability from 10 grams to one tonne. Shared pilot infrastructure is targeting the gap between laboratory fermentation and industrial validation. Michelin gains scale-up access for petrochemical substitutes, but no tire-specific molecule or result was disclosed. Watch named material programs, yields, cost targets and tire testing.
title_zh: 米其林支持的平台启动工业规模发酵项目
what_happened_zh: 位于 Clermont-Ferrand 的平台投入运行，投资额超过 EUR20 million，发酵能力最高达 15 cubic metres，放大能力覆盖 10 grams 至一吨。共享的中试设施正瞄准实验室发酵与工业验证之间的缺口。米其林由此获得石化替代品的放大通道，但未披露任何具体的轮胎用分子或结果。后续应关注具名材料项目、收率、成本目标和轮胎测试。

title: Huizhou Renxin SSBR and LCBR project clears energy review
what_happened: An in-window association recap says the RMB1.5 billion project cleared energy review on September 24 and plans 128,000 tonnes a year across continuous and batch LCBR/SSBR lines. Chinese solution-polymerized rubber investment is combining continuous and batch lines for different recipes. This is a permitting milestone; 2027-2028 start dates and capacities remain plans. Watch the government record, construction permits, equipment awards and customer qualification.
title_zh: Huizhou Renxin 的 SSBR 与 LCBR 项目通过能源评审
what_happened_zh: 报告期内的一则协会回顾信息称，该 RMB1.5 billion 项目已于 9月24日 通过能源评审，并计划通过连续法和间歇法 LCBR/SSBR 生产线实现年产 128,000 tonnes。中国的溶聚橡胶投资正把连续法和间歇法生产线结合起来，以适应不同配方。这是一个许可环节的里程碑；2027-2028 年的投产时间和产能仍属计划。后续应关注政府记录、施工许可、设备招标结果和客户认证。

title: China tire input-cost index stays roughly 25% above year-earlier levels
what_happened: Longzhong's September 28 model put semi-steel tire raw-material cost at RMB16,155.12 per tonne, up 25.43% year on year, and the all-steel index at RMB15,322.48, up 25.92%. Small daily easing is occurring inside a much higher year-on-year cost base. The index quantifies cost pressure behind price notices, while remaining a modeled basket rather than company accounting. Watch natural-rubber futures, carbon-black quotes and Shandong operating rates.
title_zh: 中国轮胎原料成本指数仍较上年同期高约 25%
what_happened_zh: 隆众 9月28日 的模型将半钢轮胎原材料成本定为每吨 RMB16,155.12，同比上升 25.43%，全钢指数为 RMB15,322.48，同比上升 25.92%。日度层面出现的小幅回落，发生在高得多的同比成本基数之上。该指数量化了价格函背后的成本压力，但它仍然是一个模型化的原料篮子，而非企业实际核算。后续应关注天然橡胶期货、炭黑报价和山东地区开工率。

title: Sumitomo Rubber creates cross-divisional natural-rubber risk committee
what_happened: The group established divisional sustainability committees and a Sustainable Natural Rubber subcommittee for supply-chain risk, biodiversity, human rights and farmer support. Natural-rubber compliance is moving from central ESG teams into operating divisions. The structure may improve accountability, but the release sets no new traceability or outcome metric. Watch KPIs, supplier mapping, farmer programs and due-diligence results.
title_zh: 住友橡胶设立跨事业部的天然橡胶风险委员会
what_happened_zh: 该集团设立了各事业部的可持续发展委员会，以及负责供应链风险、生物多样性、人权和胶农支持的可持续天然橡胶分委会。天然橡胶合规管理正从集团 ESG 部门转入各运营事业部。该架构可能改善问责机制，但本次发布没有设定新的可追溯性指标或结果指标。后续应关注 KPI、供应商图谱、胶农项目以及尽职调查结果。

title: Anlun-Liugang carbon-black project enters production in Guangxi
what_happened: An in-window recap says the project entered production September 22 with design capacity of 118,000 tonnes of high-performance carbon black, using Liugang coal tar and returning surplus tail gas as fuel. Integrated steel and carbon-black sites are turning coking by-products into reinforcing material while recycling gas. Nameplate capacity does not establish utilization or customer qualification. Watch utilization, grade mix, tire-customer approvals and emissions.

sources.publisher: China Rubber Industry Association; Liugang-attributed report
sources.link_label: China Rubber Industry Association; Liugang-attributed report

title_zh: Anlun-Liugang 炭黑项目在广西投产
what_happened_zh: 报告期内的一则回顾信息称，该项目已于 9月22日 投产，设计产能为 118,000 tonnes 高性能炭黑，使用 Liugang 的煤焦油，并将富余尾气返回用作燃料。钢铁与炭黑一体化基地正把炼焦副产品转化为补强材料，同时实现尾气循环利用。名义产能并不能说明产能利用率或客户认证情况。后续应关注产能利用率、牌号结构、轮胎客户认证和排放情况。

title: Yulin signs 80,000-tonne rubber-grade carbon-black project
companies: Shaanxi Yanchang China Coal Yulin Energy and Chemical
what_happened: An association report says a RMB743 million project will build two 40,000-tonne carbon-black lines using DCC cracked heavy oil after project filing and signing. Petrochemical sites are integrating heavy by-products into local rubber reinforcing-material production. If executed, the project adds regional supply, but current evidence is a signed and filed plan, not construction. Watch the original development-zone notice, groundbreaking, EIA and equipment contracts.
title_zh: 榆林签约 80,000-tonne 橡胶级炭黑项目
what_happened_zh: 一则协会报道称，一个 RMB743 million 的项目将在完成项目备案和签约后，采用 DCC 裂化重油建设两条 40,000-tonne 炭黑生产线。石化基地正把重质副产品整合进本地的橡胶补强材料生产。若得以执行，该项目将增加区域供应，但目前的证据只是已签约并备案的计划，而非实际开工建设。后续应关注开发区的原始公告、动工、环评和设备合同。

title: Sinopec Hunan Petrochemical tenders 60 tonnes of rubber catalyst
what_happened: Sinopec's procurement system issued an amended 2026-2027 framework tender for 60 tonnes of at least 99% titanium dicyclopentadienyl dichloride catalyst for rubber use. Specialty catalyst demand is visible through multi-year framework procurement rather than only capacity announcements. The tender is a direct input-demand signal, not evidence that the full quantity will be consumed. Watch the award, unit price, call-off volumes and supported rubber grades.
title_zh: 中国石化湖南石化招标采购 60 tonnes 橡胶用催化剂
what_happened_zh: 中国石化采购系统发布了经修订的 2026-2027 年框架招标，采购 60 tonnes 纯度不低于 99% 的二氯化二环戊二烯基钛橡胶用催化剂。专用催化剂需求正通过多年期框架采购显现，而不只是体现在产能公告上。该招标是一个直接的原料需求信号，但并不证明全部数量都会被消耗。后续应关注中标结果、单价、实际执行量以及所支撑的橡胶牌号。

title: Kumho awards KRW72 billion plant-logistics automation contract
what_happened: A Korean filing records a KRW72 billion contract for logistics automation modules and robots at Kumho's Hampyeong plant through October 2028, equal to 18.28% of Hyundai Movex revenue. New tire plants are contracting integrated material flow rather than isolated automation cells. Value and term are authoritative execution evidence; projected plant benefits remain prospective. Watch installation, acceptance, commissioning and throughput baselines.

sources.publisher: Korea DART filing; Seoul Economic Daily
sources.link_label: Korea DART filing; Seoul Economic Daily

title_zh: 锦湖轮胎授出 KRW72 billion 工厂物流自动化合同
what_happened_zh: 一份韩国公告记录了一项 KRW72 billion 合同，内容为锦湖轮胎 Hampyeong 工厂的物流自动化模块和机器人，合同期至 2028 年 10 月，相当于 Hyundai Movex 营业收入的 18.28%。新建轮胎工厂正在按整体物料流方式签约，而不是采购孤立的自动化单元。合同金额和期限是权威的执行证据，但预期的工厂效益仍属前瞻性内容。后续应关注安装、验收、调试和产能基准。

title: Dongsheng opens public review on motorcycle-tire and reclaimed-rubber expansion
what_happened: A second environmental-impact disclosure describes expansion from 2 million to 20 million radial motorcycle tires a year and from 20,000 to 100,000 tonnes of reclaimed rubber, using more than 500 additional equipment sets. Small-format tire investment is being paired with a much larger reclaimed-rubber loop at the same site. The public-comment step exposes intended equipment and capacity, but it does not show that the project is approved, built or producing. Watch for the original local-government EIA, final approval, equipment awards and commissioning.

sources.publisher: Project disclosure mirror; China Rubber Industry Association
sources.link_label: Project disclosure mirror; China Rubber Industry Association

title_zh: Dongsheng 就摩托车轮胎与再生橡胶扩产开展公示
what_happened_zh: 第二份环境影响评价公示文件描述了把子午线摩托车轮胎年产能从 2 million 条扩大到 20 million 条，并把再生橡胶年产能从 20,000 提高到 100,000 tonnes，为此将增加 500 多台（套）设备。小规格轮胎投资正与同一厂区内规模大得多的再生橡胶循环相配套。公示环节公开了拟用设备和产能，但并不说明该项目已获批准、已建成或已在生产。后续应关注地方政府的原始环评文件、最终批准、设备招标结果和投产。

title: Huangpu Tire produces first tire at Inner Mongolia aviation and specialty base
what_happened: Two industry reports say the Hohhot base produced its first tire on September 28; disclosed design capacity is 15,000 aviation tires and 50,000 specialty engineering tires a year. China is moving aviation-tire research assets into a dedicated industrial base with adjacent specialty-tire applications. A first-tire milestone is stronger than a plan, but it is short of stable qualified output and customer acceptance. Watch certification, named programs, ramp rate and qualified deliveries.

sources.publisher: Carbon Black Industry Network; China Rubber Industry Association
sources.link_label: Carbon Black Industry Network; China Rubber Industry Association

title_zh: Huangpu Tire 在内蒙古航空及特种轮胎基地产出首条轮胎
what_happened_zh: 两则行业报道称，呼和浩特基地已于 9月28日 产出首条轮胎；披露的设计产能为年产 15,000 条航空轮胎和 50,000 条特种工程轮胎。中国正在把航空轮胎研究资源移入一个专门的产业基地，并配套发展相邻的特种轮胎应用。首条轮胎下线比单纯的计划更有分量，但距离稳定的合格产出和客户验收仍有差距。后续应关注认证、具名项目、产能爬坡速度和合格交付量。

title: Guizhou Tire rooftop-solar phase five reaches EPC award
what_happened: A tender mirror records an EPC award worth RMB58.20 million for phase five of the distributed rooftop photovoltaic project, with a planned 300-day contract period. Factory decarbonization is advancing through repeat on-site power phases rather than a single pilot. The award is an execution milestone, but the accessible record does not disclose generation capacity or verified savings. Watch for the original notice, installed megawatts, grid connection and measured electricity displacement.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎屋顶光伏五期进入 EPC 中标阶段
what_happened_zh: 一则招标转载记录显示，分布式屋顶光伏项目五期的 EPC 中标金额为 RMB58.20 million，计划合同工期为 300 天。工厂脱碳正通过多期厂内发电项目推进，而不是停留在单一试点。该中标是一个执行层面的里程碑，但可获取的记录并未披露发电装机容量或经核实的节约金额。后续应关注原始公告、建成装机兆瓦数、并网情况以及经计量的电量替代。

title: Context: Hainan report describes RMB3 billion airless-tire project filing
what_happened: A trade article says a filing covers 1.2 million all-steel radial tires, 1 million airless light-truck wheel sets and 50,000 airless engineering tires a year. The proposal combines conventional truck tires with high-volume airless concepts. The scale would be material if verified, but the article cites only 'the internet' and the original filing was not recovered. The original filing was not recovered, so this item is retained only as context. Watch for the official filing, sponsor identity, land, permits and technology basis before any promotion to core.
title_zh: 背景信息：海南报道称一项 RMB3 billion 无气轮胎项目完成备案
what_happened_zh: 一篇行业文章称，一份备案涵盖年产 1.2 million 条全钢子午线轮胎、1 million 套无气轻卡车轮总成和 50,000 条无气工程轮胎。该方案把常规卡车轮胎与大批量无气概念结合在一起。若得到核实，这一规模将具有实质意义，但该文章仅引用“网络”作为来源，且原始备案文件未被找回。原始备案文件未被找回，因此本条仅作为背景信息保留。后续应关注官方备案文件、项目主体身份、土地、许可和技术基础，之后才可考虑升级为核心内容。

title: Chinese tire makers issue another wave of October price-increase notices
companies: Multiple Chinese tire makers and distributors
what_happened: A trade review documented October notices including Triangle increases of 2%-5% for OTR tires and 3%-5% for commercial tires, while several PCR and TBR suppliers announced mostly 3%-5%. Price letters are being used to pass through costs and pull dealer orders forward before the holiday. The notices show broad pricing intent, not realized transaction prices in a weak replacement market. Watch invoice realization, dealer inventory and post-holiday discounts.
title_zh: 中国轮胎企业再发一轮 10月 涨价通知
what_happened_zh: 一则行业综述记录了 10月 的涨价通知，其中三角轮胎工程机械轮胎上调 2%-5%、商用车轮胎上调 3%-5%，同时多家半钢和全钢子午线轮胎供应商宣布的幅度多为 3%-5%。价格函正被用于传导成本，并在假期前拉动经销商提前下单。这些通知显示的是广泛的调价意向，而非替换市场疲弱背景下的实际成交价格。后续应关注发票价格兑现、经销商库存和假期后的折扣。

title: Hankook wins Dynapro HPX OE fitment for North American Volkswagen Atlas
what_happened: Hankook will supply Dynapro HPX tires in 18-, 20- and 21-inch sizes as original equipment for Volkswagen Atlas models sold in North America. Korean tire makers continue expanding premium SUV OE portfolios across multiple wheel sizes. A named vehicle and size range is concrete customer evidence; volumes and duration remain undisclosed. Watch model-year coverage, plant source, awarded volume and replacement pull-through.
title_zh: 韩泰获得北美大众 Atlas 的 Dynapro HPX 原配供应
what_happened_zh: 韩泰将为在北美销售的大众 Atlas 车型提供 18-、20- 和 21-inch 规格的 Dynapro HPX 原配轮胎。韩国轮胎企业正继续在多个轮辋尺寸上扩展高端 SUV 原配产品组合。具名车型和规格范围是明确的客户证据，但供货数量和周期仍未披露。后续应关注车型年覆盖范围、供货工厂、获配数量以及替换市场的带动效应。

title: Porsche approves Continental fitments for Panamera and Cayenne
what_happened: Porsche approved SportContact 7 and SportContact 7 Force for Panamera G3 II and recommends WinterContact TS 860 S for Cayenne E4. Premium OE programs are differentiating fitments by vehicle and season. The approvals are direct customer evidence, but awarded volumes and comparisons were not disclosed. Watch marked sizes, factory-fit take rates and independent tests.
title_zh: 保时捷为 Panamera 与 Cayenne 批准大陆集团配套轮胎
what_happened_zh: 保时捷批准 SportContact 7 和 SportContact 7 Force 用于 Panamera G3 II，并推荐 WinterContact TS 860 S 用于 Cayenne E4。高端原配项目正在按车型和季节区分配套规格。这些批准是直接的客户证据，但获配数量和对比数据未予披露。后续应关注带标识的规格、整车厂装配率以及独立测试。

title: MAXAM launches the MS934 for high-flotation agricultural and track-system use
what_happened: MAXAM's MS934 product release describes a high-flotation radial with a cut-resistant compound and fitment for agricultural implements and track systems. Specialty-tire launches are targeting soil protection and equipment compatibility as a combined design problem. The direct product page gives features but no independent field-life or soil-compaction comparison. Watch named OEM fitments, field trials and measured durability.
title_zh: MAXAM 推出面向高浮力农用及履带系统应用的 MS934
what_happened_zh: MAXAM 的 MS934 产品发布介绍了一款高浮力子午线轮胎，采用抗切割配方，可配套农机具和履带系统。专用轮胎的新品正把土壤保护与设备兼容性作为一个整体设计问题来处理。该产品页面给出了产品特性，但未提供独立的田间使用寿命或土壤压实对比数据。后续应关注具名的 OEM 配套、田间试验和实测耐久性。

title: Pirelli debuts a new Moto2 soft rear structure for Mandalika heat
what_happened: Pirelli introduced F0515, a soft Moto2 rear using the existing SC0 compound with a revised structure intended to improve stability and performance consistency at Mandalika, where track temperatures can exceed 60 C. Race-tire development is separating compound choice from structural tuning to target circuit load and heat. The release explains design intent; comparative lap-life and rider-by-rider data are not disclosed. Watch race usage, wear and whether the structure transfers to other circuits or production products.
title_zh: 倍耐力为 Mandalika 高温条件推出新的 Moto2 软胎后轮结构
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力推出 F0515，这是一款采用现有 SC0 配方、结构经过修改的 Moto2 软胎后轮；在赛道温度可超过 60 C 的 Mandalika，该结构意在提升稳定性和性能一致性。赛车轮胎开发正把配方选择与结构调校分开，以针对赛道载荷与热负荷。该发布说明了设计意图，但未披露对比性的单圈寿命数据和逐位车手数据。后续应关注比赛使用情况、磨耗，以及该结构是否会移植到其他赛道或量产产品。

title: Bridgestone ties its GEN4 Formula E tire program to Shanghai's 2027 double-header
what_happened: Bridgestone's China release said the 2027 Shanghai Formula E rounds on July 10-11 will carry its title sponsorship and described GEN4 tires planned with 65% renewable and recycled materials and separate wet and dry specifications. A global development tire is being localized through a named China race program and marketing platform. Material share and race design are announced specifications; race performance and circular recovery remain unverified. Watch final homologation, Shanghai operating data and material accounting after use.
title_zh: 普利司通把 GEN4 Formula E 轮胎项目与上海 2027 年双赛周绑定
what_happened_zh: 普利司通中国发布信息称，2027 年上海 Formula E 比赛将于 7 月 10–11 日举行并由其冠名，同时介绍了计划采用 65% 可再生和再生材料、并分设湿地与干地规格的 GEN4 轮胎。一款全球开发的轮胎正通过具名的中国赛事项目和营销平台实现本地化。材料占比和赛事设计属于已公布的规格；赛道表现和循环回收仍未得到验证。后续应关注最终型号认证、上海的运行数据以及使用后的材料核算。

title: Pirelli publishes differentiated Formula 1 compound selections for three American rounds
what_happened: Pirelli selected C2-C4 compounds for Austin and the softer C3-C5 range for Mexico City and Sao Paulo, creating a three-event comparison of degradation and strategy under different track conditions. Compound allocation is being used as a controlled operational lever to shape racing strategy across consecutive venues. Selections are pre-event decisions, not evidence of final stint performance or transfer to road tires. Watch degradation, stint lengths and any safety-driven pressure or compound changes.
title_zh: 倍耐力公布三站美洲赛事差异化的 Formula 1 配方选择
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力为 Austin 选择 C2-C4 配方，为 Mexico City 和 Sao Paulo 选择更软的 C3-C5 区间，从而在不同赛道条件下形成一次覆盖三场赛事的衰退与策略对比。配方分配正被用作一个可控的运营杠杆，用来塑造连续数站的比赛策略。这些选择是赛前决定，并不构成最终单段表现或向公路轮胎转化的证据。后续应关注衰退情况、单段使用长度，以及任何出于安全考虑的胎压或配方调整。

title: Standard-range Pirelli SCX rear completes an Estoril WorldSBK hat-trick
what_happened: Pirelli reported that Nicolò Bulega won all three Estoril WorldSBK races on its standard-range supersoft SCX rear tire, while the field used the SC1 front for the Sunday races. A commercially aligned racing range is accumulating repeated high-load competition evidence rather than relying only on development specifications. A race result combines tire, rider, motorcycle and conditions and cannot isolate tire causality. Watch wear data, lap consistency and subsequent road-range technology transfer.
title_zh: 量产系列倍耐力 SCX 后胎完成 Estoril WorldSBK 三连胜
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力报告称，Nicolò Bulega 使用其量产系列超软 SCX 后胎赢得 Estoril WorldSBK 全部三场比赛，而在周日的比赛中，参赛车手整体使用 SC1 前胎。一个与商用产品对应的赛事产品系列正在累积重复的高负荷比赛证据，而不是只依赖开发规格。比赛结果由轮胎、车手、摩托车和条件共同决定，无法分离出轮胎的因果作用。后续应关注磨耗数据、单圈一致性以及后续向公路产品系列的技术转移。

title: Public recap quantifies Dunlop-Fujitsu AI speedup for tire structural analysis
what_happened: A trade publication recapped the June announcement that a graph-based AI approach cut a reported structural-analysis run from about 45 minutes to 5 minutes on a roughly 600,000-element tire model, with average accuracy reported at 87.7% against finite-element results. AI surrogates are being positioned to shorten iterative tire simulation, but deployment remains ahead of full public validation. The weekly item is a secondary recap of an earlier company announcement, and the model's error distribution and production use are not public. This is context because the weekly signal is a secondary recap and the underlying event predates the window. Watch the planned MONAKA verification and any tool release or industrial-design case study.
title_zh: 公开回顾量化了 Dunlop 与 Fujitsu 面向轮胎结构分析的 AI 加速效果
what_happened_zh: 一家行业媒体回顾了 6 月的公告：一种基于图的 AI 方法把一次结构分析的报告运行时间从约 45 分钟缩短到 5 分钟，所用轮胎模型约为 600,000 单元，相对有限元结果的平均精度据报为 87.7%。AI 代理模型正被定位为缩短轮胎迭代仿真的手段，但部署进度仍领先于完整的公开验证。本周条目是对公司早前公告的二次回顾，模型的误差分布和生产应用均未公开。本条作为背景信息，因为本周信号是二次回顾，且底层事件发生在报告期之前。后续应关注计划中的 MONAKA 验证，以及任何工具发布或工业设计案例研究。

title: US Commerce preliminarily sets a 107.57% countervailing rate on Chinese CBS accelerator
what_happened: Commerce announced an affirmative preliminary countervailing-duty determination covering N-cyclohexylbenzothiazole-2-sulfenamide from China, listing 107.57% for named respondents and all other producers or exporters. Trade controls are reaching a tire-compounding accelerator rather than only finished tires or base polymers. A high preliminary rate can alter sourcing and landed cost, but it is not the final duty order. Watch the final determination, possible alignment with the trade commission and supplier sourcing changes.
title_zh: 美国商务部初步裁定对中国 CBS 促进剂征收 107.57% 反补贴税率
what_happened_zh: 美国商务部宣布对自中国进口的 N-cyclohexylbenzothiazole-2-sulfenamide 作出肯定性反补贴初裁，对具名应诉企业以及所有其他生产商或出口商均列出 107.57% 的税率。贸易管制正延伸到轮胎配方用促进剂，而不再只针对成品轮胎或基础聚合物。较高的初裁税率可能改变采购与到岸成本，但它还不是最终征税令。后续应关注最终裁定、与贸易委员会可能的一致性处理，以及供应商采购的调整。

title: Michelin ResiCare places its first DragonFly bio-based resin line at Ajinomoto's Nesle site
what_happened: Michelin said the first industrial DragonFly line is being installed at Ajinomoto's Nesle site to make a fermentation-derived aromatic bio-monomer, with startup targeted for the second quarter of 2027. A bio-based adhesive building block is moving from development toward an industrial host-site line. The stated potential for up to 96% lower greenhouse-gas emissions is versus a fossil equivalent and remains a modeled claim pending operating data. Watch commissioning, output, customer qualification and reviewed life-cycle results.
title_zh: 米其林 ResiCare 把首条 DragonFly 生物基树脂生产线落地 Ajinomoto 的 Nesle 工厂
what_happened_zh: 米其林表示，首条工业化 DragonFly 生产线正在 Ajinomoto 的 Nesle 工厂安装，用于生产一种发酵法制取的芳香族生物单体，计划于 2027 年第二季度投产。一种生物基粘合剂基础原料正从开发阶段走向在东道工厂建设工业化生产线。公司提出的温室气体排放最多降低 96% 是相对化石基等效产品而言，在取得运行数据之前仍属模型测算主张。后续应关注投产调试、产量、客户认证和经评审的全生命周期结果。

title: Momentive starts NXT P97 silane production in Chennai with 79% renewable carbon
what_happened: Momentive said its Chennai site is producing NXT P97 silane with 79% renewable carbon content for silica-reinforced tread systems, creating an Asia, India, Middle East and Africa supply hub. Lower-carbon functional silanes are moving into regional production rather than remaining an imported specialty input. The carbon-content figure and tire-processing benefits are company claims; customer qualification and life-cycle results are not disclosed. Watch tire-customer qualification, volumes and independently reviewed life-cycle data.
title_zh: Momentive 在 Chennai 启动含 79% 可再生碳的 NXT P97 硅烷生产
what_happened_zh: Momentive 表示，其 Chennai 工厂正在生产可再生碳含量为 79% 的 NXT P97 硅烷，用于白炭黑补强胎面体系，并由此形成面向亚洲、印度、中东和非洲的供应中心。低碳功能性硅烷正进入区域化生产，而不再只是进口的特种原料。碳含量数据和轮胎加工收益均为公司主张，客户认证和全生命周期结果尚未披露。后续应关注轮胎客户认证、产量和经独立评审的全生命周期数据。

title: Sumitomo Rubber moves its natural-rubber smallholder support program into phase two
what_happened: Sumitomo Rubber announced phase two of a program supporting natural-rubber smallholders, extending its upstream engagement beyond the initial phase. Large tire makers are treating smallholder capability and resilience as supply-chain infrastructure. The release establishes program continuation but does not disclose enough farm-level income, yield or traceability outcomes to judge impact. Watch participating-farm counts, measured agronomic outcomes and purchasing linkage.
title_zh: 住友橡胶把天然橡胶小农支持项目推进至第二阶段
what_happened_zh: 住友橡胶宣布启动天然橡胶小农支持项目的第二阶段，把上游参与从首期进一步延伸。大型轮胎制造商正把小农的能力和抗风险韧性视为供应链基础设施。该发布确认了项目的延续，但未披露足以判断影响的农户层面收入、产量或可追溯性结果。后续应关注参与农户数量、可量化的农艺结果以及与采购的衔接。

title: China BR9000 spot references hold near CNY16,000 per tonne
what_happened: The market update placed mainstream BR9000 references in northern, eastern and southern China around CNY16,000 per tonne, with northern private-brand material quoted at CNY16,450-CNY16,750 per tonne. Synthetic-rubber cost pressure is broad enough to reinforce, rather than offset, the natural-rubber price signal. Spot indications vary by brand, region and transaction and do not prove tire-maker input costs. Watch plant operating rates, feedstock pricing and realized spot transactions.
title_zh: 中国 BR9000 现货参考价维持在 CNY16,000 每吨附近
what_happened_zh: 市场信息显示，华北、华东和华南地区主流 BR9000 参考价约为 CNY16,000 每吨，其中华北民营品牌货源报价为 CNY16,450-CNY16,750 每吨。顺丁橡胶的成本压力面广，足以强化而非抵消天然橡胶的价格信号。现货指示价随品牌、区域和具体成交而异，不能证明轮胎企业的实际投入成本。后续应关注装置开工率、原料价格和已实现的现货成交。

title: Chinese natural-rubber references rise sharply across the holiday interval
what_happened: A weekly market review showed selected Qingdao and Shanghai natural-rubber references rising between September 24 and October 10, including Thai No.20 standard rubber in Qingdao from CNY2,550 to CNY2,670 and Shanghai full-latex rubber from CNY19,100 to CNY20,200. Multiple physical-rubber references were repricing together, increasing near-term compound-cost pressure. Quoted assessments are market references rather than individual tire-maker procurement invoices. Track contract settlement, inventory, import arrivals and whether tire price letters cover the cost move.
title_zh: 中国天然橡胶参考价在假期区间大幅上涨
what_happened_zh: 一份周度市场回顾显示，青岛和上海部分天然橡胶参考价在 9 月 24 日至 10 月 10 日之间上涨，其中青岛泰国 No.20 标准胶从 CNY2,550 涨至 CNY2,670，上海全乳胶从 CNY19,100 涨至 CNY20,200。多个现货橡胶参考价同步重新定价，加大了近期配方成本压力。所引用的评估价是市场参考价，而非单家轮胎企业的采购发票价。后续应跟踪合约结算、库存、进口到港，以及轮胎价格函是否覆盖此次成本上移。

title: SHFE daily data records heavy trading in the January 2027 natural-rubber contract
what_happened: The exchange's October 9 daily table showed the January 2027 natural-rubber contract settling at CNY19,760 per tonne on volume of 504,349 contracts; aggregate natural-rubber volume was 579,937. Futures liquidity concentrated in the front active contract as physical-rubber references moved higher. Exchange turnover is a market signal, not a forecast of tire-maker purchase cost. Track open interest, basis behavior and whether the move persists in physical assessments.
title_zh: 上海期货交易所日度数据显示 2027 年 1 月天然橡胶合约交易活跃
what_happened_zh: 交易所 10 月 9 日的日度数据表显示，2027 年 1 月天然橡胶合约结算价为 CNY19,760 每吨，成交量为 504,349 手；天然橡胶品种合计成交量为 579,937。在现货橡胶参考价走高之际，期货流动性集中于近月主力合约。交易所成交数据是市场信号，而不是对轮胎企业采购成本的预测。后续应跟踪持仓量、基差表现，以及这一走势是否在现货评估价中延续。

title: Sentury advances a $272.82 million Turkey tire project through a listed-company filing
what_happened: Sentury filed an investment announcement and feasibility materials for a Turkey project designed for 7 million passenger and light-truck radial tires a year. The disclosed structure gives Sentury 90.1% and Tatko 9.9%, with an 18-month construction plan. Chinese overseas tire investment is moving toward joint local execution structures in markets that offer regional access. The filing establishes approval and planned economics, not construction completion, qualified output or sales. Watch overseas approvals, land and construction milestones, equipment awards and customer qualification.
title_zh: 森麒麟通过上市公司公告推进 $272.82 million 土耳其轮胎项目
what_happened_zh: 森麒麟就一个土耳其项目提交了投资公告和可行性材料，该项目设计年产 7 million 条乘用车和轻卡子午线轮胎。披露的股权结构为森麒麟持股 90.1%、Tatko 持股 9.9%，建设周期计划为 18 个月。中国轮胎企业的海外投资正转向在能够提供区域市场准入的市场采用本地联合执行结构。该公告确立的是审批和规划经济性，而非建设完工、合格产出或销售。后续应关注境外审批、土地与建设节点、设备订单授出以及客户认证。

title: Timsun restarts its old plant while installing equipment at a 12-million-tire smart factory
what_happened: Weihai government reported that the existing plant resumed work on October 5 while equipment installation and commissioning had begun October 2 at a CNY2.7 billion smart plant designed for 12 million high-performance green motorcycle radial tires a year. First tires are scheduled for June or July 2027. The project links a large two-wheel radial expansion to electric curing and one-step winding rather than treating capacity and process modernization as separate programs. The old plant restart is operating evidence, but the new capacity remains in installation and commissioning and should not be counted as output. Track first-tire production, qualification, ramp rate and measured energy consumption after commissioning.
title_zh: Timsun 老厂复工，同时在一座 12-million-tire 智能工厂安装设备
what_happened_zh: 威海市政府称，现有工厂已于 10 月 5 日复工，而一座投资 CNY2.7 billion、设计年产 12 million 条高性能绿色摩托车子午线轮胎的智能工厂已于 10 月 2 日开始设备安装和调试。首批轮胎计划于 2027 年 6 月或 7 月产出。该项目把大规模两轮子午胎扩产与电加热硫化、一步法缠绕结合起来，而不是把产能与工艺现代化当作彼此独立的计划。老厂复工是实际运行证据，但新增产能仍处于安装和调试阶段，不应计为产出。后续应跟踪首胎生产、认证、产能爬坡速度以及调试后实测的能耗。

title: Plant-level updates broaden visibility into Shandong tire operating conditions
what_happened: Longzhong's plant-data route published a cluster of dated operating updates for Shandong semi-steel and all-steel tire lines, including facilities in Dongying, Weifang and Shouguang. Factory-by-factory operating records are becoming a useful complement to aggregate utilization and order surveys. The public listing confirms the update set but does not expose a complete, nationally representative operating-rate sample. Watch the next utilization release, line restarts, maintenance and inventory movement.
title_zh: 工厂层面的更新扩大了山东轮胎运行状况的可见度
what_happened_zh: 隆众的工厂数据栏目发布了一批带日期的山东半钢和全钢轮胎生产线运行更新，涉及东营、潍坊和寿光等地的企业。逐厂的运行记录正在成为总量产能利用率和订单调查的有益补充。公开列表确认了这批更新的存在，但并未呈现一个完整、具备全国代表性的开工率样本。后续应关注下一期产能利用率发布、生产线复产、检修和库存变动。

title: US review narrows the Thai passenger-tire case and rescinds review of Sentury Thailand
what_happened: A Federal Register notice published preliminary administrative-review results for passenger-vehicle and light-truck tires from Thailand and recorded rescission of the review for Sentury Tire (Thailand). Chinese-owned overseas plants remain exposed to destination-market trade procedures even when production is outside China. Rescission for one company does not remove the broader antidumping order or establish future treatment. Track final review results, cash-deposit instructions and sourcing responses by Thai exporters.
title_zh: 美国复审收窄泰国乘用车轮胎案，并撤销对森麒麟泰国公司的复审
what_happened_zh: 《联邦公报》刊登的通知公布了泰国乘用车和轻卡轮胎行政复审的初步结果，并记录撤销对 Sentury Tire (Thailand) 的复审。即使生产地在中国境外，中资海外工厂仍会面临目的地市场的贸易程序。对一家公司撤销复审并不会取消更广泛的反倾销税令，也不确立未来的处理方式。后续应跟踪最终复审结果、保证金缴纳指令以及泰国出口商的采购应对。

title: China tire survey shows most sampled factories reporting weaker new orders
what_happened: The weekly order survey reported lower new orders at 63% of sampled semi-steel tire enterprises and 75% of sampled all-steel tire enterprises; the remainder reported orders broadly unchanged and no increase group was shown for all-steel tires. Announced price increases are appearing alongside weak order intake rather than clear demand acceleration. The survey is a sample and measures direction, not national shipment totals or realized pricing. Watch subsequent order, inventory and utilization readings after announced price increases take effect.
title_zh: 中国轮胎调查显示多数样本工厂报告新订单走弱
what_happened_zh: 周度订单调查显示，63% 的样本半钢轮胎企业和 75% 的样本全钢轮胎企业新订单下降；其余企业报告订单大体持平，全钢轮胎未出现订单增加的样本组。已公布的涨价与订单承接偏弱同时出现，而不是与明确的需求加速同时出现。该调查基于样本，衡量的是方向，而非全国出货总量或实际成交价格。后续应关注涨价生效后的订单、库存和产能利用率读数。

title: Triangle records a Green Tire Safety Week outreach event
what_happened: Triangle's official news index recorded a Green Tire Safety Week activity during the reporting window. Safety education remains part of tire makers' brand and channel engagement. The accessible public index does not provide enough participation, behavior or commercial outcome data for a core finding. Retained as context because the official surface confirms the event but exposes limited outcome evidence. Watch for event metrics, inspection outcomes and repeat programs.
title_zh: 三角轮胎记录了一场绿色轮胎安全周宣传活动
what_happened_zh: 三角轮胎官方新闻索引记录了报告期内的一场绿色轮胎安全周活动。安全教育仍是轮胎制造商品牌与渠道经营的一部分。可访问的公开索引未提供足以支撑核心发现的参与情况、行为或商业结果数据。本条作为背景信息保留，因为官方页面确认了该活动，但披露的结果证据有限。后续应关注活动量化指标、检测结果和重复举办的项目。

title: Pirelli develops a bespoke P Zero R for the Mercedes-AMG FIA Formula 1 safety car
what_happened: Pirelli introduced a 21-inch, MO1-marked P Zero R for the Mercedes-AMG GT 63 PRO 4MATIC+ safety car, using a dual-compound tread and validation at the Nuerburgring and Nardo. Virtual development is being combined with named proving-ground validation for highly specific vehicle duties. A safety-car fitment is a narrow high-performance application and does not establish results across the retail range. Watch road-car derivatives and published wet, dry and durability comparisons.
title_zh: 倍耐力为 Mercedes-AMG FIA Formula 1 安全车开发定制 P Zero R
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力为 Mercedes-AMG GT 63 PRO 4MATIC+ 安全车推出一款 21-inch、带 MO1 标记的 P Zero R，采用双配方胎面，并在 Nuerburgring 和 Nardo 完成验证。虚拟开发正与具名试车场验证相结合，用于高度特定的车辆使用需求。安全车配套属于范围狭窄的高性能应用，并不确立整个零售产品系列的表现结论。后续应关注衍生的公路车产品以及公开的湿地、干地和耐久性对比结果。

title: Michelin launches EV Charge as a customer-facing charging service
what_happened: Michelin announced EV Charge, extending its customer offer from tires and travel services into electric-vehicle charging access. Tire brands are testing adjacent digital mobility services as a route to more frequent customer interaction. The public release does not disclose user adoption, charger coverage by country or revenue economics. Watch rollout geography, network partners, active users and service retention.
title_zh: 米其林推出面向客户的充电服务 EV Charge
what_happened_zh: 米其林宣布推出 EV Charge，把面向客户的产品与服务从轮胎和出行服务延伸到电动车充电接入。轮胎品牌正在测试相邻的数字出行服务，以此作为提高客户互动频次的途径。公开发布未披露用户采用情况、各国充电桩覆盖范围或收入经济性。后续应关注推广区域、网络合作方、活跃用户和服务留存。

title: Michelin launches WORKXBIB after customer trials exceeding 50,000 km and 2,000 hours
what_happened: Michelin launched the WORKXBIB 600/55 R26.5 agricultural tire, naming Maupu, Deves and Sodimac as original-equipment users. It reports load capacity up to 6,500 kg at 65 km/h and customer trials exceeding 50,000 km and 2,000 hours. Agricultural tire launches are pairing quantified field exposure with named equipment customers. Michelin's up-to-80% life improvement is versus the prior generation under its customer tests and is not a universal field guarantee. Watch additional sizes planned for Q2 2027 and independent fleet-life results.
title_zh: 米其林在客户试验超过 50,000 km 和 2,000 小时后推出 WORKXBIB
what_happened_zh: 米其林推出 WORKXBIB 600/55 R26.5 农用轮胎，并列出 Maupu、Deves 和 Sodimac 作为原配用户。公司称其在 65 km/h 条件下的承载能力最高可达 6,500 kg，客户试验里程超过 50,000 km、时长超过 2,000 小时。农用轮胎的新品正把量化的田间使用与具名的设备客户结合起来。米其林所称最多提升 80% 的使用寿命是在其客户测试条件下相对上一代产品而言，并非普遍适用的田间保证。后续应关注计划于 Q2 2027 推出的更多规格以及独立的车队寿命结果。

title: Bridgestone China details POTENZA Race R fitment for Lamborghini Revuelto SV
what_happened: Bridgestone China's release introduced the POTENZA Race R custom fitment for the 2026 Lamborghini Revuelto SV in 20-inch front and 21-inch rear sizes, developed with virtual tire development and a motorsport-derived compound. China-facing product communication is carrying quantified virtual-development claims into the premium OE segment. The release says virtual development can reduce development-stage materials and carbon dioxide by up to 60%; this is a method claim, not the fitted tire's life-cycle result. Watch independent track results, production volumes and further OE applications.
title_zh: 普利司通中国披露 Lamborghini Revuelto SV 的 POTENZA Race R 定制配套
what_happened_zh: 普利司通中国发布信息，介绍为 2026 Lamborghini Revuelto SV 定制的 POTENZA Race R，前轮为 20-inch、后轮为 21-inch，并采用虚拟轮胎开发及源自赛车运动的配方。面向中国市场的产品传播正把量化虚拟开发主张带入高端原配领域。该发布称，虚拟开发可将开发阶段的材料和 carbon dioxide 最多减少 60%；这是方法层面的主张，并非该配套轮胎的全生命周期结果。后续应关注独立赛道结果、量产规模和更多原配应用。

title: Pirelli launches Scorpion Winter 3 after virtual development and Lapland validation
what_happened: Pirelli launched the SUV-focused Scorpion Winter 3 after virtual development, driving-simulator work and physical validation at its Sottozero Center. The maker says every replacement size available at launch holds EU wet-grip class A. Virtual tools are being integrated with controlled physical validation for heavier SUV duty cycles. Label performance and company tests define a launch boundary; long-term independent wear evidence is not yet available. Watch third-party winter tests, wear, size expansion and OE nominations.
title_zh: 倍耐力推出经虚拟开发与拉普兰验证的 Scorpion Winter 3
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力推出面向 SUV 的 Scorpion Winter 3；该产品经过虚拟开发、驾驶模拟器工作及 Sottozero Center 实车验证。公司称，上市时可提供的全部替换规格均达到 EU 湿地抓地等级 A。虚拟工具正与受控物理验证结合，用于更重 SUV 的使用工况。标签性能和公司测试界定了上市时的证据边界，目前尚无长期独立磨耗证据。后续应关注第三方冬季测试、磨耗、规格扩展和原配提名。

title: Bekaert Weihai reinforcement reaches industrial use after Triangle-linked mine testing
what_happened: Weihai government reported industrial deployment of a Bekaert reinforcement product developed locally and jointly tested with Triangle, including a high-intensity Southeast Asian mine application. Reinforcement development is combining local supplier engineering, tire-maker validation and severe-duty field evidence. The authority provides qualitative test passage but not a complete comparative dataset, compound design or service-life baseline. Watch named product specifications, test protocol, volume and repeat customer adoption.
title_zh: 贝卡尔特威海增强材料经三角轮胎关联矿区测试后实现工业应用
what_happened_zh: 威海市政府称，贝卡尔特在当地开发并与三角轮胎联合测试的一款增强材料已实现工业应用，其中包括东南亚高强度矿区工况。增强材料开发正在结合本地供应商工程能力、轮胎制造商验证和严苛工况现场证据。主管部门提供了定性测试通过信息，但未披露完整对比数据集、配方设计或使用寿命基线。后续应关注具体产品规格、测试方案、产量和客户复购。

title: Continental details concept tire behind Volkswagen Mission Efficiency record
what_happened: Continental disclosed the tire contribution to Volkswagen's certified 1,278.36 km Wolfsburg-to-Vienna efficiency run. The vehicle used 7.51 kWh/100 km including charging losses, while tire rolling resistance was reported at 4.9 kg/t, about 25% below the EU class A threshold. Tire architecture is being optimized as a quantified part of whole-vehicle electric-efficiency demonstrations. The record is a system result and cannot assign all energy performance to the tire; the run occurred before the weekly publication. Watch production feasibility, wear and independent repeat tests.
title_zh: 大陆集团披露大众 Mission Efficiency 纪录背后的概念轮胎
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团披露了轮胎对大众经认证的 Wolfsburg 至 Vienna、全程 1,278.36 km 效率行驶的贡献。车辆能耗为 7.51 kWh/100 km（含充电损耗），轮胎滚动阻力据报为 4.9 kg/t，较 EU A 级阈值低约 25%。轮胎架构正作为整车电动效率展示中的量化组成部分进行优化。该纪录是系统层面的结果，不能把全部能效表现归因于轮胎；测试发生在本周披露之前。后续应关注量产可行性、磨耗和独立重复测试。

title: Pirelli closes 23 WorldSBK seasons with more than 1.1 million race-lap kilometers logged
what_happened: Pirelli closed its 2004-2026 WorldSBK sole-supplier period and reported 1,143,782 race-lap kilometers across 661 races, plus 17 front and rear specifications used during 2026. A long single-supplier program has produced an unusually large structured application history for track-to-road development. Aggregate kilometers do not by themselves prove transfer effectiveness or isolate individual tire improvements. Watch which technologies and datasets are carried into future racing and road products.
title_zh: 倍耐力结束 23 个 WorldSBK 赛季，累计记录逾 1.1 million 比赛圈公里
what_happened_zh: 倍耐力结束其 2004–2026 年 WorldSBK 独家供应期，并报告在 661 场比赛中累计完成 1,143,782 比赛圈公里，2026 年还使用了 17 种前后轮规格。长期单一供应商项目为赛道到公路产品开发形成了规模罕见的结构化应用历史。累计里程本身不能证明技术转移效果，也不能分离单项轮胎改进的贡献。后续应关注哪些技术和数据集会延续到未来赛车及公路产品。

title: English release recaps Yokohama and dotData's manufacturing R&D AI-agent project
what_happened: Yokohama's English release described joint development of an AI agent intended to support decision-making in manufacturing R&D, following the earlier Japanese announcement. Agent-style systems are moving into industrial R&D workflows, but the public evidence remains at project-announcement stage. The event originated before the reporting window and no measured production or customer outcome is disclosed. This is context because the English weekly publication recaps a September origin and does not yet provide measured industrial results. Watch a named workflow, model architecture, evaluation baseline and deployed-user evidence.
title_zh: 英文发布回顾 Yokohama 与 dotData 的制造研发 AI agent 项目
what_happened_zh: Yokohama 的英文发布介绍了与 dotData 联合开发、旨在支持制造研发决策的 AI agent，此前双方已发布日文公告。Agent 类系统正进入工业研发工作流，但公开证据仍处于项目公告阶段。该事件源于报告期之前，且未披露可量化的生产或客户结果。本条作为背景信息保留，因为本周英文发布回顾的是 9月 的原始事件，仍未提供可量化的工业成果。后续应关注具体工作流、模型架构、评估基线和已部署用户证据。

title: CRIA publishes its October 5-11 upstream and downstream rubber price table
what_happened: The association released its weekly market-price information covering rubber-industry upstream and downstream products for October 5-11. An association-owned recurring price table provides a common checkpoint for testing cost-pass-through claims. The table is an industry reference and does not represent every company's contract price. Track subsequent weekly direction and alignment with listed-company procurement disclosures.
title_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会发布 10月5日–11日 上下游橡胶价格表
what_happened_zh: 中国橡胶工业协会发布了覆盖 10月5日–11日 橡胶行业上下游产品的周度市场价格信息。协会持续发布的价格表为检验成本传导主张提供了统一参照点。该表是行业参考，并不代表所有公司的合同价格。后续应跟踪此后各周的价格方向，以及其与上市公司采购披露的一致性。

title: wdk estimates 84,000 tonnes of German end-of-life tires had unknown destinations
what_happened: wdk reported that about 84,000 tonnes of end-of-life tires from the prior year had an unknown destination, while arguing for systematic recording of tire arisings and recovery routes. Circular-material supply is constrained not only by processing technology but by incomplete collection and chain-of-custody data. The unknown-destination estimate does not prove illegal export or a specific disposal route. Watch official tracking measures, audited flows and recycler feedstock availability.
title_zh: wdk 估计德国有 84,000 tonnes 废旧轮胎去向不明
what_happened_zh: wdk 报告称，上年度约有 84,000 tonnes 废旧轮胎去向不明，并主张系统记录轮胎产生量及回收路径。循环材料供应不仅受处理技术限制，也受到收集和监管链数据不完整的制约。去向不明的估计并不能证明非法出口或特定处置路径。后续应关注官方追踪措施、经审计的流向和回收企业原料可获得性。

title: Aliapur and Infiniteria sign a feedstock MOU for two planned French pyrolysis plants
what_happened: Aliapur and Infiniteria Europe signed a memorandum covering long-term used-tire supply for two planned French pyrolysis plants; sites are being preselected and environmental studies are part of the development process. Pyrolysis projects are trying to secure feedstock before final plant execution, addressing a recurring scale-up bottleneck. The agreement is a memorandum and neither plant is yet operating; volumes and economics are not disclosed. Watch site selection, permits, financing, binding supply contracts and commissioning.
title_zh: Aliapur 与 Infiniteria 为两座法国规划热解工厂签署原料 MOU
what_happened_zh: Aliapur 与 Infiniteria Europe 签署备忘录，为两座规划中的法国热解工厂提供长期废旧轮胎供应；项目正在预选场址，并把环境研究纳入开发过程。热解项目正尝试在最终执行前锁定原料，以解决反复出现的规模化瓶颈。该协议仅为备忘录，两座工厂均未投运；供应量和经济性也未披露。后续应关注场址确定、许可、融资、具有约束力的供应合同和投产。

title: VMI opens a Leon service facility to support Mexico's installed tire-equipment base
what_happened: VMI's October 12 release documented the October 8 opening of a 1,000-square-meter Leon service facility with a drum workshop, training, technical support and equipment maintenance for local customers. Tire-equipment suppliers are localizing after-sales capability alongside manufacturing investment in Mexico. The release establishes opening and service scope but provides no response-time baseline or customer-volume data. Watch service utilization, customer contracts and measurable response-time improvement.
title_zh: VMI 在 Leon 启用服务设施，支持墨西哥轮胎设备存量客户
what_happened_zh: VMI 于 10月12日 发布信息，记录其在 10月8日 启用一座 1,000-square-meter Leon 服务设施；该设施设有成型鼓车间，并为当地客户提供培训、技术支持和设备维护。随着墨西哥制造业投资增长，轮胎设备供应商正在本地化售后能力。该发布确认了设施启用和服务范围，但未提供响应时间基线或客户数量数据。后续应关注服务使用率、客户合同和可量化的响应时间改善。

title: Prinx Chengshan's green smart-factory pilot develops 13 manufacturing standards
what_happened: A Shandong authority reported that the national standards pilot begun in 2023 has formed 13 standards covering intelligent design, production and management for a green tire smart factory. Smart-factory programs are moving from equipment adoption toward codified operating standards. The authority reports standards output, not external adoption or measured plant performance gains. Watch standard publication, third-party assessment and uptake at other plants.
title_zh: 浦林成山绿色轮胎智能工厂试点形成 13 项制造标准
what_happened_zh: 山东主管部门称，2023 年启动的国家标准试点已形成 13 项标准，覆盖绿色轮胎智能工厂的智能设计、生产和管理。智能工厂项目正从设备采用转向运营标准的制度化。主管部门披露的是标准产出，并非外部采用情况或可量化的工厂绩效提升。后续应关注标准发布、第三方评估及其他工厂的采用情况。

title: Guizhou Tyre says Morocco smart-factory construction awaits overseas approvals
what_happened: In an investor-response disclosure, Guizhou Tyre said its planned Morocco smart factory for 6 million passenger tires a year had completed domestic approval procedures but had not started construction because overseas approvals were still in progress. Chinese overseas projects are separating domestic corporate approval from host-country execution readiness. The project is approved internally but remains pre-construction; design capacity is not operating capacity. Watch host-country permits, land, financing and a verified construction start.
title_zh: 贵州轮胎称摩洛哥智能工厂仍待境外审批，尚未开工
what_happened_zh: 贵州轮胎在投资者问答中表示，规划年产 6 million 条乘用车轮胎的摩洛哥智能工厂已完成境内审批，但因境外审批仍在进行，项目尚未开工。中国企业的海外项目正进一步区分境内公司审批与东道国执行准备度。该项目已获内部批准，但仍处于开工前阶段；设计产能不等于实际运行产能。后续应关注东道国许可、土地、融资以及经核实的开工信息。

title: Weekly sample adds a fresh utilization reading for Chinese tire factories
what_happened: The weekly dataset published updated capacity-utilization readings for sampled Chinese semi-steel and all-steel tire enterprises during a period of weak orders and rising inputs. Utilization needs to be read together with order and inventory direction rather than as a standalone capacity signal. The public summary is sample-based, and this item does not infer national output from the sampled reading. Watch next-week utilization, maintenance, inventories and new-order direction.
title_zh: 周度样本更新中国轮胎工厂产能利用率读数
what_happened_zh: 周度数据集更新了中国样本半钢和全钢轮胎企业在订单偏弱、投入成本上升时期的产能利用率。产能利用率需要与订单及库存方向一并解读，不能作为孤立的产能信号。公开摘要基于样本，本条信息不据此推断全国产量。后续应关注下一周产能利用率、检修、库存和新订单方向。

title: Linglong schedules an approximately 3% domestic TBR replacement-price increase
what_happened: A reproduced company notice said Linglong plans to raise prices by about 3% across domestic replacement-market TBR brands from November 1. Manufacturers are extending the fourth-quarter price cycle into November as material costs remain elevated. A company price letter shows intent, not transaction realization or dealer acceptance. Watch invoices, discounts, order pull-forward and post-effective-date demand.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎拟将国内替换市场全钢子午线轮胎价格上调约 3%
what_happened_zh: 转载的公司通知称，玲珑轮胎计划自 11月1日 起，将国内替换市场全钢子午线轮胎各品牌价格上调约 3%。随着材料成本维持高位，制造商正把第四季度涨价周期延续至 11月。公司价格函反映的是调价意向，并不代表实际成交价格或经销商接受程度。后续应关注发票价格、折扣、订单提前释放以及生效后的需求变化。

title: Tyres Europe joins a 44-organization call for faster EU trade defence
what_happened: Tyres Europe joined a 44-organization statement seeking more resources for EU trade-defence work and a new toolkit for state-driven distortions, noting that about 40% of the 398 million tires newly fitted in the EU in 2024 were made outside the bloc. Market-access policy is becoming a more prominent competitiveness lever for European tire manufacturing. This is an industry advocacy position, not an adopted law or Commission decision. Watch member-state response, Commission proposals and case-processing times.
title_zh: Tyres Europe 加入 44 家组织，呼吁加快 EU 贸易救济
what_happened_zh: Tyres Europe 加入 44 家组织的联合声明，要求为 EU 贸易救济工作投入更多资源，并建立应对国家驱动型扭曲的新工具；声明指出，2024 年 EU 新装配的 398 million 条轮胎中约 40% 在 EU 以外生产。市场准入政策正成为欧洲轮胎制造竞争力中更突出的杠杆。这是行业倡议立场，并非已经通过的法律或 Commission 决定。后续应关注成员国回应、Commission 提案和案件处理时长。

title: Longzhong analysis flags simultaneous pressure across China's semi-steel tire demand channels
what_happened: A market analysis described slower domestic passenger-vehicle production and sales alongside pressure in replacement and export channels, including European customs-registration friction. China's passenger-tire pressure is becoming multi-channel rather than isolated to one demand outlet. The analysis combines public indicators and market interpretation; it does not provide company-level shipment data. Watch vehicle output, exports, customs treatment, replacement sales and inventories.
title_zh: 隆众分析提示中国半钢轮胎多个需求渠道同步承压
what_happened_zh: 市场分析指出，国内乘用车产销放缓，同时替换和出口渠道也面临压力，其中包括欧洲海关登记摩擦。中国乘用车轮胎压力正从单一需求渠道扩展为多渠道压力。该分析结合公开指标和市场判断，未提供企业层面的出货数据。后续应关注汽车产量、出口、海关处理、替换市场销售和库存。

title: Linglong warns nine-month profit may fall more than 94% as costs and trade pressure bite
what_happened: Linglong's preliminary results forecast net profit attributable to shareholders of CNY62 million-CNY69 million for the first nine months, down 94.09%-94.69% year on year, citing foreign exchange, raw-material costs, trade barriers, freight and weaker domestic OE demand. Price actions are not yet fully offsetting input-cost, market-access and demand pressure in listed tire-company earnings. The release is a preliminary company estimate and not the final quarterly report. Watch audited results, realized pricing, product mix and the next cost outlook.
title_zh: 玲珑轮胎预警：成本与贸易压力拖累，前三季度利润或下降逾 94%
what_happened_zh: 玲珑轮胎业绩预告显示，前三季度归属于股东的净利润预计为 CNY62 million–CNY69 million，同比下降 94.09%-94.69%；公司提及汇率、原材料成本、贸易壁垒、运费以及国内原配需求走弱等因素。价格调整尚未完全抵消投入成本、市场准入和需求压力对上市轮胎企业盈利的影响。该公告是公司初步估算，并非最终季度报告。后续应关注审计结果、实际成交价格、产品组合及下一期成本展望。

title: Prinx Chengshan sets a 3% increase for all-steel and bias replacement tires
what_happened: A reproduced policy notice said Prinx Chengshan plans a 3% increase for all-steel radial and bias replacement-market products from October 28. The price cycle is spanning product types and multiple Shandong producers rather than remaining a single-brand move. The notice does not establish actual net prices or downstream acceptance. Watch invoice realization, dealer orders and competitive responses after October 28.
title_zh: 浦林成山拟将全钢子午线及斜交替换轮胎价格上调 3%
what_happened_zh: 转载的政策通知称，浦林成山计划自 10月28日 起，将全钢子午线及斜交替换市场产品价格上调 3%。本轮涨价已覆盖多类产品和多家山东制造商，不再只是单一品牌行动。该通知不能证明实际净价或下游接受程度。后续应关注 10月28日 之后的发票价格兑现、经销商订单和竞争对手反应。

title: Michelin's 75%-renewable-or-recycled-material exhibit tire clears Shanghai customs
what_happened: A People's Daily local report said a 75-kilogram Michelin tire containing 75% renewable or recycled materials arrived at Shanghai Pudong on October 13 as an airfreighted CIIE exhibit ahead of its Asian debut. Trade-show logistics are surfacing high-material-share tire prototypes to Chinese audiences. The accessible source is media reporting tied to customs clearance, and an in-window Michelin origin page was not recovered. Retained as context because the event is specific and material but the recovered weekly source is credible media rather than an original Michelin page. Watch the CIIE technical disclosure, material accounting and commercialization stage.
title_zh: 米其林含 75% 可再生或再生材料的展览轮胎在上海通关
what_happened_zh: 人民日报地方报道称，一条重 75-kilogram、含 75% 可再生或再生材料的米其林轮胎于 10月13日 空运抵达上海浦东并通关，将在 CIIE 上完成亚洲首秀。展会物流正把高材料占比轮胎原型带给中国受众。可访问来源是与海关通关相关的媒体报道，本报告期内未找到米其林原始页面。本条作为背景信息保留，因为事件具体且重要，但本周找回的来源是可信媒体，而非米其林原始页面。后续应关注 CIIE 技术披露、材料核算和商业化阶段。

title: Volvo approves Continental EcoContact 7 S for the electric EX60
what_happened: Continental announced original-equipment approval for the electric Volvo EX60 in 235/55 R20 front and 255/50 R20 rear sizes, both with an integrated rim protector. EV fitments continue to combine staggered sizing with application-specific sidewall protection. An OE approval establishes nomination and specification, not awarded volume or field durability. Watch vehicle production, fitted volumes and replacement homologations.
title_zh: Volvo 为纯电 EX60 批准大陆集团 EcoContact 7 S 原配轮胎
what_happened_zh: 大陆集团宣布，其 EcoContact 7 S 获得纯电 Volvo EX60 原配批准，前轮规格为 235/55 R20，后轮规格为 255/50 R20，均集成轮辋保护设计。电动车原配正在继续结合前后配规格与针对具体应用的胎侧保护。原配批准确认了提名和规格，但不代表获配数量或道路耐久性。后续应关注整车产量、实际装配量和替换市场认证。

title: Australian parliamentary inquiry tables recommendations for tire stewardship and recovery
what_happened: A House committee tabled its tire-industry inquiry report, addressing harmonized regulation, stewardship oversight, off-the-road tire recovery and support for retreading among its recommendations. End-of-life service systems are moving from voluntary program review toward a national policy agenda. Committee recommendations are not government implementation, funding or law. Watch the government response, regulatory timetable and stewardship audit actions.
title_zh: 澳大利亚议会调查提交轮胎责任管理与回收建议
what_happened_zh: 澳大利亚众议院委员会提交轮胎行业调查报告，建议内容包括统一监管、责任管理监督、非公路轮胎回收以及翻新支持。报废轮胎服务体系正从自愿项目审查转向国家政策议程。委员会建议不等于政府实施、资金安排或法律。后续应关注政府回应、监管时间表和责任管理审计行动。

title: Dunlop Geomax EN92 gains six-day enduro use in dusty and sandy conditions
what_happened: Dunlop reported that World Trophy and Club Team competitors selected Geomax EN92 tires and mousses during the six-day FIM Enduro of Nations in Portugal, with many using the scoop version for soft terrain. Competition use is adding severe-duty customer evidence to a newly updated off-road range. The company report does not disclose a controlled competitor comparison, failure rate or complete rider sample. Watch independent team feedback, wear and retail adoption.
title_zh: Dunlop Geomax EN92 在多尘与沙地条件下获得六日耐力赛应用
what_happened_zh: Dunlop 表示，在葡萄牙举行的六日 FIM Enduro of Nations 中，World Trophy 和 Club Team 车手选用了 Geomax EN92 轮胎及 mousse，许多车手在松软地形使用 scoop 版本。赛事应用正在为更新后的越野产品系列增加严苛工况客户证据。公司报告未披露受控竞品对比、失效率或完整车手样本。后续应关注独立车队反馈、磨耗和零售市场采用。
